jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewAt Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Solutions Engineering/Sales Engineering team partners with the Sales teams on new and existing customers. We paint the picture of how Theatro works, how its implemented into the customer environment and represent new "ideas" to the product team. We are the trusted advisor to customers and internal teams alike.


Job Description

Operating as a business‑technical advisor, the Solutions Engineer helps customers navigate intricate software choices by matching platform functionality with strategic goals and operational needs. This position facilitates critical technical discussions to define which challenges the software addresses, why particular architectures are necessary, and how the Theatro platform integrates seamlessly into current infrastructures.


Responsible for maintaining technical alignment and clarity, the Solutions Engineer serves as a reliable partner for both technical and business stakeholders. Their role is to understand the customer environment and asks. This knowledge helps drive our sales engagement and management plan.


Working alongside Account Executives, Account Managers, and internal departments, you are tasked with:

  • Translating customer obstacles into technical requirements
  • Assessing the feasibility and fit of proposed solutions
  • Advising customers on optimal architectural paths and usage strategies

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of direct customer engagement as a technical representative for the Sales team
  • 5+ years Technical Sales process knowledge
  • Ability to follow end to end customer engagement from introduction to delivery
  • Experience with SaaS and HaaS
  • Working knowledge of Wi-Fi and IP networking principles
  • Familiarity with APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) and common integration approaches

Location & Travel Requirements:

  • Ideal candidates will reside in North Texas
  • Travel will be up to 35% of the time.

Target Base Salary Range: $85,000 - $100,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.



Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree with 4+ years of sales, presales, solutions consulting experience
  • OR 6+ years of sales, presales, solutions consulting experience


Travel Requirements

Under 25%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

  • 401K with Company Match

  • 10 Paid Holidays

  • Generous Paid Time Off Packages

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Parental & Family Leave

  • and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

jobs.title: Entry Level Social Media Lead
jobs.excerpt: Knowt is a study app that around 8 million high schoolers use to get through AP classes, the SAT and ACT, finals, and college apps.
jobs.description:
Knowt is a study app that around 8 million high schoolers use to get through AP classes, the SAT and ACT, finals, and college apps. You'll be the lead behind Knowt's high school social presence, owning our TikTok and Instagram (@getknowt) end to end and turning them into a channel students actually find fun, relatable, and useful. You'll be a voice to the millions of students who already follow and see Knowt's daily posts.

We're looking for someone who deeply understands the daily reality of high school, AP courses, test prep, finals week, application season, and has a sharp instinct for what goes viral in that world. You'll turn that instinct into daily content that drives views, engagement, and website subscriptions.

The basics

  • Part-time or full-time depending on your availability. Minimum commitment is 10–15 hours/week.

  • Fully remote.

  • Base pay plus performance rewards tied to account growth.

  • You'll work directly with our marketing team, reporting to our Student Marketing Manager.

  • You'll be posting to an established account from day one, 476K followers, backed by a platform 8 million students use. You're not building from zero.

What You'll Do

Content Creation

  • Own the @getknowt TikTok and Instagram accounts day to day, posting daily for a high school audience.

  • Take content from idea to publish: hooks, scripts, filming, editing, and captions.

  • Speak directly to what high schoolers are dealing with, AP exams, the SAT and ACT, studying, test stress and make it feel relatable.

  • Turn Knowt's product into content students actually want to watch and use.

  • Make sure every post feels native to the platform and to high school culture.

Growth & Iteration

  • Constantly test hooks, formats, storytelling angles, and CTAs to find repeatable winning formulas.

  • Tie content to the high school calendar to catch students exactly when they need Knowt.

  • Turn platform trends, audience behavior, and performance data into new content concepts.

  • Iterate daily based on what the numbers show.

Performance & Reporting

  • Track and report on content performance with clear recommendations for what to scale, improve, or stop.

  • Measure success across views, watch time, interactions (saves, shares, comments), and signups.

What We're Looking For

You need

  • A real feel for what goes viral on TikTok and Instagram, and why.

  • Firsthand understanding of high school, AP classes, the SAT and ACT, and the pressure that comes with all of it.

  • Comfort taking a video from idea to posted.

  • A data-driven approach. Decisions off view and conversion metrics, not vibes.

Nice to have

  • Experience creating and growing short-form content, especially for edtech or exam-prep audiences.

  • Comfort on camera, or experience scripting for creators.

  • You've sat for AP exams, the SAT, or the ACT yourself.

Why This One's Worth It

  • You own the accounts. No approval chain on every post, no committee rewriting your hooks.

  • Real audience from day one. Growth on an account this size is a hard thing to point at later.

  • Small team, fast decisions. You'll work directly with our Student Marketing Manager, not through three layers.

  • Flexible hours, and room to grow the role if it's working.

How to Apply & What Happens Next

Apply through the link. If you look like a fit, the process is:

  1. Interview with our Marketing Manager

  2. Skills screen, a short practical exercise

  3. Final interview with the Marketing Manager and CMO

Overview

The Technical Sales Manager serves as a critical bridge between the Scientific and Commercial teams and plays a pivotal role within the BSB NA organisation. The position is directly responsible in conjunction with the regional account managers for delivering the overall Spatial Proteomics sales target for the region, working closely with each Regional Account Manager and engaging directly with customers, KOLs, and early adopters to advance and close opportunities from both a commercial and technical support‑ perspective.

This role is accountable for generating qualified opportunities, driving early market‑ activation, and accelerating adoption through strong scientific engagement across the NA spatial proteomics community. It blends deep scientific understanding with strong commercial acumen—connecting market needs, workflow insights, and customer relationships to promote BSB technologies, strengthen pipeline health, and support successful sales execution.

Responsibilities

Sales & Commercial Alignment

  • Own the overall Spatial Proteomics sales target for NA, partnering closely with individual Regional Account Managers to identify, progress, and convert high quality‑ opportunities through to closure.
  • Provide advanced technical guidance, scientific insight, and presales support to accelerate deals and resolve customer objections.
  • Contribute to regional commercial planning and help drive successful commercial execution across the region.

Market & Customer Development

  • Understand key scientific and commercial drivers across Academic and Industrial markets, including emerging research and technology trends.
  • Identify new customer opportunities through onsite visits, conference presence, virtual engagement, and targeted outreach.
  • Build and maintain strong networks of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) within priority geographies to support growth and market penetration.

KOL Network & Relationship Building

  • Map scientific and commercial networks, identifying influential KOLs and establishing long term, ‑trust-based‑ relationships.
  • Engage KOLs to support early-stage opportunity creation, ‑thought leadership‑ development, and deal progression.

Market Education & Early Adopter Engagement

  • Deliver scientific seminars, technical workshops, and educational presentations promoting BSB Spatial Proteomics ( GeoMx, Cellscape XR) technologies across the region.
  • Engage early adopters to demonstrate workflows, validate applications, and accelerate product adoption.
  • Leverage global content, assets, and marketing campaigns to drive local market activation and awareness.

Sales Enablement

  • Work closely with Regional Sales Executives and FAS teams to deliver presales demonstrations, seminars, and KOL f‑ocused meetings.
  • Provide scientific support at conferences, key customer meetings, territory planning sessions, and opportunity assessments.

Marketing, Collaboration & Content Development

  • Partner with Regional Marketing to create targeted social media and scientific‑community content aligned to market priorities and KOL networks.
  • Collaborate with Academic Collaboration teams to identify, support, and advance high impact‑ scientific partnerships.
  • Work with Marketing Application Support and Product Management to create compelling scientific messaging and technical content.

Market Intelligence & Strategy

  • Attend key NA conferences to identify opportunities, develop relationships, and gather competitive and market intelligence.
  • Stay current on scientific developments through research, customer dialogue, and active participation in scientific events.
  • Provide accurate Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback and early market insights to Product Management and Segment Marketing.
  • Identify emerging market drivers, quantify new opportunities, and communicate competitive dynamics to regional and global teams.

Travel

50–70% travel for customer interactions, seminars, KOL meetings, and industry events.

Qualifications

Qualifications (Required)

  • PhD in Biology or a closely related field.
  • Experience antibody-based protein assays an advantage
  • Proven track record in Spatial Proteomics, including practical experience with proteomics workflows, applications, and scientific customer engagement.
  • Deep understanding of the requirements of multi omics spatial biology and mass spectrometry as they pertain to modern proteomics research and technology adoption.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex scientific concepts in a commercially compelling and customer focused‑ manner.
  • Demonstrated experience building strong relationships with scientists, KOLs, and early adopters.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across a multi country territory and operate‑ autonomously.

At Bruker, base salary is part of our total compensation. The base salary for the role will depend on a several job-related factors, including, but not limited to education, training, experience, the geographic location of the successful candidate, skills, competencies, job-related knowledge and travel requirements for this position. Position Purpose: The Manager, Firewall Infrastructure Engineering is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery execution, workforce management, and capability advancement of the Firewall Infrastructure Engineering function.


This leader ensures the enterprise firewall ecosystem remains reliable, scalable, secure, measurable, and aligned to business and cybersecurity objectives. The role manages the engineering team responsible for firewall infrastructure, hardware lifecycle management, software currency, platform capacity, operational support, monitoring, resiliency, and continuous improvement initiatives.


The Manager, Firewall Security Engineering is accountable for the operational health, supportability, lifecycle management, and scalability of the firewall ecosystem. The role does not own firewall policy governance, firewall rule implementation, or security architecture decisions except where infrastructure requirements affect platform availability, performance, or supportability.


Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.


Team Leadership:

  • Lead a team of firewall infrastructure engineers.
  • Establish priorities, sprint objectives, and operational work plans.
  • Conduct performance management, career development, coaching, and mentoring.
  • Develop succession plans and reduce key-person dependency risks.
  • Build a sustainable operating model that distributes ownership across the team.

Operational Accountability:

  • Ensure reliable operation of enterprise firewall infrastructure and supporting services.
  • Maintain operational readiness, support models, escalation paths, and runbooks.
  • Manage engineering backlogs and technical debt initiatives.
  • Monitor platform health, performance, availability, and operational metrics.
  • Drive consistent execution of firewall engineering processes and standards.
  • Ensure operational support requirements are maintained across all firewall platforms.

Capability Management:

  • Advance firewall infrastructure capabilities across resiliency, scalability, observability, and automation.
  • Partner with Capability Stewards to develop multi-year technology and lifecycle roadmaps.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on risk reduction, operational efficiency, capacity requirements, and business value.
  • Ensure new capabilities transition successfully into production operations.

Firewall Infrastructure Ownership:

Provide operational leadership for technologies and capabilities including:

  • Enterprise Firewall Platforms.
  • Firewall Hardware Lifecycle Management.
  • Firewall Software and Code Upgrades.
  • Capacity Planning and Resource Forecasting.
  • High Availability and Resiliency Architecture.

Lifecycle and Capacity Management:

  • Forecast platform growth and future capacity requirements.
  • Establish capacity thresholds and expansion triggers.
  • Ensure infrastructure investments are aligned with future business demand.
  • Track capacity utilization and provide executive reporting on lifecycle and expansion requirements.

Program and Project Execution:

  • Lead execution of firewall infrastructure projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate resources, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
  • Partner with architecture, network engineering, cloud engineering, security operations, and infrastructure teams.

Governance and Risk Management:

  • Escalate issues requiring risk acceptance or executive decisions.
  • Support audit, compliance, and control validation activities.
  • Maintain documented standards, procedures, and engineering practices.

Vendor and Service Provider Management:

  • Hold vendors accountable to contracted deliverables and service-level commitments.
  • Review support effectiveness, hardware roadmaps, and maintenance requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement through vendor partnerships.
  • Participate in platform selection, renewal, and lifecycle planning activities.

Education/Experience: Requires a Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Required Leadership Competencies:

Soft Skills:

jobs.excerpt: About the Organization As headquarters for the YouthBuild movement, YouthBuild Global unifies and partners with an expansive network of YouthBuild programs around the world, championing opportunity youth as they achieve their ambitions and reach their full potential.
jobs.description:
About the Organization

As headquarters for the YouthBuild movement, YouthBuild Global unifies and partners with an expansive network of YouthBuild programs around the world, championing opportunity youth as they achieve their ambitions and reach their full potential. In YouthBuild programs, young people who are out of school and out of work reclaim their education, gain job skills and credentials, and become leaders in their communities. From training, technical assistance, capacity building, and innovative program enhancements to leadership development, financial stability, and narrative change and public policy, YouthBuild Global serves as a convener, collaborator, and catalyst for the entire YouthBuild movement.

For more information about YouthBuild Global and the YouthBuild movement, visit .

Job Summary

YouthBuild Global proudly partners with companies and nonprofit organizations to train, educate, mentor, and hire students and alumni from local YouthBuild programs. Our partners provide YouthBuild students and graduates with essential technical know-how, skills training, access to networks, internship and job opportunities, resources, and inspiration. Through these collaborations, our partners often gain access to a pipeline of talent, industry experts and innovations, and positive employee and customer engagement. In this role, the Manager supports the stewardship of new and existing partnerships in the US and internationally specific to manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and warehousing. The Manager will also supervise a direct report, the Strategic Partnerships Associate, who will steward partner relationships across workplace industries including hospitality, healthcare, and technology, as well as non-revenue generating partnerships with workforce training and education providers. Working with the Strategic Partnerships team and cross-functional colleagues, the Manager helps coordinate partner engagement, affiliate YouthBuild program support, technical assistance, data tracking, career pathway implementation, and team supervision so YouthBuild programs can connect students and graduates to quality training and employment opportunities. The YouthBuild team operates across seven countries including the US and multiple initiatives, and is dedicated to linking YouthBuild graduates to livelihood opportunities in the rapidly changing labor market of the 21st century.

This individual can be located remotely from the following States: MA or remote in ME, NH, MI, NY, DC, MD, SC, GA, FL, TX, CA, WA, WI. The Manager will be expected to travel occasionally to YouthBuild Global’s Roxbury, MA headquarters and to other locations. The majority of work will be performed remotely in support of the global YouthBuild network.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

Duties for this position will include but are not limited to the following. Duties are aligned with YouthBuild Global standards and goals.

Technical Assistance/Career Pathway Development 55%

  • Support the launch and implementation of manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and warehousing partnerships by coordinating with YouthBuild Global departments, helping connect partners with existing training and career development initiatives, and assisting with communication between affiliates and partners.
  • Collaborate with YouthBuild affiliate staff as they engage with national and regional corporate partners, including supporting meetings, monitoring engagement activities, tracking data, and providing responsive technical assistance.
  • Help create, refine, and share tools and resources such as guides, training materials, partner briefs, and fundraising materials related to manufacturing and logistics partnerships.
  • Coordinate with Network Engagement and international program staff to support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of relevant industry partnerships at affiliate programs.
  • Maintain tools and systems for gathering student placement and opportunity information; recommend improvements to trackers as needed; review and summarize results for internal and external use.
  • Work with YouthBuild program staff to compile and review program and participant data, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and contribute to timely impact reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate or co-facilitate industry sector training sessions with YouthBuild programs on topics such as engaging employers, understanding trade associations, and identifying relevant industry credentials.

Partnership Development 45%

  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for established and emerging domestic and international corporate and employment partners in the manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and warehousing industries.
  • Research potential new partners, support outreach and follow-up, and help develop plans to introduce appropriate partners to the YouthBuild network in collaboration with other YouthBuild Global teams.
  • Maintain working relationships with relevant industry partners, including trade associations, unions, government agencies, educational organizations, advocacy groups, and others.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to coordinate partner activity that supports YouthBuild Global’s strategic objectives, including program design improvements, pre-apprenticeship and apprenticeship pathways, equitable workforce systems, and Development priorities where appropriate.
  • Supervise the Strategic Partnerships Associate, providing guidance, prioritization, and support as the Associate stewards partner relationships across workplace industries including hospitality, healthcare, and technology, as well as non-revenue generating partnerships with workforce training and education providers.

Other Duties/Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Development, Marketing and Communications and Network Engagement Departments to maximize and publicize partnership successes, opportunities, stories, results, best practices, etc. to internal and external audiences.
  • Travel to industry-relevant conferences, partner meetings, program visits, or other events up to 25% of the time
  • Serve on self-selected internal YouthBuild Global committees and cross-departmental project teams.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Education & Experience Required

The ideal candidate will have the following experience and align with YouthBuild’s mission, vision, values.

  • A strong desire to provide a positive social impact for opportunity youth by working with employers to grow available and family sustaining career opportunities.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting partnership management, employer engagement, business development, workforce development, or a similar function; bachelor's degree and a minimum of three years' relevant experience preferred, or equivalent. Work experience may substitute for formal education.
  • Experience working with nonprofit organizations is strongly preferred; familiarity with corporate social responsibility programs, employer-nonprofit partnerships, or nonprofit service delivery is helpful.
  • Work experience and/or industry knowledge in the manufacturing and/or logistics sector.
  • Working knowledge of workforce and talent ecosystems at local, state, national, or international levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively to achieve aligned goals and objectives
  • Experience coordinating projects and program activities across departments, sites, or stakeholder groups without direct reporting authority.

Skills & Knowledge Required

  • Exercises good judgment, works well with a team, and has knowledge of the manufacturing and logistics industries
  • Experience supporting workforce development technical assistance, training, or partner implementation with a range of stakeholders.
  • Communicates clearly across diverse professional settings with a wide range of stakeholders and audiences.
  • Adaptive and organized, with the ability to respond to unplanned variables while keeping projects moving forward.
  • Strong relationship management, problem-solving, presentation, verbal communication, and business writing skills.
  • Sound business acumen and ability to convey information professionally to a variety of stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial, resourceful, and committed to YouthBuild’s mission and the YouthBuild movement;
  • Technical skills including MS Office Suite software, Salesforce database management, project tracking, and basic budget monitoring.

Physical Effort Required

Candidates should be able to travel, up to 25%of the time, and infrequently be able to push, pull, and carry items weighing < 25 lbs.

Benefits

Non-Discrimination Statement

YouthBuild Global provides equal employment opportunity to all persons regardless of age, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities.

This is a Grade 3 position with a salary range of $70,000–$75,000. We are committed to attracting world-class talent by offering a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • A 401(k) plan with an employer match
  • Generous paid holidays
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for well-being support

Join our team and contribute to meaningful, mission-driven work in a supportive and inclusive environment. This role is eligible for working in person/Hybrid in Roxbury, MA or remotely in MA, ME, NH, NY, DC, MD, NC, SC, GA, FL, WI, CA, TX.

jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Philippines.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1000 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

  • Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

  • Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

  • Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

  • Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

  • Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
  • A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
  • Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
  • Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
  • Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
  • Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

In this role, you will help train and refine Grok's voice and language capabilities in Amharic. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Senior Electrical Estimator
Location: Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate (must reside in the U.S.). Otherwise, hybrid office locations include: Hebron, KY / Cincinnati, OH; Nashville, TN; Denver, CO area; Indianapolis, IN.
Salary Range: $140,000–$165,000, depending on experience. Bonus opportunities.


Company Overview

Would you enjoy being involved in executing large-scale, complex infrastructure projects?

Connico is a national construction consultancy known for its experienced team and commitment to exceptional client service. With deep experience in aviation and complex infrastructure, we are continuing to expand our work across energy, federal, and defense markets.

Our work is technical, but how we do the work matters just as much as the quality of what we deliver. Our core values of Respect, Integrity, Innovation, Resiliency, Inclusivity, and Thoughtfulness guide how we work with our clients and with one another.

The Role

As a Senior Electrical Estimator, you will lead complex electrical cost estimating efforts from early conceptual planning through final construction documents. You will use your technical experience and judgment to develop accurate estimates, identify scope gaps and risks, reconcile costs, and help clients make informed decisions, even when project information is limited or evolving.

This is a hands-on senior technical role. You will independently develop and review estimates while also helping strengthen Connico's electrical estimating practice through mentoring, quality control, knowledge sharing, and the development of repeatable estimating practices.

You will work across disciplines and directly with clients, project teams, contractors, designers, and other estimators on complex infrastructure projects.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and independently develop electrical cost estimates across all design stages, from conceptual and Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimates through final construction documents, including Level 1–5 estimates for projects of varying size and complexity.
  • Develop detailed material and labor estimates for electrical systems including Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, Communications, Audio-Visual, Security, Video Surveillance, and Fire Alarm systems. Research and develop unit pricing, cost assemblies, and supporting assumptions using current market information and sound estimating judgment.
  • Think beyond the plans and specifications. Identify missing information, scope gaps, inconsistencies, interdisciplinary conflicts, and potential cost risks. Develop well-supported assumptions and solutions when complete project information is not available.
  • Lead estimate reconciliations, technical and quality-control reviews, contractor bid analyses, value engineering assessments, life-cycle and benefit-cost analyses, and coordination across disciplines to produce comprehensive and defensible estimates.
  • Manage multiple complex estimating assignments and priorities while maintaining accuracy, meeting deadlines, and helping project teams deliver high-quality work that reflects Connico's standards and core values.
  • Mentor and train developing estimators in conceptual estimating, quantity takeoffs, cost buildups, reconciliations, technical reviews, interdisciplinary plan analysis, reporting, and Connico estimating practices. Help create training resources and repeatable best practices that strengthen the broader team.
  • Take ownership of estimating data, cost assemblies, templates, and reporting practices by helping maintain accurate, current, consistent, and accessible information that supports repeatable results.
  • Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted technical advisor through clear communication, sound judgment, reliability, and expert guidance. Participate in client meetings, project site visits, and industry events as needed.
What You'll Bring
  • 10+ years of full-time, hands-on electrical estimating experience.
  • A Journeyman Electrician License, Master Electrician License, Electrical Engineering degree, or equivalent combination of electrical knowledge and experience.
  • An industry-recognized professional certification, license, or advanced credential, such as CCP, CPE, PCSE, CEP, CCE, PE, or another relevant advanced credential.
  • Proven ability to independently develop high-quality electrical estimates across Levels 1–5 and all stages of design, including conceptual and ROM estimates developed with limited information.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex estimating assignments, integrating estimate elements across multiple disciplines, meeting deadlines, maintaining quality, and communicating professionally with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to interpret architectural, civil, electrical, and other engineering drawings and specifications across all levels of design.
  • Expertise with electrical estimating or takeoff software such as IntelliBid, Accubid, On-Screen Takeoff, MII, MCACES, or comparable systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Teams, Outlook, and Word.
Preferred Experience
  • Electrical estimating experience supporting aviation or airport projects is highly preferred.
  • Experience with other large-scale or complex project environments, including federal government, Department of Defense or military facilities, energy and utilities, transportation and infrastructure, industrial, mission-critical, or similar technically complex work, is valuable.

Work Location Options
Hybrid (T/W/TH in-office):

  • Hebron, KY (Cincinnati area)
  • Mt. Juliet, TN (Nashville area)
  • Denver, CO
  • Indianapolis, IN

Fully Remote:

  • Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate. Must reside full-time in the U.S.
  • Minimal travel required, up to 10% (site visits, meetings, conferences)

Why Join Connico?

This is an opportunity to do more than produce estimates. You will help solve complex cost challenges, influence the quality of major infrastructure projects, strengthen estimating practices, and develop the next generation of Connico estimators.

As Connico continues to grow beyond its established aviation and infrastructure work into energy, federal, and defense markets, you will also have the opportunity to apply your expertise across an expanding range of complex projects.

We value people who take ownership, bring solutions, share their expertise, challenge thinking thoughtfully, and build trust with clients and teammates. At the Senior level, you will be expected not only to demonstrate technical excellence, but also to help strengthen the people and practice around you.

If you are an experienced electrical estimator who combines strong technical expertise with sound judgment, leadership, and a commitment to quality, we would like to hear from you!

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

Consensus leads the industry in data exchange solutions and we’re only getting started! With exciting new initiatives on the horizon, we are continuing our strategic expansion and we are looking to add to our diverse team of innovators.

Now is the ideal time to join us in our mission to solve healthcare’s biggest challenges, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of like-minded self-starters and partners to accomplish it.

Consensus Cloud Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We offer many remote and hybrid career opportunities.

How you will impact the organization…

The organization is seeking a pragmatic developer who understands that the landscape of software engineering is shifting. The purpose of this role is to balance leveraging AI for rapid, intuitive "Vibe Coding" with the technical discipline of "Spec-Driven Development" to build superior products. This individual must know how to utilize LLMs for creative exploration while pinning down maintainability through strict technical specifications.

The value you will deliver…

  • Code Quality Control: Act as the final auditor for all AI-assisted contributions to ensure they meet internal standards and security protocols.

What you will bring to the table…

  • 7+ years of professional full-stack development experience.

  • Full-Stack Architecture: Strong grasp of CS fundamentals, including system design, API architecture, and database management (SQL/NoSQL).

Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

This role applies generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) to analyze financial information, reconcile financial statements, prepare general and standard journal entries, assist in budget development, and prepare standard accounting and financial reports for management.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Compiles and analyzes financial information in preparation for entry into various financial statements and accounting reports, and makes appropriate journal entries for recording in the general ledger by checking calculations, reviewing basis for figures, and balancing and reconciling figures.

jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Plant Process Simulation Engineer to join our engineering team. We are looking to fill this position immediately.

Position Description

Oklo is looking for an experienced process simulation engineer to be responsible for the development and ownership of the plant process simulation model for the Aurora power plant to inform design, operations, and plant dynamics.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Generate and own a plant process simulation model in AVEVA Process Simulation, ASPEN/HYSYS, Siemens Flomaster, or similar tool, that models and creates both transient and steady state plant performance results.
  • Iteratively model existing and future plant equipment and maintain the model as new design parameters and drawings are produced.
  • Establish automated plant model development to accelerate design decision making and inform plant economics and operations.
  • Use equipment specifications and performance results to generate and implement detailed equipment component models.
  • Work in cross disciplinary teams, including process engineering, instrumentation and control, power generation and distribution teams.
  • Generate technical documentation and reports to be included in regulatory filings and internal/external technical reports showing plant and equipment performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in chemical, mechanical, nuclear, aerospace engineering or related engineering discipline
  • At least 5 years of experience in the development or modeling of plant processes in the power generation, petroleum, chemical, or other similar industries
  • Broad familiarity with engineering principles, with strong systems engineering and operations intuition
  • Strong knowledge of plant thermodynamic cycle and process fluid modeling at an equipment and plant-level

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with building power conversion system process simulation models
  • Experience with designing process systems in power or chemical industries

Competencies

We are looking for a Plant Process Simulation Engineer that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • Able to communicate technical content and results both verbally and in writing

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $115,000 - $150,000 base salary, performance incentives, and equity.

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

The Compliance Administrator at Ampacity keeps the company audit-ready year-round. You own the day-to-day work behind SOC reporting, PII and data privacy controls, NetSuite access governance, and IT general controls (ITGC): collecting evidence, tracking requests, and making sure controls operate as documented.

This is a 100% remote role.Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000 + Discretionary Bonus + Benefits

What You'll Do

SOC Compliance (SOC 1 / SOC 2)

PII and Data Privacy

NetSuite Access Governance

ITGC Requests and Evidence

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain the central repository of policies, procedures, and audit artifacts, and update them on a regular schedule

  • Hands-on with roles, permissions, and user administration in NetSuite or a comparable ERP
  • Able to manage many requests and deadlines at once, and comfortable working in Excel and tracking tools

About Parexel


Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Clinical Data Associate to join our team in South Africa in a remote capacity.


As a Senior Clinical Data Associate, you will support global clinical research programs by delivering high-quality data management activities across Phase I-IV clinical studies. This position plays a key role in clinical data quality, regulatory compliance, study execution, and cross-functional collaboration.


You will partner with clinical teams, statisticians, programmers, CRAs, vendors, and study management teams to ensure accurate and timely data collection, review, reconciliation, and database management activities. Responsibilities include supporting and leading data management activities, coordinating Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, developing study documentation, and contributing to database lock and study deliverables.


You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment dedicated to a single sponsor and supporting important commercial and development programs worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to clinical research that advances new therapies while expanding your expertise across data management processes, clinical technologies, and cross-functional study operations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead a small clinical study or co-lead larger studies with moderate guidance.
  • Support multiple clinical studies while ensuring high standards of data quality and delivery.
  • Manage and monitor data management activities performed by CROs and external vendors.
  • Review study protocols and evaluate data capture requirements, including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.
  • Collaborate with CRAs, programmers, study managers, and statisticians to develop annotated eCRFs and CRF completion guidelines.
  • Develop data edit check specifications and generate study data listings as required.
  • Coordinate the design, testing, and issue resolution of Electronic Data Capture systems in accordance with company standards.
  • Develop and maintain study Data Management Plans and supporting documentation
  • Perform query management, external data reconciliations, and Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities.
  • Support database upgrades, migrations, user acceptance testing, database freeze activities, and database lock activities.
  • Maintain study workbooks and data management files while ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of data management SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation.

Candidate Profile


You'll thrive in this role if you bring:


  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.
  • Experience working within clinical research and regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams as well as with external partners and vendors.
  • A patient-focused mindset with a commitment to data quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Comfort working with Electronic Data Capture systems, clinical databases, and multiple technology platforms.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's Degree in a scientific or healthcare-related field.

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.

Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.

Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.

  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required.

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements

Adastra is seeking a Lead SAS/Python Developer to support a large-scale modernization initiative focused on migrating legacy SAS-based workloads to Anaconda/Python. In this role, you will provide technical leadership for SAS decommissioning and migration activities, while remaining hands-on in application migration, automation development, governance activities, and modernization of analytical processes. You will work across technical and business teams to lead the migration or retirement of active SAS workloads, establish development standards, guide technical implementation, and ensure the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of analytical solutions.

Primary Location: Across Canada or USA (must be able to work Central (CST) hours)

Work Model: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Contractor or Full-Time

Vacancy Status: New

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide technical leadership and hands-on development throughout SAS-to-Python migration and modernization initiatives
  • Analyze complex business and technical requirements to design scalable solutions and define technical approaches
  • Lead the interpretation and migration of SAS programs, datasets, and processes to Python-based environments
  • Develop, test, and maintain high-quality Python applications and scripts
  • Build and support Unix-based automation and data processing pipelines
  • Establish and promote development standards, coding best practices, and reusable patterns across the team
  • Conduct code and technical design reviews and provide guidance to developers
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and migration challenges and drive solutions through to resolution
  • Maintain technical documentation and source code repositories using Git
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, infrastructure teams, and other technical partners to deliver migration and modernization objectives
  • Act as a technical point of contact for development and migration activities, supporting technical decision-making across the initiative

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Senior/Lead-level software development experience, including demonstrated experience providing technical leadership within complex development or modernization initiatives
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Python, including Anaconda, as well as SQL and SAS
  • Strong ability to understand, interpret, and modernize complex SAS programs and workflows
  • Experience with relational databases, including Netezza and Redshift
  • Strong Linux/Unix scripting experience
  • Experience with CRON scheduling and automation
  • Strong experience with unit testing, debugging, code optimization, and performance tuning
  • Experience conducting code reviews, establishing development standards, and guiding other developers on technical implementation
  • Ability to own technical solutions from requirements and design through development, testing, and implementation
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams
  • Commitment to code quality, accuracy, maintainability, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to work within CST hours is preferred

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity with GitHub and GitHub Copilot
  • Working knowledge of SAS Enterprise Guide
  • Working knowledge of JupyterHub
  • Previous experience leading or supporting large-scale SAS-to-Python migration or SAS decommissioning initiatives
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical direction to development teams

ABOUT ADASTRA

Adastra is a global leader in AI and data-driven transformation, helping organizations lead with artificial intelligence—responsibly, strategically, and at scale. With over 25 years of experience, Adastra empowers enterprise clients to unlock business value through data innovation, operational excellence, and smart customer engagement.

Trusted by some of the world’s most prominent brands, Adastra delivers end-to-end solutions grounded in thoughtful strategy, robust governance, and deep technical expertise. From defining vision to ensuring execution, Adastra guides organizations through every stage of their AI, data and cloud journey—building future-ready capabilities and delivering measurable, lasting impact.

Adastra serves clients across key industries including financial services, automotive, manufacturing, technology, media and telecom (TMT), healthcare, retail, and professional services. The company employs more than 2,000 professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Opportunity for advancement and career progression
  • Competitive compensation
  • Successful referral program
  • The opportunity to work with one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies
  • Satisfaction of working for a reputable company
  • A flexible, dynamic, and diverse workplace

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

In our commitment to promote fair and equitable treatment of all employees and applicants, Adastra Corporation provides equal employment opportunities for all individuals regardless of age, sex, disability, race, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other ground as described in the Ontario Human Rights Code. PeopleSoft Technical Consultant- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PeopleSoft Technical Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft Technical Developer to design, develop, and support customizations, integrations, and enhancements for enterprise PeopleSoft applications including HCM, FSCM, and Campus Solutions. In this role you will own the technical implementation of business requirements, partner closely with functional consultants, and ensure that all custom developments meet enterprise standards for quality, security, and maintainability. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on experience with PeopleTools development, Application Engine, Component Interfaces, and Integration Broker with a strong understanding of PeopleSoft architecture, upgrades, and clean-customization principles.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop PeopleSoft customizations using Application Designer, including pages, components, records, fields, and PeopleCode.
  • Build Application Engine programs for batch processing, data conversion, and ETL-style workloads.
  • Develop Component Interfaces, Integration Broker services, and File Layouts to integrate PeopleSoft with internal and external systems.
  • Build SQR and BI Publisher reports, including performance tuning and complex layout design.
  • Implement and maintain PeopleSoft Approval Workflow Engine (AWE) configurations and notifications.
  • Develop nVision reports for financial reporting requirements where applicable, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Conduct fit-gap analysis with functional consultants and translate requirements into clean technical designs.
  • Adhere to enterprise customization standards and minimize core modifications to ease future PeopleSoft upgrades.
  • Lead unit testing, support functional and integration testing, and resolve defects during UAT and hypercare.
  • Optimize SQL performance against PeopleSoft data models using explain plans, indexing, and statistics tuning.
  • Document technical designs, code, and operational procedures in line with enterprise PeopleSoft governance.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Mentor junior PeopleSoft developers and act as a technical reference.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PeopleSoft technical development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PeopleTools, Application Designer, and PeopleCode.
  • Solid experience with Application Engine, Component Interfaces, and Integration Broker.
  • Hands-on experience with SQR and BI Publisher.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with the PeopleSoft data model.
  • Familiarity with PeopleSoft HCM, FSCM, or Campus Solutions data structures.
  • Experience supporting PeopleSoft upgrades and patches.
  • Working knowledge of Approval Workflow Engine (AWE).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PeopleSoft certifications.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud HCM/ERP integration scenarios.
  • Exposure to Fluid UI development.
  • Familiarity with Oracle DBA fundamentals.
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for PeopleSoft integrations.

jobs.description:
Who we are

At Fluxon, we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Open AI, Anthropic, Stripe, Walmart and Google.

Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do.

Inside Fluxon, you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

Note: This position is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in Lithuania.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer at Fluxon, you'll lead design end-to-end on ambitious projects, often working directly with founders and product leads to shape what gets built. We are looking for design generalists, someone who owns the design surface, thrives in ambiguity, and cares as much about why something gets built as how it ships.

While specific responsibilities may differ from project to project, you will:

  • Partner with founders, product leads, and other stakeholders to turn business goals into experiences customers love
  • Lead design end-to-end, from discovery and research through interaction design and production-ready execution, calling the right level of depth for each project
  • Make the right call when user needs, technical constraints, and business goals pull in different directions
  • Collaborate closely with clients, PMs, and engineers to set the direction and ship high quality work
  • Bring a point of view on craft, process, and where the field is going, while staying current with new technologies and design trends

Qualifications

  • Experience leading product design end-to-end, from strategy through to production ready execution, delivering work that customers love and drives business results
  • Strong judgment and ability on process, knowing when to go deep on research and when to move fast
  • Strong UX foundations across the full discovery and design process, from research through interaction design, user testing and accessibility
  • Strong visual craft across layout, typography, iconography, color, and motion, with the ability to take work to a polished, production ready bar
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills across written, visual, and spoken formats, with experience presenting directly to clients
  • Comfortable collaborating closely with clients, PMs, and engineers, including managing expectations, navigating disagreement, and keeping the work aligned
  • Experience shipping with startups or founding teams, comfortable building from zero without established design foundations or process
  • Experience working with US clients (European clients a plus)

A note on applications - A portfolio is a required part of your application. We treat it as a critical element of the review process, and it must be included in your submission.

What we offer

  • Remote-first, flexible work with a budget to set up a work space that works for you
  • Localized healthcare coverage to support you and your family’s wellbeing
  • Flexible paid time off with a minimum of 3 weeks per year (plus holidays)
  • "No internal meetings" on Fridays, so you can focus on deep, uninterrupted work
  • A professional growth budget for learning that matters to you – whether it’s developing your technical skills or learning a new language
  • A monthly wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health
  • Annual company offsites, where we gather in person to build meaningful connections
  • A competitive salary that reflects your expertise, impact and experience
  • Profit-sharing, so you can benefit directly from the value we build together
  • A paid sabbatical program, designed for rest, renewal and fresh perspective

We believe diverse teams perform better, and an inclusive environment is essential to building a successful organisation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process.

This role may use AI-assisted tools to support initial screening. All assessments and decisions are made by a human reviewer.
