jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY: The Senior Application Programmer Analyst is responsible for developing, configuring, coding, testing, and debugging complex new software, enhancements to existing proprietary software or purchased software packages. In conjunction with functional users and IT Business Systems team, the incumbent assists with the design and documentation of the company’s application software environment, regularly provides guidance and training to less experience’s programmer/analysts and is responsible for leading application development projects of high complexity.


PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepare detailed technical specifications, designs, or user stories from which programs will be written or configured.
  • Write high-quality code according to provided requirements.
  • Address system defects and implements enhancements to existing functionality
  • Troubleshoot issues with minimal guidance, identifying bottlenecks in existing data workflows and providing solutions for a scalable, defect-free application.
  • Participate in the definition of application scope and objectives through research and fact finding.
  • Provide escalated support and resolution of open IT issues escalated by IT Customer Support.
  • Perform code reviews and all necessary follow-up actions.
  • Follow all required Company policies and practices relating to the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Maintain vendor relationships to resolve problems and coordinate the delivery of IT products and services.
  • Attend and participate in all Agile ceremonies.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned or apparent.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Java, Java Script, Angular and other object-oriented languages.
  • Demonstrated experience working with team using Agile methodologies and ceremonies like Daily Stand-ups, Planning, Retro, Sprint Reviews, etc.
  • Experience working with FTP, FTP encryption and secure FTP Communications.
  • Working with complex systems integrated with multiple Hybrid applications (Oracle, Salesforce, AWS, etc.)
  • Experienced at Analysis tools (X-Analysis, Hawkeye, Abstract, etc.).
  • Familiar with tuning complex queries using Visual Explain and other IBM tools to improve performance.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • 7 - 10 years working with programs using static and dynamic SQL, Data Queues, Journals, Journal Receivers, Triggers, Functions and Data Management on the IBMi space, all variations of CL, RPG, SQLRPG and DB2, RPG Free.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Store Procedures. RDi, RDP, ACS, VS Code or other Graphical tools for software development and writing free form SQL statements in large databases.
  • Advanced knowledge of IBMi Work Management (job queues, subsystems, debug in interactive and batch, etc.).
  • Familiar with features for current IBMi Operating Systems (V7R4, V7R5, etc.)

• Health care and dependent care spending accounts.

• Benefits:

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.excerpt: About CircleCI EngineeringCI/CD has been solved.  Now it's being reinvented.
jobs.description:
About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About Delivery Engineering

Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil.

Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on.

We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.
  • Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on.
  • Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate.
  • Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done.
  • Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns.
  • Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage.
  • Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows.

What You'll Bring

  • Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work.
  • Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics.
  • A platform mindset. You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption.
  • Backend depth in Go. You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration.
  • A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed.
  • Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat Pro on a Mac.

Your work covers new services and the Kubernetes operators that manage the platform, as well as migrating existing workloads onto it and maintaining it once it is live - new development runs alongside migration and run-phase work, not after it.

Go is a relatively new direction here. The team's engineering background is mainly Python, and the move to Go is still taking shape. That is the opportunity in this role: what you write early on becomes the reference for what comes after, and you have a say in how the platform's Go codebase takes shape instead of inheriting decisions made years ago.

You join a mixed team of 6+ engineers split between Poland and the Netherlands, working as one team rather than as a vendor and a client side. English is the working language, used daily in design discussions, code review and documentation.

The role is fully remote from Poland, with no on-call duty.

Role – how you’ll contribute

Design, develop, test and deploy back-end services in Go for the private cloud platform

  • Write and maintain Kubernetes operators and controllers in Go
  • Test, debug and improve existing infrastructure applications
  • Take part in migrating existing workloads onto the new platform
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitLab for the services you own
  • Work with architects, functional designers and other specialists on system and application design
  • Review code, write technical documentation and share knowledge within the team

Expectations – the experience you need

  • Min. 4 years of commercial back-end development, including min. 2 years building production services in Go
  • Go concurrency (goroutines, channels, context, sync), the standard library, and building REST and gRPC services
  • Building CI/CD pipelines in GitLab and working across the full delivery lifecycle
  • Writing tests in Go with the standard testing package and Testify or Ginkgo
  • Building and running containerised applications on Linux, including debugging services, reading logs and troubleshooting basic networking on hosts
  • English at B2 or higher - the language of the project, used daily with Dutch colleagues in design discussions, code review and documentation

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Kubernetes operators or controllers written in Go - a core part of this role, so experience here puts you ahead from week one
  • Python, incl. Pytest - the team's main language so far, and part of the tooling and testing stays in it
  • Robot Framework - used for acceptance testing alongside the Go test suites
  • Helm, Kustomize and GitOps - the platform is deployed declaratively, so these speed up your first weeks
  • HashiCorp Vault and Terraform - for secrets management and infrastructure provisioning on the platform
  • CKA or CKAD - not required, but it maps directly onto the Kubernetes work here

What we offer:

  • Flexible and remote cooperation options
  • International projects with leading global clients
  • Travels related to international projects
  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Access* to language classes
  • Access* to knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Access* to private healthcare and life insurance
  • Access* to multisport card

*The availability and terms of individual benefits may vary depending on the chosen form of cooperation.

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines employment with enjoyment.

jobs.title: Contract Manager
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Contract Manager to join our Legal team.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Contract Manager to join our Legal team.

Position Description

The Contract Manager will serve as a primary day-to-day reviewer and negotiator for procurement agreements, supporting Oklo's growing contracting needs as the Company scales and builds its first wave of projects. This role will review and negotiate agreements for the procurement of goods and services, manage assigned matters from intake through execution, and provide practical contracting guidance to Procurement, product, engineering, finance, and other business teams. This role reports to our current Contract Manager and works closely with other members of the Legal and Procurement teams.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Review a variety of agreements, with a primary focus on procurement agreements for goods and services, while also supporting SaaS agreements, event agreements, consulting agreements, and related statement of works
  • Partner with Procurement to support the acquisition of goods and services for complex or large-scale development projects
  • Identify legal and commercial issues, recommend practical solutions, and escalate deviations that fall outside approved playbooks or risk parameters
  • Independently triage and prioritize assigned matters and communicate status, open issues, and next steps to stakeholders
  • Use Ironclad to manage assigned matters, approvals, execution, and contract data throughout the contract lifecycle
  • Coordinate contract execution and maintain complete and accurate records in Oklo's contract repository
  • Apply approved templates and playbooks, identify recurring negotiation issues, and recommend practical updates
  • Provide training and self-service resources, including guidance on meaningful milestones and requirements in statements of work and task orderss

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of contract management or commercial contracting experience, including reviewing and negotiating procurement agreements for goods and services
  • No J.D. required, although relevant experience as a lawyer or non-lawyer is helpful
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements for the procurement of goods and services, including support for complex or large-scale development projects
  • Strong analytical and prioritization skills, with the ability to assess legal risk and business impact
  • Knowledge of commercial contracting principles across Master Services Agreements, Purchase Orders, Statements of Work, Task Orders, and related procurement agreements
  • Project management experience and the ability to coordinate cross-functional matters and communicate effectively with different stakeholders

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Advanced Ironclad experience and knowledge of contract lifecycle management best practices
  • Knowledge of legal technology, including appropriate uses of legal AI to support contract review and negotiation
  • Legal technology implementation or integration experience, including DocuSign or NetSuite
  • Experience with the procurement of goods and services supporting complex construction or hard tech projects

Competencies

We are looking for a Contract Manager who:

  • Exercises sound contracting judgment and balances legal risk with business objectives within established guidelines
  • Drafts, redlines, and negotiates procurement agreements for goods and services
  • Works independently within defined authority and recognizes when an issue requires escalation
  • Is comfortable bringing order to ambiguity and resolving open-ended contracting issues without unnecessary process
  • Is exceptional at independently triaging and prioritizing work
  • Communicates legal and commercial issues clearly and gives stakeholders practical options and next steps
  • Is detail-oriented while working efficiently in a fast-moving environment
  • Is collaborative with Legal, Procurement, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other business teams
  • Is willing and able to learn Oklo's business, contracting positions, and technical context quickly
  • Is passionate about clean energy and comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $110,000-$150,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Position Overview

The Chief Learning Officer (CLO) is responsible for leading the organization's enterprise-wide learning, development, and workforce capability strategy. The CLO drives a culture of continuous learning by designing and implementing programs that enhance employee skills, leadership capabilities, performance, and organizational effectiveness. This role ensures the workforce remains future-ready by aligning learning initiatives with business objectives, digital transformation efforts, and evolving industry demands.

Key Responsibilities

Learning & Development Strategy

Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise learning and development strategy aligned with business goals.

Establish a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

Identify future workforce capabilities and skills required to support organizational success.

Leadership Development & Succession Planning

Design and implement leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

Support succession planning initiatives to strengthen leadership pipelines.

Develop executive coaching and mentoring programs.

Talent Development & Workforce Capability

Assess organizational skills gaps and implement targeted development initiatives.

Create learning pathways that support career progression and internal mobility.

Drive workforce upskilling and reskilling initiatives.

Learning Technologies & Digital Learning

Oversee learning management systems (LMS), digital learning platforms, and educational technologies.

Leverage e-learning, microlearning, AI-driven learning tools, and virtual training solutions.

Ensure accessibility and scalability of learning programs across the organization.

Organizational Effectiveness

Partner with business leaders to align learning initiatives with strategic priorities.

Support organizational transformation and change management through learning interventions.

Improve employee productivity and performance through targeted development programs.

Performance & Learning Analytics

Develop metrics and KPIs to measure learning effectiveness and business impact.

Monitor employee participation, skill development, certification attainment, and performance outcomes.

Use analytics to continuously improve learning programs.

Compliance & Regulatory Training

Ensure delivery of mandatory compliance, regulatory, and risk management training.

Maintain records and reporting to support audit and compliance requirements.

Partner with legal, compliance, and risk teams to ensure training effectiveness.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Collaborate with HR, talent management, operations, technology, and business leaders.

Engage external training providers, universities, professional bodies, and industry partners.

Support employer branding through workforce development initiatives.

Innovation & Knowledge Management

Promote knowledge-sharing practices across the organization.

Develop learning communities, mentorship programs, and centers of excellence.

Introduce innovative approaches to employee learning and development.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead and mentor learning and development teams.

Build high-performing learning organizations capable of supporting enterprise growth.

Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Education, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field; Master's degree preferred.

12–15+ years of progressive experience in learning and development, talent management, organizational development, or workforce transformation roles.

Proven experience leading enterprise learning strategies and leadership development programs.

Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design, and learning technologies.

Strategic learning and workforce development expertise.

Leadership development and succession planning capabilities.

Strong organizational development and change management skills.

Expertise in learning technologies and digital learning platforms.

Excellent communication, coaching, and facilitation skills.

Analytical and data-driven decision-making abilities.

Executive stakeholder management and influence.

Employee learning participation and completion rates.

Leadership pipeline strength and succession readiness.

Workforce upskilling and reskilling outcomes.

Learning program effectiveness and ROI.

Employee engagement and development satisfaction scores.

Compliance training completion and audit results.

Organizational capability and productivity improvements.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

Armada is seeking an Infrastructure Lead to own day-to-day Department of Defense (DoD)/Department of War (DoW) infrastructure workstreams and to serve as a primary technical voice on federal capture. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage a team on day one. You will influence product, manufacturing, deployment, capture, and customer stakeholders across every DoD/DoW opportunity and awarded program you touch.

The role is split evenly between capture and delivery. On the capture side, you engage defense and government customers, shape technical responses to RFIs and RFPs, and translate mission and installation requirements into solution architectures Armada can actually build and field. On the delivery side, you drive Statement of Work (SOW) execution from award through site readiness, production, deployment, integration, and handover with accountability for schedule, technical performance, risk, and change control.

You will work across Armada's Federal infrastructure portfolio, including Galleon ruggedized Modular Data Centers (MDCs), Leviathan megawatt-scale AI-factory form factors, and the Armada Platform. The work sits at the intersection of hardware, power and cooling, connectivity, secure edge software, and the compliance regimes that govern warfighter and installation environments: disconnected operations, classified and air-gapped workloads, zero trust, and Authority to Operate.

This is a hands-on, high-expectation role in a fast-growing, mission-critical environment. You will determine your own methods on new assignments, exercise judgment across ambiguous and sensitive requirements, and make decisions with imperfect information. You are the person who makes sure what we propose to the Department can be manufactured, transported, installed, commissioned, and sustained.

Location. United States (Remote) with expected travel to the Washington, D.C., customer sites, Armada offices, fabrication partners, and deployment locations.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

DoD / DoW workstream ownership

  • Own day-to-day execution of assigned DoD/DoW infrastructure workstreams, from early customer engagement through deployment and sustainment.
  • Establish operating rhythms, KPIs, risk registers, and accountability mechanisms so federal infrastructure delivery is predictable, not reactive.
  • Translate mission requirements into scalable product and deployment patterns.
  • Balance classified and unclassified customer needs while protecting a unified core product architecture across Galleon, Leviathan, and the Armada Platform.

RFI / RFP technical engagement

  • Lead technical engagement on DoD/DoW RFIs, RFPs, and similar proposals for infrastructure and edge-compute opportunities.
  • Shape technical volumes, compliance matrices, bases of estimate, and solution narratives with Capture, Federal Product, Customer Engineering, and Legal.
  • Conduct customer technical exchanges, site surveys, and capability briefings. Translate warfighter, installation, and program-office problems into specific, actionable requirements.
  • Advise capture and go-to-market teams on what Armada can commit to: form factor, power and cooling envelope, deployment timeline, accreditation path, and manufacturing readiness.
  • Represent Armada as a trusted technical advisor to government technical evaluators, program managers, and mission owners.

SOW and Program Execution

  • Own SOW execution on awarded infrastructure efforts: scope, integrated schedule, technical performance, risk, issue, and change control.
  • Build and run the delivery cadence to include program reviews, working groups, customer status, and internal execution forums.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and Supply Chain on contract execution, delivery commitments, CLIN/SLIN traceability, and change management.
  • Drive integrated plans across engineering, manufacturing, logistics, and field deployment so cost, schedule, and technical performance stay in balance as customer priorities move.
  • Proactively surface execution risk, long-lead constraints, and critical-path slips, and drive mitigation rather than report them.
  • Support transition from capture assumptions to an executable baseline at award, including site conditions, interface control, and acceptance criteria.

Infrastructure, manufacturing, and site delivery

  • Own the infrastructure thread from site due diligence and design review through fabrication, transport, installation, integration, and commissioning for Galleon and Leviathan deployments in defense environments.
  • Partner with Form Factors, manufacturing, and supply chain on production readiness: factory strategy, throughput, quality, and long-lead items such as power, cooling, steel, switchgear, and IT infrastructure.
  • Validate that proposed designs are manufacturable, transportable, and installable against real site constraints — crane and access, laydown, sequencing, tolerances, and fit-up — before they are locked into a proposal or an issued-for-construction package.
  • Build repeatable deployment playbooks and methods of procedure so defense sites execute against a productized pattern, not a one-off plan.
  • Coordinate civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, ICT, and IT interfaces with fabricators, general contractors, and government public-works stakeholders.
  • Feed field lessons — constructability, quality escapes, commissioning gaps — back into product design and future proposals.

Security, compliance, and mission assurance

  • Partner with Security and Compliance on DoD security requirements, NIST, RMF, zero trust, and classified or air-gapped deployment models.
  • Guide the infrastructure and accreditation features needed to support Authority to Operate and government compliance and keep proposal language consistent with what the platform can evidence.
  • Drive secure edge-to-cloud and disconnected, intermittent, and limited (DIL) operating concepts for defense customers who cannot rely on centralized cloud.
  • Ensure delivery artifacts including as-builts, test and acceptance packages, configuration baselines, and sustainment handoff meet mission-assurance expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship and an active U.S. Secret clearance. Must be able to obtain and maintain the clearance required by assigned programs.
  • 12+ years of experience in infrastructure, data center, critical facilities, hardware program, or technical program roles.
  • 5+ years supporting U.S. Government or Defense customers (DoD/DoW, Intelligence Community, or federal civilian agencies), including direct customer engagement.
  • Demonstrated ownership of technical RFI/RFP responses, proposals, or customer technical evaluations for infrastructure, data center, or mission-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated SOW or contract execution experience: integrated schedule, risk and change control, and delivery against government acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to translate defense customer problems into specific, actionable requirements and into commitments engineering and manufacturing can execute.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with technical, operational, contracting, and senior government audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Direct experience with modular or prefabricated data centers, edge compute, or expeditionary infrastructure in defense, intelligence, or austere environments.
  • Experience with DoD acquisition and contracting artifacts: SOW, CDRL/SDRL, RFI/RFP technical volumes, bases of estimate, and integrated master schedules.
  • Familiarity with RMF, ATO, ICD 503, NIST 800-53, zero trust, IL4/IL5/IL6, or classified deployment models.
  • Experience with disconnected, intermittent, and limited operations, sovereign or air-gapped AI infrastructure, or installation energy and power constraints.
  • Prior military, intelligence, or government service, or experience as a program manager, TPM, capture lead, or customer engineer on a defense hardware program.

Citizenship Requirements

For select roles, due to the nature of our clientele and the technologies involved, there may be specific nationality or citizenship indicated in the required qualifications section. These roles may involve access to sensitive information that is subject to export control regulations or other legal restrictions. In such cases, employment offers will be contingent upon your ability to comply with these requirements.

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

  • Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas): $163,040 - $203,800
  • Tier 3 (other cities): $154,890- $193,610

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized)
  • HSA, FSA, and dependent-care FSA
  • 401(k) and Roth 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 14 paid company holidays

Armada is an equal opportunity employer. U.S. citizenship and an active Secret clearance are required.

Compensation
$163,040—$203,800 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

The AI Platform team owns Affirm's paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions.
  • Make AI spend attributable and governable: build the identity, quota, routing, caching, and failover controls that let teams adopt new models and tools without re-solving the same platform problems.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to set the guardrails for agentic workloads and the on-behalf-of identity model for tool access.
  • Create and monitor metrics for your team's systems, and own the operational health of what you ship: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and on-call.
  • Set and improve code review and design standards, and advocate for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks.
  • Use AI tools and agentic workflows every day as a multiplier for your own code, design review, and operations, and push the team on what a small AI-native team can deliver.

Job Summary

The Senior Salesforce Business Analyst serves as a key liaison between university business partners and technical teams responsible for Salesforce and related enterprise solutions. This position develops a broad understanding of business objectives, processes, stakeholder needs, data requirements, and existing system capabilities and translates those needs into clearly defined business and functional requirements that enable effective technology solutions. The Senior Salesforce Business Analyst works with stakeholders to analyze complex business problems and opportunities, facilitate discovery and requirements sessions, document current- and future-state processes, identify gaps, evaluate solution alternatives, develop user stories and acceptance criteria, and support solution design and implementation. The position provides guidance regarding Salesforce capabilities and helps business partners distinguish business requirements from proposed technical solutions to ensure that solutions align with university priorities, enterprise architecture, data governance, security, usability, and long-term maintainability. This position participates in and may lead business analysis activities for projects and product enhancements throughout the solution lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, solution validation, testing, implementation, and post-implementation evaluation.

The Senior Salesforce Business Analyst partners closely with product owners, Salesforce administrators, architects, developers, integration teams, data teams, project managers, and university stakeholders to ensure requirements are understood, traceable, testable, and successfully delivered. As a senior professional contributor, this position independently manages complex assignments, facilitates decision-making among diverse stakeholder groups, identifies risks and dependencies, recommends and makes moderate to significant improvements to business processes and Salesforce capabilities, and may coach or review the work of less experienced professionals.

What We're Looking For

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, computer science, or related fields
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience performing business analysis, systems analysis, business process analysis, product analysis, or comparable work involving the translation of business needs into technology solutions
  • Must be a US Citizen or have a Permanent Residency Card
  • In lieu of degree, consideration will be given to an equivalent combination of related education and work experience

Demonstrated experience:

  • eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business and functional requirements
  • facilitating requirements gathering and discovery sessions with stakeholders
  • translating complex business needs into user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
  • analyzing and documenting current- and future-state business processes
  • working with technical teams throughout the solution development lifecycle
  • coordinating or supporting user acceptance testing and solution validation

Preferred

Skills Needed

    • facilitation skills and demonstrated ability to lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, process reviews, and stakeholder discussions
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM concepts, functionality, data structures, security concepts, automation, reporting, and integration patterns sufficient to effectively partner with Salesforce technical professionals
  • Demonstrated:
    • analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-support capabilities
    • ability to independently analyze complex business problems involving multiple processes, systems, stakeholder groups, and organizational dependencies

Preferred

jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

As you'd expect from a company obsessed with keeping families connected, the eCommerce team moves fast and takes the member experience seriously – because a clunky flow is its own kind of broken promise. Sitting inside Journey Marketing, we're a mix of merchandisers, marketers, data folks, and designers who all care about the same thing: turning every member touchpoint — from first website or app visit — into long-term loyalty and lasting relationships. From the online store to in-app purchases to wherever commerce shows up next, this team builds the experience that turns interest into purchase. If you like owning outcomes, thinking in systems, and turning "maybe" into "yes" at scale, you'll fit right in.

About the Job

At Life360, our web experience is one of the most important drivers of device sell-through and subscription growth. Making smart decisions about that experience requires performance visibility – always knowing what's happening on the site, where customers are dropping off, and why.

The Site Optimization Manager drives continuous improvement of Life360's digital commerce experience through experimentation, behavioral analysis, and data-driven optimization. You'll manage the day-to-day execution of our web experimentation and personalization programs, translating customer insights and performance data into measurable improvements in conversion, engagement, and revenue.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines analytical rigor with strong technical execution. You'll identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, build and launch experiments, and translate results into actionable recommendations. Working closely with Web Experience, Analytics, Product, Engineering, and Merchandising, you'll help accelerate our optimization roadmap and build a scalable culture of experimentation.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $121,000 to $178,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 141,000 to 165,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual’s background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor site performance continuously, surfacing regressions, anomalies, and emerging trends proactively — bringing a diagnosis with business context and recommended next action alongside every flag, not just the data.
  • Identify conversion optimization opportunities by synthesizing quantitative funnel data with qualitative signals — session recordings, heatmaps, and usability findings — to understand where and why customers experience friction and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Analytics to define measurement requirements, ensure visibility into key site performance KPIs, and leverage dashboards tracking CVR, funnel step drop-off, AOV, and session quality across key web surfaces and conversion flows.
  • Own the day-to-day operation of Life360's web A/B and multivariate testing program, including test scoping, configuration, builds, QA, traffic allocation, and post-test documentation, ensuring experiments are instrumented correctly and results are interpreted with statistical rigor.
  • Maintain and groom the live experiment backlog in partnership with the Director, ensuring tests are scoped clearly, sequenced logically, and launched on time.
  • Analyze test results with rigor in partnership with Analytics, evaluating statistical significance, sizing revenue impact, and producing clear readouts that drive confident go/no-go decisions and inform future optimization opportunities.
  • Manage personalization campaign operations — maintaining segment-to-experience workflows, coordinating with UX/UI and Merchandising on creative, and tracking lift versus baseline for each active experience.
  • Partner with Digital Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Analytics on experimentation platform configuration, feature flag governance, event instrumentation QA, and tagging validation.
  • Support hands-on site optimization execution across experimentation, personalization, and content updates, leveraging CMS, commerce platforms, and no-code/low-code tools to implement and QA experiences where appropriate.
  • Translate performance insights into actionable recommendations, partnering with Analytics on reporting and contributing optimization findings, experiment outcomes, and prioritized opportunities to weekly and monthly business reviews.
  • Contribute to the financial modeling process by sizing expected lift for proposed tests and reconciling actuals to projections post-launch.
  • Document experimentation best practices, maintain the team's testing Confluence, and help build institutional knowledge around what works on Life360's web properties.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–6 years of experience in eCommerce or digital analytics, with at least 2 years of hands-on ownership of an experimentation program in a fast-paced commercial environment. Ideally within a hardware + subscription business.
  • Proficiency with Statsig preferred or equivalent experimentation platform (Optimizely, VWO, Adobe Target, Dynamic Yield, etc) – you've built and QA'd tests yourself, not just read the reports.
  • Familiarity with headless commerce architectures, content management systems (CMS), and modern eCommerce platforms such as BigCommerce and Contentful. Comfortable navigating the technical dependencies of site changes, experimentation, and personalization across commerce and content platforms.
  • Strong analytical foundation – you're fluent in GA4, Amplitude, or a comparable analytics platform, can write SQL to pull your own data, and are comfortable building and maintaining dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or similar tools. You understand the statistics behind experimentation well enough to push back when a test is being called too early.
  • Experience with personalization tools and segment-based targeting; familiarity with how audience definitions, traffic splits, and experience variants are configured in practice.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, identify customer behavior patterns, generate and refine experimentation hypotheses, and improve operational efficiency. Curious about emerging AI capabilities and how they can be applied to digital experience optimization.
  • Detail-oriented operator with strong project management instincts — you can run multiple tests simultaneously, keep stakeholders informed, and maintain clean documentation without being asked.
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to partner effectively with Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Site Merchandising, and Analytics teams.
  • Clear communicator who can translate performance data into plain-language insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Curiosity-driven: you follow the data wherever it leads, ask good questions, and treat every test as an opportunity to learn something about the customer.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

The Operations & Offices Manager is responsible for ensuring that BlackStone eIT's people, assets, compliance, and facilities operate reliably and consistently across all company locations (spanning the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, and Morocco, alongside a distributed consultant workforce).

Reporting directly to the Chief Process Officer, the role requires a high degree of autonomy, cross-border coordination capability, independent day-to-day problem-solving, structured upward management, and leadership of a geographically dispersed team of varying skill levels.

Key Responsibilities

1. People Operations — Onboarding & Offboarding

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Manage onboarding for new joiners across all geographies to ensure Day 1 readiness in coordination with HR, IT, and Finance.
  • Asset Management: Procure, prepare, and hand over equipment to new joiners while maintaining accurate asset records.
  • Offboarding & Insurance: Oversee full offboarding (equipment recovery, insurance cancellations, documentation) and handle employee medical insurance enrollment on joining and cancellation on exit.

2. Visa, Immigration & Compliance

  • Visas & Permits: Manage employee visa issuance, renewals, and cancellations across the UAE, KSA, Jordan, and Egypt, coordinating with PROs and government authorities.
  • Tracking & Registrations: Maintain a proactive tracking system for visa, permit, and commercial registration expiry dates, and oversee company commercial licenses across jurisdictions.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure full compliance with regional labor laws in the UAE, KSA, Jordan, Egypt, and the US, maintaining audit readiness at all times.

3. Payroll & Finance Operations Support

  • Payroll Inputs: Review and approve all Operations-originated payroll inputs (expense additions, deductions, reimbursements) submitted by country coordinators before the HR payroll cycle.
  • Accuracy & Timeliness: Ensure country-level payroll and expense submissions are accurate, complete, and delivered on time monthly.
  • Variance Resolution: Coordinate with HR Payroll to resolve variances or exceptions prior to Finance submission.

4. Office & Facilities Management

  • Team Supervision: Supervise country Operations coordinators and support staff across regional offices to maintain consistent operational standards.
  • Facilities & Vendors: Manage office leases, facilities, utilities, maintenance, and vendor contracts across all locations.
  • Logistics & Budgets: Oversee travel, accommodation, and transportation logistics, manage medical insurance renewals and provider relationships, and monitor administrative/facilities budgets for cost savings.

5. Process Improvement & Reporting

  • Standardization: Document, standardize, and continuously improve operational processes across all geographies.
  • Optimization: Identify operational gaps, manual workarounds, and automation opportunities, presenting recommendations with clear rationale to the CPO.
  • Audits: Support company-wide reporting, compliance checks, and operational audits.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • Experience: 7–10 years of experience in multi-country operations, office management, or administrative leadership roles.
  • Distributed Leadership: Proven track record managing a distributed team across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Immigration Expertise: Hands-on experience with visa, immigration, and government liaison processes in KSA, UAE, and/or Jordan.
  • Program Management: Experience managing medical insurance programs and vendor contracts.
  • Process Building: Demonstrated ability to build and enforce operational procedures in environments with inconsistent or absent processes.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of regional labor and compliance frameworks across KSA, UAE, Jordan, and Egypt.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office and experience working with ERP or operational management systems.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Flexible to work across multiple time zones and working week structures (Saturday–Wednesday for KSA; Monday–Friday for Egypt and Jordan).

Skills & Competencies

  • Operational Discipline: Ability to design, document, and enforce processes and hold teams accountable.
  • Cross-Border Coordination: Comfortable managing country-level operations remotely without physical oversight.
  • Diverse Team Leadership: Experienced in managing mixed-capability teams (from qualified coordinators to support staff), adapting communication styles and performance management accordingly.
  • Executive Communication: Structured and concise in managing upward; knows what/when to escalate and maintains composure under pressure.
  • Service Orientation: Approaches colleagues as internal customers to provide efficient, professional, and friction-free support.
  • Problem-Solving: Resolves operational blockers independently and escalates only what genuinely requires senior intervention.
  • Attention to Detail: Rigorous in record-keeping, tracking deadlines, and maintaining compliance documentation.

Preferred (Advantageous) Qualifications

  • Prior experience in an IT staffing, systems integration, managed services, or professional services environment.
  • Experience coordinating payroll inputs across multi-currency, multi-country payroll cycles.
  • Experience managing equipment procurement and asset tracking for a dispersed, consultant-heavy workforce.
  • Very good English language proficiency (for KSA and UAE coordination).

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward-looking vision.
jobs.description:
About Us

At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy-as-a-Service sector.

We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow.

Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success.

Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success.

Overview

The HRIS Manager leads the strategy, administration, governance, and optimization of the organization's HR technology ecosystem. This role oversees HR systems, data governance, reporting, integrations, and technology initiatives that support business operations and workforce decision-making. The HRIS Manager develops and leads a high-performing team while ensuring HR technology solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with organizational objectives. This is a hands-on leadership role that serves as the operational owner and primary technical escalation point for UKG Pro and assigned HR technologies.

Responsibilities

  • HRIS Leadership & Strategy:
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the HRIS team, establishing priorities, service standards, and performance expectations.
  • Define and execute the HR technology roadmap to support business objectives, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to identify opportunities to enhance processes, technology capabilities, and user experience.
  • Balance strategic initiatives with daily operational support, urgent business needs, compliance requirements, and available team capacity.
  • HR Technology Administration & Delivery:
  • Oversee the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of HR technology platforms, including system enhancements, upgrades, and implementations.
  • Serve as the operational owner and primary technical escalation point for UKG Pro and other assigned HR technology platforms.
  • Oversee access administration, production support, critical system processes, and timely resolution of payroll-impacting or business-critical technology issues.
  • Manage the HR technology project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are effectively prioritized, executed, and adopted.
  • Direct vendor relationships and service delivery to ensure technology solutions meet business requirements and performance expectations.
  • Data Governance, Security & Compliance:
  • Establish and maintain HR data governance standards, security controls, privacy protocols, and access management practices.
  • Ensure role-based security, least-privilege access, segregation of duties, appropriate approvals, and periodic access reviews across HR systems.
  • Maintain system documentation, testing evidence, security records, audit support materials, issue logs, and corrective-action records necessary to demonstrate effective controls and audit readiness.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and audit requirements across all HR systems.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate system, data, compliance, and operational risks.
  • Systems Integration, Reporting & Analytics:
  • Oversee HR system integrations, interfaces, and data exchanges to ensure accurate, secure, and reliable information flow.
  • Monitor critical integrations, scheduled processes, automated jobs, and data-transfer failures, coordinating timely corrective action when issues affect payroll, onboarding, benefits, compliance, or other critical processes.
  • Maintain appropriate integration inventories, data-flow documentation, testing controls, and production-deployment records.
  • Lead the delivery of HR reporting, dashboards, analytics, and workforce insights that support business decision-making.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of HR data through monitoring, audits, reconciliations, and process controls.
  • Stakeholder Partnership & Change Management:
  • Collaborate with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, Compliance, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational needs.
  • Lead testing, training, communication, and change management activities related to HR technology initiatives.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable system solutions and process improvements that enhance organizational effectiveness.
  • Supervisory Responsibilities:
  • Directly supervises HRIS personnel and is responsible for hiring, coaching, performance management, and employee development.
  • Oversees workload planning, resource allocation, succession planning, and team performance.
  • Promotes a collaborative, customer-focused culture that drives service excellence and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required Education, Experience, and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, information systems, business administration, data analytics or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive HRIS, HR technology or closely related experience.
  • 2+ years of experience leading employees, projects or major HR technology workstreams.
  • Advanced experience administering UKG Pro, including configuration, security, workflows, testing, reporting and integrations.
  • Experience supporting or administering an applicant tracking, recruiting or talent platform, preferably iCIMS.
  • Demonstrated experience managing HR technology implementations, upgrades, enhancements or optimization projects.
  • Experience with APIs, SFTP integrations, interface monitoring or system-to-system data flows.
  • Working knowledge of HR data governance, role-based security, privacy and data-quality controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop business requirements, test solutions and manage production implementations.
  • Strong project-management, prioritization and organizational skills.
  • Strong vendor-management and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Ability to analyze complex system and process issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage confidential and sensitive employee information.

Preferred Education, Experience, and Qualifications

  • SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP highly desirable.

Travel Requirements

  • 10-25% of time will be spent traveling to job site(s)/office location.

Physical Activities

  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods
  • Climbing stairs.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers

Environmental Conditions

  • Quiet environment

Physical Demands

  • Light work that includes adjusting and/or moving objects up to 20 pounds

USD $116,860.00 - USD $155,995.00 /Yr.
