jobs.description:
Clinical Program Manager

Pathways 2 Solutions (Pathways) distinguishes itself through our serious thirst for impact and our dedication to making Veterans' lives better. We are expert leaders, communicators, technologists, clinicians, and program managers united in the pursuit of effective, practical solutions for our clients.
Our mission is to help other mission-driven organizations across government, nonprofit, and business sectors. Our approach combines clinical and healthcare expertise, proven implementation practices, digital health knowledge, and disciplined program management. That's where you come in.

Position Overview

Pathways is hiring a Clinical Program Manager to organize and manage complex, interrelated program and contract-support activities for the Department of Veterans Affairs. This position coordinates project tasks, clinical and operational workgroups, documentation and template updates, coding guidance, system compatibility, stakeholder engagement, and compliance activities supporting virtual health services.
The Program Manager provides senior-level project management and technical guidance and works directly with clients, VA leadership, clinical teams, business owners, technical personnel, and contractor staff to define goals, formulate task plans, review deliverables, identify opportunities, and improve program efficiency. VA experience is preferred; direct virtual health, Remote Patient Monitoring, or Home Telehealth experience is strongly preferred.

Job Purpose

The Clinical Program Manager is accountable for organizing and managing assigned contract operational-support functions involving multiple complex and interrelated tasks.
The successful candidate will guide clinical, technical, operational, and documentation initiatives; facilitate alignment across VA groups; manage workgroups; and translate regulatory, clinical, coding, and system changes into current guidance, manuals, note templates, protocols, and implementation actions. The role documents and communicates program results, risks, decisions, and recommendations throughout.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Organize and manage contract operational-support activities involving multiple complex and interrelated project tasks and cross-functional teams.
  • Serve as a contractor interface with clients and VA leadership; collaborate to define goals, formulate and review task plans and deliverables, identify opportunities, resolve barriers, and drive program efficiency.
  • Facilitate stakeholder engagement across VA program offices, clinical groups, business owners, technology teams, coding or compliance experts, and field personnel; ensure clear communication, alignment, decision documentation, and feedback integration.
  • Manage or support workgroups focused on manual reviews, policy and guidance updates, clinical note-template changes, system compatibility, clinical operations, and related virtual health improvement priorities.
  • Update, maintain, and quality-check documentation, manuals, standard operating procedures, workflows, clinical guidance, and note templates to meet current standards and support compatibility with electronic health record systems.
  • Coordinate updates to coding guidance in response to regulatory, policy, clinical, operational, and technology changes; engage appropriate clinical, coding, compliance, and system stakeholders to validate revisions.
  • Analyze complex clinical, operational, and technical problems and develop practical, well-supported solutions and recommendations for client consideration.
  • Research and translate customer and stakeholder requirements into project plans, documentation updates, system-change requirements, implementation activities, and short- and long-range recommendations.
  • Prepare and present status, findings, options, risks, recommendations, and results to clients, VA leadership, workgroups, executives, and other decision-makers.
  • Establish and apply quality-control practices for task plans, manuals, guidance, note templates, reports, and other deliverables; track corrective actions and continuous-improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with VA data-security, privacy, access-control, records-management, and Section 508 accessibility requirements applicable to program activities and deliverables.

Leadership Expectations

This role may require leadership and strategic oversight of complex projects and cross-functional teams. The Program Manager maintains senior-level client relationships and holds contributors accountable for successful delivery. The role must exercise sound clinical, technical, operational, and contractual judgment while creating clarity, facilitating alignment, and escalating issues appropriately.

Required Qualifications

  • Clinical degree in a relevant field or a master's-level degree in health science, public health, nursing, health informatics, healthcare administration, clinical informatics, or a closely related discipline. Candidates with a relevant bachelor's degree may qualify when supported by the required level of experience.
  • At least two years of progressively responsible program or project management experience with a relevant master's or clinical degree, or at least ten years with a relevant bachelor's degree.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare systems, clinical programs, digital health solutions, remote patient monitoring, Home Telehealth, or related care-delivery and technology environments.
  • Demonstrated success organizing and managing complex, interrelated projects or program tasks involving schedules, costs, deliverables, risks, dependencies, resources, and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience collaborating with senior clients or healthcare leaders to define goals, formulate task plans, review deliverables, resolve issues, and communicate recommendations.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement and workgroups, integrating feedback, documenting decisions, and coordinating follow-through across clinical, operational, technical, and administrative teams.
  • Experience developing, updating, reviewing, or managing healthcare documentation, manuals, procedures, guidance, workflows, templates, or other controlled program materials.
  • Ability to analyze complex clinical, operational, technical, regulatory, or coding-related issues and translate findings into practical plans, documentation, and recommendations.
  • Excellent written and oral communication, facilitation, executive briefing, stakeholder-management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint; ability to learn and effectively use VA-required clinical, documentation, project, security, and reporting platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Department of Veterans Affairs experience, particularly with Remote Patient Monitoring-Home Telehealth programs, operations, workflows, stakeholders, or technology environments.
  • Current or prior Registered Nurse experience combined with Home Telehealth, remote patient monitoring, care coordination, or related virtual-care experience.
  • Relevant clinical coding knowledge and experience interpreting or updating coding guidance in response to regulatory, policy, clinical, or operational changes.
  • Experience updating clinical note templates, documentation tools, manuals, or workflows for compatibility with electronic health record systems.
  • Experience with clinical workflow improvement, technology implementation, stakeholder engagement, change management, quality improvement, or adoption and sustainment initiatives.
  • Project Management Institute credential, such as the Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP), or a comparable credential. Certification is preferred but not required.

Location and Remote Work

Pathways 2 Solutions is a fully remote government contracting organization. Employees may work remotely from approved states where the company is authorized to employ personnel and can meet payroll, tax, regulatory, security, and contractual requirements.
The position may require periodic travel to VA facilities, government offices, implementation sites, or team meetings. Travel is expected to be up to 15%, depending on client requirements. Pathways reserves the right to modify approved work locations based on business needs and applicable legal, tax, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This position involves prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee must be able to communicate effectively in virtual meetings and occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Compensation and Benefits

The anticipated salary range is $110,000.00 - $135,000.00. The upper portion of the range is reserved for candidates with exceptional directly relevant experience, including RN credentials, virtual health expertise, and relevant clinical coding knowledge. Actual compensation will be based on education, relevant experience, clinical and technical expertise, credentials, work location, internal equity, and applicable contract and funding parameters.
Pathways offers a collaborative, family-oriented workplace culture, opportunities for professional growth, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan; paid time off; and other benefits available under applicable company plans and policies.

jobs.title: Endpoint Engineer (Senior)
jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior engineering position owns endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, endpoint patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure engineering.

The Endpoint Engineer develops standardized, repeatable, and secure endpoint solutions for geographically dispersed users and locations. The engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, refresh, recovery, and retirement.

This position works closely with the Task 6 cybersecurity team while maintaining a clear division of responsibility. Task 6 identifies, prioritizes, and validates security findings. The Endpoint Engineer evaluates operational impacts and implements the approved endpoint configuration, software, image, patch, or remediation changes through established change-control procedures. The engineer then provides deployment and completion evidence for cybersecurity validation.

The Endpoint Engineer collaborates with the Service Desk, field support, Active Directory, virtualization, cloud, network, application, cybersecurity, and Government teams. This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional after-hours maintenance, critical incident support, on-site work, or travel may be required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Endpoint Engineer will:

  • Serve as the senior engineer for enterprise endpoint imaging, packaging, deployment, patching, configuration, and VDI capabilities.
  • Design, build, test, maintain, and document standardized endpoint images.
  • Maintain image components, drivers, firmware dependencies, operating-system settings, security baselines, required software, and deployment configurations.
  • Establish image versioning, testing, approval, rollback, release, and retirement procedures.
  • Validate endpoint images against functional, security, performance, compatibility, and operational requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automated deployment task sequences, provisioning workflows, configuration profiles, and enrollment processes.
  • Engineer and support endpoint deployment using approved Microsoft and Government management platforms.
  • Support modern endpoint-management and co-management capabilities involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, or comparable technologies.
  • Develop, test, maintain, and deploy application packages using approved formats and packaging standards.
  • Package commercial, Government, and internally developed software for controlled endpoint deployment.
  • Develop installation, detection, dependency, requirement, upgrade, repair, and removal logic for software packages.
  • Test application packages for silent installation, proper detection, compatibility, security, user experience, and clean removal.
  • Troubleshoot failed installations, package conflicts, missing dependencies, detection problems, and deployment errors.
  • Develop approved scripts and automation for packaging, provisioning, configuration, deployment, validation, and remediation.
  • Maintain endpoint-management automation in approved version-control and documentation repositories.
  • Design and administer endpoint patching processes for operating systems, approved applications, drivers, firmware, and management components.
  • Establish deployment rings, pilot groups, production waves, maintenance windows, deadlines, exception handling, and rollback procedures.
  • Test operating-system updates, security patches, vendor patches, and application updates before production deployment.
  • Monitor deployment progress, failure rates, compliance status, endpoint health, and outstanding exceptions.
  • Investigate failed patches and coordinate corrective actions, redeployment, or approved exceptions.
  • Engineer and support Virtual Desktop Infrastructure capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain VDI base images, desktop pools, application delivery, user-profile configurations, policies, and endpoint-access requirements.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot VDI performance, availability, login, profile, application, display, peripheral, and connectivity issues.
  • Support VDI modernization, capacity planning, testing, deployment, and optimization.
  • Coordinate VDI platform dependencies with virtualization, storage, network, identity, application, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Support enterprise endpoint deployment and refresh projects across USMEPCOM Headquarters, MEPS, Remote Processing Substations, COOP sites, and remote users.
  • Develop technical implementation plans for device refreshes, operating-system upgrades, application migrations, and endpoint-management transitions.
  • Support endpoint provisioning, enrollment, configuration, testing, deployment, replacement, recovery, and retirement.
  • Provide Tier 3 and Tier 4 engineering support for complex endpoint, application-packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI incidents.
  • Analyze endpoint logs, deployment status, policy results, management-platform data, and other technical evidence.
  • Develop corrective actions for recurring endpoint incidents and known errors.
  • Support major incidents and outages involving endpoint management, software deployments, VDI, or widespread device failures.
  • Implement approved workarounds and service-restoration actions during endpoint-related incidents.
  • Coordinate with the Service Desk and field-support teams to improve endpoint troubleshooting, escalation, and knowledge content.
  • Create technical guidance for common endpoint, deployment, packaging, and VDI problems.
  • Review Task 6 cybersecurity findings assigned to endpoint operations.
  • Assess the operational impact, dependencies, testing requirements, deployment approach, and rollback needs for assigned security changes.
  • Implement approved endpoint security changes through established change-management and release procedures.
  • Execute approved remediation involving endpoint images, software versions, patches, configurations, policies, or management settings.
  • Maintain evidence showing the affected population, deployment method, implementation status, failures, exceptions, and completion results.
  • Provide remediation evidence to Task 6 for validation and closure.
  • Coordinate unresolved or technically infeasible remediations with cybersecurity, system owners, vendors, and Government stakeholders.
  • Apply approved DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides and endpoint-security baselines.
  • Support endpoint compliance reporting, vulnerability remediation, configuration validation, and audit-evidence collection.
  • Maintain endpoint inventories, deployment records, configuration baselines, package records, patch status, VDI documentation, and technical diagrams.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, field guides, packaging standards, test plans, implementation plans, rollback plans, and recovery procedures.
  • Follow approved incident, problem, change, release, configuration, asset, security, and quality-management processes.
  • Provide endpoint health, deployment, patching, compliance, risk, issue, and modernization information for operational and program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • Minimum of eight years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, device management, desktop engineering, VDI engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience designing and maintaining enterprise endpoint images.
  • Experience developing, testing, and deploying application packages.
  • Experience supporting enterprise endpoint provisioning, deployment, patching, configuration, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience engineering or supporting Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing approved endpoint-security or vulnerability-remediation changes.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex endpoint, deployment, packaging, patching, or VDI issues.
  • Knowledge of controlled testing, pilot deployment, phased implementation, validation, rollback, and change-management practices.
  • Ability to develop technical procedures, image documentation, package records, test plans, deployment plans, rollback procedures, and completion evidence.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate certification when relevant to the assigned Microsoft 365 or Intune environment.
  • Ability to support after-hours maintenance, deployment windows, critical incidents, and endpoint recovery when required.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Intune or Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
  • Experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager or System Center Configuration Manager.
  • Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid endpoint management.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or other endpoint-automation technologies.
  • Experience packaging applications using MSI, MSIX, Win32, App-V, or comparable formats.
  • Experience with VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or another enterprise VDI platform.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense endpoint environments.
  • Experience applying DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides to Windows endpoints.
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework controls, vulnerability remediation, or authorization evidence.
  • Experience with endpoint analytics, digital employee experience, compliance, or configuration-management tools.
  • Experience supporting large-scale operating-system migrations, device refreshes, or endpoint-management modernization.
  • CompTIA Security+ or another relevant security certification.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, cloud, automation, or endpoint-management certification.

Skills and Competencies

  • Enterprise endpoint engineering and lifecycle management.
  • Image engineering and automated deployment.
  • Application packaging and software distribution.
  • Operating-system and application patch management.
  • Endpoint configuration and security-baseline implementation.
  • VDI design, deployment, and troubleshooting.
  • PowerShell and endpoint-management automation.
  • Complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
  • Controlled testing, phased deployment, and rollback planning.
  • Cybersecurity remediation execution and evidence development.
  • Technical documentation and configuration management.
  • Cross-functional engineering coordination.
  • Strong attention to detail and change discipline.

About the Role

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a deeply technical post-sales role focused on driving successful adoption of Azul Prime within a portfolio of strategic customers. Unlike a traditional TAM role, this position is hands-on and technical first. You will spend the majority of your time engaged with customer engineering teams on JVM performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and architectural guidance. Strong relationship skills matter, but it is technical credibility with developers, SREs, and architects that makes this role successful.

You will be trusted by Azul’s most important accounts to ensure that their mission-critical Java applications run on Prime with the best possible performance, stability, and cost efficiency. And you will serve as the bridge between customers and Azul’s engineering organization, feeding real-world insights back into the product.

What Makes This Role Different

  • Technical depth first. Expect to spend significant time reading thread dumps, GC logs, and flight recordings — not building slide decks.
  • Direct partnership with Azul engineering. You will work side-by-side with our runtime, GC, JIT compiler, and tooling teams on complex customer issues.
  • Ownership of technical outcomes. You own production adoption of Azul Prime within your accounts — from candidate application selection through successful rollout and ongoing optimization.

    • Enablement & Knowledge Sharing

  • Design and deliver customer-facing workshops, training sessions, and technical business reviews.

  • Share knowledge internally, mentoring peers across the TAM, Sales Engineering, and Support organizations.

  • 12+ years in senior technical roles such as software engineering, SRE, performance engineering, or cloud/platform engineering.

jobs.description:
About the company

At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

Senior Product Manager, Customer Operations

Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or London.

This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening.

You’ll own Customer Operations: the internal systems and tooling that let Nuitee's CS team resolve issues and keep bookings fulfilled, across configuration, incident handling, and fulfillment tracking.

You’ll run it as a full business and product domain. You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs.

The problem underneath is operational, not customer-facing. How do you raise fulfillment rate and cut incident volume without proportionally growing headcount or cost, in a domain with a direct, visible P&L?

What makes it interesting for you

  • You can move extremely fast. There’s very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment.
  • You own the path to the outcome. You’ll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there.
  • You own a real P&L. Fulfillment rate, incident volume, and cost-to-serve are concrete numbers you’re directly accountable for moving.
  • You’ll help build Nuitee’s product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we’re building one, and you’ll help shape it as we push toward €10B.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

The kind of problems you’ll work on

  • How do we raise fulfillment rate and cut incident/ticket volume without growing CS headcount or cost in proportion?
  • What internal tooling would let CS resolve problems faster, with less manual work and fewer handoffs?
  • Where should we invest in CS systems to get the clearest return, in P&L terms, for the company?

This role fits if you

  • Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove.
  • Understand operations, support, or internal-tooling economics, especially cost-to-serve, fulfillment, or efficiency trade-offs.
  • Can go deep into systems and operational mechanics and turn that into product decisions.
  • Are comfortable working closely with engineering on technically complex products.
  • Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself.
  • Are willing to go deep into operations and cost/efficiency thinking rather than staying at surface-level product management.

Operations or internal-tooling depth matters more to us than travel experience.

Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers.

If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
  • World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
  • Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
  • Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
  • AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us—Nuitée is the place for you.

About VALIS

We’re a fast-moving, rapidly growing B2B SaaS company focused on bringing modern technology to the metal recycling industry — an essential but underserved market segment. Our technology helps recyclers close more deals, operate more efficiently, and finally ditch the pen-and-paper workflows.

We’re an early-stage company, backed by leading climate-tech VCs, looking to bring on new team members that can help us build VALIS and transform the industry. We lead with authenticity, boldness, passion, and empathy focused on creating a more sustainable future. A career at VALIS is one where you’ll be empowered to expand your technical and leadership abilities while having a positive impact on the world.

The role

As a Software Engineer at VALIS, you'll build and scale our newest product line, taking it from a blank page to the plant floor. You'll spend time with operators and plant managers, design the schema and application, and deliver a product that scrap processors rely on to run their plant. Working directly with our CTO, product team, and end users, you'll make the architecture and design decisions, prioritize what gets built when, and see your work used every shift, every day. We're hiring across mid-senior levels, from a few years experience to senior engineers.

What you'll do

  • Own the product end-to-end: data model, API, UI, UX, deployment, and iteration.
  • Design a multi-tenant domain model (materials, loads, runs, equipment, quality) that holds up as each customer's process differs.
  • Build fast, robust, validated data-entry workflows for the plant floor.
  • Deliver insights dashboards managers act on each shift.
  • Meet with operators and facility managers weekly, get on-site, and turn what you see into product decisions.
  • Integrate new data sources with existing VALIS data and customer systems such as ERP exports, scales, and plant controls.
  • Build and deploy agentic features to surface trends from production and quality data, flag anomalies, and notify the right people.

How we work

  • Remote, US-based. Work from anywhere in the US, overlapping with East Coast business hours (roughly 9am to 5pm ET).
  • Small team, low overhead. You'll work directly with our CTO, along with a product and business team with deep industry experience.
  • Our stack: React and TypeScript on the frontend; C# and ASP.NET Core with PostgreSQL on the backend; AWS, Docker, and Pulumi for infrastructure.
  • We use Claude Code heavily and expect you to be highly effective with it. You should own and understand the code you ship; AI speeds up the work but does not replace the thinking.
  • Travel a few times a year for customer site visits and company get-togethers (on-site at our HQ in Worcester, MA or off-site elsewhere).

Requirements

Who you are

We hire for fundamentals & mindset. You:

  • Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience (for senior candidates, 5+ and have led technical projects).
  • Think data model first: you can turn a messy real-world process into a clean, normalized schema... and defend the tradeoff decisions.
  • Use types, clear boundaries, and domain language to make wrong states hard to represent.
  • Are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, finding solutions without waiting for instruction.
  • Are solid across databases, backend APIs, and frontend fundamentals.
  • Are mathematically minded, with strong quantitative and statistical fundamentals, so the numbers we show customers are ones they can trust.

ABOUT STORD


Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord is hiring a Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance to own how we recognize, record and defend revenue across a business that blends warehousing, fulfillment, parcel and software. There is no dedicated revenue accounting team today, so you will own the function from day one: set the technical accounting position under ASC 606, and build the assurance program that gives our CFO, auditors and board confidence in every revenue number we report.

What You'll Do


Revenue accounting

  • Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close, including accruals for usage-based fulfillment, storage, transportation and parcel charges, and unbilled revenue.
  • Own ASC 606 analysis for new and amended customer contracts (MSAs, SOWs, pricing schedules): performance obligations, principal vs. agent, variable consideration, contract modifications and software vs. services allocation.
  • Own the revenue recognition policy, technical memos and the revenue recognition playbook, and keep them current as the product mix changes.
  • Own the reserves for customer credits (such as service and SLA credits), including the estimation methodology, monthly true-ups and support for auditors.
  • Own revenue analytics: revenue by customer, service line and contract, flux and trend analysis, and the metrics that explain revenue movement to Finance leadership.
  • Partner with Billing and Systems to make sure contract terms, rate cards and billing data flow accurately into the general ledger.

Assurance and Controls

  • Design, run and continuously improve the revenue control environment: SOX-readiness controls, reconciliations, billing-to-GL tie-outs and revenue completeness checks.
  • Build an assurance program that tests revenue before it reaches the auditors, using data and analytics to catch billing leakage, duplicate charges and rate-card variances.
  • Be the primary revenue contact for external auditors: PBC lists, walkthroughs, technical accounting positions and remediation of findings.
  • Prepare for audit, diligence and potential IPO readiness requirements, including disclosures and footnote support.

Leadership

  • Lead and scale the revenue accounting function: hands-on today, with any team build-out to be determined as business needs evolve.
  • Drive automation of revenue workflows, reconciliations and flux analysis with the finance systems stack.
  • Brief the CFO and Controller on revenue trends, risks and judgments.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance; active CPA required.
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including experience owning revenue accounting end to end, and leading or building a team where needed, with Big 4 or public company experience.
  • Experience with M&A integrations, including bringing acquired revenue streams, contracts and systems into the close and supporting purchase accounting.
  • Deep, hands-on command of ASC 606 for complex, multi-element contracts and usage-based or variable pricing.
  • Proven experience designing and operating revenue controls in a SOX or SOX-ready environment, and managing external audits.
  • Strong comfort with data: you can trace a number from the contract to the invoice to the ledger, and you use SQL or BI tools (or direct a team that does) to test it.
  • Experience with an ERP and billing stack (for example NetSuite and a usage-based billing system) and close management tools.
  • A track record of working hands-on in a lean function and, if a team is needed, building it and developing people, and communicating technical accounting clearly to non-accountants.
  • Sound judgment, high integrity and the confidence to say "not yet" when the support isn't there.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in 3PL, logistics, supply chain or marketplace businesses with high-volume, rate-card-driven billing.
  • Experience with a combination of services and SaaS revenue streams.
  • Prior involvement in an IPO, SPAC, or carve-out readiness effort.
  • Familiarity with automation and AI tools for close, flux analysis and reconciliation work.

jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. As an Outreach Specialist on the ACCESS Team, you will play a vital, frontline role in driving patient participation, enrollment, and activation for the Aledade Access Program. Supporting the CMS Innovation Center’s ACCESS (Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions) model, Aledade is building an agentic AI patient engagement platform designed to detect, manage, and empower patients with cardio-kidney-metabolic (CKM) disease, in close partnership with primary care practices.

Operating in a dynamic, remote environment, you will serve as the crucial human connection when automated workflows require hands-on support. In this role, you will handle daily multimodal patient outreach, guide device onboarding, and manage operational queues to ensure seamless, patient-centered care. By bridging gaps when automated systems require intervention, assisting patients with technical and clinical tasks, and coordinating rapid triage, you will help uphold exceptional service standards within a high-accountability, innovative care model.

Primary Duties

    Patient Outreach & Engagement

  • Conduct outbound and inbound outreach calls when automated workflows fail or require manual intervention.

  • Assist patients with onboarding, clinical metric collection (e.g., height, weight, BP), and blood pressure monitor troubleshooting.

  • Deliver engagement nudges to prompt completion of outstanding care management tasks and support ongoing care continuity.

  • Manage high-volume inbound queue requests, SMS fallout, patient inquiries, and onboarding/enrollment support.

  • Process webform exceptions and execute timely clinical triage handoffs to RNs and Pharmacists as needed.

  • Meet core operational benchmarks for call volume, contact rates, conversion, and device onboarding while maintaining accurate documentation and HIPAA compliance.

  • Provide timely, clear, and professional communication regarding follow-ups, care plans, and practice policies.

    • Operational Support

  • Accurately document all patient interactions and maintain up-to-date records in care systems (EHRs/CRMs).

  • Track and report patient engagement metrics, participating in workflow testing to refine operations and identify improvements.

  • Respond promptly to time-sensitive updates, adjusting priorities to address critical outreach needs immediately.

  • Maintain high energy, professional empathy, and resilience during high-volume shifts and frequent patient rejections.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to advance patient engagement strategies and organizational goals.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in healthcare outreach, care coordination, or telephonic patient engagement.

  • Proven track record in high-volume environment with the ability to meet performance metrics (i.e. Activation, conversion, etc.).

  • Regular and predictable attendance

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

  • Strong organizational and documentation abilities.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently.

  • Ability to work shifts between 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST, including evenings and Saturdays as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a remote call center environment.

  • Familiarity with value-based care models and Medicare Advantage.

  • Experience with care management software and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts, carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings (upsell/cross-sell); identify whitespace across the SentinelOne product portfolio and run consultative expansion conversations, leading with customer use cases and outcomes, not just quotes; spot expansion triggers early, including new use cases, org growth, underutilized licenses ready to convert, and competitive displacement openings; build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth, not just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close; keep renewal timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book, so the primary focus remains on whitespace and expansion with your accounts; handle commercial negotiation on your accounts, including multi-year commitments, with support on the most complex deals.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by watching deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment across your accounts; run save motions on at-risk accounts, pulling in CSM, Support, and leadership when needed; flag overdeployment/downgrade exposure and get ahead of it before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across both renewal and expansion pipeline for your book; keep Salesforce and CPQ/quoting tools current, with accurate stages and a renewal/expansion pipeline you can defend; structure and close deals cleanly, using approved pricing and quote automation.
  • Partner with CSMs on account coverage so there is no gap or overlap, and with AEs and SEs on expansion opportunities; partner with our Channel/MSSP partners on renewal continuity and baseline growth for partner-managed accounts; bring the customer's voice back to Product and the broader team, including what is working, what is stuck, and where the next opportunity is.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3 to 5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role, with upsell/cross-sell closing experience on your record, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100 percent on your own book (expansion outpacing churn), not just renewal completion.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell/cross-sell motions and identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base.
  • Comfort managing multi-stakeholder conversations and negotiations, with direct experience negotiating with senior/economic buyers.
  • A risk-aware instinct: you notice the early signals of churn or downgrade and act before renewal time.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and CRM hygiene; hands-on with Salesforce and CPQ/quote tools.
  • Strong communication and organization, curiosity about customer use-cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations without being prompted.
  • Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus, not a requirement.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Position Summary

Arctera is seeking an elite, highly motivated Principal Account Executive to drive net-new logo acquisition and revenue expansion across highly regulated industries (Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma, Energy, and Government).

In this strategic role, you will own the entire end-to-end sales lifecycle—from initial strategic targeting through complex technical evaluations to final contract negotiation. You will be responsible for positioning Arctera's enterprise-grade information governance, AI compliance, risk management, and cybersecurity SaaS solutions directly to C-suite and executive buyers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Revenue Ownership: Own, manage, and close a highly strategic enterprise pipeline to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual ARR targets.
  • C-Suite Engagement: Identify, engage, and build trusted-advisor relationships with key executive stakeholders, including Chief Compliance Officers, CIOs, CISOs, General Counsels, and Chief Risk Officers.
  • Complex Deal Orchestration: Lead multi-stakeholder, long-cycle enterprise sales processes ($500K-$1M+ ARR) involving rigorous technical assessments, security reviews, and legal/procurement negotiations.

  • Value-Based Selling: Conduct deep discovery and deliver tailored, high-impact business cases demonstrating ROI, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance (e.g., SEC, FINRA, GDPR).

  • Develop, update, and maintain Medical Information resources, including response documents, handling guides, scientific content, and other materials used to support Medical Information inquiries.
  • Evaluate scientific literature, clinical guidelines, data insights, and inquiry trends to identify scientific gaps and inform clear, appropriate, and medically accurate content.

  • Coordinate Medical Information operational readiness for product launches, lifecycle management activities, congresses, scientific meetings, organizational changes, and call center training needs.
  • Provide Medical Information congress planning support for assigned therapeutic area(s), including coordination of booth staffing, staff training, and related Medical Information activities at designated scientific meetings.
  • Participate in the medical review of medical and promotional materials, as needed, to ensure scientific accuracy, balance, and compliance.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Commercial, and other stakeholders to align Medical Information activities, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategic solutions.

jobs.excerpt: Aus Fachwissen Lernangebote schaffen, die in der Pflege ankommen Als Pflegepädagoge E Learning & Webinarentwicklung (m/w/d) entwickelst du digitale Fortbildungsangebote, die Pflegefachkräfte in ihrem Arbeitsalltag wirklich weiterbringen.
jobs.description:
Aus Fachwissen Lernangebote schaffen, die in der Pflege ankommen

Als Pflegepädagoge E Learning & Webinarentwicklung (m/w/d) entwickelst du digitale Fortbildungsangebote, die Pflegefachkräfte in ihrem Arbeitsalltag wirklich weiterbringen. Deutschlandweit remote verbindest du pflegepädagogische Expertise mit zeitgemäßer Wissensvermittlung und gestaltest Lernformate, die verständlich, relevant und praxisnah sind.

Was du bewirkst

  • Entwickelst digitale Fortbildungsangebote, die Pflegefachkräfte gezielt bei den Herausforderungen ihres Berufsalltags unterstützen
  • Übersetzt komplexe Fachthemen in Lerninhalte, die verständlich sind und sich direkt in die Praxis übertragen lassen
  • Konzipierst Webinare, digitale Lernstrecken und E Learning Inhalte, die Wissen nachhaltig vermitteln und zum Austausch anregen
  • Begleitest neue Bildungsangebote von der ersten Idee über das didaktische Konzept bis zur konkreten Umsetzung
  • Erstellst Drehbücher und pädagogische Konzepte für synchrone und asynchrone Lernformate
  • Führst Webinare und digitale Lernveranstaltungen durch und sorgst dafür, dass aus Zuhören echtes Verstehen wird
  • Entwickelst bestehende Inhalte gemeinsam mit dem pädagogischen Team weiter und bringst dabei deine eigene fachliche Perspektive ein
  • Berücksichtigst fachliche Anforderungen und Anerkennungsvorgaben im Fortbildungsumfeld, ohne dabei die Lernenden aus dem Blick zu verlieren
  • Lernst die bestehenden Produkte sowie die Bedürfnisse der Kund:innen kennen und entwickelst daraus Bildungsangebote mit echtem Praxisbezug

Was du mitbringst

  • Verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Pflegepädagogik oder in einer vergleichbaren relevanten Fachrichtung
  • Besitzt eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Praxisanleiter:in
  • Bringst praktische Erfahrung aus dem Pflegeumfeld mit und kennst die Anforderungen, die Pflegefachkräfte im Arbeitsalltag begleiten
  • Hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Entwicklung von Bildungsangeboten
  • Bereitest Fachwissen didaktisch fundiert, zielgruppengerecht und verständlich auf
  • Vermittelst Inhalte souverän in digitalen Live Formaten und schaffst einen Austausch auf Augenhöhe
  • Entwickelst Konzepte und Lerninhalte eigenständig von Grund auf und bringst sie strukturiert in die Umsetzung

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Bringst Erfahrung in der Fortbildung und Weiterbildung von Pflegefachkräften mit
  • Kennst die Entwicklung digitaler und asynchroner Lernformate

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Pädagogisches Gespür Du erkennst, welche Inhalte Menschen wirklich weiterbringen und wie aus Fachwissen ein nachhaltiges Lernerlebnis entsteht
  • Kommunikationsstärke Du vermittelst auch anspruchsvolle Themen verständlich, souverän und mit einem guten Gefühl für deine Zielgruppe
  • Gestaltungsfreude Du wartest nicht auf die perfekte Vorlage, sondern entwickelst Ideen, strukturierst sie und bringst sie ins Ziel
  • Eigenverantwortung Du organisierst deine Themen selbstständig, setzt klare Prioritäten und behältst auch bei mehreren Konzepten den Überblick

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Du entscheidest: Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad – wir unterstützen Dich flexibel mit einem Zuschuss von bis zu 60 € monatlich. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von exklusiven Vergünstigungen mit Corporate Benefits
  • Du kannst auf uns zählen – TELUS Health stärkt Dich mit individuellen Angeboten für Deine mentale Gesundheit
  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen

Summary:

This position is responsible for maintaining database availability, integrity, performance, security, and recoverability while supporting application, reporting, and data requirements.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Install, configure, upgrade and maintain database(s) and underlying server infrastructure. This includes updating processes, data flows, and objects (usually shown in diagrams).
  • Maintain databases at recommended maintenance levels prescribed by the product manufacturer.
  • Monitor data retrieval from the database to determine performance improvements.
  • Provide database performance tuning in support of improving applications performance and system-wide database contention and concurrent user tuning.
  • Maintain performance and tuning plans for online processes and databases.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to allow existing exterior systems to exchange data and provide unique support required for various database applications.
  • Maintain a complete inventory of database and application interconnections and interfaces.
  • Assure maximum continuity of operations by minimizing database and data replication downtime associated with database modification or recovery.
  • Perform data/database backup and recovery routines for data integrity and recoverability.
  • Provide support to software and report developers with developing efficient application and report queries.
  • Provide support to software and report developers to troubleshoot issues that may be database or data related.
  • Maintain changes to the existing database structures and maintain software to provide synchronization.
  • Develop database solutions for application requirements when defined.
  • Perform production control and quality control functions (batch submissions, checking and corrections).
  • Merge data from various data sources import/export data from databases; extract and combine data from different sources.
  • Ensure that input data and output data and databases are correct and continually checked for accuracy and completeness.
  • Correct data accuracy and completeness errors when identified.
  • Produce exports of specific subsets of data.
  • Provide analysis of data and anomaly identification.
  • Recommend and implement corrective measures.
  • Develop data management and analysis procedures.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Advanced knowledge of database administration, development, performance tuning, backup/recovery, and data management.
  • Knowledge of database architecture, structures, interfaces, data flows, and integration.
  • Knowledge of database security, availability, integrity, and recoverability practices.
  • Knowledge of data quality, analysis, and data management principles.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex database and data-related problems.
  • Ability to develop database solutions supporting application requirements.
  • Ability to analyze data quality, performance, and system behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in database administration, database development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience administering production databases.
  • Experience with database performance monitoring and tuning.
  • Experience with database backup, recovery, and data integrity processes.
  • Experience developing or maintaining database interfaces and data exchanges.
  • Required to successfully pass a background investigation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Database Administration, or a related technical field.

Pay and Benefits

The annual salary range for this position is $130,000 to $140,000.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. jobs.excerpt: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006.
jobs.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

Tu seras responsable de la façon dont Workleap détecte les menaces, enquête et y répond, chez Workleap comme chez ShareGate, et tu bâtiras la couche d'IA qui fait tourner tout ça. Nos outils de sécurité génèrent plus de bruit qu'une petite équipe peut en traiter, et trop de constats sont ambigus ou erronés. Ce rôle existe maintenant pour transformer la détection et la réponse en un système où des agents trient, enrichissent et enquêtent, et où les humains prennent les décisions qui demandent vraiment du jugement. C'est un rôle de contributeur.trice individuel.le de niveau Staff, très concret, sans gestion d'équipe.

Ton impact :

  • Bâtir le pipeline qui fait tourner les opérations de sécurité de bout en bout : les intégrations qui extraient les alertes et les constats de chaque outil source, un système agentique qui les trie, les enrichit, les corrèle et rédige l'enquête, et une connexion à Jira qui achemine chaque résultat vers l'équipe responsable avec les preuves et une voie de correction, pour qu'aucun constat ne soit jamais recopié à la main ;
  • Définir le modèle de confiance de ces agents : ce qu'ils ferment seuls, ce qu'ils recommandent et ce qui revient toujours à un humain, appuyé par des evals et protégé contre l'injection de prompt et l'abus de permissions ;
  • Éliminer les faux positifs et les constats mal évalués de nos outils de sécurité, pour que chaque constat qui arrive à une personne soit réel et bien priorisé ;
  • Piloter l'ingénierie de détection de bout en bout, écrite sous forme de code et alignée sur MITRE ATT&CK, pour que la couverture survive à tout changement de plateforme ;
  • Mener la réponse aux incidents de sécurité, du triage au postmortem, avec des agents qui rassemblent les preuves, et tenir notre partenaire de détection gérée à un standard mesurable ;
  • Faire de la sécurité un partenaire que les équipes de développement veulent avoir, en livrant les constats dans leur flux de travail avec des preuves claires et une voie de correction.

Ton équipe

Au cours des 12 prochains mois, LeapSec livre deux paris stratégiques : intégrer la sécurité dans les squads produit, avec des agents qui portent le travail de vulnérabilités et de détection, et automatiser la collecte de preuves SOC 2 pour que personne n'ait à la faire à la main. Tu seras responsable du volet détection et réponse : nettoyer l'outillage, bâtir les agents et démontrer jusqu'où on peut leur faire confiance.

LeapSec regroupe les Opérations de sécurité et la Conformité pour Workleap et ShareGate. Tu relèveras du directeur Infrastructure et Sécurité et tu travailleras au quotidien avec notre spécialiste Staff en sécurité applicative et l'équipe d'outillage de sécurité, et au besoin avec l'Infrastructure, l'ITX et l'ingénierie produit. On est une petite équipe avec un large mandat : on suit le travail honnêtement dans Jira, on livre à dates fixes et on s'attend à ce que chacun.e prenne ses résultats en charge de bout en bout.

Notre environnement est d'abord Azure, avec aujourd'hui une plateforme SIEM et XDR infonuagique, Zscaler, Cloudflare et un partenaire de détection gérée. On choisit nos outils au mérite et on compte continuer à le faire.

Ce que tu apportes

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français;
  • 7 ans et plus en opérations de sécurité, réponse aux incidents ou ingénierie de détection, avec une expérience pratique récente dans un environnement SaaS infonuagique ;
  • Une solide expérience des constats qui ne sont pas clairs : valider ce que les outils signalent, éliminer les faux positifs à la source et trancher, avec des preuves incomplètes, si quelque chose est réel ;
  • Des années à travailler directement avec des équipes de développement, à faire livrer des correctifs sans autorité formelle et à préserver la relation quand la réponse est non ;
  • De l'expérience à bâtir et déployer des systèmes d'agents pour la sécurité dont d'autres dépendent, comme des serveurs MCP, des skills Claude ou des outils sur mesure, avec des evals qui déterminent quand leurs résultats sont fiables ;
  • Une bonne compréhension de la façon dont les systèmes agentiques échouent et sont attaqués, notamment l'injection de prompt, la gestion des permissions des outils et des identifiants ;
  • L'ingénierie de détection comme discipline : détections sous forme de code, un langage de requête SIEM que tu maîtrises et des taux de faux positifs réellement mesurés ;
  • Une solide compréhension des chemins d'attaque liés à l'identité et à l'infonuagique, idéalement dans Azure et Entra ID ;
  • Atout : expérience à diriger un partenaire de détection gérée, en chasse aux menaces ou en forensique, et aisance en français.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 125 000$ - 160 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme de bonus annuel.
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

Meet the Team

Join Cisco’s Splunk Integrated Core Platform team and help shape the architecture behind the authorization infrastructure that powers Splunk’s enterprise observability and security platform.

Our Authorization team tackles some of the most sophisticated challenges in distributed systems, identity, and access control. We design high-performance services that establish trust and enforce authorization across interconnected systems, leveraging attribute-based and role-based access control (ABAC/RBAC) to support complex enterprise environments.

With a substantial C++ codebase and an evolving Go-based, cloud-native architecture, our team offers a unique opportunity to work on deep architectural challenges, influence long-term technical direction, and build foundational systems serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


Your Impact

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Splunk Platform Authorization team, you’ll help shape the architecture of systems that enable secure, high-performance authorization across Splunk’s enterprise platform. You’ll take ownership of technically complex initiatives, make critical design decisions, and work across engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions. This is a hands-on technical leadership opportunity where you’ll influence long-term platform architecture while contributing directly to the development and evolution of our core systems.

  • Architect, design, and develop high-performance backend services using C++, while contributing to Go-based services and the modernization of Splunk’s core platform.
  • Lead technical design discussions and make architectural decisions involving distributed systems, scalability, performance, reliability, and service-to-service trust.
  • Own complex engineering initiatives from design through execution, breaking down large projects, identifying opportunities for parallel development, and coordinating work across engineers.
  • Improve and modernize large-scale C++ infrastructure, addressing architectural complexity, technical debt, and the transition toward cloud-native and Kubernetes-based services.
  • Provide technical guidance through design and code reviews, collaborate across teams, and contribute to production reliability, troubleshooting, and operational support.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience; or a Master’s degree with 4+ years of relevant experience; or a PhD with 1+ year of relevant experience.
  • Software development experience in C++, including designing, maintaining, or enhancing complex backend systems.
  • Experience designing and developing distributed systems or large-scale backend services in production environments.
  • Prior experience in software architecture, technical design, and translating complex requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives, coordinating implementation across engineers, and driving projects from design through delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Go and cloud-native infrastructure, including Kubernetes, containers, or microservices.
  • Experience designing high-performance, highly available systems operating at enterprise scale.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization, RBAC/ABAC, or service-to-service trust models.
  • Experience modernizing large legacy codebases, addressing architectural complexity, and improving system reliability and performance.
  • Experience with observability platforms, enterprise infrastructure, security systems, or highly distributed cloud services.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

You’ll join a newly formed Technical Account Management team built to make sure every Smartcat customer, at every tier, can reach a human technical expert 24/7. AI already resolves a growing share of customer issues, so you’ll own the escalations beyond what AI can handle: technical troubleshooting, integrations, and workflow questions, solved in an AI-forward way. You’ll be assigned a portfolio of accounts, and on our largest accounts you’ll be the named technical resource and work directly with the account executive.

MISSION

Be the trusted technical expert behind Smartcat’s customers: meet their needs with passion and approachability, resolve complex escalations with AI-first problem solving, keep integrations and workflows healthy, and give customers around the world fast, expert technical support at any hour.

OUTCOMES

  • Act as the technical point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts within your tier (Strategic, Enterprise, or Corporate), partnering with the account team on each
  • Take ownership of customer escalations that go beyond what Smartcat’s AI capabilities can resolve, using technical troubleshooting and AI tools to reach resolution quickly

On Enterprise and Corporate accounts, you’ll cover a larger number of accounts, with less day-to-day customer-facing time and more emphasis on efficient, AI-powered issue resolution.

  • Learn how AI handles first-line customer issues today, where human escalation takes over, and how tickets flow through Zendesk and YouTrack
  • Meet your account team, Support, Product, and Engineering counterparts, and get oriented on your assigned accounts: architecture, integrations, open issues, and health signals

  • Lead technical onboarding or integration work for at least one account

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED

  • Working knowledge of REST APIs and webhooks, and comfort reading logs and debugging integration failures; scripting experience (Python or JavaScript) is a plus
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as Zendesk and YouTrack
  • The ability to explain technical root cause to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and to run a technical workshop with a customer’s team and then summarize it cleanly for their VP
  • Comfort owning multiple accounts at once and prioritizing under pressure, including during crisis de-escalation
  • Experience working on remote, globally distributed teams
  • Openness to feedback and to others’ opinions and ideas, and eagerness to grow
  • Bonus: technical support or quality assurance experience, and experience with CMS/TMS integrations or content supply chain tooling

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

  • A global, connected team We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.

Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
  • Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation.
