jobs.description:
Overview

JOB TITLE: Senior ServiceNow Developer

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: Department of State

POSITION INFORMATION: Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting federal agency clients

LOCATION: Fully Remote (U.S.); availability during East Coast business hours required

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

CLEARANCE: Must have, at minimum, an active Interim Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a final Secret clearance.

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Developer to design, build, and deploy ServiceNow solutions for our federal agency clients. This role owns complex builds from requirements through rollout—custom applications, Service Catalog items, Flow Designer automations, IntegrationHub integrations, and the server- and client-side scripting underneath them—with the judgment to recognize when well-configured baseline functionality is a better answer than another custom script. The Senior ServiceNow Developer sets and enforces development standards, mentors other developers, leads peer reviews, and represents technical solutions in client-facing design discussions, keeping the instance clean, upgradeable, and maintainable long after go-live.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build & Configure
    • Design, develop, test, and deploy ServiceNow configurations, custom applications, and automated workflows.
    • Write and maintain server-side and client-side JavaScript using Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, and ACLs.
    • Favor configuration over customization, keeping the instance upgradeable and avoiding custom scripts that create long-term technical debt.
  • Service Catalog & Workflow Automation
    • Build advanced Service Catalog items, including catalog client scripts, UI policies, variable sets, and record producers.
    • Design and build Flow Designer automations that are readable and maintainable by developers who did not build them.
    • Deliver request experiences that end users adopt willingly rather than work around.
  • ITSM Platform
    • Support ongoing improvement and optimization of core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management.
    • Partner with business analysts and platform administrators on process design, advising when a requested configuration will create risk in future releases.
  • Integrations
    • Design and implement integrations with third-party systems using REST and SOAP web services and IntegrationHub.
    • Build the transforms, error handling, and retry logic that keep integrations reliable and supportable over time.
  • Quality, Release & Compliance
    • Execute unit, integration, and regression testing, including Automated Test Framework (ATF) coverage, with the goal of clean deployments.
    • Maintain update sets, release documentation, and technical design records so every release can be explained and, if necessary, reversed.
    • Identify risks, dependencies, and design gaps early in the development lifecycle, when they are still inexpensive to fix.
    • Ensure solutions meet federal IT standards, including Section 508 accessibility and FISMA/NIST security controls.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship
    • Mentor developers and promote ServiceNow development best practices across the delivery team.
    • Set and enforce development standards, and lead code reviews, peer reviews, release management support, and governance and compliance checks.
    • Participate in client calls and technical design discussions, translating business requirements into clear, actionable technical solutions.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development and configuration experience, including experience guiding or mentoring other developers.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited University, required.
  • Strong platform scripting skills, including server-side and client-side JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, and Script Includes.
  • Experience building Service Catalog items, workflows or Flow Designer automations, and integrations using REST, SOAP, and IntegrationHub.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex builds from requirements through rollout.
  • A track record of setting or enforcing development standards on a team and representing technical solutions in client-facing discussions.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently and across technical and functional teams.

PREFERRED:

  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and at least one ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification (CIS-ITSM preferred; additional CIS tracks such as CSM are a plus).
  • Hands-on proficiency with the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).
  • Experience with release coordination, version control, and automated testing strategies.
  • Prior experience supporting federal or defense contracting environments.
  • Experience with Service Portal, UI Builder, or the Now Experience framework.
  • Development experience outside ServiceNow, including JavaScript, REST and SOAP integrations, or other platforms.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM, IT asset and configuration management, and ITIL practices.

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have, at minimum, an active Interim Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a final Secret clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to the nature of this government contract.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This is a fully remote position within the U.S. Candidate must be available during East Coast business hours for client workshops and stakeholder sessions; occasional travel may be required for major planning events. No relocation or office reporting is expected.

jobs.description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

At Step, we believe the gap between design and engineering should be as close to zero as possible. We're looking for a Design Systems Engineer to help make that vision a reality.

This role sits at the intersection of design and engineering, owning the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that allow our teams to build beautiful, consistent, high-quality products at speed. You'll work across Figma, code, and AI-powered workflows to ensure our design system isn't just documented—it lives equally in design and production.

You'll partner closely with Product Design and Engineering leadership to evolve our design platform, reduce friction in the product development process, and create a future where moving from an idea to production is faster, more reliable, and nearly lossless.

This isn't a role for someone who simply enjoys maintaining component libraries. We're looking for someone who enjoys building the platform that enables great product teams to do their best work.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the connection between our design system and production code, ensuring they evolve together rather than separately
  • Build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, and shared foundations across iOS, Android, and Web
  • Partner closely with Product Designers to translate high-fidelity designs into production-quality components with exceptional visual accuracy
  • Collaborate with Engineering to create scalable component architecture that is flexible, performant, accessible, and easy for teams to adopt
  • Continuously improve our design-to-code workflow through better tooling, automation, documentation, and developer experience
  • Develop systems that allow designers and engineers to move faster while maintaining an exceptionally high bar for quality and consistency
  • Improve governance around component APIs, tokens, naming conventions, versioning, and adoption across teams
  • Review implementations, identify opportunities to improve the design system, and raise the overall quality of our products
  • Explore and build AI-powered workflows that improve how we design, build, document, and maintain our products
  • Help shape the future of how product development happens at Step

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience building and evolving design systems for modern consumer software products
  • Strong frontend engineering experience building reusable component libraries and design infrastructure
  • Deep understanding of design tokens, component architecture, accessibility, documentation, and modern design system best practices
  • Strong understanding of Figma and how modern design teams build and maintain systems
  • A systems thinker who naturally looks beyond individual components to improve the entire product development workflow
  • An exceptional eye for visual detail and a passion for building interfaces that feel polished and intentional
  • Someone who enjoys collaborating equally with designers and engineers and can comfortably speak both languages
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence technical and product decisions across disciplines
  • Curiosity about AI and emerging design tools, with a desire to continually rethink how products are designed and built
  • Experience shipping high-quality mobile or web applications
  • A portfolio or examples of work demonstrating both technical execution and thoughtful design systems thinking

Even better if you have:

  • Experience with React Native or building cross-platform component libraries
  • Experience building token pipelines or design system tooling
  • Experience with Storybook or similar documentation platforms
  • Experience building Figma plugins or internal developer tools
  • Experience using AI to improve design workflows, automate repetitive work, or build design tooling

Logistics

Location: Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Reports to: Head of Design

Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

jobs.excerpt: Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company?
jobs.description:
Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Join us at SB Energy, a leading infrastructure company backed by SoftBank Group and Ares Infrastructure, pairing cutting-edge innovation with best-in-class execution. Our mission is to deliver reliable and secure data center and power infrastructure to strengthen America's future.

Founded in 2019, SB Energy is a SoftBank Group company headquartered in Redwood City, California. In 2026, SoftBank Group and OpenAI announced a $1 billion investment to support SB Energy as their leading development and execution partner for data center campuses, while Ares Infrastructure continues its long-standing support of the company's growth. SB Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates some of the largest and most technically advanced energy and data center infrastructure projects in the United States. Since its founding, the company has rapidly grown into a top-tier integrated platform with more than 3 gigawatts (GW) in operation and a multi-GW pipeline of energy and data center infrastructure nationwide.

SB Energy also leverages a strong culture of innovation to identify and integrate new technologies into its projects, including its AI-based digital platform, delivering energy infrastructure that is local, reliable, and matched to load. We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today.

Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition!

Basic Function:

SB Energy is seeking a Permitting Senior Manager dedicated to the Data Center team.

In this role, you will lead building, civil, fire and life safety, and operational permitting for SB Energy’s data center campuses and supporting facilities. You will organize complex approval workflows, establish clear responsibilities, and integrate permit schedules with phased construction, occupancy, and operational readiness across projects and jurisdictions.

This role requires strong management skills, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to hold multidisciplinary teams and consultants accountable for timely, complete deliverables. You will own the Data Center team’s permitting execution and partner with Development, Real Estate, Legal, and environmental specialists on related land-use, site-control, and environmental approvals.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead building and civil permits for data centers and support facilities, including site development, grading, drainage, roads, utilities, foundations, core and shell, interiors, and coordinated trade permits.
  • Establish and maintain a consolidated permit matrix identifying jurisdiction, scope, applicant, responsible owner, prerequisites, submission dates, review durations, approval milestones, conditions, and expiration dates.
  • Integrate permitting activities with design and construction schedules; identify critical dependencies, required design maturity, agency review cycles, and sequencing for early works and phased permit packages.
  • Lead recurring coordination meetings with clear agendas, decisions, action owners, and due dates; track commitments through closure and resolve handoff gaps between teams.
  • Direct permitting consultants and coordinate architects, civil engineers, contractors, and internal stakeholders; establish scopes, resource plans, deliverable expectations, and accountability for performance.
  • Manage application readiness reviews, submission logistics, fees, agency comments, and resubmittals; confirm packages contain coordinated drawings, calculations, forms, and required supporting studies.
  • Lead fire and life safety permitting with design professionals, fire marshals, and building officials, including fire protection systems, fire alarm, access, and applicable fuel-storage and hazardous-material approvals.
  • Maintain controlled records application versions, agency correspondence, and approvals so teams work from consistent information.
  • Assess permitting impacts of changes to building locations, utility routes, access roads, staging and laydown areas, and construction phasing; coordinate amendments before affected work proceeds.
  • Partner with Development, Real Estate, and Legal to align submissions with verified site control, parcel boundaries, ownership information, easements, access agreements, and parcel consolidation or subdivision requirements.
  • Support Development-led environmental permitting by coordinating design inputs and schedules for wetlands and streams, stormwater, air, species, and cultural-resource reviews, as applicable.
  • Maintain risk and issue registers; flag missing inputs, overdue decisions, and potential delays early, and present recovery plans, options, and leadership decisions needed.
  • Develop repeatable processes, dashboards, templates, and lessons learned; coach contributors and strengthen permitting execution across the portfolio.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in permitting, land development, design management, or construction delivery, including substantial responsibility for building and civil approvals on complex projects.
  • Demonstrated management experience leading multidisciplinary teams and external consultants, establishing ownership, allocating resources, resolving conflicts, and driving commitments to completion.
  • Proven ability to organize simultaneous permitting workstreams across multiple buildings, parcels, phases, and jurisdictions under demanding schedules.
  • Strong working knowledge of building, civil, fire and life safety, and operational permitting, including agency reviews, inspections, occupancy approvals, and recurring permit requirements.
  • Experience building integrated schedules, permit matrices, responsibility assignments, action logs, risk registers, and concise leadership reporting.
  • Ability to read architectural and civil drawings, site plans, surveys, permit boundaries, and technical reports and identify missing information or conflicting assumptions.
  • Strong written communication, meeting facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, including effective engagement with permitting authorities.
  • Proficiency with project tracking and scheduling tools, Excel, document-control systems, and drawing-review platforms such as Bluebeam.
  • Data center or mission-critical campus experience preferred; experience with phased construction, Section 401/404 coordination, construction stormwater permits, and complex land assemblies is valuable.
  • Professional credentials such as PMP, AICP, PE, or RA preferred but not required

Location: Redwood City, CA or Denver, CO or San Diego, CA or Remote

Base Pay: $150,000-$200,000

For example, we’re proud to support access and opportunity in engineering and clean energy through impactful mentorship programs and workforce training. Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

The team’s primary focus during the design stage is to shape the functional architecture and system capabilities that will rapidly modernize the customer’s product line. Day-to-day activities will include (but are not limited to) requirements governance, architecture definition, system documentation, CONOPs development, and integration guidance/planning. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The KSA C4I Team is seeking a systems engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will:

  • Decompose customer requirements and use cases into system capabilities and functions
  • Perform requirements tracing to ensure that the necessary system and subsystems are developed in accordance with customer requirements/expectations
  • Create/refine MBSE models depicting system architecture and system activity/sequence diagrams
  • Help contribute to various SE CDRL documents, including (but not limited to): SEMP, ICD, SDD’s, TEMP
  • Help refine and develop overall system CONOPs to ensure planned modernization capabilities continue to meet the overall mission needs

PLEASE NOTE

  • This position may require travel to customer sites throughout the KSA.
  • This position may occasionally support off-hours test events, including overnight and weekend activities.

WHO WE ARE

The KSA C4I Modernization Team is a geographically dispersed project team that will operate in an Agile Scrum environment. Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

Come be a part of a rapidly developing, fast-paced project team that is empowered to quickly develop and iterate potential design upgrades, with a condensed feedback loop that allows for quick iterations on proposed updates. This customer environment is a unique experience for an engineer to put their stamp on drafting new system functionality with a very engaged customer in an accelerated design cycle. If the thought rapidly performing various design activities and growing your knowledge on the numerous types of systems engineering artifacts that are developed and delivered as part of design stage of a modernization upgrade project is exciting, then the KSA C4I Team is the place to be!

This team/position is contingent upon contract award.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in MBSE (Cameo, Rhapsody)
  • Experience Owning Requirements Traceability across various levels of systems/subsystems (DOORS, Jama)
  • Experience with Use Case and CONOPs Definition/Decomposition
  • Experience owning System/Subsystem Architecture Defintion/Decomposition
  • Experience Developing CDRL Documentation
  • 7+ years of relevant work experience

Desired Skills

  • Experience eliciting requirements/needs from customer interactions

  • Experience in Agile Methodologies & Tools

Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) is a market leader in online casino and sports betting, currently operating real-money gaming with our brands: BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com, and RushBet.co. We’re building bridges between online, social and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.

The Product Manager is responsible for driving product initiatives within the casino area, from problem discovery through to delivery handoff and outcome measurement. Working under the guidance of the Director, Casino Product Management, this role owns day-to-day stakeholder engagement, problem definition, initiative shaping, and roadmap management within the casino product vertical, encompassing areas such as game content and merchandising, lobby experience and navigation, promotions and bonusing mechanics, and core gameplay features across casino games.

Product Managers collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, validate problems, and shape well-defined epics. They are expected to be hands-on practitioners who bring analytical rigor, player empathy, and commercial awareness to every initiative.

This role requires a strong understanding of the online casino ecosystem, including slot and live dealer game mechanics, lobby merchandising and discovery, bonusing and free-play structures, and the player engagement loops that drive casino-specific retention and monetization. The Product Manager will work closely with Casino Operations, Data, and CRM teams to ensure the game catalog, lobby experience, and promotional mechanics reflect player preferences and deliver measurable engagement, retention, and revenue outcomes. Operating within the fast-paced and highly regulated online gaming and sports betting industry, success in this role depends on strong analytical skills, a data-driven mindset, and an understanding of the regulatory landscape that shapes product decisions across multiple markets.

Our mission is to engage and delight players by delivering fun, fair, friendly, and focused experiences. We are committed to transparency, responsible gaming, and building an award-winning platform that provides exciting, differentiated, and personalized offerings to our customers.

What You'll Do:

Product Discovery & Problem Definition

  • Conduct discovery activities to identify, validate, and prioritize problems and opportunities within your product area
  • Develop a strong understanding of player needs, business goals, and operational constraints through research, data analysis, and stakeholder conversations
  • Translate inputs from stakeholders, data, and player feedback into clearly defined problem statements and opportunity spaces

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain productive working relationships with stakeholders across the business domain
  • Ensure stakeholders have visibility into priorities, tradeoffs, and progress within your product area
  • Communicate roadmap updates, initiative status, and outcomes clearly and consistently

Ideation & Initiative Shaping

  • Collaborate with Design, Data, and Engineering to ideate product solutions that address validated problems
  • Shape initiatives into well-defined epics, including:
    • Clear problem statement and context
    • Value hypothesis and expected impact
    • Success metrics and measurement approach
    • High-level solution direction and scope
    • Initial wireframes or conceptual designs where applicable

Roadmap Management

  • Contribute to and maintain the product roadmap for your area, ensuring alignment with the broader product strategy set by senior product leadership
  • Prioritize initiatives based on impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance
  • Continuously refine the roadmap based on new insights, data and changing conditions

Outcome Ownership & Impact Assessment

  • Define success metrics for each initiative and ensure proper measurement is in place
  • Evaluate the impact of delivered initiatives against expected outcomes
  • Take accountability for results, identifying gaps and recommending follow-up actions
  • Feed learnings back into future discovery and roadmap planning

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Leverage analytics platforms, A/B testing frameworks, and player behavior data to inform product discovery, prioritization, and post-launch evaluation
  • Partner with Data and Analytics teams to define KPIs, build dashboards, and run experiments within your product area
  • Use quantitative and qualitative research methods to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes

Regulatory & Responsible Gaming Awareness

  • Factor regulatory requirements, licensing conditions, and market-specific compliance considerations into product decisions within your area
  • Support responsible gaming principles by ensuring product features align with player safety and responsible play standards
  • Stay informed on relevant regulations across RSI’s operating markets and flag product implications to senior leadership

Personalization & Player Experience

  • Contribute to product initiatives that enhance personalization, player engagement, and retention within your area
  • Collaborate with CRM, Marketing, and Data teams to support tailored player journeys and differentiated offerings
  • Advocate for the player experience in product decisions, ensuring alignment with RSI’s mission

Collaboration with Technology & Product Delivery

  • Partner with Product Owners and the Product Delivery organization, providing clear, well-defined epics that are ready for delivery planning
  • Serve as a point of contact for stakeholders on product needs within your scope
  • Ensure initiatives meet a high bar of readiness before handoff, including clear problem definition, scope, success metrics, and business context
  • Collaborate with Technology Product Managers to support solution shaping, ensuring alignment between product intent and technical approach
  • Work with Product Owners during delivery planning to clarify intent, resolve ambiguities, and support prioritization decisions
  • Stay available throughout delivery to answer questions, validate assumptions, and ensure alignment with the original problem and expected impact
  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts around handoff quality and planning effectiveness

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business administration, information systems, data science, marketing, economics, engineering, or a relevant field required.
  • 5+ years in product management with progressive responsibility, including ownership of product roadmaps and cross-functional stakeholder management.
  • Experience in iGaming, online casino, sports betting, or adjacent regulated consumer tech industries.
  • Familiarity with agile delivery, A/B testing, and analytics platforms.
  • Able to travel occasionally both domestically and internationally

  • Growth – we want you to develop personally as well as professionally

As a rapidly growing company in an emerging industry, you’ll have a huge impact on our product and our company. We like proactive team members and strive to have a company of self-disciplined professionals who enjoy collaboration, having fun, and of course, achieving together what others believe to be improbable. jobs.excerpt: Driven by Innovation and built on Trust, rockITdata partners with leading commercial and government organizations to deliver innovative technology solutions and measurable business outcomes.
jobs.description:
Driven by Innovation and built on Trust, rockITdata partners with leading commercial and government organizations to deliver innovative technology solutions and measurable business outcomes.

rockITdata is seeking a highly experienced Senior Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Federal Healthcare IT Acquisition & Contracts to provide expert-level consulting and strategic advisory services supporting complex federal healthcare technology modernization initiatives.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in federal acquisition, contract strategy, enterprise technology licensing, and complex contractual arrangements, with a strong understanding of large-scale healthcare IT programs. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to program and executive leadership, providing independent analysis, strategic recommendations, and subject matter expertise related to acquisition planning, contract terms and conditions, commercial licensing arrangements, and contractual risk mitigation.

This position requires an independent, strategic thinker capable of evaluating complex contractual and technical challenges, developing innovative solutions, and advising senior stakeholders on high-visibility initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert-level consulting and strategic advisory services related to federal acquisition, contract management, and complex healthcare IT modernization programs.

  • Provide strategic advisory support to program and executive leadership on acquisition strategies, contract structures, commercial agreements, and contractual risk mitigation.

  • Analyze complex contract terms, conditions, pricing structures, licensing arrangements, and performance requirements to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended business positions.

  • Conduct independent analysis of complex contractual arrangements, including cost and pricing structures, enterprise software licensing, intellectual property, data rights, and long-term sustainment considerations, to inform business decisions.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), and applicable federal contracting policies and procedures.

  • Evaluate contract requirements, statements of work, acquisition documentation, and proposed contractual changes to ensure alignment with program objectives and business requirements.

  • Advise on acquisition and contracting considerations associated with large-scale electronic health record (EHR) implementations, enterprise technology modernization, and multi-agency healthcare initiatives.

  • Develop strategic recommendations, executive briefings, contract assessments, and decision-support materials for senior program and business leadership.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including contracts, legal, finance, technical, and program management personnel, to address complex contractual and business challenges.

  • Identify and evaluate contractual, financial, operational, and programmatic risks, recommending practical solutions to support successful contract execution.

  • Provide guidance on Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts, task orders, contract modifications, and alternative acquisition strategies.

  • Independently plan, conduct, and lead specialized research and analysis resulting in recommendations and solutions to complex, high-visibility challenges.

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert on complex federal healthcare technology contracting matters, providing independent assessments and recommendations to support informed decision-making and successful program outcomes.

  • Interface effectively with senior client and management personnel regarding strategic issues and perform effectively under demanding assignments and compressed timelines.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Acquisition Management, Contract Management, or a related discipline.

  • 20+ years of relevant professional experience in federal acquisition, government contracting, contract management, technology program management, or related fields.

  • Extensive experience with federal acquisition strategies, complex contractual arrangements, enterprise technology agreements, and advising senior leadership on federal contracting matters.

  • Demonstrated expertise in FAR, DFARS, federal procurement regulations, and government contracting practices.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software licensing, contract pricing, intellectual property, data rights, and complex technology acquisition structures.

  • Experience supporting major federal technology programs involving multiple stakeholders, significant contract values, and complex contractual requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently evaluate complex business and contractual challenges and develop innovative, actionable recommendations.

  • Exceptional analytical, written communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

  • Ability to effectively engage with senior government, contractor, and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience serving as a federal Contracting Officer, senior acquisition executive, contracting office leader, or equivalent senior contracting advisor.

  • Extensive experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), Defense Health Agency (DHA), Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Indian Health Service (IHS), or other federal healthcare organizations.

  • Experience with federal EHR acquisition, deployment, modernization, and sustainment programs.

  • Demonstrated experience assessing enterprise software licensing agreements and complex commercial technology contracts.

  • Experience conducting cost and price evaluations, source selections, and acquisition strategy development for major federal programs.

  • Familiarity with large-scale healthcare IT implementations, system integration, and multi-agency program governance.

  • Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) contracting certification or equivalent federal acquisition credentials.

  • Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or comparable professional certification.

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are seeking a Lead Solutions Marketing Manager to support the development of industry- and segment-focused positioning, content, and sales enablement for the Lumen Security portfolio. The ideal candidate brings a passion for technology and storytelling, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to simplify complex cybersecurity concepts into clear, compelling stories that connect Lumen capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.
This role will translate customer, industry, and market insights into relevant solution narratives, messaging, content, and sales enablement tailored to priority industries, segments, and buyer audiences. The work will connect Lumen Security capabilities to customer challenges and business priorities, helping buyers understand how Lumen can address their cybersecurity needs.
The Lead Solutions Marketing Manager will work closely with Solutions Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Campaign Operations, Creative, Analyst Relations, and subject matter experts to develop differentiated, market-relevant content that supports broader go-to-market priorities.
This is a highly collaborative role for a self-motivated marketer who can independently manage projects, build strong cross-functional relationships, and turn market and customer insights into compelling stories and content.

Location

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S. Occasional travel is expected for team meetings, customer engagements, sales events, and industry conferences.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Develop expertise in priority industries and customer segments, including market trends, customer needs, pain points, buying priorities, and emerging opportunities.
  • Translate complex cybersecurity and technology capabilities into clear, customer-focused messaging, value propositions, use cases, proof points, and differentiated stories.
  • Develop industry- and segment-specific messaging, narratives, and content that connect Lumen solutions to relevant customer challenges and business outcomes.
  • Create market-facing content such as solution briefs, eBooks, whitepapers, research reports, presentations, web content, and other assets that support go-to-market priorities.
  • Develop sales enablement content that helps sellers understand customer challenges, industry and segment needs, relevant use cases, and the value of Lumen solutions.
  • Adapt broader solution messaging and content for priority industries, customer segments, and buyer audiences.
  • Partner across Solutions Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Demand Generation, and other subject matter experts to ensure messaging and content are accurate, relevant, and aligned with broader priorities.
  • Incorporate customer, seller, market, and industry insights to continually strengthen messaging, content, and use cases.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
  • 5 years of experience in solutions marketing, segment marketing, industry marketing, product marketing, content marketing, or a related B2B technology role.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity topics such as network security, SASE, DDoS protection, managed security services, threat intelligence, cloud security, zero trust, or security operations.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with experience translating complex technology concepts into clear, compelling customer-facing content.
  • Strong understanding of customers, markets, and go-to-market strategy, with the ability to turn insights into relevant solution, audience, and industry marketing.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing complex B2B technology solutions, with cybersecurity, networking, cloud, managed services, or telecommunications experience preferred.
  • Experience using customer, market, audience, and pipeline insights to identify opportunities and inform marketing strategies and content.
  • Experience developing messaging, content, and marketing programs for specific industries, customer segments, buyer audiences, or technology use cases.

Overview

Nakupuna Companies is seeking a Senior Computer Systems Engineer/Architect with Informatica expertise to join our team of talented consultants. The individual will provide solution architecture execution strategy for the Informatica implementation in NAVSUP AWS GovCloud. This role is responsible for the cross-platform design, Everything as Code approach, security architecture, availability and recovery strategy, CI/CD practices, technical integration decisions, and day-to-day engineering coordination needed to move the solution from architecture through production sustainment.

The individual will support NAVSUP Business Systems Center as the senior solution architect for the design, integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and sustainment of the Informatica Data Governance Suite within NAVSUP’s AWS GovCloud environment. Develop the cross-platform architecture and engineering standards for high availability, disaster recovery, security, Everything as Code, CI/CD, monitoring, configuration management, and change control. Coordinate technical activities across the Informatica, database, cloud, cybersecurity, and testing workstreams; identify architecture dependencies and risks; and ensure technical artifacts are secure, reproducible, supportable, and ready for Government review. Support RMF/ATO activities, performance and capacity planning, operational readiness, and knowledge transfer to NAVSUP personnel.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to mission requirements and reasonable accommodation.

  • Develop the high-availability architecture recommendation and agile prototype, including component sizing, dependencies, network design, compute, storage, load balancing, capacity, and cost considerations.
  • Define reliability objectives, RTO and RPO targets, failover strategies, backup and retention methods, restoration procedures, disaster-recovery tests, and rollback plans.
  • Lead the Everything as Code approach across infrastructure, configuration, security, governance policy, testing, and CI/CD deployment; ensure artifacts are reproducible and retained in Government version control.
  • Design AWS GovCloud resources and controls, including EC2, S3, networking, routing, security groups, load balancers, IAM roles, service accounts, logging, monitoring, and approved encryption.
  • Establish technical standards for source control, branching, peer review, automated testing, automated deployment, configuration management, and change control.
  • Lead security engineering for PKI, SSO, LDAP, OCSP, certificates, RBAC, least privilege, Zero Trust, logging, vulnerability remediation, and integration with NAVSUP security operations.
  • Coordinate RMF/ATO and STIG compliance activities, including control mappings, diagrams, system-security documentation, hardening evidence, POA&M inputs, retesting, and closure support.
  • Guide Informatica platform architecture, data integration, performance testing, interoperability, and operational-readiness decisions across the team.
  • Review and approve internal technical designs, scripts, code, configurations, tests, diagrams, runbooks, and deployment packages for quality, consistency, security, and supportability.
  • Establish continuous monitoring for availability, performance, errors, capacity, cost, API metrics, and data-quality indicators using CloudWatch, Splunk, AppDynamics, Informatica, or comparable tools.
  • Coordinate technical risk management, issue resolution, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, sprint planning, milestone reviews, Government briefings, and stakeholder decision support.
  • Plan and deliver hands-on knowledge transfer so NAVSUP administrators and engineers can operate, maintain, recover, and enhance the solution.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

Skills/Qualifications:

In addition to being able to confidently perform the above job duties, the candidate should demonstrate the following:

  • Technical Leadership - Provides clear day-to-day direction across Informatica, AWS, security, testing, and sustainment work; reviews designs and engineering artifacts critically and resolves cross-platform risks before they reach production.
  • Agile / DevSecOps - Turns architecture into prioritized, testable work with clear dependencies, acceptance criteria, and decision points; establishes repeatable source-control, peer-review, automated-testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Analytical / Problem Solving - Balances mission needs, security, reliability, performance, capacity, recovery, cost, and long-term supportability; uses evidence and prototypes to resolve uncertainty and clearly frames options for Government decisions.
  • Communication / Teamwork - Communicates technical issues, risks, and tradeoffs in terms that both engineers and Government leaders can act on; creates a collaborative environment across a small multidisciplinary team and external stakeholders.
  • Quality / Coaching - Sets and enforces standards for architecture, code, configuration, tests, diagrams, runbooks, and security evidence; builds Government ownership through practical mentoring, recorded walkthroughs, and current sustainment documentation.

Education and Experience:

Education: A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or a related technical field is preferred.

Required experience: The candidate must be able to demonstrate the following:

  • 7 years of hands-on Informatica experience
  • 10 years of senior-level experience architecting working with enterprise platforms in AWS or AWS GovCloud from design through production operations.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, storage, networking, security groups, load balancing, identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, performance, capacity, and cost optimization.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Security or Policy as Code, automated testing, Git-based version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience designing high availability, backup, disaster recovery, RTO/RPO, failover, restoration testing, and rollback for production systems.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise API, data-integration, data-governance, metadata, data-quality, and relational data-warehouse architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of RMF/ATO, STIGs, NIST 800-53 controls, system hardening, PKI, SSO, RBAC, logging, vulnerability remediation, and Zero Trust concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small multidisciplinary engineering team and work directly with Government technical, security, contracting, and program stakeholders.
  • Ability to review technical work critically, resolve cross-platform issues, manage risk, and maintain clear architecture and operational documentation.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to meet all privileged-access, background-investigation, CAC, SAAR, training, certification, and NDA requirements.

Preferred experience: The following experience will strengthen the candidate's fit for this role:

jobs.title: Meta Ads Specialist (Part-Time) - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Launched in 2012, BorrowMyDoggy is the UK’s leading dog-sharing marketplace, connecting dog owners with trusted local dog lovers.
jobs.description:
Launched in 2012, BorrowMyDoggy is the UK’s leading dog-sharing marketplace, connecting dog owners with trusted local dog lovers.

We’ve recently brought Meta advertising in-house. We spend a significant budget on paid social every month, and we want our creative to work as hard as our budget does.

What it’s like working with us

We’re a fun, supportive and ambitious team where people are encouraged to take initiative and find better ways of doing things.

We’re a small company, so there’s plenty of room to make an impact, take ownership and grow into new responsibilities.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a hands-on Meta Ads Specialist to own our Meta account end to end: running campaigns and budgets, making the ads, and using data to decide what to make next.

This replaces our agency. You’ll be the person who launches, monitors and optimises campaigns, and who turns our large library of in-house and community content into static and short-form video ads, working closely with our small in-house marketing team.

This is a part-time role (1-3 days per week). It could suit a freelancer or someone who wants to add meaningful, flexible work alongside another role, consultancy or portfolio career.

You’ll work in a creative analytics tool (such as AdNova, Motion or Superads), Meta Ads Manager and AI tools, so you’ll need to be both a confident media buyer and a capable ad maker.

What you’ll do:

Run the account

  • Manage our Meta Ads account day to day: campaign structure, audiences, budgets, pacing and bids
  • Launch and test ads at pace in Meta Ads Manager and any bulk-launch tools we use
  • Monitor performance daily and shift budget towards what’s working; pause what isn’t
  • Keep tracking and conversion data healthy (Pixel, Conversions API) and flag issues fast
  • Own channel reporting: a monthly report with clear top 5 takeaways, plus weekly headlines


Make the ads

  • Turn our existing content library into ads: we have lots of organic social, member photos and videos, and UGC. You’ll find the gems and cut them into ready-to-run statics and short-form video
  • Edit and design ads yourself (Canva, Figma, CapCut or similar), including fast iterations of winners: new hooks, captions, crops and formats from the same footage
  • Build the organic-to-paid pipeline: spot our best-performing organic posts and put them to work in paid
  • Refresh creative at least monthly, with a clear testing plan for new hooks, angles and formats
  • Keep a simple content wishlist of the gaps the data shows, so our in-house team and community can fill them, rather than commissioning expensive new shoots


Use the data to decide what’s next

  • Use a creative analytics tool to track hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA by concept and iteration, and spot fatigue early
  • Mine ad comments and audience feedback for new angles and objections
  • Use AI tools (e.g. Claude) with our brand guidelines to speed up analysis, copy and ideation, with a sharp eye for what’s actually usable


Ideal attitude

  • Curious and commercial: you always ask why an ad worked, not just whether it did
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently (fractional setup)
  • Clear communicator: you turn messy data into a few sharp, actionable points
  • Proactive: you bring ideas and new tools to us without being asked


Time commitment & setup

  • 1-3 days per week (flexible, but you’ll need to check the account briefly on other days)
  • Fully remote (we do have a small office in London, you can go to)
  • Hands-on: you build, launch and optimise, not just advise

Requirements

Essential:

  • 3+ years running Meta Ads accounts hands-on, agency or in-house, for a consumer, subscription or online business
  • Has independently managed £20k+/month in Meta spend, including budgets, structure and testing
  • A portfolio of ads you’ve made yourself (statics and short-form video), especially ads cut from existing or user-generated footage
  • Proven ability to diagnose creative fatigue and decide what to iterate, refresh or retire
  • Data-aware, with a clear grasp of hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPM, CPA and ROAS, and the attribution limits behind them
  • Clear written communication, including concise reports for non-specialists


Ideally:

  • Hands-on use of a creative analytics or launch platform (e.g. AdNova, Madgicx, Superads, Atria, Motion or Segwise)
  • Confident using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT for analysis, copy and creative ideation
  • Experience working with UGC creators and community content, and editing raw footage into ads
  • Experience in a marketplace or two-sided platform


Nice to have:

  • TikTok Ads experience (we run a small budget there)
  • Familiarity with Windsor.ai, Metabase or similar reporting tools
  • Motion design or AI video tools for fast iterations

Benefits

  • Competitive day rate
  • A fun and friendly dog-loving team
  • Real ownership of creative in a newly in-housed channel
  • Work with a mission-driven brand and an engaged, dog-loving community

*No recruiters please.

A key part of your role will be helping School Executives structure and manage school-wide Atomi deployments, coaching senior teachers on Atomi’s methodology and innovative pedagogy and building change management strategies that drive adoption, self-sufficiency and phenomenal student results. As the Account-Based Marketing Manager, you are responsible for developing and executing highly targeted account-based marketing strategies that drive engagement, pipeline creation, and revenue growth within priority accounts and target segments. Working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and Demand Generation, you lead personalized one-to-one and one-to-few programs that influence buying groups, accelerate opportunities, and strengthen relationships with strategic accounts. Sales Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Performance, Insights & Optimization

Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. Who We Are

We’re not your typical non-profit. We bring swagger to everything we do. That means we move with purpose in every step, driven by our commitment to putting our community at the centre of our work. Move forward. Together. On Mission.

The Role

The Senior Human Resources Generalist is the senior practitioner within the Human Resources function, providing independent employee relations advice, recruitment from shortlisting through offer, accommodation and return-to-work management, and delivery of people programs across a national workforce.

The role supports a fully remote organization of approximately 69 employees across multiple provinces, including Quebec.

This position leads recruitment from shortlisting onward, works with a third-party disability management provider on absence and accommodation files, and engages an outsourced recruitment provider when hiring volume requires it.

The position resolves most matters without escalation, exercising judgement grounded in employment legislation, organizational policy, and the organization’s values and core competencies.

What You Bring:

  • Post-secondary education in human resources.
  • CHRP or CHRL designation preferred.
  • Six to eight years of progressive human resources experience, including independent carriage of employee relations matters.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of employment standards, human rights, and privacy legislation in more than one Canadian jurisdiction; familiarity with Quebec requirements is an asset.

  • Experience in a small or mid-sized organization, working independently with limited HR support.
  • Written and spoken fluency in French is an asset.
  • Charitable or not-for-profit sector experience is an asset.
Key Responsibilities

Employee Relations and Labour Relations Advisory

  • Serves as the first-line advisor to people leaders on performance management, attendance, conduct, accommodation, and workplace conflict, resolving matters independently within policy and legislation.
  • Conducts workplace investigations, documents findings, and recommends outcomes.
  • Manages performance review and performance management processes.
  • Manages voluntary and involuntary departures, including exit interviews and analysis of departure themes.
  • Interprets and applies employment standards, human rights, and privacy requirements across all jurisdictions in which the organization employs staff.
  • Identifies patterns in employee inquiries and escalations and recommends policy, training, or process responses.

Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning

  • Owns the judgement-based stages of recruitment for all departments, from intake and screening criteria through shortlisting, interviews, and offer and acceptance, supported by the Human Resources Coordinator, who handles requisition administration, posting, initial screening, scheduling, and offer paperwork.
  • Advises hiring managers on role requirements, selection criteria, interview design, and candidate assessment, and challenges requests that do not align with the approved structure or compensation ranges.
  • Sets screening criteria with the hiring manager, receives the screened candidate pool from the Coordinator, conducts formal interviews with hiring managers, and completes reference checks.
  • Maintains all contact with finalist candidates and makes selection recommendations.
  • Extends offers and negotiates within approved parameters.
  • Applies the recruitment and selection policy, including internal candidate provisions.
  • Determines when recruitment volume warrants engaging the organization's outsourced recruitment provider, scopes the assignment, manages the relationship, and remains accountable for the quality of the outcome.
  • Monitors hiring activity against the approved headcount plan in partnership with Finance.
  • Interprets recruitment metrics maintained by the Coordinator and recommends adjustments to sourcing and process.

Human Resources Programs

  • Delivers the annual performance review and individual planning cycle, including manager coaching.
  • Owns recognition programs and recommends changes based on participation and feedback.
  • Supports learning and leadership development programming and follows through with participants.
  • Advances equity, diversity, and inclusion commitments through program delivery and employee engagement activities.
  • Contributes content to and facilitates staff Human Resources sessions.

Accommodation, Return to Work (RTW) and Compensation

  • Leads return-to-work and accommodation planning on absence files, working with managers on functional abilities, restrictions, and expected duration.
  • Manages accommodation requests through to resolution, including ergonomic and duty-to-accommodate matters, and advises leaders on their obligations.
  • Resolves escalations from the Human Resources Coordinator on matters that require interpretation rather than a lookup.
  • Supports the annual compensation cycle.

HR Operations, Compliance and Policy

  • Drafts and updates policies, the employee handbook, and departmental standard operating procedures.
  • Monitors legislative changes across jurisdictions and recommends required updates.
  • Supports compliance obligations, including safeguarding and sector standards.
  • Participates in Parkinson Canada's EOS operating framework, including regular meeting rhythms, quarterly priorities (Rocks), and defined role accountabilities.

Special Projects

  • Leads special projects as assigned.

The hardware and software accelerated computing ecosystem is constantly evolving, including shifts towards hybrid backends, deep integration with high-level languages and ecosystems (such as Python, Numpy, JAX, MLIR…), and optimization at runtime for maximum flexibility and performance. Our Dx APIs allow developers to embed highly-optimized mathematical operations in their applications for these and other scenarios. During your internship, you will work with senior software engineers on the libraries team who will provide mentorship and guide you in developing highly optimized algorithms. Projects will involve implementing new numerical algorithms, defining APIs, analyzing performance, performance optimizations on the latest NVIDIA GPUs, improving libraries customer experience in employing agentic workflows and AI tools for their development and other general software engineering work.


What you'll be doing:

  • Prototype and develop numerical algorithms for high-performance math device extension libraries: cuBLASDx, cuSolverDx, cuFFTDx, cuRANDDx, nvCOMPDx, NPPDx or libmathdx on ground breaking NVIDIA graphics processors.
  • Analyze the performance of GPU implementations and find opportunities for improvements
  • Collaborate with team members to understand software use cases and requirements

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing a MS or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or related field
  • Strong C++ programming, debugging, performance analysis, and test building skills
  • Parallel or GPU programming experience using CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, SYCL or similar
  • Experience with linear algebra or FFT or data compression algorithms
  • Collaboration, communication, and documentation habits.

  • Prior work in AI-assisted software development, knowledge of LLMs, MCP, and building RAGs or agenting tooling

Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

Life's messiest moments require the smoothest solutions. As our Analytics & Insights Lead, you will join our Customer Experience (CX) team to transform raw customer data and feedback into powerful, actionable insights. In this role, you will enable CX teams to seamlessly access effective data to support strategic decision-making and influence broader business choices. Your mission is to clear the path for our frontline teams, drive data integrity, and ultimately fuel both customer delight and business growth

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Leading the Metrics: Managed the intake process for new data requests and built out robust frameworks to maintain the absolute accuracy and integrity of our team scorecards.
  • Scaling with Tech: Evaluated and integrated smart tech/AI tools into our reporting frameworks to speed up insight delivery without compromising on data quality.
  • Driving Change Management: Collaborated closely with CX Leads to tie change management success metrics to overall business reporting, ensuring our data genuinely impacts operational excellence.
  • Creating a Future-Proof System: Set up governance processes and structured libraries so that past insights are easily searchable, secure, and ready to guide future business strategies.

Let’s talk about you

You are a strategic data storyteller and people coach

You don't just look at spreadsheets; you see the human stories behind the metrics. You excel at translating complex data sets into simple, compelling narratives that inspire action across different teams. As a natural leader, you love coaching others, modeling a "work smarter, not harder" high-performance culture, and aligning multiple stakeholders around a unified roadmap.

You're hands-on with data and love getting into the detail

You're just as comfortable building a dashboard as you are explaining what it means to a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You've got a strong grip on data analysis tools and techniques, and you know how to turn a jumble of numbers into something people can actually act on. You ask good questions, dig until you find the real insight and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions along the way.

You're a champion for data integrity and continuous improvement

You bring a highly organized approach to project management, building reliable data frameworks and compliance guardrails that stand the test of time. You thrive on driving a culture of continuous improvement, using evidence-backed recommendations to solve complex tracking puzzles, manage competing priorities and turn strategic ideas into measurable business value.

You build systems that are built to last

You know a great governance framework isn't just about solving today's problem, it's about setting up something that holds up as the business grows. You bring structure to ambiguity, document as you go and make sure the next person can pick up right where you left off.

You're a natural at bringing people along with you

Whether it's aligning CX Leads on a shared roadmap or navigating competing priorities from different corners of the business, you know how to build trust and keep everyone rowing in the same direction. You listen first, communicate clearly and aren't precious about being the only one with the answer.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off,as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world,generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself.   • Define how users organize and find their data at scale, balancing simplicity for new users with power for people managing thousands of items
  • Model the relationship between early product experience and activation, retention, upgrade rates, and enterprise rollout success
  • Define and monitor adoption metrics, such as time to first fill, import completion, weekly active use, and feature engagement by platform and customer segment
  • Turn customer feedback from support tickets, community forums, and research into clear, prioritized product decisions
  • Support Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success on how the everyday experience drives employee adoption in enterprise deployments
  • Share performance metrics, roadmap updates, and wins with leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, data modeling, and rapid prototyping

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the U.S. with no preference for time zone. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 4+ years experience in product management
  • Experience in user research and user experience design
  • Strong technical aptitude with a focus technical users and use cases
  • Ability to translate complex security concepts into intuitive user experiences
  • Ability to have technical discussions with engineering, making architecture and technology tradeoffs
  • Extremely organized and able to make highly informed prioritization & trade-off decisions based on company goals and user needs
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others
  • Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Interview with Director, Product Management
  • Interview with Chief Product Officer
  • Interview with Chief Technology Officer

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert. jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Storage / SAN Engineer to support enterprise storage, Storage Area Network infrastructure, data protection, service restoration, component modernization, and continuity-of-operations capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Storage / SAN Engineer will configure and troubleshoot SAN fabrics, storage arrays, Fibre Channel switches, zoning, Fabric Logins, and World Wide Name and Port World Wide Name connectivity. This role will support storage performance analysis, capacity management, component refreshes, migrations, recovery activities, technical documentation, and integration with server, virtualization, network, cloud, backup, and security platforms.

The engineer will also support COOP and disaster-recovery readiness, exercises, failover activities, backup validation, service restoration, and corrective-action planning.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours work or travel may be required during outages, maintenance windows, storage migrations, refreshes, COOP exercises, or COOP activation.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Storage / SAN Engineer will:

  • Configure, administer, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise SAN fabrics, storage arrays, switches, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Configure and maintain Fibre Channel fabrics, switch domains, ports, aliases, zones, zone sets, and associated fabric services.
  • Diagnose and resolve Fabric Login, zoning, name-server, pathing, inter-switch-link, and fabric-connectivity issues.
  • Configure and troubleshoot World Wide Name and Port World Wide Name connectivity between storage, switches, servers, appliances, and virtualization platforms.
  • Support single-initiator zoning, multi-fabric designs, redundant paths, multipathing, host-bus adapters, and high-availability storage configurations.
  • Configure and support storage volumes, logical unit numbers, storage pools, tiers, snapshots, clones, replication, masking, mapping, and host access.
  • Support Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, SMB, or other approved enterprise storage protocols.
  • Integrate storage services with physical servers, virtual machines, VMware environments, backup platforms, databases, cloud services, and infrastructure appliances.
  • Monitor storage availability, capacity, utilization, latency, input/output operations, throughput, cache performance, errors, and overall health.
  • Diagnose storage-performance issues and identify bottlenecks involving hosts, fabrics, arrays, networks, applications, databases, or virtualization platforms.
  • Develop capacity forecasts and recommend storage allocation, expansion, optimization, reclamation, or refresh actions.
  • Support storage-related incidents, performance degradation, outages, and service-restoration activities.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities and provide technical diagnosis, mitigation, workarounds, recovery, and service validation.
  • Collect logs, alerts, performance data, configuration records, and technical evidence for incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  • Coordinate technical escalation with storage vendors, hardware manufacturers, software providers, network teams, server teams, application teams, and Government personnel.
  • Track restoration actions, technical dependencies, corrective measures, and preventive recommendations through completion.
  • Plan and execute storage-array, SAN-switch, firmware, software, and supporting-component refreshes.
  • Support data migrations, platform upgrades, storage replacements, consolidation, and modernization initiatives.
  • Develop implementation plans, migration procedures, maintenance steps, validation criteria, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Stage, configure, test, implement, and validate new or replacement storage and SAN components.
  • Support non-disruptive migrations and minimize operational impact during storage-refresh and cutover activities.
  • Maintain accurate storage, SAN, asset, configuration, warranty, licensing, support-agreement, and lifecycle records.
  • Support inventory audits, equipment disposition, repository updates, and lifecycle reporting.
  • Configure and support backup, restoration, replication, failover, failback, high availability, and disaster-recovery capabilities.
  • Maintain, test, and validate system backups required to recover from local failures, storage failures, or loss of the primary site.
  • Support quarterly COOP exercises involving primary and backup data centers.
  • Support power-down, failover, backup-site operations, service validation, failback, and post-exercise corrective actions.
  • Provide technical support during COOP activation and increased user or system demand.
  • Help develop and maintain multi-year continuity testing and exercise procedures related to storage, backup, recovery, and data-center readiness.
  • Support COOP refreshes and modernization from on-premises infrastructure to centralized or cloud-hosted solutions when applicable.
  • Apply approved firmware updates, vendor patches, security patches, operating-system updates, and configuration changes.
  • Configure storage and SAN components in accordance with applicable security requirements and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Support remediation of vulnerabilities, IAVAs, CND Directives, POA&M items, and security-control deficiencies affecting storage infrastructure.
  • Follow approved incident, problem, change, configuration, release, availability, continuity, and service-transition processes.
  • Maintain SAN diagrams, storage architecture documents, zoning records, configuration baselines, capacity plans, recovery procedures, build documents, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Recommend improvements that increase storage availability, performance, resilience, recoverability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree or a relevant technical degree.
  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant storage engineering, SAN administration, systems engineering, data-center infrastructure, or enterprise IT experience.
  • Demonstrated experience configuring and troubleshooting SAN fabrics, storage arrays, switches, zoning, Fabric Logins, and WWN/PWWN connectivity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise storage or SAN infrastructure in a federal or Department of Defense environment.
  • Experience with Dell Technologies, NetApp, Pure Storage, HPE, IBM, Hitachi, or comparable enterprise storage platforms.
  • Experience with Brocade, Cisco MDS, or comparable Fibre Channel switching technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of Fibre Channel fabrics, zoning, FLOGIs, name services, inter-switch links, host-bus adapters, multipathing, and redundant storage designs.
  • Experience with Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, SMB, object storage, and cloud-storage technologies.
  • Experience integrating storage with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, Microsoft, Linux, database, backup, and cloud platforms.
  • Experience with snapshots, replication, backup, restoration, failover, failback, and disaster-recovery technologies.
  • Experience supporting COOP or disaster-recovery exercises involving physically separated data centers.
  • Experience diagnosing storage latency, throughput, IOPS, capacity, pathing, fabric, host, and application-performance issues.
  • Experience planning and executing storage refreshes, data migrations, firmware upgrades, array replacements, and SAN cutovers.
  • Experience developing capacity forecasts, storage-allocation recommendations, performance reports, and lifecycle plans.
  • Experience supporting storage-related outages, vendor escalation, service restoration, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs and supporting DoD RMF, ATO, IAVA, CND Directive, vulnerability-remediation, and POA&M requirements.
  • Certifications from Dell Technologies, NetApp, Pure Storage, HPE, IBM, Hitachi, Brocade, Cisco, VMware, or another relevant storage or infrastructure provider.
  • CompTIA Server+, Storage Networking Industry Association certification, or an equivalent industry credential.
  • ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, performance-tuning, documentation, recovery-planning, and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Ability to support after-hours outages, maintenance windows, migrations, refreshes, COOP exercises, and disaster-recovery activities when required.
