It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

jobs.title: Active Directory / Identity Engineer (Journeyman)
jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks an Active Directory / Identity Engineer to administer, sustain, secure, and recover the Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services environment supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Active Directory / Identity Engineer to administer, sustain, secure, and recover the Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services environment supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position manages AD objects, organizational units, Group Policy Objects, trusts, replication, schema changes, delegated permissions, domain services, and recovery capabilities.

The Active Directory / Identity Engineer provides direct, hands-on AD DS support while assisting with approved Identity, Credential, and Access Management initiatives. The engineer helps test potential Okta integrations and other identity-modernization technologies without reducing the program’s need for strong traditional Active Directory engineering and operational expertise.

The engineer works closely with the Senior AD/Identity Engineer, cybersecurity personnel, Service Desk, systems administrators, cloud and application teams, COOP personnel, and Government identity stakeholders. The position supports routine directory administration, complex troubleshooting, modernization testing, disaster recovery, and critical incident response.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional after-hours maintenance, COOP exercises, incident response, on-site support, or travel may be required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Active Directory / Identity Engineer will:

  • Administer, maintain, update, troubleshoot, and recover Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services.
  • Create, modify, disable, delete, and maintain authorized AD objects in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Manage users, computers, groups, service accounts, organizational units, shared resources, and related directory objects.
  • Maintain domain, organizational-unit, site, trust, Group Policy, and administrative-design documentation.
  • Implement and maintain approved organizational-unit structures.
  • Manage OU-level permissions and delegated administrative access using least-privilege principles.
  • Review delegated permissions and identify excessive, obsolete, inherited, or conflicting access.
  • Develop, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects.
  • Manage GPO links, inheritance, precedence, security filtering, WMI filters, backups, and recovery.
  • Assess proposed Group Policy changes for technical, security, and customer impact before production deployment.
  • Identify and correct conflicting, obsolete, duplicative, or ineffective Group Policy settings.
  • Maintain trusted relationships with enterprise and authorized external Active Directory structures.
  • Configure, validate, monitor, and troubleshoot approved domain and forest trusts.
  • Review trust direction, transitivity, authentication scope, name-suffix routing, and related settings.
  • Maintain AD sites, subnets, site links, replication schedules, and replication topology.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot replication failures, latency, lingering objects, directory inconsistencies, and topology problems.
  • Support the health and availability of domain controllers, directory databases, SYSVOL, DFS Replication, time synchronization, and AD-integrated DNS dependencies.
  • Monitor Flexible Single Master Operations roles and support approved role-transfer or recovery activities.
  • Support domain-controller installation, configuration, replacement, upgrade, demotion, and retirement.
  • Assist with planning and executing transitions to supported versions of Active Directory.
  • Support controlled AD schema updates and approved schema extensions.
  • Assess proposed schema changes for compatibility, replication impact, operational risk, and recovery requirements.
  • Maintain current directory schematics, architecture diagrams, trust diagrams, replication diagrams, and object-management documentation.
  • Process or support approved account, group, permission, and organizational-unit changes escalated through Service Desk and access-management processes.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, account, group-membership, policy, trust, replication, and directory-permission issues.
  • Coordinate with Service Desk personnel to improve identity-related troubleshooting, ticket routing, escalation, and knowledge content.
  • Provide advanced support during identity, authentication, domain, and access-management incidents.
  • Recognize widespread authentication failures and escalate potential outages through approved incident-response procedures.
  • Collect directory logs, replication information, policy results, configuration data, and other evidence needed for root-cause analysis.
  • Implement approved corrective and preventive actions resulting from incidents and problem reviews.
  • Maintain and execute Active Directory backup and restoration procedures.
  • Test system-state backups, deleted-object recovery, authoritative and non-authoritative restoration, and forest-recovery procedures.
  • Support COOP exercises, disaster-recovery tests, recovery validation, and actual continuity events.
  • Document recovery results, technical deficiencies, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
  • Support testing of approved ICAM and identity-modernization technologies.
  • Assist with integration testing between Active Directory and Okta or other Government-approved identity platforms.
  • Validate identity synchronization, authentication flows, attribute mappings, group mappings, account linking, provisioning behavior, access controls, and error handling.
  • Support testing involving approved federation and modern authentication protocols such as SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth, SCIM, or LDAP.
  • Develop and execute test cases, expected results, rollback steps, and validation procedures for identity integrations.
  • Document defects, technical findings, corrective actions, and test results.
  • Coordinate identity-integration activities with cybersecurity personnel, application owners, cloud teams, network teams, and Government identity authorities.
  • Evaluate approved identity-modernization capabilities while preserving required AD DS authentication, authorization, Group Policy, trust, recovery, and administrative functions.
  • Automate approved AD administration, health validation, reporting, and audit activities where appropriate.
  • Review applicable directory audit information and report activity outside approved baselines.
  • Apply approved Active Directory security baselines and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Support remediation of directory-service vulnerabilities, configuration findings, and policy deficiencies.
  • Support Risk Management Framework control implementation, evidence collection, assessment activities, and corrective actions.
  • Follow approved incident, problem, change, configuration, access, release, security, and quality-management processes.
  • Maintain standard operating procedures, recovery plans, test results, change records, configuration baselines, and technical documentation.
  • Provide directory-service health, risk, issue, recovery, and modernization information for program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented AWS Cloud Engineer to join our Team, becoming responsible for ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of critical platforms that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This person will provide day-to-day customer application support, maintain infrastructure, monitor systems, resolve incidents, while implementing automation to improve operational efficiency. This role requires strong AWS DevOps expertise, application support experience, problem-solving skills, and a proactive approach to optimizing our analytics infrastructure.

Technical Leadership

Education + Degree

  • Preferred: Master's degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering, or related field.

Experience, Certification, or Licensure

  • Required: Professional Engineer (PE) license.

This role also requires periodic travel to project sites, including locations undergoing renovation or active construction. Seeing: This role requires the ability to see, view, and distinguish all aspects of construction to ensure quality control.

Java Application Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Java Application Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an accomplished Java Full Stack Developer to architect, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems that operate at significant scale and across multiple business domains. In this role you will be responsible for the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from translating business requirements into robust technical designs, to writing production-quality code, to deploying cloud-native services and supporting them through their full operational lifespan. The successful candidate will bring deep backend expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, combined with strong hands-on experience building responsive, component-driven front-end applications using modern JavaScript frameworks. You will work closely with product managers, architects, DevOps engineers, and fellow developers in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality, secure, and performant applications that directly support strategic business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and continuously refine scalable microservices using Java (11/17) and the Spring Boot framework, ensuring each service is independently deployable, observable, and aligned with the broader enterprise architecture roadmap.
  • Author secure, well-tested, and high-quality production code that adheres to internal coding standards, follows established design patterns, and incorporates defense-in-depth security principles such as input validation, authentication, and encryption at rest and in transit.
  • Develop responsive, component-based front-end applications using React (or equivalent frameworks such as Angular or Vue), with strong attention to user experience, accessibility, browser compatibility, and performance on both desktop and mobile devices.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations that connect distributed backend systems, defining clear contracts, versioning strategies, and error-handling semantics to ensure smooth interoperability between services.
  • Actively participate in architecture and design discussions, contributing thoughtful trade-off analyses around scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and cost-efficiency, and helping the team converge on solutions that meet both current and projected business needs.
  • Continuously profile and optimize application performance, database queries, JVM tuning parameters, and API throughput, identifying bottlenecks through systematic measurement and applying targeted improvements with quantifiable impact.
  • Implement and maintain robust state management patterns (Redux, Context API, NgRx, or equivalents) for complex front-end applications, ensuring predictable data flow, easier debugging, and clean separation of concerns between UI components and business logic.
  • Develop comprehensive automated test suites — unit, integration, contract, and functional — using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Jest, and Cypress, treating tests as first-class deliverables that protect velocity and confidence over the long term.
  • Contribute meaningfully to CI/CD pipeline design and deployment automation using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, enabling fast, safe, and repeatable releases to multiple environments.
  • Proactively identify system bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses, and drive concrete remediation efforts through refactoring proposals, technical design documents, and well-scoped engineering initiatives.
  • Collaborate effectively within Agile/Scrum delivery teams, participating in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives to ensure consistent delivery of high-value increments.
  • Maintain clear, current, and comprehensive technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, API specifications, deployment guides, and runbooks — so that knowledge is shareable and the system remains supportable as the team scales.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional software development experience building production-grade enterprise applications.
  • Strong, demonstrable understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and end-to-end system design principles.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Java (versions 11 and 17), the Spring Boot framework, and the design of clean, idiomatic RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on, production-level experience designing and operating microservices architectures, including service decomposition, inter-service communication, and observability patterns.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:
CrowdStrike’s Strategic Advisory Services team assists our customers with a wide array of proactive engagements to help enhance security programs, educate employees, and develop tailored cyber initiatives. The Principal Consultant role is the leader on the ground. This role serves as the primary day-to-day lead for Strategic engagements, interacting with client leadership and ensuring that projects run on time and to our highest standards. Principal Consultants also assist our Strategic leadership team with staffing, thought leadership, business development, and other “back of office” tasks.

Am I a Strategic Principal Consultant Candidate?

  • Do you find yourself keeping up with the latest cyber breaches?
  • Do you want to help companies protect themselves against malicious adversaries?
  • Are you interested in learning your customer’s maturity and pain points to develop a plan to improve?
  • Do you thrive on engaging with executive and senior management?
  • Are you comfortable being the face of the company and dealing with difficult client situations where necessary?
  • Are you ready to “do the work” while also supporting business line development activities?
  • Do you enjoy leading and working alongside a team of A-players?
  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?
  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?
  • Do you have strong communication and writing skills?
  • Are you the smartest person on your current team? Would you prefer to engage peers who challenge you daily?

What You'll Do:

  • Lead large and complex strategic advisory service engagements, engaging with executive-level individuals across a wide range of industry segments.
  • Assess and develop cybersecurity and incident response programs in a proactive fashion to help mature the security posture of organizations prior to an incident.
  • Develop cutting-edge scenarios to help customers exercise the full range of their response capabilities.
  • Produce and ensure delivery of high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings to customer management.
  • Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts and public speaking events.
  • Identify and address emerging trends in cybersecurity, drawing on both government and private sector perspectives.
  • Manage internal programs and teams.
  • Engage in some degree of sales and business development opportunities.
  • Support staffing and scheduling of strategic resources on upcoming engagements.


What You'll Need:
Successful candidates will have at least 8-15 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • IT / Security Management Consulting: you’ve held leadership positions and owned relationships with organizational executives as a management or technical consultant. You’ve worked on a range of infosec and IT issues, including both technical cyber security (applying controls, improving architectures, etc.) and operational cyber security (organizational alignment, cyber policy review, etc.)
  • Security Program Development: you’ve personally contributed to the development, management, and implementation of a security program, helping organization build, enhance, or recalibrate their plans for a successful future-leaning security program. This may include aspects of developing a SOC, CSIRT, Fusion Center, or several security initiatives that support a centralized security function.
  • Security Analysis / Operations: you’ve held leadership or key delivery positions in organizations or on teams that focus on organizational security (such as SOCs, IR teams, etc.). You understand cybersecurity from a practitioner standpoint, and importantly, you also understand how to consolidate and communicate results to senior leaders.
  • Business Strategy / Risk Analysis: you’ve helped businesses address a range of risks, including cyber risks, across their organization. You’re familiar with how organizational risk frameworks are developed, and you have experience helping organizations improve and apply their risk frameworks to address cyber risks.
  • Cybersecurity Policy: you’ve been responsible for developing new policies or enhancing existing policies that inform how private or government organization performs and manages its various cyber security activities. You have played a key role in developing policies, plans, and/or playbooks focusing on cyber security activities, and have ideally been part of the process of transitioning these plans into practice within an organization.
  • Public / Government Affairs: you have significant experience helping government organizations, or entities that work closely with governments, refine cyber security priorities and communicate clearly about these priorities. You are highly experienced in working across a variety of sets of technical and non-technical stakeholders in an organization to develop defensible, actionable priorities and plans for improving cyber security.


Additionally, all candidates must possess the following qualifications:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communications skills, specifically in fast-paced professional environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships with a wide range of customers and team members.
  • Capable of completing complex tasks involving strategic analysis and development, without supervision.
  • Desire to grow and expand cyber aptitude, technical awareness, and soft skills.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Consistent positive work environment and attitude.
  • Ability to travel to engage with clients, up to 30% of the time, often on less than three weeks’ notice.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Education:

We are seeking candidates with the right combination of training and skills to join our team. Successful candidates coming from an academic background will likely have a BA or BS degree, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Management Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, Public Policy, Intelligence Studies, or a related field.


Applicants without a degree, but with relevant military or work experience and/or training will be considered and should apply their previous experience to the qualification areas above.

We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

About the role

As a Senior Architect within the Client Solutions Services team, you will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients, guiding them through the evaluation, design, implementation, and optimization of their infrastructure solutions. You will bring deep architectural expertise across multiple technology domains, including Cisco networking, Citrix VDI, Microsoft Azure, and NetApp storage, along with broad knowledge of data center networking, cloud, compute, storage, and adjacent infrastructure technologies.

This role requires a blend of technical architecture expertise, business insight, and exceptional consulting skills to help clients achieve their strategic goals.

Client Advisory and Consultation

  • Act as a strategic advisor, providing expert guidance on infrastructure solutions that align with client business objectives.
  • Engage with clients to understand their goals, challenges, and technical requirements.
  • Support Insight Sales Teams when they engage with customers to understand their business goals, challenges, and requirements.
  • Deliver technical guidance and best practices on solutions, products, and services.
  • Provide architecture-level expertise across Cisco, Citrix VDI, Microsoft Azure, and NetApp solutions, including evaluating current environments and developing future-state architectures.

  • Participate in the creation, review, and revision of Statements of Work (SOWs) and supporting scoping documents.

Delivery of Advisory Services

  • Lead creation of high-level solution architectures and roadmaps that align with customer objectives.
  • Participate in or lead client-facing advisory workshops and assessments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams of engineers, architects, sales, and services to develop infrastructure solutions.
  • Develop integrated infrastructure architectures incorporating Cisco networking, Citrix VDI, Microsoft Azure, and NetApp technologies based on client requirements.
  • Design, oversee implementation, and provide feedback on optimizing solutions in customer environments, ensuring quality, performance, and scalability.
  • Provide oversight to follow-on professional services engagements.
  • Complete client deliverables and supporting documents.
  • Work in conjunction with other advisory teammates to develop and ensure successful infrastructure solutions.
  • Provide feedback on client needs, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Stay current on the latest domain-specific technologies, trends, and innovations, and maintain relevant certifications and accreditations.
  • Research and make recommendations for strategic business development plans that have a significant impact on Insight business.

Be AmbITious

This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of experience working with solutions in the data center networking and infrastructure space.
  • 10+ years of experience in consulting and customer-facing roles.
  • Strong architecture-level experience designing and advising on enterprise Cisco networking solutions.
  • Strong architecture-level experience with Citrix VDI environments and solutions.
  • Strong architecture-level experience designing and advising on Microsoft Azure cloud and hybrid infrastructure solutions.
  • Strong architecture-level experience with NetApp enterprise storage solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess existing environments and develop high-level architectures, technology strategies, roadmaps, and recommendations across Cisco, Citrix VDI, Azure, and NetApp.
  • Strong knowledge of infrastructure products, services, and solutions and their integration with other technologies and platforms.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for driving business growth and client success.
  • Strong ability to influence stakeholders, present to executive audiences, and communicate complex concepts effectively.
  • Proficiency in developing compelling presentations and technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to handle complex and ambiguous situations.
  • Strong project management, teamwork, and collaboration skills with the ability to lead and mentor others.
  • Relevant intermediate or advanced certifications in infrastructure technology domains.
  • Ability to develop and execute strategy with limited direction and oversight.
  • Ability to research and make recommendations for strategic technology plans that have a significant impact for clients.
  • Strong desire to drive client success.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25% to the client site in Austin, TX.

What you can expect

We’re legendary for taking care of you, your family and helping you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:

  • Freedom to work from another location, even an international destination, for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.
  • Access to 11 thriving and diverse Teammate Resource Groups.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

Join us today, your ambITious journey starts here.

We are looking for a practical, data-driven Data Analytics Manager to lead performance tracking and analysis across our digital customer lifecycle touchpoints and 1:1 Customer Success efforts.


In this hands-on individual contributor role you will help us gather, understand and use the data we need to enable our teams and to prove the impact of our work. SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Germany

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Germany. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

Overview

JOB TITLE: ServiceNow Architect

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: Department of State

POSITION INFORMATION: Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting federal agency clients

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

CLEARANCE: Must have, at minimum, an active Interim Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a final Secret clearance.

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking an experienced ServiceNow Architect to design and drive enterprise-level ServiceNow solutions that power our federal customer's IT modernization journey. This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for a professional who thrives on solving complex challenges, architecting scalable systems, and mentoring teams to deliver excellence. As the primary technical authority on the platform, the ServiceNow Architect works at the intersection of technology, process, and mission—leading solution design across enterprise modules, architecting secure integrations, owning release management, and advising federal stakeholders on how to modernize the way government manages and delivers digital services.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Architecture & Solution Design
    • Design and lead the architecture, implementation, and optimization of the ServiceNow platform across enterprise modules, including ITSM, ITOM, HAM, SAM, HRSD, SPM, GRC, SecOps, ServiceNow Vault, Automation Engine, and CMDB.
    • Translate business goals into scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions that improve workflows, productivity, and service delivery.
    • Conduct detailed requirements analysis and review business requirements to ensure technical clarity and feasibility before development begins.
    • Lead workshops and technical design discussions with stakeholders to define platform requirements and align solutions with organizational goals.
    • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and design gaps early in the development lifecycle.
  • Development & Integration
    • Design, develop, and deploy custom applications and cross-scope solutions within ServiceNow tailored to federal requirements.
    • Architect and implement secure integrations with enterprise and third-party systems using REST/SOAP web services, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, and middleware technologies.
    • Build advanced Service Catalog items, including catalog client scripts, UI policies, and Flow Designer automations.
    • Support ongoing improvement and optimization of core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management.
    • Integrate AI-driven capabilities into ServiceNow to enhance automation, predictive analysis, and decision-making.
    • Ensure platform health through robust data management, workflow optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Release Management & Quality
    • Own end-to-end release management, including release cycle planning, environment management, update set deployment, runbook maintenance, and release documentation across Agile sprint cycles.
    • Lead technical and peer code reviews, and oversee testing, deployment, and ongoing platform improvement.
    • Execute and oversee unit, integration, and regression testing to drive high-quality, defect-free deployments.
    • Ensure solution quality through compliance and governance checks, and maintain technical design records.
  • Leadership & Collaboration
    • Serve as the primary technical authority on the platform, mentoring developers, administrators, and functional team members on ServiceNow architecture, scripting, DevOps approaches, and platform best practices.
    • Participate in client calls to lead and advise on technical design discussions, presenting technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Collaborate with federal stakeholders to align solutions with modernization goals, compliance standards, and security frameworks, including NIST and FISMA.
    • Monitor ServiceNow releases and recommend enhancements to keep the environment current.
    • Support Windows Server implementation, upgrades, and integrations as required by the environment.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • 8+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead role on enterprise implementations.
  • Proven experience architecting enterprise ServiceNow solutions across multiple modules, including ITSM, ITOM, and CMDB, plus at least one of HAM, SAM, HRSD, SPM, GRC, or SecOps.
  • Expert-level scripting and development skills, including JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, and scoped application development.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting integrations using REST/SOAP web services, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, and middleware technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of CMDB design, data modeling, and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
  • Experience owning release management, including instance and environment strategy, update set deployment, and release documentation across Agile sprint cycles.
  • A track record of setting development standards, leading code reviews, and mentoring developers and administrators.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to lead technical design discussions and present solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences, including federal stakeholders.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Application Developer (CAD) certifications, required.
  • At least one ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification, required.

PREFERRED:

  • ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA).
  • Additional Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (e.g., ITSM, Discovery, HAM, SAM, SecOps, or IRM/GRC).
  • Experience implementing ServiceNow AI capabilities, such as Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, or Virtual Agent.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Vault, Automation Engine, or platform encryption and data protection features.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, source control integration, CI/CD pipelines, and the Automated Test Framework (ATF).
  • Prior experience supporting federal or defense contracting environments, including familiarity with NIST, FISMA, and FedRAMP.
  • Windows Server implementation and administration experience.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification (or higher).

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have, at minimum, an active Interim Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a final Secret clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to the nature of this government contract.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This is a fully remote position within the U.S. Candidate must be available during East Coast business hours for client calls and technical design discussions; occasional travel may be required for major planning events. No relocation or office reporting is expected.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
jobs.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

Product marketing at Honeycomb is a small team with a wide surface area. We decide how Honeycomb is positioned, what we say at launch, what the sales team brings into a deal, and how an engineer who has never heard of us understands the product in the first two minutes. Because the team is small, the work is broad: in one week you might rewrite a product page, build a competitive one-pager, interview a customer, and run the launch checklist for a new feature.

This role is built for someone early in a product marketing career who wants to systematically improve the customer buying journey. As a product and messaging expert, you will partner with go-to-market teams to drive business impact through sales and marketing campaigns. You will get real ownership of real launches, and you will have senior product marketers, a technical field team, and engineers who like explaining their work close at hand. Our audience is engineers and platform teams, so the bar is accuracy first: we would rather be precise and useful than clever.

What you’ll do in the role:

You will support and execute product marketing across Honeycomb's core products, with a generalist mix of messaging, launches, content, enablement, and competitive work. Expect to start by contributing to pieces of each and to own more of them over your first year.

Responsibilities

  • Messaging and positioning: Write and maintain messaging for features and product areas, from the one-sentence version an engineer reads on a web page to the slide a sales engineer uses in a technical conversation. Keep it accurate and grounded in what the product actually does.
  • Launches: Run launch execution for small and mid-sized releases and support the larger ones. Build the plan, write the assets, coordinate Product, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and report on how the launch performed.
  • Content: Produce the practical material that helps people evaluate and adopt Honeycomb: blog posts, solution briefs, web copy, demo scripts, FAQs, and customer-facing one-pagers.
  • Sales enablement: Equip the field with what they need to run a good conversation, including pitch narratives, objection handling, battlecards, and release updates. Join customer calls, listen to recorded ones, and fix the material that isn't landing.
  • Competitive and market intelligence: Track the observability market and competitor moves. Maintain competitive assets and keep them current and honest, so the field trusts them.
  • Voice of customer and proof points: Talk to customers and prospects, turn what you hear into case studies, quotes, and proof points, and bring the patterns back to Product and Marketing.
  • Measurement: Help define what success looks like for your work, pull the data, and share what you learn, including the things that didn't work.

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in product marketing, or in a closely adjacent go-to-market role such as content marketing, sales engineering, technical writing, developer relations, or product management, with at least some of it in B2B SaaS.
  • Strong writing. You can take a dense technical explanation and turn it into something short, accurate, and useful, and you can tell the difference between the two yourself.
  • Curiosity about technical products and the patience to learn how they work. You ask engineers questions until you actually understand the answer, and you are comfortable in a product that assumes a technical user.
  • Passion about the team winning: Sales, marketing, and product teams will depend on you to succeed. Their success is your success, but you’re not simply an order taker: you look for the smart solutions and don’t wait to be asked.
  • The ability to run a project across teams without formal authority: setting a timeline, chasing the open items, and telling people clearly when something has slipped.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping. Our priorities move, the team is small, and the best work here comes from people who start rather than wait for a brief.
  • Willingness to use data to decide and to evaluate your own work honestly.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI tooling in your work.

Nice to have

Exposure to observability, developer tools, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, platform engineering, or reliability and SLO practices. We will teach this, but a head start helps.

Experience marketing to engineers as the primary audience.

Hands-on familiarity with AI and LLM tooling, including coding agents and MCP-based workflows.

Experience with webinars, conference talks, or community programs.

Experience working in a fully distributed company.

Base Salary based on level of experience
$171,000—$261,000 CAD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.description:
Zinda Law Group is an elite plaintiff’s personal injury and medical malpractice firm looking for ambitious, dynamic, driven, and passionate professionals to join our growing team. We are looking for a Referral Specialist that coordinates incoming attorney referrals and refers cases out. The specialist manages communication, documentation, follow-up, and financial tracking in collaboration with Marketing, Intake, Attorney Teams, Finance, and Referral Partners. We have offices in Texas, Colorado, Arizona, New Mexico, and Florida and serve clients throughout the nation.

We are not your typical law firm, and by joining us, you will have the following opportunities, and many, many more, at your disposal:

  • Valuable, Rewarding Work: Every day, you will be helping people. Our clients come to us after they have been through one of the worst days of their lives, and the work you do here will help them get the justice they deserve and get their lives back on track. Our paralegals play a critical role in our cases and often make lifelong connections with the people we help.
  • Continuous Learning: You will be mentored by and train with top professionals in your field from day one. Our in-house certifications and trainings will help you succeed no matter your level of experience.
  • Remarkable Colleagues: When you join our team, you join a group of diverse individuals who are dedicated and passionate about the work they do every single day.

Responsibilities:

Incoming attorney referrals

  • Receive, acknowledge, and track incoming referrals. Verify the referring firm, attorney contact information, referral source, current representation, and authorization for client contact before outreach.
  • Gather complete intake information, case summaries, available records, and reported deadlines. Coordinate conflict checks and attorney review; flag missing information and urgent issues.
  • Follow each referral through review and an acceptance, decline, or referral decision. Keep the referring firm informed as update requests and coordinate timely client intake and handoff to the assigned legal team.
  • Obtain and save attorney-approved referral agreements, client engagement documents, and supporting records. Record approved fee arrangements and responsibilities, and escalate incomplete or inconsistent referral terms.

Outgoing referrals

  • Maintain the pending referral queue, prepare case summaries, and send complete, authorized referrals to approved firms, following attorney direction and/or firm procedures.
  • Follow up on pending placements; coordinate receiving counsel's written acceptance, attorney-approved referral terms, and required client consent.
  • Draft withdrawal and transfer letters and obtain signed client agreement and consent before completing the transfer.
  • Securely transmit authorized case files, confirm receipt and the receiving attorney's acceptance of representation, and update assignments and status. Route unplaced or declined matters to the responsible attorney and complete approved rejection and file-closing steps.

Ongoing case monitoring

  • Monitor active referred-out cases and cases in which the firm retains an interest through resolution. Obtain status updates at least quarterly, with more frequent follow-up for pending actions, significant developments, or deadlines.
  • Obtain and save applicable documents, including signed agreements, filed petitions or complaints, settlement information, and withdrawal or closure letters. Record changes promptly and escalate missing updates or inconsistent information.

Referral relationships

  • Maintain referral-partner information by state, practice area, case criteria, and availability. Build professional relationships through responsive communication, scheduled check-ins, and feedback on referral quality and service.

Records and financial reporting

  • Keep practice management records and referral trackers current, including referral source, case type, state, responsible firms, status, class codes, agreements, last contact, next follow-up, and attorney-identified deadlines.
  • Save correspondence and documents in designated case folders, protect confidential information, and maintain accurate notes. Audit records regularly, correct discrepancies, and submit Closing File Checklists for review before processing approved closures.
  • Coordinate with Finance to obtain case-cost and trust-liability ledgers when needed, communicate approved expense-reimbursement requests, and track attorney-approved referral fees payable or receivable. Draft Closing Statements, compile payment documentation and confirm receipt and reconciliation with Finance.
  • Prepare scheduled reports on incoming and outgoing referrals, review and placement times, pending and overdue matters, case updates, referral fees, and reimbursable costs. Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements to the manager.

Required qualifications

  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) communication skills;
  • Paralegal degree, training or certification (ABA approved program);
  • Two years of personal injury or medical malpractice law firm experience in referrals, intake, legal assistant, paralegal, or case coordination;
  • Clear, professional communication with attorneys, referral partners, prospective clients, and clients experiencing stressful circumstances
  • Strong organization, accuracy, and follow-through; ability to manage a high volume of matters, prioritize deadlines, and work independently while following procedures and escalating concerns.
  • Proficiency with practice management or CRM systems, email, spreadsheets, electronic documents, and digital file management; ability to learn the firm's systems and complete required training.
  • Sound judgment with confidential information and a clear understanding of when attorney review or approval is required.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with personal injury or medical malpractice matters, law firm referral relationships, client transfers, or referral-fee tracking.
  • Experience coordinating matters across multiple states;
  • Paralegal training or certification;

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

jobs.description:
At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

Evolve is on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone, and that starts with the homeowners who trust us with their properties. For most of them, the first thing they see from us is an ad on search or social media, or a referral from another owner. As our Creative Designer, you'll own the strategy behind what we show potential customers across our ads, landing pages and mail pieces. You will work closely with product marketing and our paid marketing teams to test, learn and iterate, and put more of our budget behind what actually brings in qualified owners. This is an individual-contributor role on a small, flat, high-ownership team, with a direct line from your work to the company's growth.

The team

Growth owns Evolve's owner-acquisition funnel, from first impression through qualified lead and signup, and all of our marketing. It's a small team by design, which means less process, more surface area, and a lot of creative freedom inside a clear brand.

What you’ll do

  • Paid Creative
    • Design static, motion and short-form video ads for Meta, Reddit, display and new test channels, with multiple versions of each concept across formats and sizes
    • Ship new variants every week with our performance marketers, built around clear hypotheses — hooks, messages, formats, audiences
    • Read the results with the team, and turn what you learn into the next round rather than starting from scratch
  • Landing Pages, Mail & Brand
    • Design landing page visuals, direct mail pieces and lifecycle email creative, so the experience matches from ad to page to mailbox
    • Work with our brand and product marketing team to keep everything on-brand while still testing boldly
  • Systems & Speed
    • Build templates, asset libraries and a creative learnings log so production scales without losing quality
    • Use AI tools to raise output and speed up iteration, and help the team get better at it

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years designing performance or direct-response creative — paid social ads, display, landing pages — for a consumer, marketplace or lead-generation business
  • A portfolio that shows high-volume ad work and how it was tested and iterated, not just final hero pieces
  • Strong in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud; comfortable with motion and basic video editing (After Effects, Premiere or similar)
  • You think in tests: you can explain why a variant won, and you use performance data to decide what to make next
  • Fast, organized and comfortable with feedback and short turnaround
  • AI-native working style — you already use AI tools to generate, iterate and resize creative; this is a baseline here, not a differentiator
  • Nice to have: experience designing for print or direct mail and working with print vendors, reading Meta Ads Manager or channel dashboards yourself, and copywriting instincts for headlines and hooks

Compensation

Our base salary is $110,000- $135,000 depending on experience.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

  • Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.
  • Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.
  • Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.
  • Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.
  • Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.
  • Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

jobs.description:
The Role That We Need:

PadSplit is hiring for an Account Executive to expand our marketplace by engaging traditional property owners to become PadSplit Hosts. This role is critical in helping homeowners unlock additional income by listing their properties, while addressing housing affordability by creating more shared housing opportunities in the Chicago, Illinois market.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We are seeking a driven and personable Account Executive with experience in sales or real estate who excels at building relationships with property owners and real estate investors. This role involves delivering a tailored value pitch on how the PadSplit model and technology consistently drive superior rental income compared to traditional single-family rentals. The ideal candidate thrives in a remote environment, demonstrates strong communication skills, and wants to have an impact on the affordable housing crisis - one room at a time.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Prospect and Qualify Leads: Research and identify potential property owners who might be interested in becoming PadSplit Hosts and qualify them based on suitability.
  • Conduct Outreach: Execute outreach strategies, including cold calling, emailing, and networking, to connect with traditional property owners.
  • Host Discovery Calls and Meetings: Engage property owners in initial conversations to understand their needs, goals, and potential barriers to joining PadSplit.
  • Deliver Value Propositions: Clearly articulate the benefits of PadSplit's model, such as increased revenue potential, simplified management, and societal impact.
  • Build and Nurture Relationships: Develop trust-based relationships with property owners, acting as a trusted advisor to address concerns and highlight opportunities.
  • Tailor Solutions: Customize hosting solutions based on the unique circumstances of property owners, including financial modeling, property suitability, and compliance requirements.
  • Close Deals: Guide property owners through the decision-making process, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements for onboarding as PadSplit Hosts.
  • Collaborate with Onboarding Teams: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding for new Hosts, providing accurate property details and expectations.
  • Track and Report Metrics: Maintain detailed records in CRM systems, tracking outreach activities, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators.
  • Stay Updated on Market Trends: Monitor the real estate market, competitive landscape, and legislative changes to refine outreach and value propositions effectively.
  • Host Educational Sessions: Organize webinars or in-person sessions to educate property owners on PadSplit’s benefits and address common misconceptions.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful:

  • Sales Experience: Proven success in B2B or B2C sales, particularly in the real estate or property management sectors, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Relationship-Building Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication abilities to build trust and long-term relationships with property owners.
  • Self-Motivation and Independence: High level of self-discipline and motivation to thrive in a remote, fast-paced startup environment with minimal supervision.
  • Adaptability and Problem-Solving: Ability to think on their feet, overcome objections, and tailor solutions to meet the unique needs of property owners.
  • Knowledge of Real Estate Markets: Familiarity with the dynamics of real estate investing, rental markets, and property management is highly desirable.
  • Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using CRM systems (we use Salesforce and Hubspot), sales enablement tools, and virtual communication platforms for outreach and reporting.
  • Strong Presentation Skills: Ability to confidently present PadSplit’s value proposition through virtual meetings, calls, or live presentations.
  • Analytical Skills: Capable of interpreting market data, calculating ROI, and presenting financial benefits to potential Hosts.
  • Team Collaboration: Effective at collaborating with cross-functional teams, such as marketing and onboarding, to ensure a seamless experience for new Hosts.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Resilience and resourcefulness to tackle challenges and drive results in a rapidly changing startup environment.
  • PadSplit Core Values: Consistently demonstrate our values of compassionate directness, high integrity, optimism, intellectual curiosity, strong work ethic, empathy, self-awareness.

The Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Sales for forty-five (45) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with a small panel of key stakeholders for one (1) hour. For this interview, a candidate would present a short case study to the panel for discussion.
  • If warranted, the final step would be an in-person meeting with our Head of Sales at a PadSplit hosted event.
  • If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:

  • Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan
  • National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
  • Company provided life insurance policy
  • Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
  • Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
  • 401(k) plan
  • Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both eligible birth and non-birth parents
  • The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

jobs.description:
Consensus Cloud Solutions is a publicly traded, leading digital cloud fax and interoperability solutions organization in the United States and globally, focusing on connecting and empowering healthcare providers, payers, care teams, and technology innovators to unify multiple systems that wouldn’t otherwise talk to each other. Consensus is a trailblazer in our industry and believes that data transformation will reshape the world of healthcare.

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

Consensus leads the industry in data exchange solutions and we’re only getting started! With exciting new initiatives on the horizon, we are continuing our strategic expansion and we are looking to add to our diverse team of innovators.

Now is the ideal time to join us in our mission to solve healthcare’s biggest challenges, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of like-minded self-starters and partners to accomplish it.

Consensus Cloud Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We offer many remote and hybrid career opportunities.

How you will impact the organization…

The Payroll Manager is responsible for leading the organization's global payroll operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing for employees across multiple countries. This role oversees end-to-end payroll administration, payroll tax compliance, system administration, reporting, audits, and continuous process improvements while partnering closely with HR Operations, Finance, Internal Audit, Tax, Accounting, Benefits, and external payroll providers. This position is a “player/coach” managing the payroll team.

The Payroll Manager serves as the subject matter expert for payroll operations, ensuring compliance with applicable federal, state, local, and international payroll regulations while delivering exceptional employee service and maintaining strong internal controls. This position is responsible for driving payroll operational excellence, identifying process improvement opportunities, and supporting organizational growth through effective payroll administration.

The value you will deliver…

  • Manage the end-to-end payroll process for domestic and international employees, ensuring payrolls are processed accurately and on schedule.
  • Partner closely with the Senior Director of Global HR Operations to support global payroll strategy, operational excellence, compliance initiatives, and continuous improvement of payroll processes.
  • Administer payroll through ADP Workforce Now (WFN) and coordinate payroll activities with international payroll providers and partners.
  • Conduct bi-weekly payroll audits for U.S. payroll operations to validate payroll accuracy, confirm employee deductions are calculated correctly, verify tax withholding and benefit deductions, review payroll adjustments, and identify discrepancies prior to payroll submission for processing.
  • Manage global time-off administration, including ownership of vacation, sick leave, personal leave, statutory leave, and other paid and unpaid time-off programs across all countries and jurisdictions where employees are located.
  • Maintain and administer country-specific time-off policies, rules, accruals, eligibility requirements, carryover provisions, and statutory requirements to ensure compliance with local labor laws and company policies.
  • Maintain oversight of payroll tax registrations, jurisdiction setup, tax withholding requirements, and regulatory updates across all applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictions.
  • Review ADP SmartCompliance reports, tax filings, agency notices, and compliance alerts to identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and coordinate timely resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable payroll, tax, wage and hour, and employment regulations in all jurisdictions where employees are located.
  • Maintain employee payroll records, earnings, deductions, taxes, garnishments, direct deposits, and benefit deductions.
  • Oversee payroll tax reporting, filings, reconciliations, and year-end processing.
  • Partner with Finance to reconcile payroll-related general ledger accounts and support month-end and year-end close activities.
  • Review payroll reports and conduct regular audits to ensure payroll accuracy and data integrity.
  • Manage payroll interfaces between HRIS, timekeeping, benefits, finance, retirement, and third-party payroll systems.
  • Partner with HR Operations to ensure employee lifecycle transactions (new hires, promotions, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, and compensation changes) are accurately reflected in payroll.
  • Develop, document, and maintain payroll policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries and resolve payroll issues in a timely and professional manner.
    Coordinate internal and external payroll audits and support compliance initiatives.
  • Monitor changes in payroll legislation and ensure timely implementation of regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes through automation, system enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Prepare payroll metrics, reports, and analytics for leadership.
  • Lead payroll-related projects, including system implementations, acquisitions, organizational changes, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Train, mentor, and develop payroll team members while fostering a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement in a player/coach capacity.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or requested. Consensus reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

What you will bring to the table…

  • 7 or more years of progressive payroll experience, including payroll leadership responsibilities.
  • Experience processing payroll for multi-state and/or multinational organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with ADP Workforce Now (WFN).
  • Experience managing payroll tax compliance, reconciliations, and year-end payroll activities.
  • Experience working with third-party international payroll providers.
  • Experience partnering with HR Operations, Finance, Internal Audit, Tax, Accounting, Benefits, and external payroll providers.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of payroll compliance and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience supporting audits and implementing payroll process improvements.
  • Advanced knowledge of payroll administration and payroll compliance.
  • Extensive experience managing payroll through ADP Workforce Now (WFN) or comparable HRIS/payroll solutions.
  • Experience coordinating payroll across multiple countries and working with global payroll providers.
  • Knowledge of payroll taxation, wage and hour regulations, and employment compliance.
  • Experience with payroll accounting, reconciliations, and general ledger processes.

jobs.excerpt: Silver Lining is hiring a Financial Controller to own the day-to-day finance, bookkeeping, and compliance function for the company.
jobs.description:
Silver Lining is hiring a Financial Controller to own the day-to-day finance, bookkeeping, and compliance function for the company. This is a hands-on execution role — not a strategic CFO seat. You keep the books clean, the filings on time, and the numbers trustworthy, so the founders and leadership can make decisions on financials they can rely on.

You take over the day-to-day finance operations the company has been running in-house, working closely with leadership and our external accountants. You own accuracy, timeliness, and compliance end to end, and you are the single point of accountability for the integrity of our books.

How we work — read this before applying Silver Lining is building toward a modern, AI-assisted finance function. Our intent is to automate the routine reporting, reconciliation, and data-preparation work — and this role is central to helping set that up and then running it as the human in the loop.

In practice that means you will help stand up the tooling and processes, then review, validate, correct, and sign off on AI-prepared work — owning the accuracy and compliance judgment that no tool can own. You should be genuinely comfortable working alongside AI finance tools: directing them, catching their mistakes, knowing when not to trust them, and being personally accountable for the final output that leadership and regulators see.

This is not a role for someone who wants to do everything by hand, and it is not a role for someone who will rubber-stamp whatever a tool produces. We want a controller who treats automation as leverage and treats their own review as the control that makes it safe. Candidates with experience operating as the human reviewer in an AI-augmented or highly automated finance function are strongly preferred.

What you'll do:

  • Bookkeeping & month-end close Own day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction categorization, journal entries, accruals, and a disciplined month-end close.

  • Maintain a clean, auditable chart of accounts and consistent coding.

  • Accounts payable & receivable

  • Manage AP and AR end to end; run, reconcile, and chase aging.

  • Ensure vendors are paid on time and receivables are collected and applied correctly.

  • Reconciliations

  • Perform and document bank, credit card, and balance-sheet account reconciliations on a fixed cadence.

  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies, leaving a clear audit trail.

  • Payroll Support payroll processing and reconciliation; ensure payroll is recorded accurately and on schedule.

  • Compliance & filings Prepare and file required statutory, tax, and compliance filings on time.

  • Coordinate with external accountants and auditors; prepare clean workpapers and respond to requests. Track filing deadlines so nothing slips.

  • Reporting

  • Produce clean, reliable monthly financial reporting packs — P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.

  • Deliver them on a predictable schedule with variance notes that a non-financial reader can follow. AI / automation & controls

  • Help design and stand up AI and automation tooling for finance (reconciliation, data prep, reporting).

  • Act as the control point: review and validate tool output before it is relied upon, and own the final sign-off.

  • Continuously tighten the process so more of the routine work is automated and your time goes to judgment and review.

  • Communication

  • Explain financial adjustments and results clearly to non-financial founders and leadership.

  • Flag risks, cash concerns, and compliance issues early and plainly.

    What you bring (required):

  • Proven bookkeeping / controller experience for a small business, with hands-on

  • QuickBooks Online expertise (QuickBooks ProAdvisor or equivalent active certification preferred).

  • A repeatable, documented process for producing P&Ls, AR/AP, and bank reconciliations — you can show us how you close a month.

  • Comfort and confidence using AI and automation tools in a finance context; experience as the human-in-the-loop reviewer strongly preferred.

  • Strong, plain-English communication — able to make complex financial detail simple for non-financial leaders.

  • High integrity, sharp attention to detail, and genuine ownership of compliance and deadlines. Ability to work independently and remotely with minimal oversight.

    Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting a lending, fintech, or multi-entity business.

  • Familiarity with US tax and statutory filing requirements.

  • Track record introducing automation or AI tooling into a finance function and owning the controls around it.
