jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Virtualization / Automation Engineer to operate, maintain, automate, and improve the virtualization and Software-Defined Data Center platforms supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Virtualization / Automation Engineer to operate, maintain, automate, and improve the virtualization and Software-Defined Data Center platforms supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position supports VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager, and associated infrastructure-automation capabilities.

The Virtualization / Automation Engineer maintains secure, available, scalable, and recoverable platform services across production, development, testing, COOP, disaster-recovery, and hybrid-hosting environments. The engineer develops and maintains Infrastructure as Code and configuration-automation solutions that improve operational consistency, deployment speed, security, compliance, and recoverability.

This role is focused on the virtualization platform and its supporting automation. Routine ownership of guest operating systems, applications, databases, and cloud workloads remains with the appropriate system, application, database, and cloud teams. The engineer supports those teams by delivering and maintaining the underlying compute, storage, network-virtualization, and recovery capabilities their workloads consume.

The position also supports the transition of applicable infrastructure and services from on-premises environments to centralized DISA-hosting platforms through discovery, documentation, platform preparation, migration support, technical validation, and post-transition stabilization.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional on-site support, after-hours maintenance, incident response, and travel may be required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Virtualization / Automation Engineer will:

  • Configure, administer, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise hypervisor and Software-Defined Data Center platforms.
  • Support VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager, and associated platform-management capabilities.
  • Maintain virtualization clusters supporting production, development, testing, COOP, and disaster-recovery environments.
  • Configure and support vSphere High Availability, Distributed Resource Scheduler, resource pools, clusters, hosts, datastores, distributed switches, and related platform services.
  • Support ESXi host and vCenter installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate maintenance, and lifecycle activities.
  • Monitor platform capacity, availability, performance, utilization, health, and configuration compliance.
  • Analyze processor, memory, storage, network, and cluster utilization and recommend corrective or capacity actions.
  • Configure and support vSAN clusters, disk groups, storage policies, capacity controls, fault domains, and health monitoring.
  • Troubleshoot vSAN capacity, performance, availability, resynchronization, hardware, and policy-compliance issues.
  • Configure and support approved NSX network-virtualization capabilities, including segments, transport zones, gateways, virtual switching, routing, and distributed security controls.
  • Coordinate NSX activities with network, cybersecurity, systems, application, and cloud teams.
  • Administer VMware Site Recovery Manager configurations, protection groups, inventory mappings, network mappings, and recovery plans.
  • Execute and document approved recovery-plan tests, failover activities, and failback activities.
  • Support quarterly COOP exercises, disaster-recovery testing, backup restoration, and actual continuity events.
  • Document exercise results, technical deficiencies, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, PowerCLI, APIs, or comparable tools.
  • Create reusable modules, playbooks, scripts, templates, and workflows for provisioning, configuration, validation, patching, compliance, and recovery.
  • Maintain automation code in approved version-control repositories.
  • Follow established peer-review, testing, approval, release, rollback, and documentation procedures for automation changes.
  • Implement appropriate logging, error handling, secrets protection, state management, and validation within automation solutions.
  • Automate repetitive administrative and configuration activities when authorized.
  • Support automated configuration-baseline checks and identify drift from approved platform standards.
  • Support infrastructure provisioning while preserving the division between platform ownership and guest operating-system, application, database, and workload ownership.
  • Coordinate with system administrators and workload owners regarding resource requirements, placement, templates, snapshots, virtual hardware, and platform dependencies.
  • Coordinate with storage, network, cloud, application, database, and cybersecurity teams to troubleshoot cross-platform incidents.
  • Provide advanced engineering support for virtualization, software-defined storage, network virtualization, automation, and recovery issues.
  • Support outage response by isolating platform failures, restoring services, implementing approved workarounds, and providing technical status updates.
  • Collect platform logs, events, performance information, configuration data, and other evidence needed for root-cause analysis.
  • Implement approved corrective and preventive actions resulting from incident and problem reviews.
  • Maintain backups of applicable platform configurations and support restoration testing.
  • Apply approved platform security baselines, patches, hardening settings, and configuration standards.
  • Support compliance with DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides and applicable vulnerability directives.
  • Assist with Risk Management Framework control implementation, evidence collection, assessment support, and remediation activities.
  • Review vendor notices, vulnerabilities, patches, and lifecycle information for potential platform impact.
  • Support technology refreshes and modernization activities involving compute, storage, network virtualization, hyperconverged infrastructure, and SDDC capabilities.
  • Assist with assessments of platform capacity, technical debt, security gaps, lifecycle risks, and modernization opportunities.
  • Contribute technical information to architecture options, implementation plans, schedules, cost estimates, and engineering recommendations.
  • Support the transition of applicable infrastructure and services to centralized DISA-hosting platforms.
  • Perform discovery and document existing platform inventories, configurations, interfaces, dependencies, network requirements, storage requirements, and recovery requirements.
  • Assist with platform-readiness assessments and coordinate with guest operating-system, application, database, and cloud-workload owners.
  • Support migration test plans, implementation procedures, rollback plans, cutover activities, validation, and post-migration stabilization.
  • Coordinate with Government stakeholders, DISA representatives, vendors, and technical teams during hosting-transition activities.
  • Support integration of SDDC capabilities with cloud, COOP, and on-premises environments.
  • Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, as-built documentation, configuration baselines, standard operating procedures, automation documentation, and recovery procedures.
  • Follow approved change, release, incident, problem, configuration, security, and quality-management processes.
  • Provide platform metrics, capacity information, accomplishments, risks, issues, and modernization status for program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant experience in virtualization, systems engineering, data-center infrastructure, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise hypervisor or Software-Defined Data Center platforms.
  • Experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience supporting vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager, or comparable software-defined storage, network-virtualization, and disaster-recovery technologies.
  • Experience developing, executing, or maintaining infrastructure-automation solutions.
  • Experience troubleshooting issues across virtualization, compute, storage, network, and automation layers.
  • Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup, restoration, capacity management, performance monitoring, and infrastructure lifecycle practices.
  • Ability to create and maintain technical procedures, automation documentation, configuration records, architecture diagrams, and recovery documentation.
  • Ability to support after-hours maintenance, disaster-recovery exercises, and critical incident response when required.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Formal Terraform training.
  • Formal Ansible training.
  • VMware Certified Professional certification.
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate certification.
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation or comparable automation certification.
  • Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Aria automation and operations capabilities.
  • Experience with PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or comparable scripting technologies.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense virtualization environments.
  • Experience supporting DISA-hosted services or migrations to DISA enterprise-hosting platforms.
  • Experience with DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, Risk Management Framework controls, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance.
  • Experience integrating virtualization platforms with hybrid-cloud, COOP, or disaster-recovery environments.
  • Experience developing Infrastructure as Code within controlled version-control and CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, peer review, code scanning, and configuration-drift detection.
  • Experience supporting data-center modernization, platform migrations, or hosting transitions.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • Relevant cloud, security, storage, or network certification.

Skills and Competencies

  • Enterprise virtualization and SDDC administration.
  • VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, and SRM.
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration automation.
  • High availability, disaster recovery, and COOP support.
  • Platform capacity, performance, and lifecycle management.
  • Secure configuration and compliance support.
  • Complex infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Hybrid-hosting and migration support.
  • Technical-documentation development.
  • Cross-functional engineering coordination.
  • Controlled change and release implementation.
  • Strong attention to detail and configuration discipline.
  • Ability to distinguish virtualization-platform responsibilities from guest operating-system and workload ownership.

jobs.description:
Global Strategic Account Manager

About JRNI

JRNI is the enterprise platform for scheduling and managing high-value, one-to-one customer experiences — appointments, virtual and in-person consultations, events, and queuing — at global scale. Some of the world’s largest retail and financial services brands rely on JRNI to connect customers with the right expert at the right moment, turning individual interactions into measurable revenue, loyalty, and lifetime value. We serve blue-chip enterprises across multiple regions and industries, and our customers sit at the center of everything we build and every decision we make.

Role Summary

The Global Strategic Account Manager owns the growth and expansion of a portfolio of JRNI’s most important global enterprise accounts. This is a senior, quota-carrying individual-contributor role reporting directly into the CCO organization that owns Customer Expansion and Growth. You are the commercial owner of your book of business: accountable for protecting and growing recurring revenue, deepening executive relationships across complex multinational organizations, and converting customer success into commercial outcomes.

This role is for a consultative, outcome-oriented seller who thrives on long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise relationships. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, orchestrate cross-functional internal teams around each account, and build multi-year expansion plans that align JRNI’s roadmap to your customers’ strategic priorities. Success is measured by net revenue retention, expansion bookings, and the durability of the partnerships you build.

Key Responsibilities

Own revenue retention and growth

  • Carry and consistently achieve a net-new expansion and renewal quota across a defined portfolio of global strategic accounts.
  • Drive net revenue retention (NRR) by protecting the existing base and expanding through cross-sell, upsell, seat and volume growth, and new use cases, regions, and business units.
  • Own the full renewal lifecycle — forecasting, negotiation, and on-time closure — protecting value while minimizing churn and contraction.

Build and execute strategic account plans

  • Develop and maintain multi-year account and territory plans that map JRNI’s capabilities and roadmap to each customer’s strategic and financial objectives.
  • Identify whitespace and build a data-driven expansion pipeline spanning additional geographies, lines of business, and product lines.
  • Lead executive business reviews (EBRs) that quantify realized value and secure sponsorship for the next phase of growth.

Cultivate executive and multi-threaded relationships

  • Establish and expand relationships with senior stakeholders — from economic buyers and C-suite sponsors to operational champions — across complex, matrixed global organizations.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor, bringing industry insight, benchmarks, and a clear point of view on how enterprises create value through customer experience.
  • Navigate and multi-thread across regions and functions to reduce single-threaded risk and build durable, sponsor-backed partnerships.

Orchestrate the internal team

  • Act as the commercial quarterback for each account, aligning Customer Success, Solutions/Value Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services around a shared growth plan.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success to translate adoption, health, and value realization into commercial expansion.
  • Channel customer needs and market signals back to Product and Leadership to inform roadmap and go-to-market priorities.

Forecast, negotiate, and operate with rigor

  • Maintain accurate, timely forecasts and healthy pipeline hygiene in the CRM; deliver predictable results against monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations — pricing, packaging, and multi-year contracting — in partnership with Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance.
  • Apply a structured value-selling and mutual-success-planning methodology throughout the customer lifecycle.

Success Metrics

Performance in this role is evaluated against a clear set of growth and retention outcomes:

Metric

What it measures

Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

Primary measure of growth within the assigned book of strategic accounts

Expansion / Upsell Bookings

New ARR generated through cross-sell, seat/volume growth, and new use cases

Pipeline Coverage

Qualified expansion pipeline sufficient to support quota attainment

Account Health & Adoption

Product utilization, executive engagement, and reference-ability

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying experience in enterprise SaaS account management, strategic/key account management, or enterprise expansion sales, with a consistent record of exceeding retention and growth targets.
  • Demonstrated success managing and growing large, global, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts (six- and seven-figure ARR).
  • Proven ability to drive net revenue retention through renewals, upsell, and cross-sell in a recurring-revenue model.
  • Strong executive presence and consultative, value-based selling skills; able to build credibility with C-level and senior business leaders.
  • Excellent commercial negotiation skills across complex, multi-year enterprise agreements.
  • Experience orchestrating cross-functional internal teams (Customer Success, Product, Solutions, Professional Services) around account outcomes.
  • Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in a modern CRM (e.g., Salesforce); familiarity with a structured sales methodology (e.g., MEDDICC, Command of the Message, value selling).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable operating across global time zones and cultures.

Preferred

  • Experience selling into or within retail and/or financial services enterprises.
  • Background in customer experience, appointment scheduling, CRM, or related enterprise software categories.
  • Experience expanding accounts across multiple regions and business units within a single global customer.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Competencies

  • Ownership and accountability — treats the book of business as their own P&L.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen — connects customer outcomes to revenue.
  • Relationship-building and influence — earns trust with senior stakeholders.
  • Collaboration — leads without authority across internal teams.
  • Resilience and drive — thrives in long, complex enterprise cycles.
  • Customer-first mindset — puts durable customer value ahead of the short-term deal.

Compensation & Benefits

Target compensation: Base salary of $135,000–$155,000 with a variable component tied to retention and expansion performance, for an on-target earnings (OTE) range of $225,000–$265,000 (approximately a 60/40 base-to-variable split). Final offers are calibrated to experience, and the package includes equity, comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits, and paid time off.

Note: Compensation ranges are indicative and should be finalized with People/Total Rewards and calibrated to current market bands and candidate location.

Overview

The Technical Trainer is responsible for planning and delivering training programs that enable warehouse teams to effectively use the Warehouse Management System. This role develops training materials, schedules training sessions, and ensures operators and supervisors understand system workflows. The Technical Trainer also supports go-live activities and conducts process audits to ensure operational adherence to system processes

Responsibilities

Training Planning & Delivery

  • Develop and manage training schedules for WMS implementations and system enhancements

  • Deliver instructor-led and hands-on training for warehouse operators, supervisors, and super users

  • Coordinate training sessions with site leadership and project teams

  • Facilitate classroom and floor-based training sessions

Training Content Development

  • Create and maintain user guides, job aids, and process documentation

  • Develop role-based training materials for different warehouse functions (receiving, picking, packing, shipping, inventory)

  • Determines utilization and validates documentation through testing systems.

  • Update training content as system changes or enhancements are introduced

  • Support creation of simulation scenarios in training environments

  • Report training metrics related to systems training, such as satisfaction, completion rates, learner retention.

Go-Live Training Support

  • Support WMS implementations through onsite training and floor support

  • Assist operators and supervisors in executing system workflows during initial adoption

  • Address training-related questions and provide immediate coaching

Process Compliance & Audits

  • Assess learners’ retention of learning and ensure they are able to apply their knowledge to their everyday use of the technical systems. Measure the effectiveness of the training.

  • Conduct process enforcements during go-live and stabilization phases

  • Ensure operational teams are following defined WMS processes and scanning procedures

  • Identify process gaps and provide corrective coaching

  • Escalate training or process issues to project leadership

Collaboration

  • Partner with operations, IT, and implementation teams to align training with system configuration

  • Support superuser development at warehouse sites

  • Promote user knowledge sharing of the technical systems through the use of our social collaboration tool.

  • Maintain and continuously improve the training program and resources.

  • Maintains technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing publications.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, adult learning experience or similar degree required.
  • 3–5 years of experience in warehouse operations, WMS, or supply chain systems training
  • Strong understanding of warehouse processes (receiving, putaway, picking, packing, shipping, inventory)
  • Demonstrates intermediate facilitation skills, both in the classroom and virtual environments.
  • Experience delivering instructor-led or operational training
  • Demonstrates intermediate skills in all phases of instructional design/delivery (ADDIE). Demonstrates working knowledge of e-learning development software and learning management systems.

  • Has a high level of attention to detail, quality, and customer focus.

About Unreal

Our story began when two kids asked a simple question: Why does everything that tastes so good have to have so much junk?

They set out to prove that unbelievably delicious chocolate snacks could be made with real, simple ingredients and way less sugar. In doing so, they sent a bold message to the whole category: do better.

More than a decade later, that same ambitious spirit still drives Unreal. What started as a simple question has grown into a beloved national brand, raising the bar for snacking in over 35,000 stores including Target, Whole Foods Market, Costco, Sprouts, Kroger, and Publix. We're also sold online through Amazon, Thrive Market, and at .

Job Summary

The Manager, Small Format will lead the development and growth of Unreal’s business across Convenience, Drug, Off-Price, and Military channels. This role will be responsible for expanding distribution, securing new national and regional accounts, establishing strong customer and route-to-market partnerships, and building channel-specific sales strategies that drive sustainable velocity. The ideal candidate will bring a builder's mindset and strong commercial initiative to help establish the strategies, programs, and partnerships needed to build Small Format into a meaningful, scalable, and sustainable growth channel for Unreal.

The Manager, Small Format will be a vital member of the Unreal Field Sales team and report to the Director, Foodservice. In this role, you will collaborate closely with teammates across the Commercial department (including Customer Strategy & Planning and Digital Marketing) as well as cross-functional partners in Operations and Finance. This is a remote position that requires approximately 25% travel for in-person customer meetings, distributor shows, industry trade events, field visits, and company offsite events.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute comprehensive growth strategies across Convenience, Drug, Off-Price, and Military channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective national and regional account opportunities to win incremental distribution placements.
  • Develop and grow relationships with key retail buyers, category managers, brokers, and military partners to expand distribution.
  • Manage day-to-day operations with distributors, wholesalers, and redistributors to ensure high fulfillment and in-stock rates.
  • Design channel-specific product assortment, pricing models, promotional plans, and merchandising strategies that increase velocity and drive repeat purchase.
  • Manage volume forecasting, trade spend budgets, and performance reporting.
  • Translate syndicated data platform insights (SPINS, IRI, Nielsen) and distributor reports into compelling customer presentation decks.
  • Partner closely across Customer Strategy & Planning (CS&P), Digital Marketing, Operations, and Finance to ensure seamless execution from account sell-in through product launch.
  • Represent Unreal at food shows or foodservice events, retailer meetings, and industry conferences.
  • Build a repeatable Small Format sales playbook to establish the foundation for scalable, long-term channel expansion.

Who You Are

  • Demonstrated key account management experience in CPG food or beverage sales required, with direct experience selling into Convenience (C-Store), Drug, Off-Price, Military, or Away From Home channels a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to build new account business from prospecting through retail launch and ongoing management.
  • Experience managing external broker networks, wholesalers, and redistributors.
  • Knowledge of channel pricing structures, trade spend management, promotional planning, forecasting, and product assortment strategies.
  • Ability to translate syndicated data (SPINS, IRI, Nielsen) into compelling sales narratives and buyer presentations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience with Trade Promotion Management (TPM) software (Modus or similar) is a plus.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets (Excel/Sheets) and presentation decks (PowerPoint/Slides).
  • Ability to prioritize account pipelines and execute sales goals independently.
  • Valid driver's license and vehicle for field visits.

jobs.title: Senior Venture Builder, Jobtech Alliance
jobs.excerpt: About us BFA Global is an impact innovation firm that combines research, advisory, venture building, and investment expertise to build a more inclusive, equitable, and resilient future for underserved people and the planet.
jobs.description:
About us

BFA Global is an impact innovation firm that combines research, advisory, venture building, and investment expertise to build a more inclusive, equitable, and resilient future for underserved people and the planet. We partner with leading public, private, and philanthropic organizations, both global and local, to catalyze innovation ecosystems for impact across emerging markets.

About the Jobtech Program

In late 2021, the Jobtech Alliance was launched by BFA Global and Prosper Global, a Pan-African ecosystem-building initiative around inclusive jobtech in Africa. The Jobtech Alliance has a portfolio of grants for acceleration activities with jobtech startups and for wider ecosystem-building. We learn by doing, conduct research to better understand what makes these innovations work (or not), and explore emerging themes to help define and guide the sector. Digital Advancement for Women Now (DAWN) is a project in Nigeria that enables underserved young people, with a particular focus on young women, alongside refugees and displaced people and persons with disabilities, to access safe, inclusive and dignified work through jobtech startups.

About the Role

The Senior Venture Builder will play a critical role in helping DAWN's portfolio of jobtech and digital platforms grow, strengthen their business models, and expand their capacity to create dignified, sustainable and inclusive work opportunities for financially disadvantaged youth. The role combines hands-on venture building with strategic advisory, experimentation, technical assistance, and ecosystem engagement. The Senior Venture Builder will work directly with exceptional founders and leadership teams to diagnose constraints, identify growth opportunities, design and execute targeted interventions, and translate business growth into measurable transition-to-work outcomes.

This is a highly hands-on role. The Senior Venture Builder will be expected not only to advise companies but to work alongside founders to solve hard problems, test solutions, analyze data, build and launch experiments, and drive implementation and execution.

This role will report to the Head of Venture Building and work closely with the Investment Lead, other Venture Builders, BFA specialists, consortium partners, and external experts to ensure each startup engagement delivers meaningful business and employment outcomes, and contributes to the wider DAWN program objectives.

Key responsibilities

Support Platform Selection & Portfolio Development (5%)

Contribute to building a strong pipeline and portfolio of platforms aligned with DAWN's objectives.

  • Support the sourcing and evaluation of promising jobtech and digital platforms.
    • Identify companies capable of reaching underserved workers beyond traditional urban technology ecosystems.
  • Assess companies for commercial potential, scalability, founder capability, work-creation potential, inclusion, and strategic fit.
  • Contribute to due diligence and company-selection processes.
  • Where required, take platforms through our selection committee process, including contracting with the Project Manager
  • Surface emerging sectors, platform models, and business models with potential to generate significant employment and income opportunities.
  • Identify cross-portfolio opportunities where companies can collaborate

Lead Venture Building Engagements (65%)

Lead complex venture-building engagements with selected jobtech and digital platforms from initial diagnosis through execution and learning.

  • Proactively experiment with and apply AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of venture-building work.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with founders and senior leadership teams.
  • Lead Sprint 0 and diagnostic processes to understand each company's business model, growth trajectory, operational constraints, worker experience, and opportunities for scale.
  • Translate company challenges into clearly defined venture-building scopes with measurable objectives, deliverables, timelines, and outcomes.
  • Develop clear hypotheses linking proposed interventions to company growth and increased work opportunities for financially disadvantaged youth.
  • Support portfolio companies to become stronger, more scalable businesses capable of sustainably creating work for financially disadvantaged youth.
  • Lead each venture-building engagement autonomously from beginning to end.
  • Provide strategic guidance to founders on business model evolution, growth strategy, product development, operations, fundraising, partnerships, and long-term growth pathways.
  • Coordinate any relevant BFA specialists and external experts required to deliver engagements.
  • Provide hands-on specialist support where appropriate rather than relying solely on external resources.
  • Manage all engagements within agreed budgets and timelines while maintaining a high standard of founder experience.
  • Identify risks or underperformance early and work with the Head of Venture Building and founders to make appropriate course corrections.
  • Bring a strong experimentation and product mindset to each engagement.
  • Document what was tested, what worked, what failed, and what should be scaled or discontinued.

Drive Business Growth & Transition-to-Work Outcomes (10%)

Help our portfolio companies translate commercial growth into increased access to work and income opportunities for DAWN participants.

  • Understand the commercial drivers behind each platform's ability to create work, including customer demand, worker supply, unit economics, pricing, retention, geographic expansion, and operational capacity.
  • Work with founders to identify and remove bottlenecks preventing them from onboarding and activating more workers.
  • Develop strategies that improve worker acquisition, activation, utilization, productivity, retention, and earnings.
  • Ensure particular attention is given to the barriers affecting young women, refugees and displaced people, persons with disabilities, and other underserved groups.
  • Analyze company and worker-level data to understand what is driving or limiting work outcomes.
  • Help platforms establish commercially sustainable approaches to inclusion rather than relying solely on program-funded interventions.
  • Work with platforms to define realistic pathways from participant onboarding to verified work and income.
  • Track whether venture-building interventions are generating the intended business and transition-to-work outcomes.

Ecosystem & Partnership Engagement (10%)

Build relationships that strengthen both individual portfolio companies and the wider jobtech ecosystem.

  • Develop relationships with investors, corporates, technology partners, funders, industry experts, accelerators, and ecosystem organizations.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that can accelerate portfolio company growth.
  • Facilitate introductions between founders and potential investors, customers, partners, and experts.
  • Identify investors whose theses align with DAWN portfolio companies.
  • Gather recommendations from investors and ecosystem partners on promising companies and emerging market opportunities.
  • Represent BFA Global and DAWN at relevant conferences, industry events, roundtables, and ecosystem forums.
  • Advocate for commercially sustainable approaches to inclusive job creation and platform-based work.

Learning, Insights & Venture-Building Methodology (10%)

Ensure lessons from individual engagements strengthen BFA's wider approach to venture building and DAWN's learning agenda.

  • Harvest insights systematically from venture-building engagements and experiments.
  • Identify recurring patterns across business models, sectors, worker pathways, and growth challenges.
  • Document case studies, practical tools, playbooks, and lessons from engagements.
  • Contribute to blogs, reports, learning products, and other thought-leadership outputs.
  • Translate company-level experiences into practical insights that can inform DAWN's future platform strategy.
  • Work with the Head of Venture Building and Jobtech Alliance research and learning teams to identify what interventions are most effective in driving business and work outcomes.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in venture building, startups, accelerators, management consulting, venture capital, product management, innovation, or a fast-growing technology company.
  • Demonstrated experience working directly with startup founders and senior leadership teams to solve complex business and growth challenges.
  • Strong experience supporting startups in Nigeria or other emerging markets.
  • Demonstrated experience taking companies or products through experimentation, validation, growth, or scale.
  • Strong understanding of startup business models, unit economics, growth strategy, product development, operations, and fundraising.
  • Experience designing and executing MVPs, pilots, experiments, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Expertise in lean product management, including design sprints, value proposition design, hypothesis-driven experimentation, customer discovery, and roadmap prioritization.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical capability, including the ability to conduct deep dives into company and customer data and translate findings into action.
  • Experience supporting companies to raise capital or direct experience in startup investing would be advantageous.
  • Strong networks across the startup, investor, technology, or innovation ecosystem.
  • Experience mentoring founders, Venture Builders, analysts, or other junior team members.
  • Strong project management and execution capability, with the ability to manage several complex engagements simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial, highly collaborative, and geographically distributed environment.

Demonstrated experience in jobtech, marketplaces, digital platforms, future of work, fintech, e-commerce, or other technology-enabled business models is highly desirable.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Technology, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
  • An MBA, Master's degree, or other relevant advanced qualification is an advantage, but equivalent practical startup and venture-building experience will be strongly considered.

The Summer 2027 Predictive Modeling & Data Science Graduate Internship provides graduate students with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience developing advanced analytics and data science solutions that support meaningful business decisions, processes, and strategic initiatives. This internship is designed for students who are passionate about using data, statistics, and machine learning to solve complex problems and translate analytical findings into actionable business insights.


As a member of the advanced analytics team, the intern will work alongside experienced data scientists, analysts, and business partners to help design, develop, and evaluate analytical solutions that address real-world business challenges. Participants will gain practical experience applying statistical and machine learning methodologies, developing predictive models, analyzing complex datasets, and visualizing results to support data-driven decision-making.


The program provides exposure to the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, from understanding a business question and exploring available data through model development, evaluation, visualization, and delivery of findings. Interns will also have opportunities to explore new data sources, analytical tools, and emerging techniques while contributing to next-generation analytics initiatives.


Typical responsibilities include conducting exploratory and statistical analysis, supporting predictive model development, preparing and transforming data, evaluating model results, creating data visualizations, researching new analytical approaches, and communicating findings and recommendations to technical and business audiences. Through mentorship, cross-functional collaboration, and project-based learning, participants will strengthen their technical, analytical, problem-solving, and storytelling skills while building a strong foundation for a career in data science and advanced analytics.

jobs.excerpt: About UsUJET leads the way in AI-powered contact center innovation, delivering a future-proof, cloud platform that redefines the customer experience with cutting-edge AI, true multimodality, and a mobile-first approach.
jobs.description:
About Us

UJET leads the way in AI-powered contact center innovation, delivering a future-proof, cloud platform that redefines the customer experience with cutting-edge AI, true multimodality, and a mobile-first approach. We infuse AI across every aspect of your customer journey and contact center operations, to drive automation and efficiency. UJET's AI solutions empower agents, optimize customer journeys, and transform contact center operations for elevated experiences and actionable insights. Built on a cloud-native architecture with a unique CRM-first approach, UJET ensures unmatched security, scalability, and prioritized data insights (without storing PII). Designed for effortless use, UJET partners with businesses to deliver exceptional interactions, smarter decision-making, and accelerated growth in the AI-driven world.

Learn more at .

The Opportunity

Lead the team responsible for the production GCP and Kubernetes infrastructure powering our cloud-native SaaS platform.

The Cloud Infrastructure team owns the cloud environment that powers our products, including GCP architecture, networking, Kubernetes infrastructure, infrastructure provisioning, observability foundations, IAM and secrets, infrastructure security primitives, and cloud cost optimization.

As Senior Manager, Cloud Infrastructure, you will lead experienced infrastructure engineers, set technical strategy and execution priorities, and own the reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency of our underlying cloud environment. You will turn complex infrastructure challenges into clear plans, safe changes, and measurable outcomes.

This is a technical engineering leadership role for someone who has personally built, operated, and troubleshot production cloud infrastructure, including Kubernetes clusters, not just deployed applications into existing clusters. You will not implement every Terraform module or resolve every incident yourself, but you must have the depth to guide senior and staff engineers, question designs, and lead decisions during complex infrastructure failures.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing team of senior and staff infrastructure engineers; set clear priorities, ownership, expectations, and delivery accountability.
  • Own the strategy and evolution of the cloud environment, including GCP architecture, networking, Kubernetes infrastructure, infrastructure provisioning, and shared infrastructure services.
  • Provide technical direction for GCP organization and project architecture, shared networking, VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, routing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, load balancing, IAM, and service connectivity.
  • Own the technical strategy and operational standards for production Kubernetes/GKE clusters, including provisioning, control-plane and node lifecycle, networking, scheduling, autoscaling, capacity, upgrades, and cluster-level troubleshooting.
  • Set engineering standards for Terraform modules, remote state, Git-based reviews, automated validation, infrastructure provisioning, change safety, and reusable infrastructure patterns.
  • Establish and evolve infrastructure security foundations including IAM, service accounts, secrets management, network controls, and other cloud security primitives.
  • Ensure teams have strong foundational observability capabilities, including metrics, logging, tracing, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Drive cloud cost efficiency through architecture, capacity planning, resource optimization, and visibility into infrastructure spend.
  • Lead major GKE, Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure upgrades or migrations with explicit plans for testing, compatibility, staged rollout, rollback, blast-radius reduction, and operational readiness.
  • Define measurable outcomes for cluster health, upgrade currency, infrastructure reliability, provisioning quality, operational toil, security posture, capacity, and cloud spend; use them to prioritize improvements.
  • Partner closely with Platform Engineering, SRE, Security, and application engineering teams to establish clear ownership boundaries and provide infrastructure that enables teams to operate effectively.
  • Develop senior and staff engineers, providing technical coaching, career development, and opportunities for increased ownership and influence.
  • Build a culture of systematic debugging, strong design reviews, incident learning, operational ownership, pragmatic decision-making, and continuous improvement.

What This Team Owns

Cloud Infrastructure owns the foundational environment the company runs on, including:

  • GCP organization and project structure
  • Cloud networking, VPCs, load balancers, routing, and DNS
  • Production Kubernetes/GKE cluster architecture, operation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle
  • Terraform frameworks, modules, state, automation, and infrastructure provisioning
  • Base infrastructure observability and telemetry
  • IAM and service accounts
  • Secrets infrastructure
  • Infrastructure security primitives
  • Cloud capacity and cost optimization
  • Infrastructure upgrades and lifecycle management

The team does not own the applications running in that environment. Application reliability, application deployment workflows, developer tooling, and CI/CD are owned by adjacent engineering teams.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional engineering experience in cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, infrastructure platform engineering, SRE, or related disciplines, including substantial direct production infrastructure ownership.
  • 3+ years of people management experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and leading senior-level infrastructure engineers.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, provisioning, operating, and troubleshooting production public-cloud infrastructure; substantial GCP experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep working knowledge of cloud networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, firewalls, NAT, DNS, load balancing, service connectivity, TCP/IP, HTTP(S), and TLS.
  • Direct production experience administering and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters, preferably GKE, with understanding of control planes, worker nodes, scheduling, services, ingress, networking, DNS, storage, resource pressure, node pools, and upgrades. Experience limited to deploying applications into Kubernetes is insufficient.
  • Significant hands-on Terraform experience, including reusable modules, remote state, automation, Git-based workflows, and safe review and deployment of infrastructure changes.
  • Experience designing and operating highly available, scalable production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals including IAM, service accounts, secrets management, and infrastructure security controls.
  • Experience leading complex infrastructure migrations, upgrades, or architectural changes with significant potential blast radius.
  • Excellent systems and production troubleshooting judgment across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, DNS, and cloud services; ability to lead teams through difficult root-cause investigations.
  • Demonstrated ability to make pragmatic technical tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, security, engineering velocity, and cost.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, developing, evaluating, and retaining strong infrastructure engineers while delegating meaningful technical ownership.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership to senior and staff-level engineers without needing to personally own every implementation detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, security, product, and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading teams responsible for large-scale, multi-cluster or multi-region GKE/Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience designing reusable Terraform frameworks and infrastructure standards used across multiple engineering teams.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging, infrastructure alerting, tracing, and observability standards.
  • Experience driving meaningful cloud cost optimization initiatives.
  • Experience operating infrastructure for SaaS platforms with high availability and scalability requirements.
  • Experience working in environments with strong security and compliance requirements.
  • Experience helping define clear organizational boundaries between Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, SRE, Security, and application engineering.

What Success Looks Like

You will build a Cloud Infrastructure organization that senior engineers respect and application teams trust.

Production GKE clusters and GCP networking are resilient, observable, and consistently maintained. Terraform changes are repeatable and reviewed. Major upgrades are planned and executed with controlled risk. Incidents lead to durable fixes. Cloud capacity and spending are understood and managed. Senior and staff engineers operate with autonomy, clear accountability, and strong technical guidance.

Most importantly, Cloud Infrastructure provides a stable, secure, and well-automated foundation so product teams can move quickly without needing to become experts in the underlying cloud environment.

Annual US Hiring Range: $170,000 - $190,000

*A candidate’s actual placement within this range will depend on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

Why UJET?

  • Impactful Work: Be at the forefront of innovation, directly shaping the future of customer experience.
  • Dynamic Culture: Join a collaborative, inclusive team that values big ideas, creative solutions, and powerful relationships.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, wellness benefits, and more.

UJET is an Equal Opportunity Employer

UJET provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compliance Responsibilities

Security, data protection and compliance (SDPC) are paramount to the success of our partnerships. All roles at UJET require compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and acceptance and adherence to all policies and standards within UJET. Personnel acknowledges they are personally responsible for reporting any suspected violations or abuse and are required to complete SDPC training and fulfill role-specific SDPC responsibilities.

AI Use in Our Hiring Process

UJET uses artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist with the initial review and filtering of job applications against the qualifications listed in this posting. AI does not make hiring decisions, does not conduct interviews, and has no authority to reject or advance a candidate on its own. All application review decisions, candidate screening, and interviews are conducted by members of our human recruiting and hiring teams.

Reasonable Accommodation

If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, including an alternative to AI-assisted screening, please contact .

Work Authorization & Sponsorship

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which this position is located, without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa sponsorship. UJET does not sponsor employment visas for this role.

HarmonyCares is a leading national value-based provider of in-home primary care services for people with complex healthcare needs. HarmonyCares employs more than 200+ primary care providers to deliver patient-centered care under an integrated, team-based, physician-driven model.

Our Mission– To bring personalized, quality-based healthcare to the home of patients who have difficult accessing care.

Our Shared Vision– Every patient deserves access to quality healthcare.

Our Values– The way we care is our legacy. Every interaction counts. Go the extra mile. Empower and support each other.

- Health, Dental, Vision, Disability & Life Insurance, and much more

Position Summary

The Accounts Payable Officer is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of supplier, subcontractor, and employee-related transactions. The role maintains a reliable accounts payable ledger, prepares the weekly payment run, supports month-end close, and works with operational teams to resolve issues with invoices, purchase orders, and approvals.

Job Details

Work-from-home

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM AEST

Following Australian Holidays

Key responsibilities
  • Invoice processing and coding
  • Receive, review and process supplier and subcontractor invoices, credit notes and adjustments across all assigned HL Group entities.
  • Validate entity, supplier details, ABN and GST treatment, invoice arithmetic, project or cost code, purchase order and required approval before posting.
  • Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect charges, missing documentation and other exceptions before payment.
  • Match invoices to purchase orders, delivery records, hire dockets, subcontract claims or other supporting documents where applicable.
  • Allocate costs accurately between projects, departments, assets, inventory and overhead accounts in accordance with the chart of accounts and finance procedures.

Approvals and payment runs
  • Monitor approval workflows and follow up outstanding approvals so invoices are ready for the weekly Tuesday payment run.
  • Prepare payment proposals by entity and payment method, including due-date, cash-flow and supplier-priority checks.
  • Verify bank account changes through an independent control process and escalate any suspected fraud or unusual request immediately.
  • Provide payment-run reports and supporting records for authorised review and release; do not release payments outside delegated authority.
  • Issue remittance advices and record payments accurately after authorisation.

Supplier and subcontractor accounts

  • Set up and maintain supplier records using approved onboarding documentation and controls.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to supplier queries, invoice disputes, account holds and payment-status requests.
  • Reconcile supplier statements to the accounts payable ledger and investigate missing invoices, credits, unapplied payments and aged items.
  • Maintain complete supporting records for subcontractor claims, retentions, statutory declarations, insurance or licence requirements where relevant to payment.
  • Monitor credit terms and help maintain constructive supplier relationships without bypassing HL's approval or cash-management controls.

Corporate cards and employee expenses

  • Review corporate card and employee expense transactions for valid tax invoices, correct coding, business purpose and required approval.
  • Follow up missing purchase orders and tax invoices in line with HL policy and escalate unresolved personal or unsupported expenditure.
  • Assist with timely reconciliation of card accounts and clearing accounts.

Month end and reporting
  • Complete accounts payable close tasks to the finance timetable, including cut-off reviews, outstanding invoice checks and reconciliation of control accounts.
  • Prepare or support accruals for goods and services received but not invoiced and reverse them as directed.
  • Reconcile accounts payable ageing and supplier balances to the general ledger and investigate variances.
  • Support intercompany allocations, audit requests, cash-flow forecasting and management reporting as required.
  • Maintain organised electronic records that support audit trails, tax compliance and document retention requirements.

Controls and continuous improvement

  • Follow segregation-of-duties, delegated-authority, payment-security, privacy and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Protect confidential supplier, employee, banking and commercial information.
  • Identify recurring invoice or workflow issues and recommend practical process improvements.
  • Maintain procedure notes and provide coverage or training support to other finance team members when required.
  • Carry out other reasonable finance and administration duties consistent with the position.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable (AP).
  • Proven experience managing the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, including invoice processing and payment coordination.

jobs.excerpt: At Spotted Zebra, we're building something we genuinely believe in: an AI-native end-to-end hiring platform that helps the world's leading organisations find the right people, faster and fairer than ever before.
jobs.description:
At Spotted Zebra, we're building something we genuinely believe in: an AI-native end-to-end hiring platform that helps the world's leading organisations find the right people, faster and fairer than ever before. In short, we're making hiring something everyone loves again - both talent teams and candidates alike.

We're a multi-award-winning Series A company giving talent leaders the solution they've always needed. Skills science native. AI-amplified. Built by people who've lived and breathed TA and knew there had to be a better way.

Spotted Zebra runs enterprise hiring end to end on one platform. It defines what great looks like for every role, then assesses, interviews and shortlists every candidate with AI. Every applicant gets a fair hearing, and candidates and hiring managers can put their time where success is most likely. One agent and assistant, Spot, works across every step, from booking interviews automatically to supporting confident, defensible decisions. Built on skills science and AI governance, it works the way talent teams need it to, with humans always in control.

The result is talent teams get the insight to predict who will succeed, the speed to move before competitors, the governance to defend every hiring decision, and the capacity to focus on the human moments that matter most.

But our product is only part of the story. We're also building an AI-native company. AI is changing how we build, sell, support customers and make decisions, helping us move faster, stay closer to customers and give talented people more leverage in their roles. Joining Spotted Zebra is a chance to shape what the future of work looks like inside a scaling company: compact, ambitious teams using AI to collaborate better, make decisions quickly, and deliver meaningful impact at speed.

The FTSE100 and Fortune500 companies trusting us include British Airways, NIQ, Domino's, Lidl, Merlin Entertainments, AWE, United Utilities, and Paramount. We've been named Personnel Today's Talent Acquisition Supplier of the Year, secured gold across multiple industry awards, and were recently named on the UK Top 100 Startups List.

But what we’re most proud of is the team. People join Spotted Zebra because the mission is real, the product is genuinely exciting, and the opportunity to shape the future of hiring is huge. What makes it special is the way we work: smart, committed people in compact teams where trust is high, decisions happen quickly, and everyone has the chance to make a visible impact. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to do your best work - read on.

Our Dazzle (that's our team!) 🦓

Fun fact: A group of zebras is called a dazzle – and ours truly is dazzling!

We create a culture in which our team thrives and gallops ahead.

As we roam free and empower our dazzle, we gallop ahead on the journey to achieving our goals. We understand this journey will pose challenges along the way, yet we brighten the trail with our positive mindset and encouragement of others. The dazzle continuously moves, gaining knowledge and skills so that we can graze new grounds.

What you'll be doing

As our Senior Occupational Psychologist (Product & Skills Science), you'll help define what assessment looks like in an AI-native world. AI is changing how candidates are assessed, from conversational AI interviews to scoring that learns from real hiring outcomes. You'll be the scientific expert making sure that shift is built on sound occupational psychology. This is a senior individual contributor role for a deep specialist who wants to turn skills science into products that change how the world hires.

You'll work directly with our Co-Founder, Nick Shaw, to set the scientific direction for our assessments. You'll define the principles behind them and work with our Data Science team to turn them into scalable, data-driven products. You'll champion rigorous, evidence-led approaches so our assessments are fair, predictive and effective at launch, and so they keep improving as they learn from more data.

You'll join a fast-moving, AI-native company that's rethinking assessment from first principles. Success in this role means combining scientific rigour with curiosity, pragmatism and a bias for action, and building new forms of assessment that stand up to scrutiny and deliver results in the real world.

Key responsibilities:

  • Shape the scientific foundations of a new generation of assessments, owning the skills science principles that determine what we measure and how we uncover the signals that matter
  • Pioneer new approaches to AI-powered assessment, from conversational interviews to adaptive formats, turning promising ideas into practical pilots and testing what works
  • Set the standard for intelligent scoring, defining strong and weak performance and creating golden examples and benchmarks to evaluate both candidates and our AI
  • Partner with our Data Science team to design evaluations that connect technical performance with sound psychological judgement, helping turn scientific principles into effective AI scoring
  • Build the evidence behind assessment innovation, leading ongoing validation to demonstrate reliability, fairness and predictive power as our products evolve
  • Make the science behind our products clear and credible through rigorous technical reports and manuals that give our teams and clients confidence in the results
  • Turn assessment data into product breakthroughs, using statistical analysis to uncover insights and translate them into better assessment design and scoring
  • Bring our science to life with clients, supporting validation and research alongside colleagues across the business to show how our assessments perform in the real world

Requirements

Must-haves ✅

  • A background in occupational or organisational psychology, with deep expertise in psychometrics and assessment design
  • Hands-on experience developing assessments such as situational judgement tests, personality measures or ability tests, ideally in an R&D environment
  • Proven validation experience: producing technical manuals or detailed validation reports that show an assessment’s reliability, fairness and predictive validity
  • Strong statistical and analytical skills, with experience using SPSS or similar statistical packages
  • Experience defining performance standards and building scoring frameworks or benchmarks
  • Startup or scale-up experience, and comfort with pace, ambiguity and changing priorities
  • An open-minded, solution-focused approach to AI in assessment: you look for ways to make new approaches work rather than reasons they can’t

Nice-to-haves 🌟

  • Experience with AI-enabled assessment, such as AI-scored interviews, automated scoring or other AI-driven assessment methods
  • Experience using Python or AI coding tools for analysis and validation work
  • Experience designing in-person assessment centres or exercises
  • Experience writing technical manuals or documenting assessments
  • Experience working closely with data scientists, engineers or product teams
  • Familiarity with evaluation methods for AI or machine learning systems
  • Chartered status with the BPS and/or HCPC registration as an Occupational Psychologist

Benefits

🏥 Health insurance

💰 Enhanced pension

🍼 Nursery salary sacrifice scheme
🏖️ 25 days holiday (excluding bank holidays)
🏠 Remote-first
💻 Work from home budget

🦷 Dental cover
👀 Eye-care support
🏢 Co-working space budget
🧘 Wellbeing allowance
✈️ Travel insurance

🚗 Electric car scheme

Beyond our core benefits, you'll get access to the latest AI-powered tools and technologies, giving you everything you need to do your best work.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Spotted Zebra, we welcome people of all stripes. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and an inclusive and diverse culture.

We believe that each and every one of us possesses an extraordinary set of skills and abilities, waiting to be discovered, nurtured, and harnessed for the benefit of all.

We are a team. And no matter your race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability, we will empower you to unleash your superpower to help us create a world where everyone is able to utilise their unique blend of skills and abilities to contribute to the greater good.

Everyone is unique and we encourage you to let us know in your application, or share with your recruiter directly, if there is anything we can do to make your interview experience with us more comfortable and positive.

At Spotted Zebra, everyone is welcome. So even if you don't meet all the requirements, we would still love to hear from you. We are always keen to speak with people who are passionate about our mission.

Ready to gallop ahead with us? We're a team that moves fast, thinks big, and isn't afraid to challenge how things have always been done. If you're excited about using AI and skills science to transform how the world hires, apply now and a member of our dazzle will be in touch! 🦓

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!


Job Description

Neogen Corporation is seeking a highly organized and analytical Supply Planner to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing product replenishment and developing supply plans through the review of forecasts, inventory levels, safety stock, and production requirements for both purchased and manufactured goods.


As a key connection between supply and demand, the Supply Planner serves as a primary point of contact across Manufacturing, Production, Sales, Quality, Customer Service, Laboratory, and other business functions. This position plays an important role in ensuring supply plans remain aligned with customer demand, production capabilities, inventory targets, and overall business objectives.


The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver who is comfortable working with ERP and planning systems, analyzing inventory and supply needs, and communicating across multiple levels of the organization.


Location: This position is remote with possible travel.


What You'll Do

As a Supply Planner, you will:

  • Create and maintain supply plans utilizing ERP and applicable supply chain planning systems.
  • Establish, maintain, and implement planning parameters within ERP and supply planning systems to support business and inventory requirements.
  • Review forecasts, inventory levels, safety stock, production capabilities, and other relevant data to develop effective replenishment plans.
  • Utilize ERP and supply chain tools to support targeted customer service levels while maintaining appropriate finished goods inventory.
  • Manage purchase orders for buy/sell finished goods and coordinate replenishment activities as needed.
  • Execute established supply planning processes and standard work while supporting adherence to key planning metrics.
  • Partner closely with Manufacturing, Production, Sales, Quality, Customer Service, Laboratory, and other business functions to align supply plans with operational and customer needs.
  • Develop both short- and long-term supply plans to balance supply and demand while supporting customer requirements.
  • Support capacity planning, demand and supply synchronization, and execution against strategic business objectives.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate stock and safety-stock levels while proactively working to prevent excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer service levels, inventory turns, inventory health, and overall supply chain performance.
  • Monitor inventory availability and backorders, identifying potential supply constraints and escalating concerns when appropriate.
  • Communicate inventory status, backorder levels, supply risks, and planning priorities clearly and effectively across varying levels of the organization.
  • Analyze supply and inventory trends and recommend actions that support sustainable operational improvements.

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

  • Associate degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Planning, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.
  • 2 or more years of experience in supply planning, inventory planning, logistics, production planning, purchasing, or a related supply chain function preferred.
  • Experience working with ERP, MRP, or other supply chain planning systems preferred.
  • Ability to analyze forecasts, inventory levels, supply requirements, and related planning data.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and changing business needs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across departments and organizational levels.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to use available information to make timely, well-informed decisions.

Skills & Competencies


Cultural Savvy – Demonstrates Neogen's Pillars of Trust—Openness, Honesty, Credibility, Respect, and Service—through actions, behaviors, decisions, and communication.


Communication – Communicates clearly and effectively with colleagues and stakeholders, adapts communication to the audience, and actively listens to understand business needs and priorities.


Collaboration & Leadership – Leads by example and contributes to a culture of trust, accountability, and teamwork while building productive cross-functional relationships.


Decision Making & Problem Solving – Identifies and evaluates relevant information, recognizes potential risks or constraints, and makes timely, informed decisions to support business objectives.


Driving Performance – Maintains focus and accountability, meets productivity and performance expectations, seeks opportunities for improvement, and knows when to engage others for support.


Organizational Strategy – Understands how individual responsibilities contribute to broader supply chain and organizational objectives and demonstrates curiosity about the needs of the business.


Physical Demands

The physical demands of this position are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the role. Specific physical requirements may vary depending on the work environment and assigned responsibilities.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.


Why Neogen

At Neogen, we believe that taking care of our employees allows them to do their best work. When you join our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work, collaborate with talented colleagues, and build your career with an organization focused on protecting the world's food supply.

Benefits Include

  • Benefits Starting on Day One – Medical, dental, and vision coverage begin on your first day of employment.
  • 401(k) with Company Match – Build toward your future with retirement savings and company contributions.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Take time to rest, recharge, and spend time with those who matter most.
  • Career Growth Opportunities – Access opportunities, tools, training, and support designed to help you continue developing your career.
  • Meaningful Work – Contribute to work that makes an impact on our customers, communities, and the world around us.
  • Collaborative Culture – Be part of an environment that values innovation, respect, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Join Neogen

If you're an analytical and collaborative supply chain professional who enjoys balancing customer needs, inventory, and operational priorities, we encourage you to apply and explore the opportunity to grow your career with Neogen.

Apply today and help Neogen protect the world's food supply.

Equal Employment Opportunity & Accommodations


Neogen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.


Neogen provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and applicants who require accommodation during the application or hiring process, consistent with applicable law.


Employment may be contingent upon the successful completion of applicable pre-employment requirements, which may include verification of identity and authorization to work in the United States and other job-related screening requirements, as permitted by applicable law.

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

jobs.description:
We Are

We are entering into a new decade of Data & AI that will reshape work and society. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data & AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry-defining work.

With over 77,000 professionals dedicated to Data & AI, Accenture’s Data & AI organization is powered by experienced innovation, strategic investment, exceptional talent, and our power ecosystem.

You Are

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and deploying next-generation AI systems powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). You will contribute across the full AI lifecycle — from researching and fine-tuning foundation models to prompt engineering, system integration, and deployment into production environments. You will improve performance, accuracy and alignment of the LLMs and AI systems. You bring a mix of hands-on engineering skills, deep knowledge of modern AI architectures, and a passion for applying AI responsibly to solve real-world problems. In addition, you will utilize your strong skills to develop and integrate AI Systems into products and services. You have expertise in designing, developing, and optimizing AI prompts.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize AI prompts and next-generation applications powered by foundation models, including Large Language Models (LLMs).

  • Architect and implement generative agent systems using frameworks for multi-model coordination to tackle complex tasks.

  • Develop application and component strategies, overseeing both user experience and backend systems.

  • Define, evaluate, and optimize AI system architectures, leveraging relevant frameworks and best practices.

  • Conduct thorough code reviews, provide expert guidance on enhancements and issue resolution, and ensure adherence to engineering standards.

  • Build and maintain scalable machine learning infrastructure, including distributed training pipelines and seamless integration with APIs and tools.

  • Apply advanced evaluation methodologies to ensure model robustness, safety, fairness, and minimize hallucination risks.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including business leaders, engineers, architects, and designers—to align AI systems with business objectives.

  • Support troubleshooting and issue resolution during testing phases as well as in production environments.

  • Document technical architecture, methodologies, and innovations for effective knowledge transfer and ongoing advancement.

Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s what you need

  • Minimum of 3 years of demonstrated expertise in successfully designing and building resilient AI systems or products, implementing controls and guardrails, context engineering, utilizing Evals in AI systems, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, and experience implementing best practices in implementing AI systems in production such as tracing, logging and unit testing.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience designing and creating AI Solutions using design patterns like retrieval augmentation generation (RAG) and handling data pipelines.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Engineering teams with one or more programming languages and frameworks, such as Python, JavaScript, Java, Spring or GoLang, showcasing a strong command over the technical foundations and mastery of one or more AI Frameworks like Autogen, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and others.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience working with application services from at least one public cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.), including use of AI and GenAI services and capabilities on these or similar platforms such as Anthropic.

  • Minimum of 1 years of experience leading a team or being part of team management, preferably in AI-driven project environments.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate's degree, must have minimum 6 years' work experience)

Bonus Points if you have

  • Experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs and multimodal foundation models using advanced techniques such as self-supervised and transfer learning.
  • Experience designing value justification frameworks for AI solutions, including cost estimation, ROI calculation, and tradeoff analysis.
  • Experience building AI solutions that utilize Model Context Protocol, Agent to Agent protocols and understanding of evolving agent standards and protocols.
  • Experience developing applications for both mobile and web platforms, showcasing versatility and adaptability in diverse environments.
  • Experience developing Agentic AI systems.
