jobs.excerpt: Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world.
jobs.description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead our Connected Experiences pod across three squads: Insights, MCP & API, and Integrations. Reporting to the Head of Product, you’ll own the product vision, strategy and outcomes across a connected set of product areas that are central to Fuel50’s next phase of growth.

You’ll help Fuel50 become more than a SaaS application by shaping how our platform delivers connected, contextual and portable work intelligence through APIs, integrations, MCP and agent-to-agent protocols. You’ll also lead the evolution of Fuel50 Insights, helping customers understand how their talent programmes are performing, identify critical skills and work intelligence signals, and make stronger talent decisions.

This is a senior product leadership role for someone who can turn an ambitious vision into clear priorities, practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes. You’ll bring strategic insight, technical depth and exceptional cross-functional leadership to complex product challenges, working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Go-to-Market teams.

If you’re a technically fluent product leader who enjoys creating clarity, solving complex problems and turning emerging opportunities into real customer value, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

  • Own the vision, strategy, roadmap and outcomes for the Connected Experiences pod across Insights, MCP & API, and Integrations.
  • Define a bold, practical vision for an MCP-first, distributed and agnostic work intelligence platform.
  • Lead the evolution of Fuel50 Insights, surfacing contextual signals that help customers make stronger talent decisions.
  • Shape an integration strategy that balances responsive enterprise delivery with reusable, out-of-the-box connectors and seamless ecosystem interoperability.
  • Turn customer, market, technology and ecosystem opportunities into focused priorities, experiments and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional teams from discovery and technical solution design through delivery, launch and ongoing optimisation.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design on platform capabilities, interoperability, extensibility and pragmatic architectural innovation.
  • Strengthen product practice through coaching, mentorship and collaboration across Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Go-to-Market.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Solution Consulting on positioning, packaging, pricing, go-to-market plans and market narratives.
  • Stay close to customers, competitive dynamics, emerging protocols and market trends, translating insight into product strategy and clear documentation.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in product management within a high-growth B2B SaaS, platform, API, developer or enterprise technology organisation.
  • Strong technical acumen, with the ability to engage deeply in architectural, API, integration, data and design discussions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-dimensional product initiatives across multiple squads or interconnected product areas.
  • Advanced experience with product discovery methodologies, including sophisticated experimentation techniques.
  • A proven track record of driving significant product innovation that delivers measurable business impact.
  • Deep expertise in designing and scaling enterprise-grade product and platform experiences.
  • Experience shaping products that operate across organisational, technical or ecosystem boundaries.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and lead at all organisational levels, including technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading and mentoring product managers and strengthening product practice.
  • Demonstrated success in driving product strategy in enterprise HR technology, talent management, skills intelligence, work intelligence or adjacent platforms.
  • The ability to hold a bold, long-term product vision while translating it into clear priorities, practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
  • A genuine interest in emerging approaches to connected and distributed product experiences, including MCP, agent-to-agent protocols and AI agents.

A degree in Computer Science, Business or a related technical field would be advantageous but is not essential. Previous experience in HR technology platforms would also be valuable.

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.

Benefits

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:

  • A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversary
  • A “ReFuel Day” once a quarter to relax and refuel
  • Remote work and flexible work times – we're supportive of school commitments, travelling in off-peak hours and attending to life’s events
  • A progressive parental leave policy
  • Subsidised health insurance with Southern Cross

What’s it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50’s team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning, and other team events. If you’re based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, we’ll pay for you to get here.

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful. Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.

We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition – be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.

We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.

We'll have your back when you need help – your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.

We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients – when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.

Application process

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If you’re not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.

This role is based in New Zealand; candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ, i.e. citizenship or a work visa, at the time of application.

jobs.excerpt: Sentinel Blue is seeking a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst II to join our Overwatch Team.
jobs.description:
Sentinel Blue is seeking a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst II to join our Overwatch Team. In this role, the SOC Analyst II will lead the analysis, containment, and remediation of complex threats that extend beyond initial triage.

The ideal candidate can manage concurrent investigations across a multi-tenant client base, determine scope of impact, and investigate incidents from detection through resolution. They can think like an attacker and reconstruct how compromises occurred, drive improvements to workflows, playbooks, and documentation, and help advance our capabilities in digital forensics and incident response (DFIR), threat hunting, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence. Collaboration and mentoring junior staff will be key as we work to drive innovation.

This is a full-time position that is fully remote. Due to the nature of our work, you must be a U.S. citizen with eligibility for a clearance. No exceptions.

What We Can Offer:

Sentinel Blue is a young company with a focused mission: we’re bringing enterprise-class cybersecurity to small and medium sized businesses. Frankly, we’re pushing the envelope of how things are done and constantly seeking innovative ways to meet that mission. The pace is fast, and we’re always learning new things. This is a great place if you want to expose yourself to new and emerging technologies, want to be challenged, and want to build your skills. Further, success in this role can quickly transition into a team leadership role. The right person will find themselves in a fun, dynamic environment, working on interesting problems and making a real difference.

Requirements:

  • U.S. citizenship - by nature of our work with the defense industry, all employees must be eligible for a Secret clearance.
  • Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a Security Operations Center and/or a combination of experience in cyber-adjacent or IT administration roles such as.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for Tier I analysts and take ownership of critical/high-severity alerts and escalated security incidents.
  • Analyze endpoints, network traffic, and other log data to validate security incidents and perform root cause analysis.
  • Lead containment, eradication, and recovery during active security incidents, ensuring Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Incident Response (IR) Plans are followed and documented.
  • Reconstruct attack chains, utilizing the MITRE ATT&CK Framework and Cyber Kill Chain to map adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Conduct intelligence and/or hypothesis-driven threat hunts across environments to detect advanced threats that evade security tools and controls.
  • Write executive reports with a clear narrative structure, detailed analysis, and actionable recommendations.
  • Manage the vulnerability management lifecycle by analyzing scan results, prioritizing critical vulnerabilities based on risk and exploitability, and coordinating remediation efforts with IT/Engineering.
  • Develop and maintain IR playbooks and SOPs to ensure consistent and efficient event handling.
  • Provide technical guidance, training, and feedback to Tier 1 analysts to improve their triage capabilities and knowledge.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide coverage for critical security incidents outside of standard business hours.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Incident Response: Perform deep dives, event correlation across logs, host and network artifacts for root cause analysis and respond across the IR lifecycle with remediation/containment actions.
  • Windows OS Internals: Intermediate to advanced understanding of various components and internal workings of the Windows OS such as Event Tracing for Windows, Win32 API, the Registry, Memory, and Process operations.

Attack Lifecycles & Frameworks: Map adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Correlate incidents with threat feeds using Indicators of Compromise (IoCs), threat actor attribution, and vulnerability exploitation patterns.
  • Networking & Protocols: Intermediate to advanced understanding of common network protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, SSL/TLS, etc.
  • Scripting & Automation: Intermediate to advanced writing and interpretation of Python or PowerShell scripts to parse logs or automate manual, repetitive tasks. Other scripting languages are beneficial as well.
  • System Administration: Ability to safely manage Windows devices via the command line using PowerShell or Batch.
  • Basic Malware Analysis: Ability to detect and reverse engineer malicious scripts or other high-level languages. Understanding of various code injection technique and other attack / evasion techniques as they relate to Windows.
  • Tools: Prior experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, ELK/Elastic Stack, Splunk, etc; Hands-on experience with Sysinternals Suite (Process Explorer, Autoruns, etc); Volatility; SIFT Workstation; CyberChef; Forensic Browser for SQLite; Velociraptor; Explorer Suite; Wireshark; malware analysis sandboxes, etc. Other equivalent tools are acceptable.
  • Adversarial Tradecraft: Familiarity of trending malware development, social engineering, phishing, exploitations, persistence, evasion techniques, credential theft, C2, exfiltration, and lateral movement.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Possession of intermediate to advanced certifications such as: GCIH/GCIA/GCFA, OSCP, BTL2, or equivalent is highly desired.
  • Previous experience in a team lead or supervisory leadership capacity, demonstrating the ability to drive operational goals, manage complex escalations, and effectively mentor junior staff.
  • Experience with Azure, Microsoft Sentinel/Defender XDR, Entra ID, and Kusto Query Language (KQL).
  • Active participation in Capture-the-Flag (CTF) events and homelabbing, a plus.
  • Understanding of various low-level mechanics such as x64 assembly, Windows data structures, and researching undocumented parts of the Windows OS.
  • Familiarity with low level reverse engineering, debugging and related tools such as Ghidra, x64dbg, IDA, etc.

Benefits:

  • Fully paid individual healthcare, vision and dental insurance for the employee.
  • Paid certification and training opportunities.
  • Three weeks of paid vacation + 11 paid holidays.
  • A supportive environment with a focus on keeping healthy work-life balance.
  • Retirement benefit (401k) with company match.
Salary: $70,000 – $80,000 / year

jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

  • Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

  • Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

  • Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

  • Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

  • Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
  • A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
  • Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
  • Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
  • Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
  • Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.

Serving as the gatekeeper of the product backlog, the Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst ensures no user story reaches sprint planning without meeting the Definition of Ready. This role bridges federal mission requirements and the technical teams who build against them—mentoring junior analysts and developers, conducting peer reviews of functional designs, and advising government stakeholders on ServiceNow best practices to avoid customizations that create long-term technical debt.

    • Serve as backlog gatekeeper, reviewing all user stories for accuracy, completeness, and ambiguity to ensure nothing enters sprint planning without meeting the Definition of Ready.

    • Conduct peer reviews of functional designs and test scripts to maintain quality standards across the delivery team.

Job Description

Position Overview

The Strategic Client Success Manager is the relationship anchor for Momentive's most strategic enterprise clients. In this role, you own the full client experience after implementation — from onboarding through long-term adoption and renewal readiness — and serve as the trusted point of contact for a defined portfolio of Tier 1 accounts. You are accountable for client health and retention, not just client satisfaction.


Position Summary

This role sits within the Account Management structure and owns the post-implementation relationship with Momentive's Tier 1 enterprise clients. You are responsible for driving measurable outcomes — product adoption, tracking & improving client health,, value realization, and gross revenue retention — across a defined portfolio of high-value accounts. You will build executive-level relationships, orchestrate cross-functional resources, and translate client goals into clear, structured success plans. You report to the Director, Account Management and work in close partnership with Account Managers, Implementation, Support, and Product to deliver one connected client experience.


It is important for us to maintain a strong connection with the core client success organization to share methods, best practices and insights gleaned from clients to drive product innovation and organization performance improvements. To ensure this connection is strong, the Director, Account Management and team will have a dotted line to the leader of Client Success


This role works collaboratively with the Account Manager and the goal is to keep and grow the client relationship.


A Day in the Life


  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of Tier 1 enterprise clients post-implementation, owning the full client experience from onboarding through renewal.
  • Lead structured onboarding for new enterprise clients — establish success plans, define adoption milestones, and ensure a seamless transition from implementation to sustained product use.
  • Monitor and manage client health across your portfolio, product utilization data, NPS, and stakeholder sentiment; act early when risk appears, not after a contract is already at risk.
  • Build and maintain relationships at multiple levels of the client organization, including C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, to embed Momentive as a strategic partner.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with senior client stakeholders that connect product usage to the client's strategic goals and demonstrate clear value delivered.
  • Own renewal readiness for your accounts: build the case well before contract dates, flag risk early, and coordinate with the Account Manager to ensure timely, confident renewals.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources — Support, Product, Implementation, and Professional Services — to resolve client issues and keep accounts progressing.
  • Track and report against key outcome metrics for your portfolio: Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), health scores, NPS, and product utilization.
  • Maintain accurate account records in Salesforce, including success plans, health notes, stakeholder maps, and renewal timelines
  • Bring client feedback and portfolio-level patterns back to Product, Marketing, and Sales leadership so the roadmap and messaging reflect what enterprise clients need.
  • Partner with the Account Manager on account strategy — coordinating on accounts with both retention and growth activity and contributing to a unified account plan.
  • Build and refine scalable playbooks for onboarding, health recovery, and executive engagement that raise the bar for the entire Tier 1 segment.

We are looking for someone who brings


Experience:

  • 5+ years in Client Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role in B2B SaaS, with direct experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
  • A demonstrable track record of driving adoption, improving health scores, and retaining complex, high-value accounts against GRR and NPS targets.
  • Experience leading executive-level business reviews and building trusted relationships with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage post-implementation onboarding and build structured success plans that directly connect product use to client outcomes.
  • Comfort coordinating across internal teams — Support, Product, Implementation — to solve client problems and deliver a connected experience.
  • Experience working with associations, nonprofits, or membership organizations is a plus.

Technical/Computer Skills:

  • Salesforce or a comparable CRM, used daily to manage account health, success plans, and renewal timelines.
  • Client success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, or ChurnZero for health scoring, lifecycle management, and portfolio reporting.
  • Comfort working with product utilization data and translating usage trends into client conversations about value and adoption.
  • Microsoft Office 365, including Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and executive-ready presentations.

Other Skills:

  • Relationship-first mindset with the ability to build trust quickly at multiple levels of a client organization.
  • Strong executive presence — comfortable facilitating senior stakeholder conversations and presenting data-driven insights with clarity and confidence.
  • Proactive, structured approach to portfolio management: you know where every account stands, what the risk is, and what the next step is.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information — client goals, product capabilities, usage data — into a clear and compelling success narrative.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative internal partner: you bring the right people in at the right time to serve clients well without creating noise.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with enterprise clients and support key account moments.

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks two Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide experienced customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks two Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide experienced customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. These positions receive and assess incidents and service requests, resolve approved first-contact and Tier 2 issues, maintain complete ticket records, confirm service restoration, and escalate potential outage signals.

Senior Analysts handle complex or high-priority cases within the Tier 1/2 support scope and provide technical guidance to less-experienced service-desk personnel. They help ensure that tickets are accurately prioritized, thoroughly documented, resolved through approved procedures, and escalated to the appropriate technical team when necessary.

The Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts support issues involving computer hardware, software, operating systems, networks, telecommunications, websites, portals, user access, audio-visual equipment, and enterprise connectivity. They work closely with service-desk leadership, field support, network and systems administrators, cybersecurity personnel, application teams, engineering teams, and Government stakeholders.

These positions are remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Analysts must be able to work assigned shifts and support after-hours, weekend, holiday, or surge coverage when required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analyst will:

  • Serve as an experienced initial point of contact for USMEPCOM users requiring technical support.
  • Receive incidents and service requests through approved telephone, email, website, self-service, monitoring, and escalation channels.
  • Create complete and accurate ServiceNow records for incidents, requests, problems, customer contacts, and technical actions.
  • Verify customer identity, contact information, location, affected service, operational impact, urgency, and relevant equipment or system information.
  • Categorize, prioritize, assign, route, and track incidents and requests in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Resolve approved first-contact issues using established diagnostic procedures, scripts, knowledge articles, known-error information, and remote-support tools.
  • Provide Tier 1 and authorized Tier 2 support for computer hardware, software, operating systems, networks, telecommunications, websites, portals, system access, audio-visual equipment, and connectivity.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex end-user incidents within the authorized Tier 1/2 support scope.
  • Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, zero clients, thin clients, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and related equipment.
  • Diagnose LAN, WAN, VPN, wireless, internet, remote-access, circuit, and general network-connectivity problems.
  • Support approved user-account, password, authentication, and access-management activities.
  • Troubleshoot email, collaboration, browser, productivity software, and enterprise-application issues.
  • Provide remote technical support and guide users through approved diagnostic, recovery, and restoration procedures.
  • Apply approved workarounds when a permanent resolution is not immediately available.
  • Determine when an incident requires field support, system administration, network, application, cybersecurity, engineering, vendor, or other specialized assistance.
  • Escalate incidents that exceed the analyst’s authority, technical capability, service-level target, or approved support scope.
  • Identify and immediately escalate potential outage signals, including multiple related incidents, widespread connectivity failures, significant service degradation, or loss of mission-critical functionality.
  • Document initial outage symptoms, affected users and locations, business impact, start time, troubleshooting actions, and available technical evidence.
  • Support SEV 1 and SEV 2 incident response by maintaining accurate ticket information and providing requested technical details.
  • Monitor assigned tickets and maintain current status, troubleshooting notes, communications, escalations, dependencies, and resolution information.
  • Retain ownership of assigned incidents through resolution, approved reassignment, or formal escalation.
  • Communicate status, expected next steps, known workarounds, delays, escalation actions, and restoration information to customers.
  • Confirm with customers that service has been restored and verify satisfaction before closing tickets.
  • Ensure closed tickets include accurate resolution notes, applicable knowledge references, closure codes, and customer confirmation.
  • Reopen or re-escalate incidents when restoration is incomplete, a workaround fails, or the issue recurs.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to Journeyman and less-experienced service-desk analysts.
  • Review complex tickets and recommend appropriate troubleshooting, escalation, or assignment actions.
  • Assist service-desk leadership with queue monitoring, backlog reduction, priority-ticket management, and workload balancing.
  • Support shift handoffs by communicating open priority tickets, outages, VIP issues, escalations, pending actions, and operational risks.
  • Provide experienced support for VIP, executive, and other high-priority incidents and requests.
  • Identify recurring incidents, ineffective workarounds, missing knowledge, and emerging service problems.
  • Recommend new or revised knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures, automated resolutions, service-catalog content, or process improvements.
  • Contribute incident history, technical evidence, business impact, workarounds, and resolution information to problem-management activities.
  • Support the development and review of known-error records and reusable technical guidance.
  • Perform ticket-quality reviews when assigned and identify documentation, categorization, escalation, or resolution deficiencies.
  • Help reinforce consistent ticket documentation, customer communication, and escalation practices across the service desk.
  • Follow approved incident, request, access, problem, knowledge, escalation, security, and customer-communication processes.
  • Protect sensitive, personal, operational, and Government information during all support activities.
  • Meet established response, update, escalation, and resolution targets.
  • Provide ticket, queue, incident, outage, and customer-support data for operational dashboards and program reporting.
  • Participate in technical training, readiness activities, process reviews, and continual service-improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Associate’s degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant experience providing enterprise service-desk, help-desk, desktop-support, end-user support, or related technical services.
  • Experience receiving, documenting, troubleshooting, resolving, and escalating technical incidents and service requests.
  • Experience resolving complex Tier 1 or Tier 2 technical-support issues.
  • Experience using an enterprise ticketing or IT service-management platform.
  • Working knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, productivity software, user accounts, networks, remote access, and common enterprise applications.
  • Ability to recognize and escalate potential outages and other mission-impacting incidents.
  • Ability to maintain complete, accurate, and timely ticket documentation.
  • Ability to communicate technical instructions clearly to users with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to less-experienced service-desk personnel.
  • Strong customer-service, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts and support after-hours, weekend, holiday, or surge coverage when required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • CompTIA A+ certification.
  • CompTIA Network+ certification.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • Experience using ServiceNow.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense users.
  • Experience working in a multi-tier enterprise service-desk environment.
  • Experience providing technical guidance, peer mentoring, or shift-lead support.
  • Experience supporting geographically dispersed or remote users.
  • Experience supporting a 24/7/365 operational environment.
  • Experience supporting VIP or executive users.
  • Experience supporting SEV 1 and SEV 2 incidents.
  • Familiarity with ITIL incident, request, problem, knowledge, access, and service-level management practices.
  • Experience using remote-support, endpoint-management, directory-services, or knowledge-management tools.
  • Experience identifying incident trends or contributing to known-error, root-cause, and problem-management activities.

Skills and Competencies

  • Advanced customer-facing technical support.
  • Complex Tier 1/2 troubleshooting and problem isolation.
  • Clear verbal and written communication.
  • Accurate ticket and incident documentation.
  • Incident prioritization, routing, and escalation.
  • Hardware, software, account, and network troubleshooting.
  • Outage recognition and rapid escalation.
  • Peer guidance and technical mentoring.
  • Queue, priority, and workload awareness.
  • Ability to follow approved procedures and knowledge content.
  • Ability to manage multiple tickets and changing operational priorities.
  • Professionalism when assisting frustrated, senior, or time-sensitive customers.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with remote and specialized technical teams.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

We are looking for a Virtual Executive Associate to provide reliable administrative, executive, and operational support to international clients in a fully remote environment.

This role is ideal for an organized, detail-oriented, and proactive professional with 3–5 years of experience in administrative support, executive assistance, or virtual assistance. You will help clients stay organized and productive by managing communications, maintaining records, coordinating administrative processes, organizing information, supporting research, and ensuring day-to-day tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, learning new systems quickly, and communicating professionally with clients, vendors, and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and organize emails, communications, documents, and digital information.

  • Organize and manage files using Google Drive and other digital document-management tools.

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Executive Assistance, Administrative Assistance, Virtual Assistance, Administrative Operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience providing administrative or operational support to executives, managers, teams, or business operations.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience with email management, document management, scheduling, data entry, reporting, and administrative coordination.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability when learning new tools, systems, and processes.
  • Professional and dependable approach to client communication and confidential information.
  • Quiet home office, stable internet connection (≥10 Mbps download / 2 Mbps upload), and a backup internet connection.

Benefits

Our Core Values at Work

We live by ACTION (get things done), CARE (help others and do things right), OUTSTANDING (operate at the highest standards), DEPENDABLE (own every commitment), and ENERGY (bring positivity every day). You’ll thrive here if these values resonate with you.

jobs.excerpt: About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet.
jobs.description:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

About the Role
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Script Writer to join our dynamic content
team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of short-form storytelling, social
media trends, and audience psychology. You’ll be responsible for conceptualizing and writing
engaging scripts for videos, ads, and branded content that resonate with Hindi-speaking
audiences across platforms like Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create compelling short-form scripts (under 60 seconds) with strong storytelling flow.
  • Translate content from Regional Language to English and English to Regional Language .
  • Write sharp, attention-grabbing hooks to maximize engagement and retention.
  • Craft platform-specific content for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and other channels.
  • Analyze ad metrics (CTR, watch time, drop-off rates) to refine creative strategy.
  • Collaborate closely with video editors, designers, and creative strategists to bring ideas to life.
  • Translate copy ideas into strong visual narratives and impactful storytelling sequences.
  • Identify and adapt to emerging content and creative trends.
  • Simplify complex ideas into relatable and emotionally resonant content.
  • Constantly read and watch diverse content (books, short films, ads) to expand creative
    vocabulary and visual literacy.
  • Provide creative inputs during production to ensure content quality and tone consistency.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Any Bachelor’s degree.
  • 1–3 years of experience in content writing, scriptwriting, or copywriting (preferably digital/video
    content).
  • Proven ability to write short-form content with a strong storytelling structure.
  • Strong command over Regional Language and English (written and spoken).
  • Deep understanding of Indian audiences and cultural nuances.
  • Familiarity with digital metrics and performance-based storytelling
  • Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks.
  • Why Join Us?
    We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and
    access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the
    roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts

jobs.description:
Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.

Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 


Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

  • Здійснювати продаж банківських продуктів існуючим та новим клієнтам банку

Твій досвід та навички: 

  • Вільно володієш українською мовою
  • Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером
  • Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла

  • Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації
  • Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми
  • Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді
  • Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

  • Конкурентна заробітна плата: гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.
  • Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.
  • Комфортні умови праці: гібридний формат роботи у м. Івано-Франківськ або віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
    (засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
  • Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.

  • Крута команда: наші колеги – це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.
  • Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.
  • Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення!

    • Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

    • Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів

    • Ми відкриті до найму ветеранів і людей з інвалідністю та готові адаптувати робоче середовище під ваші особливі потреби
    • Співпрацюємо зі студентами та людьми старшого віку, створюючи умови для зростання на будь-якому етапі кар’єри.

В Райфі ти маєш значення!

jobs.title: YouTube Strategist & Scriptwriter (Business Niche, USD 2-5k/month)
jobs.excerpt: The role in one sentenceYou'll ideate and write the videos Richard reads on camera: starting at four scripts a week across two channels, for an audience that's already there.
jobs.description:
The role in one sentence

You'll ideate and write the videos Richard reads on camera: starting at four scripts a week across two channels, for an audience that's already there.

This is a creative role with a research backbone. You're not taking briefs and filling them in. You bring the idea, you defend it, you write it.

Who Richard is

Richard turned a $500 digital product into an 8-figure online education company. He now teaches other people how to build online businesses, documenting the journey as he goes. The brand is impact-driven, scaling fast, and aiming to become one of the most influential voices in business education.

  • Main channel:

Read this first

You'd be writing at least four scripts a week for a channel that already works.

70k+ subscribers in AI and business. A real company behind it: the videos drive revenue, not ad pennies. There's a filming schedule that doesn't slip, a full editing team, a dedicated thumbnail designer, and an ideation and scripting system that took this channel from zero to where it is now.

What that means for you: every script you write gets made and shipped. You'll know within 72 hours of posting whether your idea worked, and you'll get that feedback loop over 100 times a year.

Most writers get 30 shots a year, half of them into channels nobody watches. If you want to get genuinely great at this, rep count on a channel with distribution is the entire game.

What you'd actually do day to day

Roughly 50% ideation, 30% scripting, 20% QC.

Ideation. You'll generate a lot of concepts to find the few that are great: angles, titles, formats. Then filter hard. We have a proven process and we'll teach it to you. What we can't teach is the instinct underneath it: knowing why a video worked, feeling when a format is fatiguing, spotting an outlier on someone else's channel and understanding what's actually transferable.

Scripting. Four a week. Three for the main business channel, one for our AI-avatar channel. Our method is systematic, not vibes. We study what's already working, extract the psychological framework doing the heavy lifting, and retrofit it to our own audience and offers. It's been refined across dozens of videos. You'll learn it, then run it.

QC. You'll take the first two passes on each edit. Did the hook land, did the pacing hold, did the retention structure survive? Timestamped notes to the editors. The final pass stays with the Head of YouTube. It's the simplest part of the job, and it's yours because the person who wrote the script is the person who notices when the edit lost the plot. Long-form for now; short-form QC will likely fold in as that output scales.

You'll work directly with the Head of YouTube, the editing team, and the thumbnail designer, with a weekly 1:1 to pressure-test your reads.

What you'd be measured on

Median views per video, how many outliers we produce per quarter, and retention. Not hours logged. Your performance pay is tied to the same numbers, so we're reading the same scoreboard you are.

Requirements

You've written long-form YouTube scripts that performed, and you can explain why they performed. Send the links and the numbers.

You can hand us a video from any channel and reverse-engineer it out loud: what the hook is doing, where the open loops sit, why the audience stayed.

You watch YouTube like an operator. You have opinions about packaging. You notice when a channel changes format, and you have a theory about why.

You genuinely like writing. Hooks, structure, the sentence-level work. It's the part you'd do anyway.

You can hit volume without dropping quality, and you take editorial notes without friction.

You write English at a native or near-native level. This is copywriting for a US audience; the voice has to be seamless.

You can overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Eastern business hours, wherever you're based.

Bonus:

  • Experience writing for AI-avatar or faceless channels
  • Direct-response background: VSLs, emails, ads, webinars
  • Enough editing literacy that your QC notes speak the editors' language
  • Familiarity with outlier-hunting tools like 1of10 or VidIQ

Not for you if

  • You want to be a generalist content person. This role is narrow and deep on purpose.
  • You want to write essays. This is direct-response writing built to hold attention and move people.
  • You need a finished brief to start. You'll be writing the briefs.

Benefits

$2,000–$5,000 USD/month OTO, full-time contractor, paid as a monthly base plus a performance component tied to how your videos actually do. Mechanics get walked through on the call.

  • The range is negotiable and depends on what you bring. The top of it is real: it's where a strong performer lands, not a number we put in a posting.
  • Open to higher tiers for exceptional writers, and we promote internally. We've moved people from entry level to C-suite level inside this company.
  • Remote, from anywhere, as long as the overlap works. We care about output, not time zone.

Why join

  • A brand with momentum. No "help us figure out YouTube." The channel works, the team exists, and your job is to make it bigger.
  • Real creative ownership. Your ideas get made. You'll have autonomy to experiment and to be wrong in public occasionally.
  • You'll be taught a system by someone who already used it to build this channel, not left to guess.
  • Upside tied to results, not to how many hours you sat in a chair.
  • Room to grow. More scope, more channels, more comp, as the results come in.

Process

  1. Application
  2. Zoom with the Head of YouTube
  3. Paid script test, from your own ideation
  4. Zoom with the Head of Marketing
  5. Offer

We pay for test work because we're asking for real output, and because we want to see how you work rather than how you interview.

jobs.description:

Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue :

  • Planifier, coordonner et superviser plusieurs projets interdépendants;
  • Participer à l’élaboration des stratégies de transformation numérique;
  • Encadrer des équipes multidisciplinaires composées de ressources TI, cliniques et d’affaires;
  • Assurer le suivi des budgets, échéanciers, risques et enjeux;
  • Participer au déploiement et à l’évolution de solutions clinico-administratives;
  • Conseiller les gestionnaires et les décideurs relativement aux orientations technologiques;
  • Élaborer des stratégies de communication et d’accompagnement du changement;
  • Produire les redditions de comptes, indicateurs et rapports exécutifs;
  • Animer des comités de pilotage, ateliers de travail et rencontres de gouvernance;
  • Assurer l’arrimage entre les objectifs organisationnels, cliniques et technologiques;
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de gestion de programmes et de projets.

Requirements

  • Détenir un diplôme en informatique, gestion des technologies de l’information, ingénierie ou tout autre domaine connexe;
  • Posséder un minimum de dix (10) années d’expérience pertinente en gestion de projets ou programmes TI;
  • Détenir plus de cinq (5) années d’expérience en gestion de projets TI complexes comportant une forte intégration organisationnelle ou clinique;
  • Démontrer une expérience significative en gestion de programmes ou de portefeuilles de projets complexes et interdépendants;
  • Posséder une expérience dans le déploiement ou le rehaussement de solutions clinico-administratives telles que les DME, ADT, systèmes de télésanté ou solutions d’imagerie médicale;
  • Maîtriser les approches de gestion de projet traditionnelles, agiles ou hybrides;
  • Posséder une expérience en gouvernance de projet, gestion budgétaire, analyse des risques et reddition de comptes;
  • Démontrer une excellente connaissance des enjeux liés à l’organisation et à la gouvernance des technologies de l’information dans le réseau de la santé et des services sociaux;
  • Posséder des compétences reconnues en accompagnement stratégique auprès de la haute direction;
  • Démontrer d’excellentes aptitudes en communication, en rédaction stratégique et en animation de groupes de travail;
  • Faire preuve de leadership, d’autonomie, de rigueur et d’un fort esprit de collaboration.

Benefits

  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l’innovation
  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)

  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant

  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail
  • Cheminement de carrière

SALAIRE

Lanaudière - Télétravail avec possibilité de présence occasionnelle

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA ?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connaît une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

jobs.excerpt: O Grupo Boticário é líder de Beleza no Brasil.  Unimos tecnologia, varejo, logística e soluções digitais (com A Mooz) para transformar dados em desejo e conectar toda a nossa cadeia de valor.
jobs.description:
O Grupo Boticário é líder de Beleza no Brasil. Unimos tecnologia, varejo, logística e soluções digitais (com A Mooz) para transformar dados em desejo e conectar toda a nossa cadeia de valor. Somos uma rede de talentos que impulsiona resultados exponenciais com responsabilidade, cuidado e espírito de colaboração.

Acreditamos que a beleza pode e deve inspirar mudanças.

Construa o futuro da beleza com a gente. Vamos juntos?

O que é o nosso time de Venda Direta?

No time de Venda Direta temos a missão de trazer beleza para a vida das nossas representantes. Entendemos a venda direta também como forma de empoderar quem sonha em empreender, e por isso queremos a melhor experiência possível para as pessoas empreendedoras. Em um mundo cada vez mais digital, transformar esse canal pela tecnologia é como construímos um ecossistema de beleza.



No Grupo Boticário, Inteligência Artificial Generativa é pilar estratégico. Você irá atuar no time de Plataforma de Agentes: plataforma centralizada para criar, gerir e executar agentes LLM nos canais de negócio do GB. Sua missão será criar uma plataforma de construção de agentes para dar autonomia ao uso de Gen AI em times funcionais. Nosso foco é garantir que chegue até os diversos clientes do Grupo Boticário as melhores soluções envolvendo IA, alavancando resultados tangíveis para a empresa.


Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Manager I (coordenadora), com perfil empreendedor e alta capacidade de adaptação, para liderar o time de engenharia de Plataforma de Agentes.

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Gestão das pessoas do time de desenvolvimento de software, com o intuito de acompanhar e desenvolver nossos colaboradores (PDI), realizando sessões de 1:1, estabelecendo planos de ação e dando feedbacks de forma frequente;
  • Orientar as pessoas de sua equipe na utilização de práticas ágeis, facilitando cerimônias que façam parte da metodologia adotada pelo squad, como plannings, refinamentos, retrospectivas, etc.;
  • Remover impedimentos do time;
  • Promover um ambiente de respeito e confiança em conjunto com os membros do time, adaptando o seu estilo de liderança a diferentes situações;
  • Navegar pela companhia, identificando oportunidades e papéis-chave para o sucesso do time;
  • Coordenar iniciativas em que um ou mais times são necessários para o sucesso do produto;
  • Realizar sessões com todos os tipos de stakeholders para mostrar os últimos resultados alcançados, colher feedbacks/insights e realizar alinhamentos sobre o roadmap do produto;
  • Capacidade/habilidade de apresentar informações técnicas complexas de maneira clara e concisa para todos os tipos de stakeholders;
  • Construir a visão e missão do squad em conjunto com os membros do time;
  • Acompanhar frequentemente métricas de produto, métricas de negócio e indicadores técnicos, criticando, aprimorando e dando visibilidade dos objetivos e status de iniciativas do time;
  • Participar de processos de discovery de produto, mapeamento de problemas e soluções de incidentes;
  • Contribuir com a definição dos objetivos e métricas-chaves do produto/squad, expondo frequentemente esses resultados aos stakeholders (OKRs);
  • Estabelecer um processo de construção de software e a manutenção de um ritmo constante e saudável;

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Column is the software platform for public information.
jobs.description:
Column is the software platform for public information. We build automated tools and workflow solutions that help governments, law firms, and media organizations notify the public. Today, thousands of publishers and tens of thousands of agencies, firms, and individuals rely on Column to keep their communities informed every day. We’re reimagining how public information connects people, institutions, and media.

We're a remote-first team of engineers, designers, and builders who are committed to creating software that supports an informed public.

About the Role

Column | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time

The Content Marketing Manager will build Column’s content engine: turning our expertise, customer stories, frontline insight, and national public notice developments into consistent, high-quality content that establishes Column as the expert on, and advocate for, public information, access to it, and public notice.

You’ll own the marketing calendar and Column’s core publishing channels, including our blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, monthly Public Notice reports, educational resources, case studies, and sales collateral. You’ll stay closely connected to our Customer Success and Services teams so our content reflects what is actually happening in the field.

As Column invests in SEO, media, partnerships, and demand generation, this role will help establish us as the definitive resource on public notice. We’re looking for a strong writer and steady operator who values quality over quantity, publishes consistently, and writes in a voice that is strong, professional, mature, and trustworthy. Candidates should also be able to move fluidly between long-form thought leadership, visual and video content, CMS publishing, and email campaigns while maintaining a consistent, high-quality publishing cadence.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Column’s marketing calendar and publishing cadence across the blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, email, and internal enablement, managing projects from request through drafting, review, publication, and distribution.
  • Follow public notice and public information news nationally, turning legislation, court decisions, industry shifts, and market trends into timely, credible content, including news commentary for our media channels.
  • Build a content source of truth with CSMs and our Services team (affidavits, pagination, and placement), turning their frontline knowledge into educational resources, FAQs, and enablement materials.
  • Write and produce high-quality content across formats, including weekly SEO blog posts, newsletters, customer case studies, guides, press releases, and sales collateral.
  • Own customer storytelling and case studies, from interviews and data collection through written stories, pull quotes, graphics, and video testimonials, while also supporting partnership announcements and sponsored content opportunities.
  • Create compelling visual and video content for marketing campaigns, social media, YouTube, reports, presentations, one-pagers, conference collateral, and other channels, bringing strong graphic design and video production/editing skills to Column’s content.
  • Grow Column’s LinkedIn presence and repurpose content for distribution and conversion, turning reports, customer stories, webinars, product launches, and news commentary into posts, graphics, short video, and email while improving CTAs, lifecycle campaigns, and website performance through testing.

What We’re Looking For

  • Exceptional writer and editor who makes complex, legal, or regulatory subjects clear and credible, with a high bar for accuracy and a mature, trustworthy voice.
  • Consistent, organized operator who manages an editorial calendar, juggles multiple projects, and ships on schedule without sacrificing quality.
  • Genuinely news-engaged, with curiosity about government, law, local media, and access to information, and the judgment to know what is worth writing about and when.
  • Experienced B2B content marketer with a track record of blogs, newsletters, case studies, reports, and educational resources.
  • Strong visual judgment and an eye for design, with experience creating polished assets such as reports, PDFs, presentations, social creative, email graphics, and sales collateral.
  • Digitally fluent and performance-minded, with experience publishing in a CMS, understanding SEO fundamentals, and using data, testing, and conversion insights to improve content and campaigns.
  • Collaborative and comfortable becoming an expert, able to interview customers, CSMs, operators, and leadership and translate what they know into clear content.

What Success Looks Like

Key performance indicators will include:

  • Consistent publishing cadence: Approximately 1 blog post per week, 1 LinkedIn post per week, 1 newsletter per month, 1 Public Notice report per month, 1 case study per month.
  • Campaign and channel support: Timely press releases, webinar and lifecycle communications, conference collateral, sales enablement, and social distribution tied to major launches, partnerships, events, and customer stories.
  • Authority and education: Column’s blog, reports, and resources become a go-to reference on public notice and public information, and Sales, CSMs, and Services actively use them. You also establish a reliable monthly loop with internal teams to surface trends, customer questions, and field insights into published content.
  • Audience growth: Growth in organic traffic, newsletter engagement, LinkedIn followers and engagement, and gated resource downloads.
  • Business impact: Clear attribution between content and pipeline, showing which blogs, newsletters, reports, case studies, and posts generate and influence marketing leads.
  • Editorial execution: Maintain a clear content calendar, independently manage recurring workflows. Ensure content moves efficiently from idea through publication and distribution.
  • Content repurposing: Major webinars, research, case studies, product education, and customer conversations are consistently turned into multiple useful formats across web, email, LinkedIn, video, and sales enablement.

Your First 90 Days

First 60 Days: Learn Column and Build the Foundation

The first 60 days focus on learning Column’s products, customers, voice, and the public notice ecosystem, while quickly contributing to our content engine.

You will:

  • Learn Column’s products, customer segments, positioning, marketing priorities, and the public notice landscape
  • Review our existing blogs, newsletters, case studies, email programs, and sales enablement
  • Take over the Marketing Calendar, Marketing Requests, and recurring content workflows
  • Set up a regular check-in with CSMs and Services team to source insights and stories
  • Build a news-monitoring routine for public notice legislation and public information developments

By Day 60, you will have:

  • Published 2 blog posts
  • Published 2 newsletters
  • Published 1 customer case study
  • Published 2 LinkedIn posts
  • Published 1 Public Notice report
  • Responded to and managed incoming content and marketing requests
  • Actively maintained and managed the Marketing Calendar

By the end of your second month, you understand Column’s voice, audience, products, and priorities—and can independently own standard content projects from request through publication.

Days 61-90: Own and Build

By your third month, you are independently running Column’s content engine: a weekly blog, newsletters, the monthly Public Notice report, steady LinkedIn publishing, and timely news commentary for Glorion.

By Day 90, you have published a second monthly Public Notice report, built a repeatable process with CSMs and Services for sourcing content, and established a consistent, recognizable Column voice across every channel.

Must Haves

  • 2+ years of experience in content marketing, B2B marketing, editorial, journalism, communications, or a related field
  • Excellent writing, editing, research, and interviewing skills, with experience producing substantive long-form content
  • Strong visual judgment and experience creating polished marketing assets in Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
  • Strong project management skills, including managing editorial calendars, multiple stakeholders, and competing deadlines
  • A track record of publishing on a consistent cadence and owning projects from idea through distribution

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with lifecycle marketing platforms like and website tools like Framer
  • Deeper experience with B2B SEO, original research, and A/B-tested email campaigns
  • Experience covering legal, policy, or government news, or building a LinkedIn audience for a B2B brand
  • Experience supporting PR, sponsored content, media, or industry partnerships
  • Familiarity with government technology, legal technology, local media, public notice, or another regulated industry

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $80k-$100k based on experience
  • 401K with match
  • Health, dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Flexible PTO and fully remote work environment (U.S.-based)

Position Summary

The Compliance Analyst supports Applied Digital’s compliance and enterprise risk management programs by coordinating audits and assessments, maintaining compliance documentation, tracking risk remediation activities, and supporting ongoing governance initiatives. Compliance Monitoring & Reporting

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

At Parry Labs we believe the modern combat advantage relies on the speed and scale of open systems. We’re redefining the edge of the increasingly ever-changing battlespace by delivering game changing capabilities to our warfighters through digital engineering, software, and hardware solutions that are essential to our core of being a Digital Systems Integrator.

Born digital and agile, Parry Labs is building a winning team to be the premier provider for Next Generation Mission Systems Integration across air, land, sea, space and cyber.

Are you ready to be an instrumental part of experts in the industry? Join us in the innovation of integration at Parry and apply to help develop the technologies of tomorrow while reaching new heights in your career today.

About The Job

Join our team as an FP&A Manager, Corporate FP&A, where you’ll lead the financial planning and analysis function supporting high-impact government programs. This role is ideal for an experienced finance leader who pairs deep technical expertise in financial statement modeling, cash flow forecasting, and indirect rate management with the ability to serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead the enterprise-wide financial planning and forecasting process — annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-term financial planning (Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) — across multiple business areas and departments.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of financial analysts, reviewing their models and deliverables and building bench strength within the FP&A function.
  • Direct the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of tools and models used for gathering, aggregating, and reporting actual and forecast data, including full three-statement modeling and orders reporting.
  • Set the strategy and standards for financial reports and dashboards (Power BI, Costpoint BI, databases, Excel, or similar tools), ensuring outputs are automated, accurate, and tailored to the needs of executive stakeholders.
  • Drive automation, process improvement, and standardization across FP&A tools, templates, and workflows to increase efficiency, enable real-time reporting, and reduce manual effort.
  • Serve as the senior point of contact for non-contract related forecasting (indirect expense, capital spend, inventory, etc.), presenting findings and recommendations to leadership.
  • Own the cash forecasting function in both direct and indirect methods, including 13/26-week cash modeling, and report to leadership on liquidity position, trends, and risks.
  • Lead indirect rate development, modeling, and strategy, including rate variance analysis, and communicate rate changes and their business impact to executive leadership and other stakeholders.
  • Identify, track, and prioritize business risks and opportunities enterprise-wide, and lead development of mitigation and action plans in partnership with department leaders.
  • Partner with executive leadership to align financial goals with business objectives, providing analysis and recommendations that inform key business decisions.
  • Establish and monitor key financial metrics, trends, and performance indicators across the organization, escalating issues and opportunities as needed.
  • Lead the development of what-if and stress-test scenarios to support strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Represent FP&A in cross-functional and executive forums, including budget reviews, program reviews, and leadership presentations.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or CMA preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in Corporate FP&A or a similar role, including significant experience in a government contracting environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in corporate forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, to include financial statement modeling, indirect rate modeling and management, and direct and indirect cash flow modeling.
  • Strong data analysis capabilities, with an understanding of data processing, transformation, and dashboarding in Power BI, Costpoint BI, databases, Excel, or similar tools. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Power Query, LAMBDA, LET functions, Pivots/Power Pivots, etc.).
  • Knowledge of database and data warehouse architecture, design, and best practices.
  • Deep understanding of government contracting and various contract types (FFP, T&M, CPFF, etc.) and their financial and reporting implications.
  • Extensive experience with ERP systems, Deltek Costpoint preferred.
  • Excellent executive-level communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and influence without direct authority.

Why Join Parry Labs?

At Parry Labs, we foster a culture of curiosity and collaboration. Employees are given the autonomy to leverage their skills in creating state-of-the-art tech solutions that aid in the protection of the American Warfighter. We encourage new and bold ideas that push the status quo. It is this entrepreneurial spirit that drives us.

Parry Labs will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives with benefits such as education assistance and unlimited paid time off, just to name a few.

We completely understand, that is why we have made the application process easy. We promise. This will be simple.
