jobs.title: Freelance Outdoor Fotograf*in (Projekt- oder Stundenbasis)
jobs.excerpt: In einer Welt, in der Bilder immer perfekter werden und manchmal kaum noch erkennbar ist, was echt und was KI-generiert ist, möchten wir bewusst auf das setzen, was man nicht künstlich erzeugen kann: echte Momente.
jobs.description:
In einer Welt, in der Bilder immer perfekter werden und manchmal kaum noch erkennbar ist, was echt und was KI-generiert ist, möchten wir bewusst auf das setzen, was man nicht künstlich erzeugen kann: echte Momente.

Das Licht an einem frühen Morgen in den Bergen. Dreckige Wanderschuhe nach einem langen Tag draussen. Ein ehrliches Lachen. Wind, Regen, Sonne und all die kleinen ungeplanten Momente dazwischen.

Wir glauben: Die Verbindung zwischen Mensch und Natur kann man nicht faken.

Deshalb bauen wir ein Netzwerk aus Fotograf*innen, Studierenden, jungen Talenten und kreativen Outdoor-Menschen auf, die gemeinsam mit uns die Bildwelt von NIKIN gestalten.

Du musst dafür kein riesiges Portfolio und keine jahrelange Erfahrung als professionelle*r Fotograf*in mitbringen. Entscheidend ist, dass du fotografieren kannst, ein Auge für echte Momente hast und unseren Outdoor Lifestyle fühlst.

Dein Impact bei uns

Als Teil unseres Photography Networks kannst du auf zwei Arten mit NIKIN zusammenarbeiten:

Wir briefen dich.
Für Kampagnen, neue Produkte oder bestimmte Content-Bedürfnisse kommen wir mit konkreten Projekten auf unser Netzwerk zu. Du erhältst ein Briefing und setzt dieses selbstständig in deiner Region und mit deinem eigenen kreativen Blick um.

Du pitchst uns deine Idee.
Du hast eine Idee für eine Fotostory, kennst eine besondere Person oder hast einen Outdoor-Trip geplant, bei dem NIKIN perfekt reinpassen würde? Dann komm auf uns zu.

Schick uns deine Idee, erzähl uns kurz, was du vorhast, welchen Content du produzieren möchtest und welches Budget du dafür benötigst. Wenn die Idee zu NIKIN und unserer aktuellen Planung passt, geben wir dir grünes Licht.

So möchten wir Content schaffen, der nicht nur für eine Kampagne inszeniert wird, sondern dort entsteht, wo echte Geschichten draussen passieren.

Was du bei uns machst

Du…

  • produzierst authentischen Foto-Content für NIKIN Kampagnen, Social Media, Website und weitere Kanäle

  • setzt unsere Produkte draussen in der Natur und in echten Situationen in Szene

  • interpretierst unsere Briefings mit deinem eigenen fotografischen Stil

  • bringst eigene Ideen, Locations, Menschen und Geschichten ein

  • organisierst deine Shootings weitgehend selbstständig – von Location und Timing bis zu passenden Personen vor der Kamera

  • findest Menschen, die authentisch zu unserer Bildwelt passen – Modelerfahrung ist dabei kein Muss

  • fotografierst mit professionellem Equipment und bearbeitest deine Bilder selbstständig

  • lieferst uns eine professionelle und qualitativ hochwertige Bildauswahl

Besonders spannend finden wir Content, der nicht nur schön aussieht, sondern eine Geschichte erzählt. Wenn daraus eine Story entsteht, die zu dir und NIKIN passt, sind beispielsweise auch gemeinsame Collab Posts auf Social Media möglich.

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

Du…

  • fotografierst leidenschaftlich gerne – egal, ob du Fotografie studierst, dir alles selbst beigebracht hast oder bereits professionell arbeitest

  • beherrschst eine Spiegelreflex- oder spiegellose Systemkamera sicher

  • kannst mit einem professionellen Bildbearbeitungstool umgehen

  • hast ein gutes Auge für Licht, Komposition, Menschen und echte Momente

  • fühlst dich draussen wohl und bist selbst gerne in der Natur unterwegs

  • kannst Shootings selbstständig organisieren und passende Personen dafür finden

  • arbeitest zuverlässig und kannst dich an Briefings, Abmachungen und Deadlines halten

  • verstehst unsere Marke und kannst NIKIN visuell auf deine eigene Art interpretieren

Wichtig: Die von dir produzierten und von NIKIN vergüteten Bilder sollen wir zeitlich und medial unbeschränkt für unsere Kommunikation und unser Marketing nutzen können. Die genauen Nutzungsrechte werden vor der Zusammenarbeit transparent vereinbart.

Wie die Zusammenarbeit funktioniert

Du wirst Teil unseres NIKIN Photography Networks. Das bedeutet nicht zwingend regelmässige Einsätze oder eine fixe Anzahl Stunden.

Wenn wir ein passendes Projekt haben, können wir direkt auf dich zukommen. Gleichzeitig kannst du jederzeit eigene Ideen bei uns einreichen.

Vor jedem Projekt definieren wir gemeinsam den Umfang, die erwarteten Deliverables und das Budget. Je nach Projekt kann die Vergütung auf Stundenbasis oder als fixes Projektbudget vereinbart werden.

Bei eigenen Projektideen schickst du uns direkt eine Budgetvorstellung mit. Wir prüfen den Pitch und geben dir vor der Umsetzung ein Go – oder sagen transparent ab, wenn das Projekt gerade nicht zu unserer Planung passt.

So wissen beide Seiten vor dem Start, was erwartet wird und welches Budget zur Verfügung steht.

Was du bei uns findest

bezahlte Fotoaufträge auf Stunden- oder Projektbasis

die Freiheit, eigene Ideen und Fotostorys bei NIKIN zu pitchen

echte Kampagnen und Content Produktionen, die du auch für dein Portfolio nutzen kannst

die Chance, deine Bilder einem breiten Publikum zu zeigen

Markierung als Fotograf*in, wenn deine Bilder auf unserem Instagram Kanal veröffentlicht werden

die Möglichkeit für gemeinsame Collab Posts, wenn Bild, Story und Kanal dazu passen

Mitarbeitendenrabatt auf NIKIN Produkte

Einladungen zu ausgewählten NIKIN Team Events

ein kreatives Netzwerk rund um Outdoor, Fotografie und Natur

und hoffentlich ziemlich viele gute Gründe, mit deiner Kamera nach draussen zu gehen 🌲

Wenn du für ein Shooting eigene Models organisierst, vergüten wir diese grundsätzlich mit je CHF 100.– pro Halbtag plus CHF 50.– NIKIN Gutschein pro Person, sofern im jeweiligen Projekt nichts anderes vereinbart wurde.

So bewirbst du dich

Uns interessiert weniger dein perfekter Lebenslauf und mehr, wie du die Welt siehst.

Schick uns:

ein paar Worte über dich und warum du Teil unseres Photography Networks werden möchtest

deine Antwort auf die Frage: «Wie sieht für dich die perfekte NIKIN Bildwelt aus?»

drei bis fünf deiner Bilder, die deiner Meinung nach bereits heute zu NIKIN passen würden – und kurz weshalb

dein Portfolio oder weitere Arbeitsbeispiele

falls vorhanden deinen Instagram Account oder eine andere Plattform, auf der wir mehr von deiner Arbeit sehen können

deinen Wohnort bzw. die Regionen, in denen du hauptsächlich fotografieren möchtest

Und keine Sorge: Wir suchen nicht nur ausgebildete Profis.

Wenn du eine Kamera hast, dein Handwerk beherrschst und beim Lesen dieser Ausschreibung bereits drei Orte, Menschen oder Geschichten im Kopf hast, die du gerne für NIKIN fotografieren würdest, dann möchten wir von dir hören.

Vielleicht entsteht unsere nächste Kampagne ja aus deiner Idee.

Together for Nature. Tree by Tree.

  • Knowledge of safety standards and certifications for stationary battery systems (e.g., UL 1973, UL 9540A, IEC 62040)
  • Battery monitoring system (BMS) and control logic experience
  • Experience supporting full product life cycles

Key Competencies:

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a highly driven Expansion Manager to expand Tether’s growth and presence in Cote d’Ivoire through adoption of its solutions, products and services. The Expansion Manager will play a pivotal role in identifying and executing new business opportunities, establishing strategic partnerships, and navigating regulatory landscapes. This role requires close collaboration with internal teams to develop and implement go-to-market strategies in Cote d’Ivoire and across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate professional who believes in financial inclusion, digital currencies, and driving innovation in Africa’s financial ecosystem. Frequent local and international travel is required.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with a proven track record in business development, market expansion, and partnership management. You have:

  • A degree in Business, Management, or Finance (MBA preferred).

  • Strong analytical skills and experience in setting/monitoring KPIs.

  • A proactive, independent, and well-organized approach to work.

  • The ability to thrive autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • A history of successfully building and managing strategic partnerships.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, engage, and secure new business opportunities in Cote d’Ivoire and in the Francophone region.

  • Build strong relationships with partners, customers, and stakeholders.

  • Build and manage commercial and strategic partnerships with Ivorian banks, fintechs and large corporates

  • Develop pipeline of USDt integration opportunities across the Francophone countries payment ecosystem

Market Strategy & Execution

  • Design and implement go-to-market strategies to expand Tether’s products and services.

  • Track and analyze KPIs to assess and optimize market strategies.

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify trends, threats, and growth opportunities.

  • Analyze USDt and fiat flows for data-driven decision-making.

  • Monitor regulatory changes and assess their business impact.

Stakeholder & Government Engagement

  • Manage relationships with regulators, government agencies, and industry bodies.

  • Represent the company at key meetings and industry events.

Marketing & Community Engagement

  • Support and participate in fintech events, conferences, and meetups to enhance brand visibility.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of the Francophone market, culture, and regulations in blockchain, fintech, finance, remittances, and payments.

  • Existing relationships at BCEAO and national central banks across WAEMU

  • 7-10 years work experience in cross-border settlements, mobile money, and/or payment infrastructures; telecom or banking experience is a plus.

  • Fluent in English and French (native preferred), with a Business, Management, or Finance degree (MBA preferred).

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with partners, regulators, and stakeholders.

  • Proven experience in partnerships, KPI monitoring, and business growth.

  • Analytical, strategic, and results-driven with problem-solving skills.

  • Entrepreneurial background and project management expertise.

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, evolving environments with international travel readiness.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
System Engineer – Managed Kubernetes

The Container Services team is responsible for delivering Leaseweb Managed Kubernetes: a platform that empowers customers to deploy, manage, and update their own Kubernetes clusters while simplifying the complexity that comes with running them at scale. We are looking for a motivated System Engineer to help build and evolve this product.

Product Engineering at Leaseweb

Our team of approximately 145 engineers works in small scrum teams, each with end-to-end responsibility for a specific product or part of our architecture. We work on a remote-first basis, coming together in person at our Amsterdam headquarters twice a year.

Our organizational structure is flat, placing a high value on independence and entrepreneurship. The atmosphere is informal and relaxed, creating a highly motivating work environment where you will work alongside some of the most inspiring colleagues in the industry.

What is the role about?

As a System Engineer in the Container Services team, you are responsible for developing our container offering based on Kubernetes. Your main activities will be automating the deployment of Kubernetes clusters across Leaseweb's various compute offerings, as well as maintaining and monitoring those clusters.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of experienced professionals: software engineers, system engineers, a scrum master, product owner, and product management.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Automate deployment, management, patching, and deletion of Kubernetes clusters across Leaseweb's compute offerings

  • Architect, explore, evaluate, integrate and tune Kubernetes components, advising on best practices and identifying issues before they reach production

  • Build and tune alerting & observability: Develop the monitoring, alerting, and logging that tells us our clusters are healthy — create & tune dashboards, alert, and metrics, using the SRE philosophy.

  • Maintain the platform: Deploy new Kubernetes version, Update components, and make sure our components are secure.

  • Investigate production issues, Troubleshoot, contribute to runbook and create permanent fixes for the issue we discover.

  • Help the team design new features for Leaseweb's customers

  • Support customers and development teams, Participate in regular on-call duty (Engineer on Duty)

  • Grow the engineers around you:Share your Kubernetes expertise with engineers in other teams, mentor colleagues within your own team, and contribute to cross-functional efforts on problems bigger than any single team

  • Align with the wider architecture:Make sure the team's solutions line up with the department's architecture standards, and spot where the team can improve

What we're looking for:

You love working in a team setting. You enjoy building new solutions using the latest technologies. You believe that continuous improvement also applies to yourself and have the desire to grow. You are not afraid to experiment.

  • Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes at scale, supporting multiple clusters across different environments including production

  • Good knowledge of the CNCF & Kubernetes ecosystem, knows enough to be able to compare choices, and state tradeoff for common technology choices.

  • Mastery of ArgoCD or a similar GitOps tool for continuous delivery, with a solid understanding of GitOps, SRE, and DevOps principles

  • Demonstrable knowledge of Kubernetes inner-workings, components, networking and storage fundamentals

  • Experience working & architecting cloud-native applications

  • Solid knowledge of Linux operating systems, with experience performing standard system administration tasks (OS maintenance, networking, DNS, backups)

  • Good communication skills (in English)

  • Experience with containerized application packaging and deployment

  • Scripting skills in Shell and/or Python for automation and tooling

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tooling

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Golang

  • Previous contributions to open-source projects such as Kubernetes or related tools

Benefits include:

  • Participation in annual company bonus scheme and company pension

  • Internet allowance and travel allowance

  • Working from home policy

  • Work from abroad: Up to 4 weeks per year, following policy guidelines

  • Lease bike plan

  • 25 days of paid time off (and the option to buy or sell up to 5 more days)

  • Free lunch, parking, and fresh fruit provided when in the office

  • Access to the Leaseweb Academy, a personalized learning platform offering a variety of studies, (Dutch) courses, and trainings

  • Attractive relocation packages and an agency that takes care of the entire visa process

  • Fun events year-round – from virtual pub quizzes to summer parties, company runs, quarterly hackathons and much more

  • A multicultural work environment (our colleagues are from over 60 countries!) in a company where you can truly make a difference

Ready for the next step?

If you'd like to apply, please do so online. To learn more about us, follow us onLinkedInorInstagramto get an inside look at life at Leaseweb. For questions, please reach out to Demetra Spyrou, Talent Acquisition Specialist, at:.

jobs.description:
EARLY CHILDHOOD DEVELOP AND HEALTH BOARD

First Things First (FTF) is an essential leader and partner in creating a family-centered, equitable, high quality early childhood system that supports the development, well-being, health and education of all Arizona’s children, birth to age 5. Created by voter initiative in 2006, FTF is governed by a state Board with 28 regional partnership councils. First Things First is a decentralized organization that engages diverse constituencies to accomplish its mission. Organizational values include a commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion; a focus on accountability, transparency, coordination and collaboration; and an emphasis on improving outcomes that will ensure young children start kindergarten healthy and ready to succeed in school and in life.

First Things First values its government-to-government relationships with tribes in Arizona. Tribes can participate in First Things First in one of two ways: by electing to have their tribal lands treated as separate regions by the statewide FTF Board, or by electing to have their tribal lands treated as part of the FTF regions in which their lands are geographically located. To date, 19 federally recognized tribes have elected to participate in First Things First (10 as separate regions, and nine as part of the region in their geographic area). The Havasupai, Hopi, Kaibab Band of Paiute, Navajo Nation, White Mountain Apache Tribe and Yavapai Apache tribes are located within the Northeast Regional Area.

Administrative Specialist III

Job Location:

Flagstaff, AZ

Posting Details:

Salary: $47,840

Grade: 17

Job Summary:

The Administrative Specialist III (ASIII) position is a central coordinator for the Northeast Regional Area including administrative support for the five regions: Coconino, Navajo/Apache, Navajo Nation, White Mountain Apache Tribe and Yavapai and assists the Northeast Regional Area Director. A key function of this position is the active support of these five regional partnership councils, each representing 11 volunteer members of the community, to ensure meetings comply with legal obligations established for First Things First. This position is an integral part of a team-based environment providing a variety of complex administrative activities as well as being part of a culture that offers exemplary customer service. The ASIII serves as an ambassador and trustworthy representative of First Things First, coordinating work with regional staff, regional council members and ensuring effective communication with internal colleagues and external community partners. This position also has the opportunity to work as an active and contributing member of multiple teams, including working professionally and effectively with other administrative specialists to develop increased efficiencies in administrative work. This remote, community-based position may also require in-person participation at meetings held outside the immediate service area.

This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:
  • Administratively support staff and volunteer regional council members.
    ○ Examples of staff support include senior regional director and regional directors and regional area administrative specialist team. Includes directly reporting to the senior regional director.
    ○ Examples of support include calendar management, reimbursement and travel management, coordination of regional council meeting logistics (includes virtual and in-person formats) and meeting document preparation such as meeting packets, recording and retaining meeting minutes, etc. in adherence with Open Meeting Law.
    ● Project manager and leader for multiple/simultaneous administrative responsibilities.
    ○ Examples include regional area budget and procurement monitoring, office management, records retention, file management, state vehicle management and cross-regional collaboration activities.
    ○ Proficient in communicating using multiple modalities, including email, instant messaging, phone and text.
    ○ Process applications and related paperwork using a web-based platform for volunteer regional council members and support the member onboarding process while maintaining strict confidentiality of all information.
    ○ Examples of regional council member support include coordinating interview processes, onboarding and off boarding process, including training and paperwork and maintaining the regional council member database.
    ○ Coordinate, prepare and process travel related activities and reimbursements for regional staff and regional council members.
    ○ Assist with the request for the grant application process in alignment with Arizona State Procurement procedures, including accepting requests for grant application proposals from applicants, coordinating applicable meetings related to the confidential review process and assisting with the mailing and delivering of applications.
    ○ Serve as a subject matter expert and support to staff in Open Meeting Law, conflict of interest and computer applications such as Adobe Acrobat Pro, SharePoint, Google Workspace and virtual meeting applications.
    ● Onboarding and training new staff, such as administrative specialist II and regional directors in administrative processes and procedures. The position may serve as an interim support to other regions when necessary.

● Leading quality improvement practices

○ Examples include initiating and leading workgroups to create, review and update administrative procedures to promote efficiencies within the organization. Accurately and timely communicating changes for the target audience.
○ Participation in and/or leading discussions and regional area team meetings with other administrative specialists throughout the regional area and/or state.
● Performs duties in a manner that supports the First Things First internal culture and mission with respect and cooperation.
● Supports additional opportunities as related to the role and regional team functions.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):
  • At least four years of administrative experience working in a team environment; or a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a relevant field with at least two years of administrative experience working in a team environment.
    ● Evidence of strong oral, written and listening communication skills, including editing and formatting documents and demonstrating excellent writing skills. Experience in developing and maintaining email distribution lists.
    ● Possess strong, current computer skills in Adobe Acrobat Pro; Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Chat, Gmail, Meet and Sites); and Microsoft Office (SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Publisher) and virtual meeting applications.
    ● Extensive organizational and time management skills, experience with project management processes, ability to handle multiple projects and adjust priorities to meet deadlines.
    ● Previous experience in offering exemplary customer service with the communities within the Northeast Regional Area is strongly preferred.
    ● Experience with minute-taking and writing. Maintaining record retention of documents in accordance with Open Meeting Law is preferred. Knowledge of Arizona Open Meeting Law and experience working with a community group of volunteers, board or council is preferred.
    ● Flexibility in work schedule, such as an occasional meeting that occurs during the evening and/or weekend hour.
    ● Ability to travel, including overnight stays. This remote position also requires regular in-person participation at meetings held outside the immediate service area.
Pre-Employment Requirements:

If this position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job to conduct State business, then the following requirements apply: Driver’s License Requirements.

All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify).

Benefits:

By providing the option of a full-time or part-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion.

The goal is to improve members' quality of life and ensure cost-effective outcomes by using internal and community-based resources.

Experience with those who have disabilities and knowledge of Child and Families Services
  • Have a minimum three (3) years of clinical experience in an acute care and/or outpatient setting (required)
  • Experience and proficiency with Microsoft Office products
  • Possess a Case Management Certification (preferred)
  • Have Bilingual abilities (preferred)

Essential functions and Roles and Responsibilities:

Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

Where you'll create impact

  • Own end-to-end execution for backend systems and infrastructure

  • Own secure connectivity with banks and partners by provisioning host-to-host connections (SFTP), managing endpoint setup, and handling SSH + PGP key exchange and rotations.

  • Implement and validate end-to-end payment and data pipelines — from ISO 20022 parsing/validation (PAIN, CAMT) to real-world bank testing (penny tests), reconciliation, and production readiness.

  • Lead integration projects across both banking and enterprise systems, defining scope, designing the integration approach, and driving delivery for domestic + international payment flows.

  • Build and maintain customer-facing integrations between DualEntry and third-party platforms (AP/AR tools, billing, CRM, payroll, data warehouses), ensuring data accuracy, reliability, and clean sync behavior.

  • Debug and resolve connectivity, payment, and statement issues by tracing through logs, monitoring/observability tools, file payloads, and database records.

  • Increase reliability and scale by reducing manual work: automate onboarding and integration playbooks, standardize test frameworks, and build maintainable backend tooling that keeps pipelines stable.

  • Drive measurable outcomes that accelerate DualEntry’s product velocity and stability

What sets you up for success

  • 8+ years building backend systems, ideally in high-growth, high-ownership environments where you ship fast and own outcomes end-to-end

  • Deep expertise in Python and modern backend frameworks (FastAPI/Flask/Django)

  • Strong database fundamentals: PostgreSQL, SQL, schema design, migrations, ORMs

  • Experience building production-grade APIs

  • Hands-on with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and the full delivery lifecycle: CI/CD, deployments, monitoring and incidents

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred

  • Familiarity with payment rails and flows (SEPA, ACH, Wires, Faster Payments, CHAPS, Bacs) and payment messaging/file formats (PAIN, CAMT) is a plus.

  • Able to operate in messy, evolving requirements — you design systems that scale while staying pragmatic.

  • Clear communicator (C1+ English). You can collaborate with banks, customers, and teammates across time zones without things slipping.

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • Bonus: you’ve built bank integrations using H2H, SFTP or ISO 20022

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

📍 Location:Remote - this role is available across all countries with 4hr+ overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

Benefits & Perks

  • Base Salary: $100K–$175K USD

  • Equity: ~$50K USD

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

As a Customer Experience Specialist at Reserv, you will be an integral part of our dedicated team focused on providing exceptional service to our customers during the insurance claims process. You will handle phone and email inquiries, provide support, and ensure a smooth and positive experience for all involved parties as they navigate their claims journey. Your expertise in multi-line insurance and claims will enable you to deliver exceptional, empathetic assistance.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, providing professional and compassionate assistance throughout the claims process via phone, email, and other communication channels
  • Anticipate the customer needs and take action to manage the process to full resolution
  • Provide guidance and information to customers regarding the claims process, taking any additional steps necessary for the prompt and accurate resolution of their claims
  • Develop and maintain a solid understanding of multi-line claim procedures to provide accurate and consistent information to customers
  • Accurately record and update customer information, claim details, and related documentation in our internal systems, ensuring data integrity and adherence to company protocols
  • Identify and address customer concerns, complaints, and disputes with empathy and professionalism
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to investigate and resolve complex issues, escalating matters when necessary to achieve timely resolutions
  • Strive to exceed customer expectations by delivering exceptional service, actively listening to customer feedback, and proactively seeking ways to improve the customer experience
  • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, ensuring the privacy and confidentiality of customer information at all times

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent is needed; bachelor's degree or relevant insurance certifications are a plus
  • Previous experience in customer service or a call center environment within the insurance industry, preferably with a focus on property or liability claims; high volume, fast-paced
  • Strong knowledge of multi-line insurance claims processes, terminology, and best practices
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically to customers
  • Active listening skills to understand customer needs, concerns, and emotions, and respond appropriately
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities
  • Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) systems and other relevant software applications
  • Empathy, patience, and resilience to handle challenging customer interactions with professionalism and composure
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines effectively
  • Must be able to obtain designated home state claim adjuster license in 60 days

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

DebtHammer is a dynamic technology startup located in the USA, founded by individuals with experience in working with international remote teams. Our mission is to assist millions of families in breaking free from the payday loan cycle. Each year, 12 million individuals resort to high-interest loans, often becoming trapped in a cycle of perpetual debt. We aim to put an end to this cycle and revolutionize the personal finance industry.

Joining us now presents an exceptional opportunity to play a pivotal role in DebtHammer's growth journey, working closely with the company's founder. Although our team is currently small, we are rapidly expanding.

We are seeking individuals to join our operations team—individuals who are enthusiastic about building a long-term career with us. If you are sales-oriented, possess a customer-first mindset, and aspire to elevate your customer service and sales skills by joining our remote operations team, we encourage you to apply!

Overview
As a Consumer Sales Representative at DebtHammer, your mission is to drive revenue for the company. Your primary responsibility will be engaging with potential customers actively seeking loan relief. We utilize three modes of communication to reach our customers: phone, text, and email. Once engaged, representatives use open-ended questions and active listening to understand the needs of the customer and position DebtHammer as the best solution. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.

Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

Requirements

  • Must have a minimum of 3 years of solid SALES experience in a call center setting (Non-negotiable requirement).

  • We are seeking candidates with highly effective English communication skills, both written and verbal, to ensure successful collaboration with our diverse team and stakeholders. Fluency close to native-level proficiency is preferred.

  • Must have your own laptop or PC, a high-quality headset, high-speed internet, and a backup connection

  • Must be amenable to working night shifts and overtime

*Please send us a copy of your updated resume that highlights your experience in sales.

jobs.excerpt: deine aufgabenMit Remazing Nova unterstützen wir unsere Kund:innen wie Purelei, Rosental, Henkel oder Emma dabei, ihre Produkte auf allen internationalen Amazon Marktplätzen ideal zu positionieren, Sales zu steigern sowie die eigenen Produkte an die Voraussetzungen der Plattform anzupassen.
jobs.description:
deine aufgaben

Mit Remazing Nova unterstützen wir unsere Kund:innen wie Purelei, Rosental, Henkel oder Emma dabei, ihre Produkte auf allen internationalen Amazon Marktplätzen ideal zu positionieren, Sales zu steigern sowie die eigenen Produkte an die Voraussetzungen der Plattform anzupassen.

AMAZON ADVERTISING: Du übernimmst die Konzeption, Steuerung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Amazon-Advertising-Kampagnen für nationale und internationale Brands. Dabei arbeitest du datengetrieben entlang relevanter KPIs wie ACoS, CPC, CTR, Organic Rank oder Sponsored Rank.

PERFORMANCE ANALYSE & REPORTING: Du analysierst Kampagnen- und Performance-Daten, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kund:innen ab. Die Ergebnisse bereitest du strukturiert in Reportings und Präsentationen auf.

STRATEGIEENTWICKLUNG: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickelst du individuelle Advertising-Strategien zur Erreichung ihrer Wachstums- und Umsatzziele auf Amazon.

BUDGET MANAGEMENT: Du verantwortest die Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung von Werbebudgets und sorgst für einen effizienten Einsatz der eingesetzten Media-Budgets.

ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT & CONSULTING: Du bist regelmäßige:r Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Kund:innen und berätst sie strategisch zu ihren Amazon Advertising Aktivitäten sowie zu neuen Wachstums- und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.

KNOWLEDGE SHARING & WEITERENTWICKLUNG: Du teilst dein Fachwissen zu Amazon Advertising, aktuellen Trends und Best Practices mit Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen und entwickelst dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiter

ÜBER AMAZON HINAUS – NEUE MARKTPLÄTZE: Amazon ist dein Kerngeschäft – gleichzeitig bekommst du bei uns die Chance, in weitere Marktplätze wie Otto, Kaufland oder Shop Apotheke hineinzuwachsen. Das ist ausdrücklich kein Muss, sondern eine echte Entwicklungsperspektive: Wir leiten dich an, du baust Schritt für Schritt Know-how im Bereich Marktplätze auf und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Team Marktplätze zusammen.

dein profil

Uns überzeugt vor allem, dass du Amazon Advertising verstanden und schon selbst gesteuert hast – auf welchem Weg du dahin gekommen bist, ist zweitrangig.

AMAZON-ADVERTISING-ERFAHRUNG: Ob mit einem Jahr oder mehreren Jahren – entscheidend ist, dass du Sponsored Ads hands-on gesteuert hast und ein Gefühl dafür hast, an welchen Hebeln du drehst. Woher die Erfahrung kommt, ist uns egal: aus einer Agentur, inhouse auf Markenseite oder als (ehemaliger) Amazon-Seller, der seine Ads selbst gemacht hat.

ANALYTISCHES DENKEN: Du arbeitest gerne datengetrieben, hast ein gutes Gespür für Performance-KPIs und bist sicher in Google Sheets oder Excel.

TOOL-KENNTNISSE: Idealerweise hast du schon mit Amazon- und Keyword-Tools wie Helium10 gearbeitet.

E-COMMERCE & PERFORMANCE MINDSET: Du brennst für E-Commerce und Performance Marketing und willst messbare Ergebnisse für deine Kund:innen erzielen.

KOMMUNIKATION: Du sprichst Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie sehr gutes Englisch, trittst sicher gegenüber Kund:innen auf und erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich.

PLUSPUNKT: Erste Berührungspunkte mit Amazon DSP oder AMC sind ein nettes Extra – ein Muss sind sie nicht, dafür haben wir eigene Spezialist:innen im Team.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Kein Problem – bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir schauen aufs Gesamtbild, nicht auf die Häkchenliste.

jobs.description:
About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

As our Backend Engineer, you’ll build and own critical features end-to-end, increasing product velocity and powering DualEntry’s AI-native ERP. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership.

📍 Location: Remote - this role is available across all EU/LATAM countries with overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

Where you'll create impact

  • You’ll own end-to-end execution for backend systems and infrastructure

  • You’ll build APIs, services, and real-time systems handling complex accounting logic

  • You’ll collaborate with founders, product, and frontend engineering to turn complex workflows into secure, performant systems

  • You’ll design, implement, and ship production-ready features at high speed

  • You’ll manage data migrations, scaling challenges, external integrations, and end-to-end reliability

  • You’ll drive measurable outcomes that accelerate DualEntry’s product velocity and stability

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering

  • Proven track record in high-growth, high-ownership environments

  • Strong skills in PostgreSQL, SQL, ORMs, migrations, and schema design

  • Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure

  • Strong API design and testing experience

  • Understanding of CI/CD, deployment, and production readiness

  • Bonus: expertise in Python and modern frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)

  • Ability to manage complex systems with evolving requirements

  • Fluent English (C1+) with clear communication

How You Operate

  • Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability -- we use Postgres until it breaks

  • Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three" - Jeff Bezos. We wrote this job post during the weekend

  • Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

  • Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

Benefits & Perks

  • Base Salary: $65,000 – $135,000 USD

  • Equity: $50,000+ USD

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills.

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone.

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

Bei uns, der SW Digital Tax, erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Mandanten sowohl in laufenden Steuerfragen als auch in komplexen Gestaltungsberatungen zu unterstützen.

Egal, ob du erfahren bist im Umgang mit nationalen oder internationalen Steuermandaten, bei uns kannst du dein Know-how voll ausschöpfen und weiter ausbauen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von einem Arbeitsumfeld, das auf Vertrauen, Flexibilität und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung setzt.

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Individuelle Entwicklung: Wir bieten dir maßgeschneiderte Weiterbildungen und Schulungen, damit du stets auf dem neuesten Stand der Steuerrechtsentwicklung bist. Unsere Karrierewege sind klar strukturiert und bieten dir zahlreiche Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Bei uns erwartet dich eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, die deinen Leistungen gerecht wird.
  • Breites Mandatenspektrum: Arbeite mit einer Vielzahl von Mandanten, von mittelständischen Unternehmen bis hin zu prominenten Persönlichkeiten, und entwickle steuerliche Strategien, die nachhaltig Erfolge sichern.
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Unsere Büroräume bieten dir eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre mit moderner technischer Ausstattung.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du eigenverantwortlich die steuerliche und rechtliche Betreuung unserer Mandanten übernehmen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen unter anderem:

  • Gestaltungsberatung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung individueller steuerlicher Gestaltungskonzepte.
  • Laufende Steuerberatung: Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen, betrieblichen Steuererklärungen sowie die Beratung in steuerrechtlichen Fragestellungen.
  • Rechtsberatung: Abhängig von deiner Qualifikation, Betreuung und Beratung in rechtlichen Angelegenheiten, insbesondere im Steuerrecht.
  • Unterstützung bei Umstrukturierungen und M&A-Projekten: Begleitung und Beratung unserer Mandanten bei Unternehmensumwandlungen und anderen strategischen Entscheidungen.
  • Mandantenkommunikation: Direkter Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten zur Besprechung von steuerlichen und rechtlichen Themen sowie zur Entwicklung von Lösungen, die auf ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse zugeschnitten sind.

Eckdaten zur Stelle:

  • Gehalt: 70.000 bis 110.000 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt
  • Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Vorhanden
  • Einarbeitungsphase: In der Regel 2–4 Monate

Interesse geweckt?

Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Teams werden möchtest, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Sende deine Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins direkt per E-Mail an

kannst du dich auch auf unserer Webseite über weitere offene Stellen informieren und die passende Position für dich finden.

Dein SW Digital Tax Team

Requirements

  • Du bringst fundierte Fachkenntnisse im Steuerrecht mit und verfügst über einschlägige Berufserfahrung.

Our mission is to assist millions of families in breaking free from the payday loan cycle. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.

Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior Field Support Technician / Deputy Lead to provide advanced troubleshooting, hands-on technical support, and field-team leadership for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Field Support Technician / Deputy Lead to provide advanced troubleshooting, hands-on technical support, and field-team leadership for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position supports remote locations, enterprise network connectivity, telecommunications, structured cabling, end-user devices, equipment installations, MEPS relocations, and outage recovery.

The Senior Field Support Technician / Deputy Lead coordinates technicians during assigned incidents, guides complex installations and recovery activities, and serves as the acting Field Operations Lead when the Lead is unavailable. The position works closely with the Outage Response Team, Service Desk, network and systems engineers, Government personnel, local IT service providers, telecommunications carriers, vendors, and site personnel.

This is a senior, hands-on position requiring the ability to move between technical troubleshooting and team coordination. The successful candidate will be able to diagnose complex problems, organize field activities, maintain accurate incident documentation, and communicate clearly during high-priority service disruptions.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Travel and on-site support at USMEPCOM Headquarters, MEPS, Remote Processing Substations, COOP sites, and other supported locations may be required. Participation in on-call and after-hours support rotations is also required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Field Support Technician / Deputy Lead will:

  • Provide advanced remote and on-site troubleshooting for network, telecommunications, cabling, hardware, software, end-user device, and connectivity incidents.
  • Serve as the primary deputy to the Field Operations Lead and perform lead responsibilities during assigned periods or absences.
  • Coordinate field technicians during assigned incidents, installations, refreshes, site moves, and restoration activities.
  • Assign work, clarify technical priorities, monitor progress, and escalate barriers affecting service restoration or task completion.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership during complex installations, equipment replacements, network cutovers, and outage-recovery activities.
  • Support the program’s 24/7/365 outage-response and remote-location support requirements.
  • Participate in on-call coverage and respond to operational incidents within established contractual timeframes.
  • Receive, assess, document, and triage outage notifications from monitoring systems, the Service Desk, site personnel, and end users.
  • Provide immediate technical support for outages and significant service degradation affecting USMEPCOM and MEPS operations.
  • Support SEV 1 and SEV 2 incidents by coordinating technicians, documenting actions, and providing timely status information to incident leadership.
  • Maintain accurate incident timelines covering notifications, assignments, technician dispatches, troubleshooting actions, communications, workarounds, recovery activities, and restoration.
  • Coordinate with the Service Desk, engineering teams, local IT service providers, vendors, utilities, telecommunications carriers, and other third parties to resolve incidents.
  • Implement approved temporary workarounds and contingency measures when complete service restoration is not immediately possible.
  • Collect logs, equipment information, technician notes, test results, photographs, and other evidence needed for root-cause analysis and incident reporting.
  • Verify service restoration with site personnel and ensure associated trouble tickets and incident records are updated.
  • Troubleshoot LAN, WAN, internet, VPN, circuit, router, switch, firewall, and remote-site connectivity problems.
  • Coordinate with installation IT service providers to resolve Recruiting Services Network, NIPR internet, cloud connectivity, and other remote-network issues.
  • Configure, install, test, maintain, and replace laptops, desktops, thin clients, zero clients, network devices, telecommunications equipment, and related peripherals.
  • Support network-equipment installation and replacement involving switches, routers, circuits, firewalls, wireless devices, and other infrastructure components.
  • Verify that devices are securely configured and tested before connection to USMEPCOM networks.
  • Support patching, firmware updates, operating-system upgrades, approved security configurations, and equipment recovery activities.
  • Perform and oversee copper and fiber cabling work, patch-panel changes, rack maintenance, cable testing, labeling, and documentation.
  • Help conduct site surveys to identify equipment, cabling, network-drop, rack-space, access, and installation requirements.
  • Support the relocation of network equipment and related supplies to new or renovated MEPS locations.
  • Guide technicians through installation plans, cabling diagrams, equipment layouts, checklists, recovery procedures, and approved changes.
  • Support remote-location telecommunications services, including VoIP equipment, mobile devices, circuits, and coordination with local service providers.
  • Assist with COOP exercises, activations, equipment refreshes, backup restoration, and disaster-recovery support when assigned.
  • Maintain site-specific equipment inventories, configuration records, as-built diagrams, rack layouts, and related technical documentation.
  • Develop and update field guides, troubleshooting procedures, installation instructions, recovery checklists, and standard operating procedures.
  • Review completed field-work documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with program procedures.
  • Mentor technicians in troubleshooting methods, installation standards, escalation procedures, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Identify recurring technical problems and recommend preventive actions, documentation improvements, training, or engineering support.
  • Provide field-support metrics, accomplishments, outage information, risks, issues, and corrective actions for program reporting.
  • Participate in incident reviews, operational readiness reviews, technical planning sessions, and continual-improvement activities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, networking, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant experience supporting enterprise IT operations, field services, network connectivity, telecommunications, cabling, or related infrastructure.
  • Ability to meet the applicable DoDM 8140.03 qualification requirements for the assigned work role.
  • Advanced experience troubleshooting enterprise network connectivity, end-user equipment, telecommunications systems, or related IT infrastructure.
  • Experience coordinating technicians or providing hands-on technical leadership during incidents, installations, cutovers, or outage recovery.
  • Experience supporting remote users or geographically dispersed operating locations.
  • Ability to read and work from technical diagrams, rack layouts, cabling documentation, installation plans, and recovery procedures.
  • Ability to document incidents, troubleshooting actions, configuration changes, installations, and final resolutions accurately.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear technical direction during operational incidents.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support when required.
  • Ability to travel and provide on-site support at USMEPCOM and MEPS locations when required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Cisco Certified Network Associate certification.
  • CompTIA Network+ certification.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • BICSI cabling or telecommunications certification.
  • CompTIA Security+ or another certification aligned with the assigned DoDM 8140.03 work role.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead, shift lead, team lead, or deputy lead.
  • Experience supporting SEV 1 and SEV 2 incidents in a 24/7 enterprise environment.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or another enterprise IT service-management platform.
  • Hands-on experience installing, terminating, testing, labeling, and troubleshooting copper and fiber-optic cabling.
  • Experience supporting routers, switches, circuits, firewalls, VPNs, wireless devices, and remote-network connections.
  • Experience supporting VoIP, SIP, telecommunications circuits, mobile devices, or unified communications.
  • Experience supporting COOP exercises, disaster recovery, or mission-continuity activities.
  • Experience conducting site surveys and supporting network installations, technology refreshes, or facility relocations.
  • Familiarity with DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides and secure device-configuration requirements.
  • Experience maintaining equipment inventories, as-built diagrams, rack layouts, and site-specific configuration documentation.

Skills and Competencies

  • Advanced technical troubleshooting and problem isolation.
  • Hands-on leadership during incidents and complex field activities.
  • Technician coordination, mentoring, and task prioritization.
  • Network, telecommunications, cabling, and end-user support.
  • Critical incident and outage-recovery coordination.
  • Clear and timely operational communication.
  • Accurate incident, installation, and configuration documentation.
  • Ability to remain calm and organized during mission-impacting events.
  • Ability to work independently at remote or field locations.
  • Strong customer-service and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage concurrent technical issues and changing priorities.
  • High attention to detail and consistent follow-through.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Manager-RB-BHT to join our team! The Care Manager-RB-BHT is responsible for providing complex care coordination and monitoring to members having a primary Intellectual or Developmental Disability, which may include a secondary mental health or substance abuse, and/or complex medical/physical health need. The Care Manager-RB-BHT assists with integrated care management through multi-disciplinary collaborations and referrals, including but not limited to: assistance with the TCM opt in/opt out process, completion of care needs screenings, 90-day transition plans, completion/updates of CMCAs and care plan development, and service coordination as needed/deemed appropriate. This position has a primary focus on members that have been diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder, particularly children (18mos – 15yo). The Care Manager-RB-BHT would be expected to work and be available at their remote location between the hours of 8:30 am – 5:00pm and be flexible to travel within the community to meet with members as well as attend other meetings as needed.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned members, providing ongoing care management and advocacy.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of member needs using person-centered planning methods and organizational tools.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized care plans in collaboration with members, families, and multidisciplinary support teams.
  • Coordinate services across providers, agencies, and community resources to address member physical, behavioral, and social health needs.
  • Ensure assessments and care plans are updated to reflect changes in member needs and circumstances.

Employee Benefits:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR

A graduate of a college or university with a master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3.
