jobs.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you'll do

As the Senior Director of Product Marketing at Pindrop, you’ll play a crucial role at the nexus of Marketing, Product, and Sales, with substantial impact potential on company growth. Your core results will include:

  • Leading product positioning, launch processes, and customer insight programs for AI-driven security and authentication solutions.
  • Defining and executing go-to-market strategies for new and existing products, collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing.
  • Translating complex technology (including AI models, machine learning, and deepfake detection) into compelling messaging and proof points that resonate with technical and business audiences.
  • Developing impactful content and sales enablement materials tailored for technical buyers, business leaders, and diverse customer segments.
  • Documenting customer buying journeys, personas, and our competitive landscape.
  • Acting as the primary thought leader for AI-centric products externally, through industry presentations, analyst briefings, and written media.
  • Driving competitive and market intelligence; understanding buyer personas, customer journeys, and security market trends.
  • Managing product marketing plans, budgets, and program KPIs to inform strategic decisions and future investment.
  • Supporting and training sales channels on highly complex, AI-enabled product solutions and value delivery.
  • Owning launches of innovative new products and features, particularly those leveraging AI for authentication, fraud detection, and voice biometrics.
  • Leading development of customer success stories and case studies that showcase AI impact.
  • Mentoring and growing a team of product marketing professionals passionate about driving security innovation.
  • Managing all internal and public-facing documentation, such as claims and customer references.

Who you are

  • Executive-ready and credible. You bring the confidence, maturity, and experience to engage senior executives. You articulate a clear point of view, make thoughtful recommendations, and defend your perspective while staying open to challenge. You take direct feedback with humility and turn it into meaningful action and stronger outcomes.
  • Confident in your influence. You hold your own in a room of strong opinions and experienced leaders. You challenge thinking constructively, navigate difficult conversations, and influence decisions through preparation, sound judgment, and a well-informed perspective. You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you know how to make your voice count.
  • A leader who develops others and yourself. You lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams. You set clear expectations, give actionable feedback, and build a culture of accountability and growth. You’re equally committed to your own development: you seek feedback, challenge yourself, and keep raising the bar on your leadership and impact.
  • An exceptional cross-functional partner. Product Marketing sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Go-to-Market, making this one of the most cross-functional roles at Pindrop. You understand each function’s priorities, translate between technical, commercial, and marketing perspectives, and bring teams together to drive alignment and results.
  • A strategic thinker with hands-on execution. You see the big picture, anticipate what’s next, and build strategies that move the business forward, then you own them through completion. You’re as comfortable presenting to the executive team as you are getting into the details, and you know when to operate at 30,000 feet and when to roll up your sleeves. The rapidly evolving AI and security landscape motivates you.

Your skill-set

Must-haves

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, including at least 2 years in a market-facing role. Experience translating technical concepts (especially AI or machine learning) for varied audiences is required.
  • Direct experience marketing security, authentication, AI/ML, or cloud contact center solutions, including go-to-market strategy and product launches.
  • Deep understanding of the cybersecurity industry, with exposure to AI trends, data protection, Zero Trust approaches, and domain expertise in areas such as SIEM, EDR, or voice biometrics.
  • Advanced proficiency with collaboration, CRM, and automation tools (Slack, Salesforce, Marketo, DemandBase, Google Analytics).
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal; comfortable presenting technical ideas and outcomes to external audiences.

Nice-to-haves

  • 10+ years overall experience in product marketing, cybersecurity, or high-tech SaaS environments.
  • Hands-on experience developing and executing marketing strategies for AI-powered products.
  • Experience leading a product marketing team, with demonstrated mentorship and talent development.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. Advanced degree (MBA or technical master’s) preferred.
  • Familiarity with cloud security, data privacy regulations, and emerging security technologies.

What's in it for you

AI-driven fraud and deepfakes have made trust in every interaction a board-level priority. As Pindrop’s senior product marketing leader, you’ll shape how the market understands that problem and why Pindrop is the answer.

  • Define the story for a category in motion. Identity trust and deepfake detection are still being defined. You’ll set the positioning, narrative, and proof points that shape how buyers, analysts, and the industry see Pindrop.
  • Work directly with the Executive Leadership Team. You’ll bring recommendations to senior leaders, influence product and go-to-market strategy, and see firsthand how decisions get made as Pindrop scales.
  • Sit at the center of the business. Your work connects the roadmap to revenue, giving you a direct line to outcomes across Product, Marketing, and Sales.
  • Launch differentiated technology. You’ll bring to market solutions backed by more than 300 patents and models trained on over 1.5 billion real-world interactions a year.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team. You’ll mentor and grow product marketers and shape how the function operates as the company grows.
  • Operate inside an AI-first organization. With Innovation as our first core value, you won’t just market AI, you’ll use it to sharpen research, messaging, launches, and enablement.
  • Grow as Pindrop grows. This is a career-defining opportunity to expand your scope and influence as we take Pindrop to its next level.

If you want to lead the story of a company protecting trust in the AI era, and be proud of the company you help shape, this is that opportunity.

What to expect in the interview process

This role requires the ability to communicate, influence, and present effectively at the executive level. As part of our interview process, you’ll prepare and deliver a presentation to members of Pindrop’s Executive Leadership Team. It’s an opportunity to show your strategic thinking, product marketing expertise, ability to communicate a clear point of view, and approach to executive-level discussion and feedback.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer. This position is eligible for additional compensation in the form of an annual discretionary bonus.

US Base Pay Range
$225,000—$270,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

Client Success owns relationship strategy, client health, value realization, executive engagement, retention, and renewal readiness.

    You are joining Atmosera to protect and grow the managed services client base by building a consistent, measurable client-success operating model. You will lead the client journey from transition into managed services through onboarding, value realization, renewal, and expansion, while strengthening executive relationships and creating early visibility into risk.

  • Microsoft ecosystem growth: Partner across Atmosera to identify Azure consumption, Microsoft co-sell, cloud security, FinOps, Data & AI, and application modernization opportunities within the installed client base.

What Success Looks Like

    After 90 Days

  • The Foundation: Develop a clear view of the managed services portfolio, renewal calendar, MRR concentration, client health, executive relationships, active escalations, team capability, capacity, coverage model, and the systems and data used to manage the client lifecycle.
  • The Integration:Establish trusted working relationships with Client Operations, Security Operations, Sales, Professional Services, Finance, and Microsoft alliance stakeholders. Confirm decision rights, escalation paths, commercial handoffs, and leadership cadences.

Performance is reflected in Gross MRR Retention, Net MRR Retention, Expansion MRR Growth, renewal timing and rate, renewal and expansion forecast accuracy, client satisfaction and advocacy, and improved onboarding and time to value.
  • Your Growth: You have built a capable leadership bench and a Client Success team that operates with clear standards, strong business and technical fluency, appropriate portfolio capacity, and consistent execution. Team capability, leadership depth, employee retention, and succession plans demonstrate sustained organizational progress.
  • Your Influence:Atmosera uses client evidence more effectively to improve services, prioritize investments, identify growth opportunities, and make decisions. Executive Business Reviews and service reviews occur on a consistent cadence; strategic accounts have active executive sponsors and current success plans; executive relationship gaps are closed; key client commitments remain visible through leadership transitions; and health scoring, risk aging, and save plans drive earlier action across Client Success, Client Operations, Security Operations, Sales, and Professional Services.

The Skills Matrix

  • Years of Experience: 10+ years in Client Success, account management, service delivery, or client-facing technology leadership, including 5+ years leading managers or senior professionals.
  • Role-Specific Mastery: Demonstrated ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, executive relationships, and client-risk management in a recurring-revenue technology business such as managed services, SaaS, cloud services, or IT services.
  • Client Success Operating Model:Experience building or materially improving client-success frameworks, portfolio segmentation, health scoring, success planning, executive reviews, renewal governance, and client-feedback loops.
  • Business and Financial Acumen: Ability to interpret MRR performance, forecast renewals and expansion, evaluate account economics, prioritize a portfolio, and distinguish relationship, delivery, commercial, and adoption risk.
  • Technical and Industry Fluency: Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with cloud and security leaders, connect Azure operations, security, FinOps, and modernization opportunities to business outcomes, and translate service information for executive audiences.

    • Experience leading through organizational change, including relationship transitions, operating-model redesign, or integration of teams and processes.

About the Role

As a Mid-Level QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and integrity of software applications through manual and automated testing. Your primary responsibility will be to define and validate test scenarios, identify and manage quality risks, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage and deliver high-quality software solutions.

    • Create, document, manage, and track bugs and defects throughout their lifecycle.

    • Investigate issues, analyze test results, and work with development teams to ensure defects are properly addressed.
    • Support the integration of testing activities into CI/CD pipelines and contribute to the continuous delivery of reliable software.

    • Testing Methodologies: Understanding of manual and automated testing practices, test design techniques, regression testing, and risk-based testing.

jobs.description:
Overview & Responsibilities

The Senior Application Engineer serves as a technical authority and strategic commercial partner within the rotating equipment and turbomachinery manufacturing sector. This role is responsible for leading the design, proposal development, and commercial execution of mission-critical centrifugal machinery including compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps—for major global clients across Petrochemical, LNG, and emerging Clean Energy markets.


Position Purpose


  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert in the application and system integration of centrifugal rotating equipment, including centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps.
  • Architect and deliver competitive, high-reliability technical proposals and engineered-to-order solutions tailored to client specifications across the Petrochemical, LNG, and Sustainability markets.
  • Deliver joint technical and commercial leadership to expand market share, support sales pursuits, and advance key strategic business initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary technical bridge across multidisciplinary teams—liaising with engineering, operations, global manufacturing hubs, and customer representatives to clarify bid details and create high-impact promotional technical materials.

Key Responsibilities


Proposal Engineering & Equipment Design

  • Inquiry Evaluation & Bid Strategy: Thoroughly analyze customer inquiries, design requests, and tender specifications to evaluate project objectives, aligning closely with sales teams to devise competitive bidding strategies based on market trends, budgets, and competitive dynamics.
  • Aerodynamic & Mechanical Machine Sizing: Perform comprehensive machine sizing and engineering analyses, covering aerodynamic performance, rotordynamic stability, stress and strain evaluations, and overall mechanical integrity.
  • Scope Definition & Balance of Plant: Define the scope of supply for equipment packages and auxiliary systems surrounding the primary turbomachinery train.
  • Cost Engineering & Estimation: Build accurate cost models encompassing core hardware, labor, engineering hours, drafting, vendor-supplied components, testing, and project-specific contingency costs.
  • Vendor Sourcing & Sub-Supplier Specifications: Author technical specifications for major purchased auxiliary equipment and act as the principal engineering authority managing sub-vendor technical evaluations.
  • Proposal Delivery: Assemble and issue comprehensive proposal packages, including detailed engineering data sheets, performance curves, scope matrices, pricing breakdowns, project delivery schedules, and technical/commercial exceptions and deviations.
  • Sales Support: Assist sales representatives in delivering technical presentations, value propositions, and bid walk-throughs to customer evaluation teams.

Technical & Commercial Support (Quote-to-Award Phase)

  • Bid Clarifications: Rapidly resolve technical and commercial queries raised by sales teams and client engineering teams throughout the bidding cycle.
  • Proposal Optimization: Revise and re-rate equipment configurations, scopes, and proposals as project parameters and customer requirements evolve.
  • Commercial Alignment: Partner with sales and executive management to fine-tune scope, delivery schedules, and pricing structures to maintain competitive positioning while preserving gross margins.
  • Pre-Contract Alignment: Participate directly in pre-award meetings, customer clarification sessions, and contract negotiation discussions.

Project Transfer & Post-Order Support

  • Global Team Handover: Transition awarded contracts smoothly to project execution teams in the USA and Japan.
  • Design Specification Handover: Prepare final design specifications and baseline engineering documents reflecting final negotiated terms.
  • Kick-Off Coordination: Lead and attend internal and client-facing kick-off meetings and formal handover sessions.
  • Project Definition Packages: Compile and deliver comprehensive project handover packages—including original and revised inquiry specifications, final scope definitions, detailed costing files, delivery milestones, and engineering schedules—to assigned Project Managers.
  • Ongoing Engineering Advisory: Serve as the continuous technical and commercial consultant to the Project Manager throughout the detailed engineering, procurement, and testing phases.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

  • Design Automation: Develop and refine standardized workflows, automating repetitive calculation routines and equipment selection procedures to accelerate inquiry turnaround times.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enhance interface protocols and information sharing between internal divisions, specifically between the New Equipment engineering team and the Rerate/Aftermarket services group.
  • Technology & Market Intelligence: Stay at the forefront of turbomachinery technology through industry periodicals, trade symposiums, technical papers, and formal internal/external training programs.
  • Competitive Analysis: Monitor competitor offerings, patent releases, and customer trends to identify emerging technology applications and continuous product enhancement opportunities.

Strategic Market Initiatives & Business Development

  • Market Analytics: Leverage specialized engineering expertise, commercial insight, and industry networks to conduct quantitative and qualitative market assessments.
  • Technical Thought Leadership: Author white papers, application guidelines, and technical reports to assist sales and marketing in launching new technologies and penetrating emerging applications.
  • Client Engagement: Lead high-level technical presentations to engineering contractors (EPCs) and end users to drive brand preference and early-stage project specification development.

Required Qualifications & Technical Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (or equivalent) with extensive understanding of aerodynamic and thermodynamic performance principles (gas properties, heat transfer, efficiency, head, work).
  • Proven design and application knowledge of centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, expanders, pumps, and key auxiliary packages (motors, gears, lube systems, etc.).
  • Strong mechanical and analytical capabilities in rotordynamics, bearings, seals, metallurgy/materials, and dynamic/thermal stress and strain.
  • Proven techno-commercial capability to strategically balance equipment cost, performance, delivery lead times, and operating reliability.
  • Familiarity with target sectors and emerging sustainability markets, including Hydrogen, CCS/CCUS, Ammonia, and Energy Storage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail for authoring customer proposals, technical papers, procedures, and presenting in commercial meetings.
  • Proficiency with engineering application software, standard productivity tools (Word, Excel, Lotus Notes), and Sun/IBM operating environments.
  • Ability to travel an average of 4–6 times per year (typically 2–3 days per trip) to support sales pursuits, attend pre-contract meetings, participate in trade shows/discussion groups, present technical papers, and complete off-site training.

Base Location & Work Schedule

​This is a permanent full time, remote position based in Saudi Arabia or Bahrain.

The world turns to Elliott.

Customers throughout the world choose Elliott for the design, manufacture and service of their critical rotating equipment. Elliott’s global service network routinely installs, overhauls, repairs, upgrades and rerates machines from any manufacturer. Customers everywhere turn to Elliott for precision engineering, extraordinary reliability and unparalleled service.

jobs.title: Director, Brand & Marketing Communications
jobs.excerpt: Landmark Ventures is seeking an exceptional Director, Brand & Marketing Communications to lead how Landmark and our growing portfolio of brands communicate with the world.
jobs.description:
Landmark Ventures is seeking an exceptional Director, Brand & Marketing Communications to lead how Landmark and our growing portfolio of brands communicate with the world.

This is a senior, hands-on role at the intersection of brand, communications, content and marketing; a brand-first position for someone with strong creative judgment and taste. We are looking for a strong writer and editor who can also look across our websites, presentations, proposals, digital experiences and other market-facing materials, see what could be significantly better, and help make it so. You do not need to be a designer, but you need a highly developed eye for what great looks like.

The Director will own and elevate Landmark’s brand voice, messaging and communications standards; lead the development of high-value content and communications; steward our portfolio of brands; and help bring new brands, programs and initiatives from idea to launch.

At its core, this is a role for someone with extraordinary creative judgment and taste – someone equally comfortable refining a message, rethinking a presentation, evaluating a website or directing a creative partner toward better visual work.

There is a tremendous amount of communication that happens across Landmark every day – websites, presentations, proposals, event invitations, thought leadership, speaker materials, marketing campaigns, executive communications and more. We need someone who can partner with our teams to make it better.

This person will help determine what we say, how we say it and how we show up – then work across our team and creative partners to bring that vision to life.

And in a world where AI can generate an endless amount of reasonably good content, we believe taste, judgment and originality matter more than ever. The right person will know how to use AI exceptionally well – to research, explore, prompt, draft and iterate – while having the judgment and editorial ability to transform good work into great work.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Stewardship

Own and evolve how Landmark and our portfolio of brands show up in the world.

  • Own Landmark’s brand voice, messaging, positioning and communications standards.
  • Translate brand strategy into practical guidelines, messaging frameworks and tools that can be used across the organization.
  • Ensure brand consistency and quality across websites, presentations, proposals, marketing materials, events and digital experiences.
  • Serve as a steward of Landmark’s brand guidelines and help teams apply them thoughtfully across different audiences and contexts.
  • Partner with leadership to continually refine how Landmark tells its story to clients, prospects, partners, employees and other stakeholders.
  • Help oversee and evolve the identities of Landmark’s growing portfolio of brands.

The goal is to create standards, tools and shared creative playbooks that help us consistently produce thoughtful, distinctive and compelling communications.

Writing, Editorial & Executive Communications

Serve as a senior writer, editor and communications partner for Landmark’s most important work.

  • Write, edit and elevate high-value communications across the organization.
  • Develop and refine website copy, presentations, pitch decks, proposals, capabilities materials, executive communications, thought leadership, event invitations, speaker materials and other strategic content.
  • Partner with company leadership on communications that require a particularly high level of thought, nuance or polish.
  • Establish editorial standards for voice, tone, structure and quality across Landmark.
  • Help teams translate complex ideas into clear, concise and compelling communications.
  • Review and improve work produced internally, externally or with AI before it reaches important audiences.

Sometimes you’ll start with a blank page. Often, you’ll start with something that’s already 80% there.

Your job is to see the remaining 20%.

Marketing Communications & Content

Translate Landmark’s brands, ideas and stories into compelling market-facing communications.

  • Partner with marketing, sales, events and business teams to develop messaging and content for campaigns, launches and ongoing communications.
  • Develop content across email, web, social, events, sales materials and other marketing channels.
  • Help establish content strategies and editorial calendars across Landmark and its portfolio of brands.
  • Ensure communications are tailored appropriately for different audiences, objectives and channels rather than simply repeating the same message everywhere.
  • Develop repeatable messaging, templates and content systems that enable teams to produce high-quality work more efficiently.
  • Support thought leadership and other content initiatives that strengthen Landmark’s market presence and point of view.

This is not a traditional demand-generation or performance-marketing role, nor is it a design or creative director role. The focus is on elevating how our brands show up in the world – across messaging, content, visual execution and the overall quality of our market-facing work.

Brand Development & Launches

Help turn new ideas into real brands, programs, events and communities.

  • Lead or support the development of positioning, naming, messaging and brand architecture for new initiatives.
  • Develop clear creative and brand briefs that translate strategy into actionable direction.
  • Work with designers and creative partners to develop visual identities, websites, launch materials and supporting brand assets.
  • Manage brand and creative projects from initial concept through development, refinement and launch.
  • Help establish the guidelines, templates and foundational materials needed to successfully operate a new brand after launch.
  • Maintain coherence across Landmark’s portfolio while allowing individual brands to have distinct identities and personalities.

This person should be comfortable moving a process from idea → positioning → identity → execution → launch.

Creative Direction & Execution

Turn strategy and words into exceptional finished work.

  • Brief and direct graphic designers, web developers, agencies, freelancers and other creative partners.
  • Provide clear, thoughtful and actionable feedback throughout the creative process.
  • Review creative work for messaging, design, brand consistency and overall quality.
  • Bring strong visual judgment and taste to websites, presentations, proposals and other market-facing work, ensuring the words, visuals and overall presentation work together.
  • Recognize when work feels generic, dated, inconsistent or simply not at the level we should be putting into the marketplace – and articulate why.
  • Manage communications, brand and creative projects from brief through final delivery.
  • Help navigate and manage the right external creative resources for different projects.
  • Maintain high standards while balancing quality, speed, budget and practical business needs.

You don’t need to personally design the website or build the presentation. But you should know what great looks like – and know how to help talented people get there.

AI & Modern Communications

Help Landmark develop an AI-leveraged approach to communications without producing AI-toned communications.

  • Use modern AI tools extensively for research, ideation, drafting, iteration, editing and creative exploration.
  • Develop effective approaches to incorporating AI across different communications workflows.
  • Help establish AI-enabled tools, processes and standards that improve the speed and quality of content creation across Landmark.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment to distinguish genuinely strong ideas from polished but generic output.
  • Ensure final communications retain originality, personality, accuracy and a distinctly human point of view.

AI can produce ten good options in seconds.

The skill we’re looking for is knowing which one matters, what’s still wrong with it and how to make it great.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in brand, communications, content, marketing communications, editorial, creative or a related discipline.
  • Exceptional creative judgment and brand instincts, including strong writing and editing skills and a highly developed visual sensibility, with a portfolio demonstrating high-quality market-facing work across multiple formats.
  • Demonstrated experience developing brand positioning, messaging, voice and communications standards.
  • Experience creating and overseeing content across websites, presentations, proposals, campaigns, events and other external communications.
  • Strong understanding of brand identity and enough design fluency to effectively brief, direct and evaluate creative work.
  • Experience developing creative briefs and managing designers, developers, agencies or other external creative partners.
  • Experience bringing brands, products, programs or campaigns from concept through launch.
  • Strong fluency with modern AI tools and AI-assisted creative workflows.
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to manage multiple brands, projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and comfort working directly with senior executives and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong business curiosity and the ability to understand sophisticated B2B audiences, complex offerings and the commercial objective behind a communication.
  • High standards, strong attention to detail and the ability to move from strategy to hands-on execution.

Agency experience or experience managing multiple brands or experience in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment is a plus.

The Person We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is equal parts brand thinker, creative operator, writer and editor – with the taste and judgment to elevate both what we say and how we show up visually.

Your career may come from brand strategy, communications, editorial, content, creative, marketing or an agency environment. It may not fit neatly into a single category.

That’s okay.

What matters is that you’re someone people naturally turn to when something important needs to be communicated well.

You can look at a sentence and know it isn’t quite right.

You can look at a 30-slide presentation and identify the five slides that actually tell the story.

You can look at a website, presentation or campaign and immediately see where the visual hierarchy, imagery, design, words or overall experience are keeping it from feeling exceptional.

You can listen to someone explain a complicated idea and find the three sentences that make it understandable.

You can look at a piece of market-facing work and know that, while technically polished, it still doesn’t quite work – and explain why.

You understand that different audiences and moments require different messages. You care about the details without losing sight of the objective. You can create something from scratch, but you’re equally energized by making something good significantly better.

You have high standards, but you ship.

And most importantly, you have the judgment, curiosity and taste to know the difference between finished and great.

About Landmark Ventures

For more than 25 years, Landmark Ventures has worked with extraordinary founders, brands and enterprises to realize their growth ambitions. We help organizations reach new customers, enter new markets, build strategic relationships, accelerate pipelines, create extraordinary events and experiences, execute M&A transactions, raise capital and unlock new opportunities. Today, Landmark operates across multiple businesses, events, communities and emerging brands – creating an unusually rich environment for someone who loves building brands, shaping stories and bringing new ideas into the world.

Landmark Ventures is committed to hiring a diverse team that provides important perspectives in our work and is an equal opportunity employer that welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, physical or mental ability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience building with LLM APIs or AI/ML components in production contexts.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience using AI coding agents (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) in software development workflows.

Bonus Points if you Have

jobs.title: Senior Pricing Analyst (Government Contracting)
jobs.excerpt: Overview Goldbelt Apex, a part of the Healthcare Technology Transformation Group, is a data-focused company dedicated to process and quality in every aspect.
jobs.description:
Overview

Goldbelt Apex, a part of the Healthcare Technology Transformation Group, is a data-focused company dedicated to process and quality in every aspect. As healthcare IT experts, Apex is committed to building systems for healthcare organizations to seamlessly communicate and exchange data across different systems and devices.

Summary:

We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Senior Pricing Analyst to join our team. The Senior Pricing Analyst will play a critical role in developing pricing strategies for competitive bids and proposals, particularly in federal government contracting. The Senior Pricing Analyst will also provide financial guidance and analysis, and act to provide insights and data-driven recommendations to support financial decision making. This position requires strong analytical skills, an in-depth understanding of cost structures, and the ability to develop competitive and compliant pricing models. This role will also be responsible for various functions including data analysis, financial forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning. They will provide SME support to Program managers to ensure effective contract performance, execution, and delivery.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Pricing Analysis
    • Responsible for developing compliant cost models and effective pricing strategies for proposals by collaborating with the business development, capture, proposal, human resources, and finance departments
    • Responsible for researching and tracking competitor pricing and market trends, analyzing the impact of pricing changes on profitability and growth rates
    • In collaboration with other managers, develops price-to-win goals, and provides input for competitive direct/indirect rates
    • Ensure the final cost proposals compliance with Governmental regulations, including CAS, FAR and DFARS
    • Corporate policies and procedures; and specific requirements in each of the clients’ solicitations Develops Cost Strategy Plan and ensures that leadership and assigned capture manager approve of the plan
    • Brings to pricing manager's attention, all concerns with the pricing section requiring resolution Certifies to executive leadership that cost proposal is in full compliance with Request for Proposal (RFP) and organization's costing procedures
    • Develops proposals pricing for various programs in compliance with the proposed technical solution(s) by working with the business development and the operations team members during the proposal development phase
    • Builds cost models and develops basis of proposal estimate working with the operations team, finance representatives, HR leads, capture manager and subcontractors. Works with the capture and executive leadership to arrive at the labor cost pools for bid pricing as needed
    • Identifies areas of continuous improvement for pricing strategies and present pricing models Uses creative and strategic thinking to develop, manage and institutionalize pricing and cost models for reusability and scalability
    • Coordinating, planning, and executing competitive analysis and research of primary competitors in support of Price to Win (PTW) and capture team information requirements for high priority projects
    • Develop and brief PTW analysis supporting Best Value and Low Price Technically Acceptable Competitions
    • Develop competitive assessments, funding analysis, top-down program price analysis, bottoms up program price analysis, market-based price analysis, and other similar target allocations
    • Provide assessments of competitor actions/strategies and their impact on high priority pursuits Support market assessments and early-stage capture planning
  • Cost Variance & Performance Tracking
    • Provide analytical, forecasting, reporting, and project support to senior management
    • Analyze project profitability, labor rates, indirect rate application, cash flow forecasting, and margin impacts across active contracts and new business pipelines and generate monthly reports
    • Conduct monthly Earned Value Management (EVM) analysis, monitoring Schedule Variance (SV), Cost Variance (CV), and Estimate at Completion (EAC) across complex government projects
    • Calculate, track, and update Estimate to Complete (ETC) and Estimate at Completion (EAC) models, proactively identifying budget risks or margin slippage
    • Analyze contract burn rates and funding thresholds to notify program managers before reaching 75% funding limits (Limitation of Funds/Costs clauses)
    • Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within the finance function, streamlining workflows and enhancing efficiency
  • Indirect Rate & Cost Pool Management
    • Model and evaluate indirect cost pools (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, Material Handling) to evaluate structural profitability and competitive rate positioning
    • Monitor actual indirect expense absorption against target rates to calculate mid-year adjustments and mitigate under/over-absorption risks
    • Prepare annual Incurred Cost Electronically (ICE) submissions and year-end indirect rate true-up reconciliations
  • Subcontractor & Vendor Financial Oversight
    • Review and evaluate subcontractor price proposals and Basis of Estimates (BOEs) to perform Commercial Item Determinations and Cost/Price Reasonableness Analyses
    • Monitor subcontractor invoice burn rates against purchase order ceilings, funding obligations, and performance milestones
  • Corporate Forecasting & Profitability Analysis
    • Perform scenario-based financial modeling and sensitivity analyses for executive leadership to test margin impacts under varying labor mix, fringe, or overhead assumptions.
    • Track pipeline win probability against projected resource allocation to build multi-year revenue, gross margin, and cash flow forecasts.
    • Conduct post-award financial autopsies comparing original proposal pricing models against actual execution costs to refine future bidding strategies.
    • Assist in the preparation of financial statements and disclosures for quarterly and annual reporting cycles

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Full life cycle RFP/Task Order response knowledge
  • Must have knowledge of all Contract Types (e.g., FFP, FFP LOE, FPIF, CPAF, CPFF, T&M, etc.)
  • Must have strong analytical, organizational, and planning skills to balance and prioritize work
  • Must be proficient with MS Office including Outlook, Word, and SharePoint
  • Must be knowledgeable to ensure compliance with accounting standards, regulations, and company policies in all financial reporting activities
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel in developing and manipulating formulas
  • Track record of submitting compliant pricing proposals
  • Negotiating with subcontractors or work with primes and subcontractors during pricing proposal development/process
  • Must be flexible, independent, and reliable, with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Possess innovative writing skills
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 - 8 years of prior relevant experience or master’s degree with 4 - 6 years of prior relevant experience
  • Previous experience with pricing and proposal writing in government contracting environment
  • Must have experience working with the Service Contract Act (SCA) and Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA) Research market trends and develops competitive pricing strategies for proposals Building, filling in, and creating cost models
  • Supervisory role in previous experience
  • US citizenship is required and able to obtain security clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced certifications such as Certified Pricing Professional (CPP) or Certified Government Financial Manager (CGFM)
  • Experience with large multi-million dollar proposals
  • Experience using VENA Solutions software strongly preferred
  • Previous experience working with Alaska Native Corporations (ANCs)

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $112,700-$150,000 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. jobs.excerpt: About Extend:Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth.
jobs.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role

You'll join our centralized Risk, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team as a Senior Manager, serving as the leader in the Finance Analytics function and help build and scale up the team. You'll work closely with Extend’s leadership team on how Extend plans, forecasts, and monitors its financial performance: the forecasting methodology we standardize on, the financial models leadership uses to make strategic decisions, and the analytical bar for the function as a whole. You'll be accountable not just for your own forecasts and models being right, but for the team's methodology and financial data being sound.

We've invested heavily in modern data infrastructure and AI tooling, and we want someone who's excited to actually use them. If you're a little bored of traditional FP&A and want the scope and influence of a senior manager with the hands-on depth of an IC at a fast-growing company, this role is for you.

What You'll Be Doing

Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

  • Own the financial forecast methodology, the process, and the output. Own the driver-based models behind Extend's key financials, top-line forecast (merchant GMV, attach rates, etc.), revenue, cash balances, and margin across our product lines. Define the assumptions governance and variance-review standards that make every forecast defensible.
  • Own the annual operating plan and long-range plan. Lead the annual budgeting cycle and the 3–5 year financial model, linking growth ambitions to cash and capital needs, and partner with Accounting so the plan reconciles with reported results.
  • Run the performance-management cadence. Track KPIs and OKRs against plan, diagnose variances down to merchant, product, and segment level, and deliver forward-looking insights.

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Own the financial strategy conversation with senior leadership. Be the CFO's and leadership team's analytical thought partner. Communicate the business performance on a regular basis and provide valuable insights for strategic decisions.
  • Turn reporting into a decision engine. Own the end to end P&L modeling and performance reporting, help drive business decisions and changes based on analytical insights from day to day reporting.
  • Put the entire business operation under the Unit Economics framework. Build and maintain the unit-economics framework (true contribution margin at the contract level) and embed it in pricing, merchant deal reviews, and product investment decisions.
  • Evaluate strategic initiatives and capital allocation. Build ROI and scenario/sensitivity models for new products, markets, merchant partnerships, and major investments; support fundraising, insurer/reinsurance partner economics, and M&A or corporate-development analysis as needed.
  • Drive resource and headcount planning. Partner with People and department leaders on workforce and capacity plans, and track budget-vs-actual on major initiatives to flag where to reallocate.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration. Serve as the primary finance partner to Sales, Growth, Operations, Risk, Accounting, and others, representing Finance in key forums, aligning teams on shared assumptions and priorities, and turning financial insights into action across the business.
  • Raise the floor for the whole team. Drive AI-native ways of working so the function produces more, faster, at a higher standard. You'll have latitude to experiment and the expectation that you will.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or corporate development, with a track record of owning forecasting methodology or financial strategy, such as driver-based financial modeling, long-range planning, scenario analysis, and unit economics
  • Strong analytical and data skills spanning SQL and financial modeling end to end; experience with dbt, Snowflake, Python, and BI tools is a plus
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex analysis into board- and executive-level materials, ideally within Insurtech, fintech, or financial-services experience is a strong plus
  • Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring senior analysts and raising a team's technical bar
  • Excited and passionate about new AI tools (Claude, Gemini, etc.) and eager to learn how they can improve day-to-day efficiency
  • Ability and interest in thinking beyond the finance organization, considering the challenges of other teams, and prioritizing what is best for the business holistically
  • Empathy, humility, and curiosity

Expected Pay Range: $175,000 - $185,000 per year salaried*

* The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.
  • 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

jobs.excerpt: Job Type: Full-Time | Location: Texas | Department: Data Center Delivery | Reporting to: Director, Network Delivery | Work Location Type: #remote IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference.
jobs.description:
Job Type: Full-Time | Location: Texas | Department: Data Center Delivery | Reporting to: Director, Network Delivery | Work Location Type: #remote
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
Reporting to the Director, Network Delivery, the Senior Project Manager – Network Infrastructure Design & Standards is the portfolio design authority for the passive and physical network infrastructure that supports IREN’s data center campuses: outside-plant and inside-plant fiber, carrier entrances and meet-me rooms, campus backbone, structured cabling, pathways, and the rack, rack-unit and power placement of network equipment.
The role develops and maintains the network infrastructure standards the Director approves, and then holds every campus to them: approving designs, deviations and test packages, directing external architecture and engineering partners on telecom design, and setting the acceptance criteria that construction is measured against. It is an individual-contributor role with design-approval authority, working alongside the Senior Project Manager – Route Planning, the Senior Project Managers – Network Delivery and the Senior Project Managers – Site Network Delivery.
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

Standards and governance
  • Develop and maintain the portfolio network infrastructure standards – fiber architecture, cable and connector types, panel and splice architecture, pathways, MMR and MDF/IDF design, labeling, testing and acceptance criteria – and submit them to the Director, Network Delivery for approval.
  • Approve or reject telecom and fiber designs, deviations and substitutions against the approved standards; maintain the technical exception record and the remediation conditions that go with it.
  • Run design reviews at 30 / 60 / 90 percent and IFC for every campus; no construction package is released and no carrier order is placed before the gate is passed.

  • Set and track engineering KPIs: standards compliance, RFI and change-order reduction, first-pass test acceptance, documentation completeness and turnover quality.
Fiber infrastructure engineering
  • Lead the engineering review of OSP and ISP fiber infrastructure across the portfolio: carrier connectivity, campus backbone, inter-building and inter-campus connectivity, and the fiber serving compute, enterprise and operational technology networks.
  • Establish fiber-count and capacity requirements from current demand, redundancy, customer growth and future expansion; own the spare-capacity strategy for strands, panel ports, pathways and telecommunications spaces.
  • Set fiber-loss budgets, optical performance requirements and standardized distribution and patching architectures, including splice-versus-patch decisions.
Carrier entrance, MMR and diversity criteria
  • Set the standards for carrier entrance facilities, meet-me rooms, duct banks, manholes, handholes and diverse building entrances.
  • Define the physical-diversity and shared-risk criteria that the Senior Project Manager – Route Planning applies to candidate routes; review route packages for compliance.
  • Define demarcation, rack, cross-connect, power, grounding and carrier equipment placement standards in the MMR.
Campus infrastructure and equipment placement
  • Develop and approve campus fiber backbone architectures and MMR, core, MDF, IDF and telecommunications-room connectivity requirements.
  • Determine the room, rack and rack-unit position for new network equipment; coordinate A/B power and PDU outlet assignments with Electrical and Facilities Engineering.
  • Coordinate telecommunications infrastructure with civil, electrical, architectural, structural and mechanical design so pathways, rooms and power are protected in every building.
A/E and consultant direction
  • Direct external A/E firms and engineering consultants on telecom design: scopes of work, deliverables, milestones and review expectations.
  • Review and approve basis-of-design documents, specifications, drawings, fiber schematics, rack elevations, pathway plans, splice diagrams, port assignments and fiber matrices.
  • Hold consultants accountable for quality, completeness, constructability and compliance with IREN standards; evaluate performance across projects.
Construction support and engineering assurance
  • Conduct constructability reviews before construction packages are issued; superintendents and Senior Project Managers – Site Network Delivery attend the 60 percent review.
  • Provide technical direction on field conditions and engineering conflicts raised through RFIs by the Senior Project Managers – Site Network Delivery; evaluate proposed changes for reliability, capacity, cost, schedule and future expansion.

  • Participate in engineering-verification walks and confirm installed infrastructure matches approved design intent.
Testing and acceptance
  • Set the portfolio fiber acceptance standard: Tier 1 testing, Tier 2/OTDR, insertion loss, optical return loss where applicable, polarity, end-face inspection, splice-loss limits and launch/receive requirements.
  • Review and approve test packages before infrastructure is accepted; define the process for failed tests and deficiencies.
  • Apply acceptance criteria consistently across campuses and contractors.
NetBox, DCIM and documentation
  • Own the NetBox/DCIM data standard for physical infrastructure: asset, rack, panel, port, cable, circuit and pathway naming and the data required at each construction stage.
  • Define the handover data required from designers, contractors and carriers so as-builts match installed conditions.
Cross-functional coordination and risk
  • Partner with Network Engineering so logical design and equipment standards are reflected in physical design before construction; Network Engineering decides what a device does, this role decides where it lives and how it connects.
  • Provide technical input into RFQs, contractor bids and carrier proposals; support make-versus-buy decisions with the Senior Project Manager – Route Planning and Procurement.
  • Identify engineering risks and single points of failure across the portfolio; conduct root-cause analysis after significant infrastructure failures and drive portfolio-wide corrective actions.
  • Escalate unresolved technical risks to the Director, Network Delivery with a recommendation.

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years of telecommunications, fiber infrastructure, data center engineering or network infrastructure experience.
  • 5+ years of proven project management on mid to large data center or mission-critical programs, including ownership of telecom or fiber design scope through construction and acceptance.
  • Deep technical expertise in outside-plant and inside-plant fiber, carrier entrance and MMR design, campus backbone, structured cabling and telecommunications spaces and pathways.
  • Experience directing engineering consultants and A/E firms and reviewing complex construction and engineering packages: basis of design, specifications, drawings, fiber schematics, splice diagrams, fiber matrices, rack elevations, submittals and RFIs.
  • Working knowledge of ANSI/TIA-568, 569, 606 and 758, ISO/IEC 11801, BICSI TDMM and OSP guidance, IEEE 802.3, NEC and applicable NFPA requirements.
  • Advanced understanding of fiber-optic systems: OS2 and OM4/OM5, MPO/MTP and LC connectivity, optical-loss budgets, Tier 1 and Tier 2/OTDR testing, splice-loss acceptance, DWDM and coherent optics.
  • Experience with NetBox or other DCIM platforms, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Procore or similar tools.
  • Executive presence and reporting: able to explain technical risk and recommend a decision to technical and executive audiences, in writing and in person.
  • Experience in a fast-paced growth environment and in solving complex problems with company-wide impact.
  • OSHA 30.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Suite (Project, Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).
Preferred qualifications – network and telecommunications
  • High-capacity architectures: 100G, 400G and 800G optical connectivity, DWDM and optical transport, and coordination with Network Engineering on logical design.
  • Network equipment physical deployment: room, rack and rack-unit placement, A/B power and PDU outlet assignment, cable management and airflow constraints.
  • Operational technology networks: physical infrastructure dependencies for BMS, EPMS, fire and life-safety monitoring, security, CCTV, access control, Wi-Fi and environmental monitoring.
  • Infrastructure records: NetBox or other DCIM data standards, naming conventions, port and cable identifiers, and as-built validation.
  • Standards and program governance: authoring and rolling out design standards, templates and acceptance criteria across multiple sites.
Also highly regarded
  • BICSI RCDD, OSP or RTPM, FOA CFOS/D, PE or equivalent credentials.

About the Role

At Jobsity, we are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven Technical IT Sourcer to join our Technology Talent Acquisition team.

We're looking for someone who goes beyond simply finding profiles. You should understand technical roles, know how to build effective sourcing strategies, and consistently deliver qualified candidates who match both technical requirements and business needs.

If you enjoy solving sourcing challenges, exploring new talent markets, and working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we'd love to meet you!

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for multiple IT and technology positions across different levels of seniority.

  • Identify and engage qualified candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, ATS platforms, and other sourcing channels.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines aligned with active client openings and hiring priorities.

  • Source candidates for specialized technical positions, including Software Engineering, Cloud, DevOps, Data, and other technology-related roles.

  • Balance sourcing volume, candidate quality, and speed to consistently deliver strong talent.

  • Maintain accurate and updated candidate information, sourcing activities, and pipeline records.

  • Ideally 3+ years of hands-on experience in technical sourcing for IT and technology positions. Candidates with less experience but exceptional sourcing capabilities will also be considered.

  • Strong understanding of technical profiles, technologies, and the IT talent market.

  • Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, including complex searches, filters, and candidate pipeline management.

  • Strong Boolean search skills and the ability to develop effective sourcing strategies.

  • Experience managing multiple searches simultaneously while maintaining candidate quality and organization.

  • Ability to evaluate technical profiles and identify candidates who genuinely match role requirements.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership.

  • Excellent organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to communicate professionally in English (B2 or higher).

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting across multiple Latin American markets.

  • Exposure to niche or highly specialized technical positions.

  • Experience sourcing senior-level professionals, including Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, Architects, Directors, or VPs.

  • Consistently identify and deliver qualified, actionable candidates aligned with business priorities.

  • Maintain healthy talent pipelines that support a steady flow of interviews and client submissions.

At Jobsity, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with an international Talent Acquisition team, work on diverse and challenging technology searches, and contribute directly to connecting exceptional LATAM talent with U.S. companies.

We value people who take ownership, communicate openly, embrace challenges, and continuously pursue quality in everything they do.

Senior Solutions Engineer — Atlanta

Location: Atlanta, GA / US Remote

Role overview

Nasuni is looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and prospects across the Southeast. Partnering closely with Account Executives, you will lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, architecture discussions, and proof-of-concept engagements for organizations evaluating how to modernize and protect their unstructured data.

You will translate complex customer requirements across file infrastructure, cloud, data protection, security, migration, and business continuity into scalable solutions built around the Nasuni platform.

This role is well suited for an experienced pre-sales professional who enjoys owning technically complex opportunities, communicating with audiences ranging from infrastructure architects to executives, and helping customers connect technology decisions to measurable business outcomes. It is not designed as a product-demo-only or post-sales implementation role.

Scope of the role

You will operate independently across complex enterprise opportunities while partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, partners, and customer stakeholders.

You will own technical recommendations within your opportunities, identify architecture and implementation risks, establish technical validation plans, and help customers make informed decisions while maintaining clear ownership boundaries with post-sales teams.

What you'll do

  • Lead technical discovery with infrastructure, cloud, security, architecture, and business stakeholders to understand customer requirements, constraints, risks, and success criteria.
  • Design and communicate solutions for complex enterprise environments involving file data, cloud storage, migration, backup, disaster recovery, ransomware resilience, security, and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Deliver tailored demonstrations, workshops, and technical presentations for audiences ranging from practitioners and architects to senior technology executives.
  • Own technical evaluations and proof-of-concept engagements, including objectives, success criteria, architecture, execution, issue resolution, and final recommendations.
  • Translate Nasuni's technical capabilities into business value and help Account Executives advance opportunities through informed technical decision-making.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers, partners, and internal account teams throughout complex sales cycles.
  • Surface recurring customer requirements and field insights to Product, Engineering, and Marketing.
  • Contribute reusable technical content, enablement, demonstrations, and field best practices while mentoring other Solutions Engineers when appropriate.
  • Support technically complex RFI/RFP responses, proposals, and solution documentation.
  • Use AI-enabled tools appropriately to accelerate research, discovery synthesis, technical preparation, documentation, and customer communication while validating outputs and protecting confidential information.

Qualifications

Must-have

  • Demonstrated success in enterprise Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, technical pre-sales, or a closely related customer-facing infrastructure role.
  • Experience independently leading technical discovery and solution design for complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience planning and leading customer evaluations, pilots, or POCs with defined technical success criteria.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting large, multi-site or technically complex enterprise customers.
  • Experience partnering with channel or technology partners.

Ideal

  • AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certification.
  • Experience creating technical enablement, presentations, blogs, demonstrations, or other thought-leadership content.
  • Experience mentoring other Solutions Engineers.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-enabled workflows to improve technical sales productivity while maintaining rigorous human validation.

Experience guidelines

Strong candidates will typically bring 7+ years of relevant enterprise technology experience, including approximately 4+ years in customer-facing solutions engineering, pre-sales, architecture, or technical consulting.

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world’s unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.

jobs.description:
About Point Foundation

Point Foundation is the nation's largest scholarship-granting organization for LGBTQ+ and ally students, supporting 1,250 scholars in the 2026–27 academic year. Point provides scholars with financial support, leadership and career development, and a lifelong community of students, alumni, and leaders in every field and industry.

Point’s mission is to support the educational aspirations of LGBTQ+ and ally students to become impactful leaders in their lives, careers, and communities. Point is proud to be a top-rated nonprofit by watchdog groups including Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and the Better Business Bureau.

We pursue excellence in all we do and are building for scale - growing the number of scholars we serve, expanding leadership and career development opportunities, and innovating the systems and technology that let a nimble team reach further every year.

Position Overview

Point Foundation seeks a hands-on, systems-minded Director of Development Operations to serve as the engine behind the Development team's fundraising success. This is a builder role - someone who can zoom out to shape a forward-looking and AI-powered technology roadmap and zoom back in to troubleshoot a broken integration before it slows the team down. The Director will own the full technical infrastructure that powers fundraising at Point. Partnering closely with the Chief Development Officer on the day-to-day, and with the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems on strategy and the buildout of the technical roadmap, this person will be both the engineer of Point's fundraising technology stack and the hands-on operator who keeps it running.

Reports to: Chief Development Officer

Status: Full time, exempt

Supervises: One associate-level direct report

Location: Remote position based in the greater Los Angeles area. Occasional in-person meetings and events require candidates to be located in, or willing to relocate to, the L.A. area. Relocation assistance is available.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Database, Data Integrity & Reporting Oversight - own overall accountability for the donor database, including data integrity standards, hygiene, reporting, and analytics. Direct staff on day-to-day data work while remaining hands-on with complex reporting, troubleshooting, and data strategy as needed.
  • Data Governance & Compliance - establish and enforce Development-specific policies for donor data privacy, security, and user access permissions, in line with organization-wide standards set by the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems, and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and PCI standards across all fundraising platforms.
  • Fundraising Analytics & Reporting - build dashboards, KPIs, and revenue forecasts that give the Chief Development Officer, gift officers, and leadership clear visibility into pipeline, portfolio performance, and progress toward goals.
  • Platform & Vendor Management - serve as the primary owner of the Development team's technology stack, including Fundraise Up, iWave, and other giving and prospect research platforms; manage related vendor relationships and design and maintain integrations between Development systems and those used by Finance, Marketing, and Programs, ensuring data flows accurately and consistently across the organization.
  • Technology Strategy & Roadmap -
    partner with the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems and the Director, Program Operations to plan and launch Point’s CRM strategy, and develop a forward-looking roadmap for the Development team’s technology needs that integrates within the organization's overall technology roadmap, including evaluating new tools and platform upgrades.
  • AI & Emerging Technology - harness AI and emerging technologies to increase efficiency, automation, and outcomes across Development operations, identifying high-value use cases, piloting and implementing new tools, and ensuring responsible use that safeguards donor data.
  • Gift Processing, Acknowledgment & Revenue Operations -
    oversee staff responsible for gift entry, processing workflows, and revenue reconciliation in partnership with the Finance Team, ensuring accuracy and compliance with data standards. Oversee timely, accurate gift acknowledgments and tax receipts, ensuring donor documentation meets IRS requirements and Point's stewardship standards.
  • Campaign & Event Operations - support appeals, campaigns, and events through list segmentation, appeal and campaign coding, and integration of registration and giving data into the donor database.
  • Process Improvement & Team Enablement -
    train and support Development staff on system use, troubleshoot user issues, and continuously refine processes to reduce manual work and improve data quality across the team.
  • Documentation & Standard Procedures - create and maintain documentation for data standards, gift processing procedures, and system configurations so institutional knowledge is preserved and the team can scale.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of development operations, database administration, or fundraising systems experience, including 2+ years in a senior or leadership capacity overseeing staff or systems strategy.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Direct, hands-on experience administering a nonprofit CRM/donor database (e.g., Raiser's Edge), including data integrity management, gift processing and attribution, and report building.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple integrated fundraising platforms (e.g., online giving tools like Fundraise Up, prospect research tools like iWave) as a system owner, not just an end user.
  • Proficiency in building and running reports, queries, and donor/prospect lists from a CRM database to support gift officer portfolios, board reporting, and organizational fundraising analysis.
  • Hands-on experience identifying, piloting, and implementing AI tools to automate workflows and improve data quality, including responsible-use practices that protect sensitive donor data.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with other staff to evaluate and identify technology solutions for fundraising needs, including researching, assessing, and recommending new platforms or integrations that address gaps in the Development team's tech stack.
  • Highly organized and deadline-driven, managing multiple high-priority projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive organizational and donor information.
  • Passionate about Point's mission and enthusiasm about communicating the organization's philosophy, mission, and values.
  • Commitment to advancing equity and inclusion in all areas of responsibility and across the organization.
  • Preferred: experience with SQL, data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), or advanced reporting/analytics beyond native CRM reporting; experience managing technology vendor relationships and leading system migrations or platform implementations; and experience in nonprofit fundraising specifically, understanding the unique data and reporting needs of a development shop.

Core Competencies - Our Ways of Working

  • Ownership: Owns outcomes, not just tasks. Follows through on commitments or proactively resets expectations and raises issues early and directly.
  • Learn & Adapt: Stays curious and self-aware. Seeks feedback, reflects on impact, and applies learnings as conditions change.
  • Focus & Excellence: Prioritizes the highest-impact work, delivers consistent high-quality results, and makes tradeoffs visible and intentional.
  • Trust & Belonging: Builds relationships grounded in respect, honesty, and inclusion. Engages candidly, assumes good intent, and addresses issues constructively.
  • Collaborate for Scale & Growth: Clarifies roles and handoffs, shares information transparently, commits decisions once made, and designs sustainable, repeatable systems over "boutique" solutions.

Compensation and Accommodations

Pay range: $110,000 - $145,000/year. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus based on performance. Our total compensation goes well beyond salary: Point pays 100% of employee health insurance premiums, with coverage for dependents available at additional cost. Our full benefits package also includes a 403(b)-retirement plan with an employer match of up to 3%.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accommodations: We want the process to work for you. If you need accommodation at any stage - application, screen, interview, or work sample - tell your recruiter. We offer accommodations proactively and honor them at any later stage.

The purpose of this job description is to provide an overview of the position. This is not a comprehensive list of duties and responsibilities.

Salary: $110,000 - $145,000 / year
