At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity benefits our employees, company, customers, and community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees are responsible for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal-opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, MCI's policy is to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees with protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

ABOUT MCI (PARENT COMPANY)

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services. In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa's Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI's subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines. Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

Strong computer literacy, Excellent Math and problem-solving skills. Data entry and 10-key by touch.

Growing happiness guides everything we do and our core values - Unleash Greatness, Never Stop Learning, Ignite Your Passion, Thankful Living, and Inspire Innovation & Change - inspire us to maintain a culture where our people take pride in their work and have fun doing it.

We support 100% remote work for applicants who reside in the United States.

The Senior Media Planner is a critical role within Tinuiti’s Client Strategy team. The role is focused on promoting and expanding Tinuiti’s Strategic Planning function. It is fit for someone with deep media experience in telling stories using planning and research tools, as well as being a trusted advisor to clients. You establish and define high-impact, long-term marketing strategies at the business level by developing account strategies, audience & messaging insights, consumer journey, and media mix recommendations.

You are not satisfied with the status quo and are hungry for strategic, insightful innovation. You have a proven track record of success at leading progressive strategies, being a trusted advisor, growing businesses, training up, and mentoring talent. You possess the superior presentation skills to communicate your data-driven strategic direction and insights to clients, prospects, and teams effectively.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Use audience, competitive, channel, and media planning tools and strong media acumen to help answer critical questions and make recommendations around the timing, size/budget, duration/flighting, and media mix of new and existing campaigns reflective of a client’s business strategy to advance its share/penetration and achieve profitable growth

  • Lead the identification of media partners/platforms, programming/networks opportunities that are best to suited for our client(s) and their unique needs, with the aim of maximizing the impact of their campaigns through a range of media platforms; predominantly OTT, Linear TV, Terrestrial Radio, Online Video, Social, Search and Digital Audio

  • Analyze demographic data and trends in consumption to ensure these are factored into our media recommendations. Interpret insights and data from tool suite to drive actionable full-funnel media recommendations around brand awareness, consideration, and brand performance

  • Leverage past offline media planning experience and agency case studies to inform the core planning metrics and benchmarks (i.e. the optimal reach, frequency, TRP/GRP, impressions to meet a given client objective)

  • Own conception and delivery of innovative, well-targeted business-building marketing solutions and serve as a key point of contact for the client in the development and approval of these plans

  • Operate cross-functionally with our investment team and our client strategy team to ensure that our planning outputs and recommendations are synced with our measurement capabilities and our buying footprint

  • Work in lockstep with Client Strategy & Analytics counterparts to understand our performance-based attribution and optimizations, arriving at a synergistic approach that combines these outputs with the future planning inputs for a blended campaign that hits our client’s KPIs

  • Partner with our Strategic Planning lead to serve as the agency liaison with our external planning tool partners. Help evaluate and roadmap the further development of Tinuiti’s suite of tools including evaluation, recommendations, and rationale for changes or enhancements

Core Competencies:

  • Communication & Presentation Skills- Effective in both written, and both formal and informal presentation settings

  • Collaboration - Ability to work well and adapt to work well with a variety of personalities and levels (both internally and externally)

  • Leadership - Everyday team management including:, project and allocation management, career pathing, feedback and support, work quality control

  • Resourcefulness & proactive thinking - the ability to research, find, and deliver actionable insights

  • Drive - Does not settle simply for “good”, always strives to deliver the highest quality of work

  • Planning Tools – Knows the ins and out of pulling data from 3rd Party Planning tools (Kantar, Commspoint, Pathmatics, SimilarWeb, Resonate, NMI) and finding key insights. Familiar with the landscape of tools available in the industry, their strengths, and weaknesses.

  • Insights - Possess the ability to see the heart of an issue and respond accordingly

  • A data-driven mindset; review results and performance of paid media campaigns based on predetermined success indicators, determine the effectiveness and report back to the client

We’d love to hear from you if:

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of media buying, planning & strategy experience with a focus on strategic and operational planning in US national market

  • Experience with cross-channel planning required, Including: linear TV, streaming video/audio, and overall digital media (search, social, display, etc)

  • Expert knowledge and use of planning and research platforms including Nielsen suite (Commspoint, Nielsen Media Impact, NPower, National TV View), Resonate, Comscore, Kantar

  • Understanding of companies/campaigns with KPIs that range from performance marketing to true brand awareness efforts

  • Strong POV of industry planning, insights, and competitive tools

  • Expert knowledge of the media landscape - both traditional and digital

  • Ability to build relationships with clients and peers (trusted advisor)

  • Strong written and oral communication skills, specifically around presentation story-telling

  • Ability to travel to onsite meetings 1-2 times a month at most

Job Overview

IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle.ThePatient Centered Solutions (PCS) team leads the industry ingenerating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialization of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions.We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients – mostly life science/pharmaceutical companies – through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to design scientifically rigorous research. This research is broad and includes qualitative (e.g. interviews, focus groups), quantitative (e.g. clinical outcome assessments (COAs)/patient-reported outcomes (PROS), preference research) and passive (e.g. digital health technology tools) approaches to understand patient, caregiver and healthcare professional experiences and expectations of disease and treatment.

To meet our client expectations and retain the excellent reputation built up over time the IQVIA PCS team is committed to recruiting, training and supporting driven individuals who have bothconsulting skills and life science skills that can be applied to PCS research activities. Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding and progressive career in patient-focused research. You’ll have the opportunity toaddress challenging client issues, across multiple geographies with a hands-on influence in developing and delivering solutions. We operate in a truly multi-cultural, collegial and collaborative work environment that is rich in development and growth.

Role & Responsibilities

The role-holder will need to be a committed individual, who combineshigh emotional intelligence and excellent communication skills. They will thrive in a fast-paced environment and be comfortable managing conflicting priorities. The environment is dynamic and ever-changing, moving at the pace of our clients’ needs and the candidate will be expected to understand the sense of urgency that is synonymous with the business.

As a Consultant, ClinRO Services within the PCS team at IQVIA, you will directlyadminister assessments to participants in a clinical trial, or evaluate the quality of assessments performed by others and provide feedback regarding interview technique and scoring.Responsibilities include:

  • Review of scalesadministered by raters in a clinical trial to ensure that assessments are being conducted in a standardized manner to ensure data reliability.
  • Evaluation the quality of assessments, conducting live interactions with raters to discuss assessment methodology, scoring technique, and to provide guidance, as necessary.
  • Evaluate case dataand appropriately prepare for discussions with raters (e.g., prepared to discuss relevant issues and scale items, and have necessary documents available).
  • Complete rater interactions and assigned tasks as scheduled.
  • Responsible for timely submission of all documentation associated with assigned tasks.
  • Participate in all orientation, training and calibration activities as required.
  • Functional assessments of rater performance (e.g., mock interview) and assistance in preparing and disseminating communications.
  • Contacting clinical trial participants remotely (e.g., via proprietary app, Engage) to administer assessments, and will appropriately document resultant information (e.g., notes, scores)

What do you need to apply?

  • Minimum of aMaster’s degree(MA/MS) in Psychology, Counseling, Psychiatric, Nursing or Social Work, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience working with schizophrenia and major depressive disorder populations.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience working administering psychiatric assessments including the PANSS, to these populations is also required.
  • Clinical Trials experience preferred (central nervous system (CNS) trials experience would be a plus).
  • Advanced level ofEnglish.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to interact with all levels of personnel and clientele in a professional manner.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, time management and problem solving skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications [solid excel/power point knowledge].

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights, and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at .

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

We create a culture of belonging by valuing the perspectives of all talented employees worldwide and providing them with the opportunity to power smarter healthcare for everyone, everywhere. The Senior Solutions Engineer provides pre-sales technical support for the development and implementation of complex products, applications, and solutions. This role leverages deep product expertise to support the sales organization, prospective customers, and existing customers through technical presentations, product demonstrations, and solution design. The Senior Solutions Engineer partners closely with sales staff to assess how company products can address the needs of both new and existing customers, and translates those needs into detailed technical specifications, prototypes, and implementation plans.

  • Serve as the primary technical resource for the sales team throughout the pre-sales cycle, delivering product demonstrations, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs to prospective and existing customers.

jobs.description:
About Easy Dynamics Corporation

Easy Dynamics designs, builds, and secures the systems that protect our people, places, and way of life. We are a trusted advisor delivering best-in-class technology solutions in Digital Identity, Cybersecurity, and Risk Management. Our teams combine engineering excellence with a disciplined, forward-leaning approach to solve our clients' hardest technical challenges. We bring our “East Coast address, West Coast attitude” to everything we do, combining mission focus with our innovative, collaborative, and flexible culture that puts people first. Our subject matter experts work at the cutting edge of cybersecurity and technology, delivering identity management, zero trust, cloud, and security automation solutions that directly impact critical government missions. We believe the best work happens when talented people have the freedom and support to do what they do best.

We don't run on rigid hierarchy or playbooks that are locked in once and expected to work for the rest of time. We're a company of self-starters who take ownership without being asked twice and treat ambiguity as room to run rather than a roadblock. Our practice is growing quickly, and our structure stays deliberately light so ideas can move fast and the people closest to the work have real say in how it gets done. Every role comes with an opportunity to help shape how we deliver impact for both our clients and our team.

Growth isn't a perk here, it's an expectation we hold for ourselves and for each other. We build in the time and support for our people to keep sharpening their professional skills, because the technology we work in doesn't sit still and neither should we. Across our practice, we're putting AI to work in deliberate, high-trust ways, from surfacing patterns in client requirements to accelerating process and quality analysis, so our teams can spend their time and judgment on the problems that actually need it. We invest in our people's growth because it's how we stay ahead of the mission and how our teams keep getting better at what they do.

About the role

We're looking for a Capture Manager to own the strategy, positioning, and competitive shaping of our pursuits from qualification through submission and award. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on figuring out how we win, and who is also comfortable picking up a pen to help draft proposal content when a pursuit needs an extra set of hands.

We're a small, lean business, and we don't run a traditional, Shipley-defined capture organization with rigid lane boundaries between capture and proposal roles. Instead, your specific responsibilities will be assigned per pursuit based on team capacity and what that opportunity needs. On one pursuit you might be the strategy owner directing a separate Management Volume writer; on the next, you might be the Management Volume or Past Performance writer yourself while someone else owns the win strategy; on another, you might be brought in solely as a reviewer to pressure-test win themes and technical soundness. Each pursuit's kickoff will name your specific role, and expectations will be set explicitly rather than assumed.

This is a blended capture/proposal role by design. You'll need the strategic instincts of a capture lead, the working knowledge of a proposal writer, and the flexibility to move between those functions as staffing and opportunity size require. Many capture roles stop at strategy and hand off to a proposal team for execution, in a fixed lane that never changes pursuit to pursuit. This one doesn't. You'll move between owning the win strategy, writing the volumes that carry it, and reviewing someone else's work, depending on what each pursuit needs and who else is available. If you want a role that flexes with a lean, fast-moving team rather than a rigid title, this is built for you.

What you'll do

The activities below span the full range of what this role covers across a fiscal year. Which of these you're doing on any given pursuit depends on your assignment for that pursuit (see above), not a fixed job lane.

Lead Capture Efforts (Qualification through Award)

  • Take ownership of the pursuit at BD-to-Capture handoff and maintain the Capture Deck as the central strategy artifact,
  • Brief Senior leadership at deal reviews on opportunity status and bid/no bid decisions
  • Coordinate subcontractor and teaming partner engagement for the pursuit (scope splits, past performance contributions, staffing)
  • Develop price-to-win in coordination with the Pricing Lead and Executive Team
  • Lead customer intelligence gathering and pursuit question strategy
  • Coach technical teams through win theme development and validate that the capture/win strategy is fully set before Proposal Development begins
  • Lead pre-RFP strategy validation (“Blue Team”) sessions and build initial storyboard templates

Ensure Strategy Integrity Through Proposal Development

  • Validate that win themes, discriminators, and competitive positioning are actually landing in the written volumes, not just present in the capture plan
  • Participate in color team reviews (Pink/Red/Gold) with specific responsibility for evaluating strategic and competitive strength of the draft
  • Flag any evaluation-response or clarification content that would change technical, pricing, or strategic commitments
  • Draft Management Volume content, including staffing narratives, management approach, and BOE labor inputs, in coordination with the Solution Architect / Technical Team's staffing model
  • Draft or contribute to Past Performance narratives, tailoring selected references to the specific opportunity's win themes
  • Support Proposal Manager-led kickoff, volume assignments, and compliance reviews as a working contributor, not just a strategy reviewer

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in capture management, business development, or proposal management within the federal contracting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build and defend a win strategy, not just manage a schedule
  • Working proficiency in proposal writing, specifically Management Volume and Past Performance content;
  • Comfort operating across the full pursuit lifecycle, from qualification through post-award transition
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, working closely with Business Development, Proposal Management, Solution Architects, Contracts, Pricing, and Delivery
  • Ability to synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into a coherent, compelling narrative under deadline pressure
  • Project management experience
  • Comfortable using or learning CRM / pursuit-tracking tools (e.g., NextStage, GovWin, SAM.gov research)
  • Experience wearing both capture and proposal-writing hats on smaller pursuits or in a lean BD organization
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted document writing and proposal prompting
  • Prior experience with Basis of Estimate (BOE) inputs or cost-volume coordination
  • Someone who comes to the table with a point of view, not just looking to facilitate a process
  • An individual looking for a role that will require hard work to deliver high impact and high reward

Salary range: $160,000 - $190,000/year

If you are individual who is looking to roll up their sleeves and work with a team of technologists, managers and consultants who are smart, committed and focused on growth that aligns with mission and capabilities, this may be a great role for you. Easy Dynamics is a growing, tech-forward team of professionals who are committed to continuous improvement and evolving our capabilities and solutions to meet the market, the technological challenges and the missions we support.

Easy Dynamics is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
Social Media & Growth Coordinator

Employment Type: Full-time
Work Setup: Remote / Offshore
Location: Philippines
Schedule: Australian business hours, with overlap during AEST

About the Client

Our client is an Australia-based private equity and asset management firm focused on the lower-mid-market across Australia, New Zealand, and Southeast Asia.

The business partners with founders and management teams, providing capital and strategic support to established businesses with opportunities for operational improvement, category expansion, and geographic growth. Its sector focus includes healthcare, wellness and beauty, consumer, and specialty retail.

The firm takes a disciplined, operator-led approach to investing, working closely with management teams and focusing on sustainable value creation, operational performance, and long-term growth.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Social Media & Growth Coordinator to manage social media, content, and local growth marketing across multiple brands and business verticals.

This is a full-time, dedicated role suited to a creative and commercially minded marketing professional who can take ownership of content from planning and creation through to publishing, community engagement, lead generation, and performance reporting.

You will work across multiple brands, audiences, and stakeholders, adapting content and communication styles while maintaining strong brand consistency. Beyond content execution, you will be expected to identify marketing gaps, build repeatable processes, and proactively recommend opportunities that can improve engagement, enquiries, bookings, and overall business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Content

  • Manage and maintain a consistent social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
  • Develop and maintain monthly content calendars for each assigned brand.
  • Create and publish social media content, including feed posts, Stories, Reels, TikTok videos, and other short-form content.
  • Develop content that reflects each brand's unique tone, audience, positioning, and content pillars.
  • Repurpose existing marketing collateral and assets into engaging social and digital content.
  • Coordinate with business teams and relevant stakeholders to source photos, videos, promotions, events, and other content.
  • Maintain and regularly update Google Business Profiles, including photos, opening hours, posts, and Q&A.
  • Ensure content is timely, relevant, engaging, and aligned with business objectives.

Content Management & Organisation

  • Maintain a central content library using SharePoint, OneDrive, or an equivalent platform.
  • Organise content into clear categories such as raw photos/videos, team content, client content, products, events, UGC, promotions, content to be edited, ready-to-post content, and published content.
  • Review and organise content provided by business teams.
  • Select suitable content and transform it into polished marketing assets.
  • Regularly audit existing content to identify opportunities for reuse and repurposing.
  • Maintain an efficient workflow from content collection through to publication.

Brand & Creative Management

  • Create content using approved Canva brand kits, templates, colours, fonts, and logos.
  • Maintain consistent visual identity and messaging across all channels.
  • Adapt content appropriately for different brands, audiences, and platforms.
  • Ensure all content follows applicable brand, advertising, and compliance requirements.
  • Review relevant campaign and promotional materials and incorporate approved assets into local content strategies.
  • Ensure no unapproved artwork, filters, edits, or alterations are applied to branded or campaign assets.

UGC & Creator Partnerships

  • Identify and build relationships with relevant local content creators and influencers.
  • Research creators based on audience, engagement, location, platform, and brand relevance.
  • Maintain an organised creator database covering contact details, platforms, followers, engagement, location, offers, content received, and results.
  • Coordinate UGC opportunities and creator collaborations.
  • Build relationships with complementary local businesses for cross-promotions, giveaways, and collaborative content.
  • Organise and maintain creator- and partner-generated content for future use.

Local Events & Community Engagement

  • Identify relevant local events, markets, sporting activities, and community opportunities.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders on agreed promotional events and activities.
  • Develop content before, during, and after local events.
  • Repurpose event content across multiple social media channels.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen local brand awareness and community engagement.

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate with relevant local partners and community organisations to maximise marketing opportunities.
  • Where applicable, liaise with shopping centres and other local partners regarding EDMs, newsletters, social media, digital screens, and promotional opportunities.
  • Coordinate monthly promotions and campaigns for relevant local marketing opportunities.
  • Support the preparation of marketing artwork and promotional materials as required.

Reviews & Reputation Management

  • Develop and maintain a consistent process for encouraging positive customer feedback and public reviews.
  • Monitor relevant review platforms and identify opportunities to strengthen online reputation.
  • Repurpose strong customer reviews and testimonials into engaging social media content.
  • Create review-based content such as graphics, Reels, testimonial posts, and other social assets.
  • Support customer engagement and retention initiatives.

Paid Advertising

  • Set up and manage paid Facebook and Instagram campaigns.
  • Develop and test audiences, creatives, and campaign variations.
  • Manage advertising budgets and monitor campaign performance.
  • Optimise campaigns based on performance and business objectives.
  • Focus on measurable outcomes such as enquiries, leads, and bookings, rather than reach and impressions alone.
  • Use performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.

Lead & Enquiry Management

  • Monitor dedicated enquiry inboxes and social media DMs.
  • Respond to and follow up on customer enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Support the conversion of enquiries into bookings or other desired actions.
  • Track enquiry volume and conversion performance by brand and channel.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from social engagement through to conversion.

Monthly Content Planning

  • Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar for each assigned brand.
  • Plan content around upcoming campaigns, promotions, events, collaborations, product or service focuses, and other key marketing priorities.
  • Coordinate content requirements with relevant stakeholders in advance.
  • Ensure content is prepared and scheduled consistently across channels.

Reporting & KPIs

  • Prepare a simple monthly marketing and social media report for each assigned brand.
  • Track key performance indicators, including:
    • Follower growth
    • Reach
    • Engagement
    • Saves and shares
    • UGC activity
    • Creator and partnership activity
    • Review growth
    • Enquiries
    • Bookings
    • Conversion rates
    • Revenue, where measurable
  • Analyse performance to identify which activities are contributing to business results.
  • Make recommendations and adjust content and marketing activity based on performance insights.

Proactive Growth & Systems Building

  • Proactively identify gaps in current marketing, engagement, content, and reporting processes.
  • Research, test, and implement practical solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Identify tools and systems that could improve marketing efficiency and customer engagement.
  • Develop repeatable processes and workflows where none currently exist.
  • Bring forward ideas for new creator partnerships, local events, content opportunities, campaigns, and engagement initiatives.
  • Take ownership of building practical marketing solutions using available systems and tools.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–3+ years of experience in social media management, content coordination, digital marketing, or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing business accounts across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
  • Strong experience creating social media content, including Reels and short-form video.
  • Experience planning and managing paid Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
  • Understanding of audience testing, creative testing, campaign optimisation, and budget management.
  • Strong Canva skills with the ability to create polished, on-brand marketing materials.
  • Basic video editing skills for Reels, TikTok, and other short-form content.
  • Experience managing a shared content library and digital content workflow.
  • Experience with SharePoint or OneDrive is preferred.
  • Experience sourcing and managing influencers, UGC creators, or content partnerships is highly desirable.
  • Ability to manage multiple brands, audiences, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency.
  • Excellent written English and professional communication skills.
  • Experience working with a regulated or compliance-focused industry such as health, aesthetics, beauty, wellness, financial services, or professional services is highly regarded.
  • Previous experience supporting an Australian business or working in an offshore/BPO environment is an advantage.
  • Strong initiative, problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently research and implement solutions.

Systems & Tools

Experience with the following platforms and tools is preferred:

  • Canva
  • Microsoft 365
  • SharePoint / OneDrive
  • Google Business Profile
  • Meta Business Suite
  • Facebook / Instagram Ads Manager
  • TikTok Ads Manager
  • LinkedIn
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Social media scheduling and reporting platforms

Working Arrangements

  • Full-time, dedicated offshore position.
  • Remote work from the Philippines.
  • Working hours aligned with Australian business hours, with sufficient overlap during AEST for regular communication with stakeholders.
  • Australian public holidays are not required to be worked.
  • Regular check-ins with the client and relevant stakeholders.
  • This is a dedicated resource role, with the successful candidate focused exclusively on the assigned brands and business activities during working hours.

Why Join This Role?

  • Work with a growing Australian business across multiple brands and industries.
  • Take ownership of social media and growth marketing initiatives from strategy through execution.
  • Work closely with senior stakeholders and contribute directly to business growth.
  • Have the opportunity to build marketing systems and processes from the ground up.
  • Gain exposure to multiple brands, audiences, and growth initiatives.

Confidentiality & Compliance

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of company, brand, customer, and marketing information.
  • Follow all applicable advertising, content, and brand compliance requirements.
  • Handle customer enquiry and social media data responsibly.
  • Use authorised systems and platforms when handling company and customer information.
  • Maintain appropriate access controls for brand assets and customer data.
  • Ensure brand and customer information is not disclosed, copied, or retained outside authorised systems.

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative Sr. Customer Analytics Director to serve as the lead individual contributor driving analytics, performance metrics, and data-driven insights across our Customer organization. Working closely with the Chief Customer Officer (CCO) and key cross-functional partners, this role connects financial and operational data to improve customer retention, optimize revenue performance, and drive organizational accountability.

The ideal candidate possesses deep SaaS financial acumen, advanced data architecture and reporting skills, and the proven ability to translate complex recurring revenue datasets into actionable strategic recommendations for executive leadership.

What You'll Do

  • Customer Revenue Metrics & Standards: In partnership with Finance (owners of official ARR and financial reporting), ensure all key customer performance metrics—including ARR movement, Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), up-for-renewal rates, cohort views, and churn drivers—comply with Thoma Bravo standards and industry best practices. Translate overall company metrics into actionable operational views for Customer Success, evaluate renewal forecast accuracy, and build reporting on cross-sell and upsell pipelines owned by Sales and Renewals.
  • Executive & Board Reporting: Lead the end-to-end data preparation and analytical narrative for CCO presentations, board packs, Thoma Bravo operating reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs). Frame business performance, revenue risks, and investment asks around quantifiable business outcomes, ensuring executive reporting directly aligns with underlying operational reality.
  • Renewal & Retention Variance Analysis: Own the ongoing reporting, modeling, and variance analysis for renewal rates, comparing official forecasts against planned targets and actual results while providing detailed root-cause breakdowns of underlying drivers.
  • Planning & Capacity Modeling: Partner with Finance to construct the annual customer renewal and retention model, setting historical baselines, target assumptions, and segment-level forecasts. Build data-driven headcount, coverage-ratio, and capacity models linked directly to book-of-business segmentation.
  • Customer Health & Early Warning Systems: Design, refine, and maintain the organization’s customer health scoring model, risk telemetry, and predictive churn analyses to proactively flag accounts at risk.
  • Analytics Requirements & Data Governance: Define customer organization reporting requirements across Salesforce, the enterprise data warehouse, and BI platforms. Partner with Systems & Operations and Data & Analytics teams to ensure data models align strictly with Finance’s standardized definitions, while independently executing custom quantitative analyses for the CCO.
  • Cross-Functional Strategy Alignment: Collaborate with Revenue Operations and CRO leadership to align on unified data models for improving Net Retention Rate (NRR). Work alongside Product Strategy to deliver granular churn and revenue forecasting sliced by product line and usage behaviors.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in customer analytics, revenue analytics, FP&A, strategic finance, or Customer Success/Revenue Operations within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS recurring revenue models and financial mechanics, including ARR, GRR, NRR, cohort analysis, contraction, and churn dynamics.
  • Advanced proficiency in querying, modeling, and visualizing complex enterprise datasets using SQL, Excel, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) alongside CRM platforms like Salesforce.
  • Proven experience translating business requirements into technical data specs and building executive-ready dashboards.
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear, persuasive executive visual narratives and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong cross-functional influencer and communicator capable of driving alignment across Finance, Sales, RevOps, and Product leadership.
  • Prior experience operating within a Private Equity-backed enterprise (Thoma Bravo or similar portfolio environment) and supporting board-level reporting is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record as a high-output individual contributor capable of managing complex data projects independently from concept to execution.

Salary Range: $160,895 - $214,527

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Our Benefits:

Send your resume and a short note on one project you're proud of: what you built, the stack, and the measurable result. Be ready to go deep on anything on your resume. Our technical interview asks you to explain your own work in detail.

You’re a fit for this role if you have deep customer empathy (product engineering) and enjoy spending time sifting through customer pain points, identifying trends, and implementing opportunities for customers to automate complex clinical and operational processes across the platform.

What You'll Do

  • Build and expand Healthie’s customer-facing workflow automation capabilities, enabling healthcare organizations to automate operational and clinical workflows directly within the Healthie platform.

  • Engineer reliable, scalable automation infrastructure, including retries, idempotency, error handling, failure visibility, and clear customer-facing feedback when automated workflows don't execute as expected.
  • Ship an intuitive, scalable, and error-free Automation builder that enables Healthie customers to create, configure, and manage workflows without requiring technical expertise.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI, LLM APIs, and intelligent workflow orchestration to deliver smarter, more adaptive automation capabilities that improve customer efficiency and operational outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Security, and Operations to ensure automation capabilities are secure, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across the Healthie platform.
  • Own the end-to-end technical delivery of customer-facing automation features, from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, and optimization, while establishing reusable frameworks, engineering standards, and best practices.

About you

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade automation solutions.
  • Experience building and running event-driven or workflow systems in production, including on-call responsibility for them.
  • Comfort working in Rails or a similar backend framework.
  • Experience handling the unglamorous parts of integration work: webhooks, queues, duplicate events, rate limits, and partial failures.
  • Ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers, in writing or in person.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, and modern CI/CD tooling.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration, job scheduling, event-driven architectures, and automation frameworks.
  • Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and background processing systems such as Redis or Sidekiq.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-powered development tools, LLM APIs, or building agentic workflow automation tools.

Job Title: Front-End Developer

About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
